3. 功能实现要点
F-01 画布初始化 + 双缓冲
C++
 |
// 在DrawView的OnDraw中实现双缓冲
void CDrawView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC) {
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    
    // 创建内存DC和位图(双缓冲)
    CDC memDC;
    memDC.CreateCompatibleDC(pDC);
    CBitmap bitmap;
    bitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(pDC, rect.Width(), rect.Height());
    CBitmap* pOldBitmap = memDC.SelectObject(&bitmap);
    
    // 在内存DC上绘制所有图形
    memDC.FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    for(auto& shape : m_shapes) {
        shape->Draw(&memDC);
    }
    
    // 一次性拷贝到屏幕
    pDC->BitBlt(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height(), &memDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
    memDC.SelectObject(pOldBitmap);
}
F-04 撤销/重做
C++
 |
class AddShapeCommand : public DrawCommand {
private:
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<IShape>>& m_shapes;
    std::unique_ptr<IShape> m_shape;
public:
    void Execute() override {
        m_shapes.push_back(std::move(m_shape));
    }
    void Undo() override {
        m_shape = std::move(m_shapes.back());
        m_shapes.pop_back();
    }
};

 |
class CGdiObjectWrapper {
private:
    HGDIOBJ m_hObject;
public:
    CGdiObjectWrapper(HGDIOBJ obj) : m_hObject(obj) {}
    ~CGdiObjectWrapper() { 
        if(m_hObject) DeleteObject(m_hObject); 
    }
    operator HGDIOBJ() { return m_hObject; }
};
4. 关键消息处理
C++
 |
// 鼠标消息处理
void CDrawView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point) {
    m_bDrawing = true;
    m_ptStart = point;
    m_pCurrentShape = ShapeFactory::CreateShape(m_currentTool);
    m_pCurrentShape->SetStartPoint(point);
    SetCapture();
}

void CDrawView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point) {
    if(m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape) {
        m_pCurrentShape->SetEndPoint(point);
        Invalidate(); // 触发重绘
    }
}

void CDrawView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point) {
    if(m_bDrawing) {
        m_pCurrentShape->SetEndPoint(point);
        auto cmd = std::make_unique<AddShapeCommand>(m_shapes, std::move(m_pCurrentShape));
        m_commandManager.ExecuteCommand(std::move(cmd));
        m_bDrawing = false;
        ReleaseCapture();
        Invalidate();
    }
}

步骤2：实现双缓冲渲染策略
文件：Core/DoubleBufferStrategy.h

C++
 |
#pragma once
#include "IRenderStrategy.h"

class DoubleBufferStrategy : public IRenderStrategy {
private:
    CDC* m_pMainDC;
    CDC m_memDC;
    CBitmap m_bitmap;
    CBitmap* m_pOldBitmap;
    CRect m_rect;

public:
    DoubleBufferStrategy();
    ~DoubleBufferStrategy();
    
    void Initialize(CDC* pDC, const CRect& rect) override;
    void BeginRender() override;
    void EndRender() override;
    CDC* GetRenderDC() override { return &m_memDC; }
};
文件：Core/DoubleBufferStrategy.cpp

C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "DoubleBufferStrategy.h"

DoubleBufferStrategy::DoubleBufferStrategy() 
    : m_pMainDC(nullptr), m_pOldBitmap(nullptr) {
}

DoubleBufferStrategy::~DoubleBufferStrategy() {
    if (m_pOldBitmap) {
        m_memDC.SelectObject(m_pOldBitmap);
    }
}

void DoubleBufferStrategy::Initialize(CDC* pDC, const CRect& rect) {
    m_pMainDC = pDC;
    m_rect = rect;
    
    // 创建内存DC和兼容位图
    m_memDC.CreateCompatibleDC(pDC);
    m_bitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(pDC, rect.Width(), rect.Height());
    m_pOldBitmap = m_memDC.SelectObject(&m_bitmap);
}

void DoubleBufferStrategy::BeginRender() {
    // 清空背景为白色
    m_memDC.FillSolidRect(&m_rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
}

void DoubleBufferStrategy::EndRender() {
    // 将内存DC内容拷贝到屏幕DC
    m_pMainDC->BitBlt(0, 0, m_rect.Width(), m_rect.Height(), 
                      &m_memDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
}

C++
 |
#pragma once

enum class ShapeType {
    LINE,
    RECTANGLE, 
    ELLIPSE,
    FREECURVE
};

class IShape {
public:
    virtual ~IShape() = default;
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) = 0;
    virtual void SetStartPoint(const CPoint& pt) = 0;
    virtual void SetEndPoint(const CPoint& pt) = 0;
    virtual void SetColor(COLORREF color) = 0;
    virtual void SetLineWidth(int width) = 0;
    virtual IShape* Clone() const = 0;
    virtual ShapeType GetType() const = 0;
    virtual void Serialize(CArchive& ar) = 0;
    
protected:
    CPoint m_startPoint;
    CPoint m_endPoint;
    COLORREF m_color;
    int m_lineWidth;
};

class Line : public IShape {

    void SetEndPoint(const CPoint& pt) override { m_endPoint = pt; }

    void SetLineWidth(int width) override { m_lineWidth = width; }

};
文件：Shapes/Line.cpp

C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "Line.h"

Line::Line() : m_color(RGB(0,0,0)), m_lineWidth(1) {
}

Line::Line(const CPoint& start, const CPoint& end, COLORREF color, int width)
    : m_color(color), m_lineWidth(width) {
    m_startPoint = start;
    m_endPoint = end;
}

void Line::Draw(CDC* pDC) {
    // 创建画笔
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_lineWidth, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    // 绘制直线
    pDC->MoveTo(m_startPoint);
    pDC->LineTo(m_endPoint);
    
    // 恢复画笔
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void Line::Serialize(CArchive& ar) {
    if (ar.IsStoring()) {
        ar << (DWORD)ShapeType::LINE;
        ar << m_startPoint.x << m_startPoint.y;
        ar << m_endPoint.x << m_endPoint.y;
        ar << m_color << m_lineWidth;
    } else {
        ar >> m_startPoint.x >> m_startPoint.y;
        ar >> m_endPoint.x >> m_endPoint.y;
        ar >> m_color >> m_lineWidth;
    }
}

文件：Shapes/Rectangle.cpp

C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "Rectangle.h"

Rectangle::Rectangle() : m_color(RGB(0,0,0)), m_lineWidth(1) {
}

Rectangle::Rectangle(const CPoint& start, const CPoint& end, COLORREF color, int width)
    : m_color(color), m_lineWidth(width) {
    m_startPoint = start;
    m_endPoint = end;
}

void Rectangle::Draw(CDC* pDC) {
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_lineWidth, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    // 设置透明画刷（只绘制边框）
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    // 绘制矩形
    CRect rect(m_startPoint, m_endPoint);
    rect.NormalizeRect(); // 确保坐标正确
    pDC->Rectangle(&rect);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
}

void Rectangle::Serialize(CArchive& ar) {
    if (ar.IsStoring()) {
        ar << (DWORD)ShapeType::RECTANGLE;
        ar << m_startPoint.x << m_startPoint.y;
        ar << m_endPoint.x << m_endPoint.y;
        ar << m_color << m_lineWidth;
    } else {
        ar >> m_startPoint.x >> m_startPoint.y;
        ar >> m_endPoint.x >> m_endPoint.y;
        ar >> m_color >> m_lineWidth;
    }
}

文件：Core/ShapeFactory.h

C++
 |
#pragma once
#include "IShape.h"
#include <memory>

class ShapeFactory {
public:
    static std::unique_ptr<IShape> CreateShape(ShapeType type);
    static std::unique_ptr<IShape> CreateShape(ShapeType type, 
        const CPoint& start, const CPoint& end, 
        COLORREF color = RGB(0,0,0), int width = 1);
};
文件：Core/ShapeFactory.cpp

C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "ShapeFactory.h"
#include "../Shapes/Line.h"
#include "../Shapes/Rectangle.h"
#include "../Shapes/Ellipse.h"
#include "../Shapes/FreeCurve.h"

std::unique_ptr<IShape> ShapeFactory::CreateShape(ShapeType type) {
    switch (type) {
    case ShapeType::LINE:
        return std::make_unique<Line>();
    case ShapeType::RECTANGLE:
        return std::make_unique<Rectangle>();
    case ShapeType::ELLIPSE:
        return std::make_unique<Ellipse>();
    case ShapeType::FREECURVE:
        return std::make_unique<FreeCurve>();
    default:
        return nullptr;
    }
}

std::unique_ptr<IShape> ShapeFactory::CreateShape(ShapeType type, 
    const CPoint& start, const CPoint& end, COLORREF color, int width) {
    
    auto shape = CreateShape(type);
    if (shape) {
        shape->SetStartPoint(start);
        shape->SetEndPoint(end);
        shape->SetColor(color);
        shape->SetLineWidth(width);
    }
    return shape;
}

class PropertyManager {
private:
    static PropertyManager* s_instance;
    std::vector<IPropertyObserver*> m_observers;
    
    COLORREF m_currentColor;
    int m_currentLineWidth;
    ShapeType m_currentShapeType;
    
    PropertyManager();
    
public:
    static PropertyManager* GetInstance();

    void UnregisterObserver(IPropertyObserver* observer);
    
    void SetColor(COLORREF color);
    void SetLineWidth(int width);
    void SetShapeType(ShapeType type);
    
    COLORREF GetColor() const { return m_currentColor; }
    int GetLineWidth() const { return m_currentLineWidth; }
    ShapeType GetShapeType() const { return m_currentShapeType; }

    void NotifyLineWidthChanged();
    void NotifyShapeTypeChanged();
};
文件：Core/PropertyManager.cpp

C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "PropertyManager.h"

PropertyManager* PropertyManager::s_instance = nullptr;

PropertyManager::PropertyManager() 
    : m_currentColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
    , m_currentLineWidth(1)
    , m_currentShapeType(ShapeType::LINE) {
}

PropertyManager* PropertyManager::GetInstance() {
    if (!s_instance) {
        s_instance = new PropertyManager();
    }
    return s_instance;
}

void PropertyManager::RegisterObserver(IPropertyObserver* observer) {
    m_observers.push_back(observer);
}

void PropertyManager::UnregisterObserver(IPropertyObserver* observer) {
    auto it = std::find(m_observers.begin(), m_observers.end(), observer);
    if (it != m_observers.end()) {
        m_observers.erase(it);
    }
}

void PropertyManager::SetColor(COLORREF color) {
    m_currentColor = color;
    NotifyColorChanged();
}

void PropertyManager::SetLineWidth(int width) {
    m_currentLineWidth = width;
    NotifyLineWidthChanged();
}

void PropertyManager::SetShapeType(ShapeType type) {
    m_currentShapeType = type;
    NotifyShapeTypeChanged();
}

void PropertyManager::NotifyColorChanged() {
    for (auto observer : m_observers) {
        observer->OnColorChanged(m_currentColor);
    }
}

void PropertyManager::NotifyLineWidthChanged() {
    for (auto observer : m_observers) {
        observer->OnLineWidthChanged(m_currentLineWidth);
    }
}

void PropertyManager::NotifyShapeTypeChanged() {
    for (auto observer : m_observers) {
        observer->OnShapeTypeChanged(m_currentShapeType);
    }
}

BOOL CPropertyPanel::OnInitDialog() {
    CDialogEx::OnInitDialog();
    
    // 注册为观察者
    PropertyManager::GetInstance()->RegisterObserver(this);
    
    // 初始化控件
    SetDlgItemInt(IDC_EDIT_WIDTH, 1);
    CheckRadioButton(IDC_RADIO_LINE, IDC_RADIO_CURVE, IDC_RADIO_LINE);
    
    // 设置Spin控件范围
    CSpinButtonCtrl* pSpin = (CSpinButtonCtrl*)GetDlgItem(IDC_SPIN_WIDTH);
    if (pSpin) {
        pSpin->SetRange(1, 20);
        pSpin->SetPos(1);
    }
    
    UpdateColorPreview();
    
    return TRUE;
}

void CPropertyPanel::OnBnClickedBtnColor() {
    CColorDialog dlg(m_currentColor);
    if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK) {
        m_currentColor = dlg.GetColor();
        PropertyManager::GetInstance()->SetColor(m_currentColor);
        UpdateColorPreview();
    }
}

void CPropertyPanel::OnBnClickedRadioLine() {
    PropertyManager::GetInstance()->SetShapeType(ShapeType::LINE);
}

void CPropertyPanel::OnBnClickedRadioRect() {
    PropertyManager::GetInstance()->SetShapeType(ShapeType::RECTANGLE);
}

void CPropertyPanel::OnBnClickedRadioEllipse() {
    PropertyManager::GetInstance()->SetShapeType(ShapeType::ELLIPSE);
}

void CPropertyPanel::OnBnClickedRadioCurve() {
    PropertyManager::GetInstance()->SetShapeType(ShapeType::FREECURVE);
}

void CPropertyPanel::OnEnChangeEditWidth() {
    int width = GetDlgItemInt(IDC_EDIT_WIDTH);
    if (width >= 1 && width <= 20) {
        PropertyManager::GetInstance()->SetLineWidth(width);
    }
}

void CPropertyPanel::UpdateColorPreview() {
    CRect rect;
    m_colorPreview.GetWindowRect(&rect);
    ScreenToClient(&rect);
    
    CDC* pDC = GetDC();
    CBrush brush(m_currentColor);
    pDC->FillRect(&rect, &brush);
    ReleaseDC(pDC);
}

void CPropertyPanel::OnColorChanged(COLORREF color) {
    m_currentColor = color;
    UpdateColorPreview();
}

void CPropertyPanel::OnLineWidthChanged(int width) {
    m_currentWidth = width;
    SetDlgItemInt(IDC_EDIT_WIDTH, width);
}

void CPropertyPanel::OnShapeTypeChanged(ShapeType type) {
    switch (type) {
    case ShapeType::LINE:
        CheckRadioButton(IDC_RADIO_LINE, IDC_RADIO_CURVE, IDC_RADIO_LINE);
        break;
    case ShapeType::RECTANGLE:
        CheckRadioButton(IDC_RADIO_LINE, IDC_RADIO_CURVE, IDC_RADIO_RECT);
        break;
    case ShapeType::ELLIPSE:
        CheckRadioButton(IDC_RADIO_LINE, IDC_RADIO_CURVE, IDC_RADIO_ELLIPSE);
        break;
    case ShapeType::FREECURVE:
        CheckRadioButton(IDC_RADIO_LINE, IDC_RADIO_CURVE, IDC_RADIO_CURVE);
        break;
    }
}

void CPropertyPanel::OnPaint() {
    CPaintDC dc(this);
    UpdateColorPreview();
}

    void Undo() override;

文件：Commands/AddShapeCommand.cpp

C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "AddShapeCommand.h"

AddShapeCommand::AddShapeCommand(
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<IShape>>* shapeList,
    std::unique_ptr<IShape> shape)
    : m_pShapeList(shapeList)
    , m_shape(std::move(shape))
    , m_isExecuted(false) {
}

void AddShapeCommand::Execute() {
    if (!m_isExecuted && m_shape) {
        m_pShapeList->push_back(std::move(m_shape));
        m_isExecuted = true;
    }
}

void AddShapeCommand::Undo() {
    if (m_isExecuted && !m_pShapeList->empty()) {
        m_shape = std::move(m_pShapeList->back());
        m_pShapeList->pop_back();
        m_isExecuted = false;
    }
}

    std::unique_ptr<IShape> m_removedShape;
    size_t m_index;

                       size_t index);
    
    void Execute() override;
    void Undo() override;
};
文件：Commands/RemoveShapeCommand.cpp

C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "RemoveShapeCommand.h"

RemoveShapeCommand::RemoveShapeCommand(
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<IShape>>* shapeList,
    size_t index)
    : m_pShapeList(shapeList)
    , m_index(index) {
}

void RemoveShapeCommand::Execute() {
    if (m_index < m_pShapeList->size()) {
        m_removedShape = std::move((*m_pShapeList)[m_index]);
        m_pShapeList->erase(m_pShapeList->begin() + m_index);
    }
}

void RemoveShapeCommand::Undo() {
    if (m_removedShape) {
        m_pShapeList->insert(m_pShapeList->begin() + m_index, 
                            std::move(m_removedShape));
    }
}
步骤4：实现命令管理器
文件：Commands/CommandManager.h

C++
 |
#pragma once
#include "ICommand.h"
#include <memory>
#include <stack>

class CommandManager {
private:
    static CommandManager* s_instance;
    std::stack<std::unique_ptr<ICommand>> m_undoStack;
    std::stack<std::unique_ptr<ICommand>> m_redoStack;
    const size_t MAX_UNDO_LEVELS = 50;
    
    CommandManager() = default;

public:
    static CommandManager* GetInstance();
    
    void ExecuteCommand(std::unique_ptr<ICommand> command);
    void Undo();
    void Redo();
    void Clear();
    
    bool CanUndo() const { return !m_undoStack.empty(); }
    bool CanRedo() const { return !m_redoStack.empty(); }
    
    size_t GetUndoCount() const { return m_undoStack.size(); }
    size_t GetRedoCount() const { return m_redoStack.size(); }
};
文件：Commands/CommandManager.cpp

C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "CommandManager.h"

CommandManager* CommandManager::s_instance = nullptr;

CommandManager* CommandManager::GetInstance() {
    if (!s_instance) {
        s_instance = new CommandManager();
    }
    return s_instance;
}

void CommandManager::ExecuteCommand(std::unique_ptr<ICommand> command) {
    if (!command) return;
    
    command->Execute();
    
    // 清空重做栈
    while (!m_redoStack.empty()) {
        m_redoStack.pop();
    }
    
    // 添加到撤销栈
    m_undoStack.push(std::move(command));
    
    // 限制撤销栈大小
    if (m_undoStack.size() > MAX_UNDO_LEVELS) {
        // 移除最底层的命令（需要临时栈辅助）
        std::stack<std::unique_ptr<ICommand>> tempStack;
        while (m_undoStack.size() > 1) {
            tempStack.push(std::move(m_undoStack.top()));
            m_undoStack.pop();
        }
        m_undoStack.pop(); // 删除最底层
        while (!tempStack.empty()) {
            m_undoStack.push(std::move(tempStack.top()));
            tempStack.pop();
        }
    }
}

void CommandManager::Undo() {
    if (CanUndo()) {
        auto command = std::move(m_undoStack.top());
        m_undoStack.pop();
        
        command->Undo();
        m_redoStack.push(std::move(command));
    }
}

void CommandManager::Redo() {
    if (CanRedo()) {
        auto command = std::move(m_redoStack.top());
        m_redoStack.pop();
        
        command->Execute();
        m_undoStack.push(std::move(command));
    }
}

void CommandManager::Clear() {
    while (!m_undoStack.empty()) m_undoStack.pop();
    while (!m_redoStack.empty()) m_redoStack.pop();
}

class Layer : public ILayer {

文件：Core/Layer.cpp

C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "Layer.h"

Layer::Layer(const std::wstring& name)
    : m_name(name)
    , m_visible(true)
    , m_locked(false) {
}

void Layer::Draw(CDC* pDC) {
    if (!m_visible) return;
    
    for (auto& shape : m_shapes) {
        if (shape) {
            shape->Draw(pDC);
        }
    }
}

void Layer::AddShape(std::unique_ptr<IShape> shape) {
    if (shape) {
        m_shapes.push_back(std::move(shape));
    }
}

void Layer::RemoveShape(size_t index) {
    if (index < m_shapes.size()) {
        m_shapes.erase(m_shapes.begin() + index);
    }
}

IShape* Layer::GetShape(size_t index) {
    if (index < m_shapes.size()) {
        return m_shapes[index].get();
    }
    return nullptr;
}

void Layer::Clear() {
    m_shapes.clear();
}

void Layer::Serialize(CArchive& ar) {
    if (ar.IsStoring()) {
        CString name(m_name.c_str());
        ar << name;
        ar << m_visible << m_locked;
        ar << (DWORD)m_shapes.size();
        
        for (auto& shape : m_shapes) {
            shape->Serialize(ar);
        }
    } else {
        CString name;
        ar >> name;
        m_name = name.GetString();
        ar >> m_visible >> m_locked;
        
        DWORD count;
        ar >> count;
        
        m_shapes.clear();
        for (DWORD i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            DWORD type;
            ar >> type;
            
            auto shape = ShapeFactory::CreateShape((ShapeType)type);
            if (shape) {
                shape->Serialize(ar);
                m_shapes.push_back(std::move(shape));
            }
        }
    }
}

#pragma once

class LayerManager {

public:
    static LayerManager* GetInstance();

    void RemoveLayer(size_t index);
    ILayer* GetLayer(size_t index);
    ILayer* GetCurrentLayer();

    size_t GetLayerCount() const { return m_layers.size(); }
    size_t GetCurrentLayerIndex() const { return m_currentLayerIndex; }

文件：Core/LayerManager.cpp

C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "LayerManager.h"
#include "Layer.h"

LayerManager* LayerManager::s_instance = nullptr;

LayerManager::LayerManager() 
    : m_currentLayerIndex(0) {
    // 创建默认图层
    AddLayer(L"Layer 1");
}

LayerManager* LayerManager::GetInstance() {
    if (!s_instance) {
        s_instance = new LayerManager();
    }
    return s_instance;
}

ILayer* LayerManager::AddLayer(const std::wstring& name) {
    auto layer = std::make_unique<Layer>(name);
    ILayer* pLayer = layer.get();
    m_layers.push_back(std::move(layer));
    return pLayer;
}

void LayerManager::RemoveLayer(size_t index) {
    if (index < m_layers.size() && m_layers.size() > 1) {
        m_layers.erase(m_layers.begin() + index);
        if (m_currentLayerIndex >= m_layers.size()) {
            m_currentLayerIndex = m_layers.size() - 1;
        }
    }
}

ILayer* LayerManager::GetLayer(size_t index) {
    if (index < m_layers.size()) {
        return m_layers[index].get();
    }
    return nullptr;
}

ILayer* LayerManager::GetCurrentLayer() {
    return GetLayer(m_currentLayerIndex);
}

void LayerManager::SetCurrentLayer(size_t index) {
    if (index < m_layers.size()) {
        m_currentLayerIndex = index;
    }
}

void LayerManager::DrawAllLayers(CDC* pDC) {
    for (auto& layer : m_layers) {
        layer->Draw(pDC);
    }
}

void LayerManager::Clear() {
    m_layers.clear();
    m_currentLayerIndex = 0;
    AddLayer(L"Layer 1");
}

void LayerManager::Serialize(CArchive& ar) {
    if (ar.IsStoring()) {
        ar << (DWORD)m_layers.size();
        ar << (DWORD)m_currentLayerIndex;
        
        for (auto& layer : m_layers) {
            layer->Serialize(ar);
        }
    } else {
        DWORD count;
        ar >> count;
        ar >> (DWORD&)m_currentLayerIndex;
        
        m_layers.clear();
        for (DWORD i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            auto layer = std::make_unique<Layer>();
            layer->Serialize(ar);
            m_layers.push_back(std::move(layer));
        }
    }
}

BOOL CLayerPanel::OnInitDialog() {
    CDialogEx::OnInitDialog();
    
    // 设置列表控件样式
    m_layerList.SetExtendedStyle(
        m_layerList.GetExtendedStyle() | 
        LVS_EX_FULLROWSELECT | LVS_EX_GRIDLINES);
    
    // 添加列
    m_layerList.InsertColumn(0, L"名称", LVCFMT_LEFT, 120);
    m_layerList.InsertColumn(1, L"可见", LVCFMT_CENTER, 50);
    m_layerList.InsertColumn(2, L"锁定", LVCFMT_CENTER, 50);
    
    RefreshLayerList();
    
    return TRUE;
}

void CLayerPanel::OnBnClickedBtnAddLayer() {
    LayerManager* pMgr = LayerManager::GetInstance();
    CString name;
    name.Format(L"Layer %d", pMgr->GetLayerCount() + 1);
    pMgr->AddLayer(name.GetString());
    RefreshLayerList();
}

void CLayerPanel::OnBnClickedBtnRemoveLayer() {
    if (m_selectedIndex >= 0) {
        LayerManager::GetInstance()->RemoveLayer(m_selectedIndex);
        RefreshLayerList();
    }
}

void CLayerPanel::OnBnClickedBtnMoveUp() {
    // 实现图层上移逻辑
    // 需要在LayerManager中添加MoveLayer方法
}

void CLayerPanel::OnBnClickedBtnMoveDown() {
    // 实现图层下移逻辑
}

void CLayerPanel::OnBnClickedCheckVisible() {
    if (m_selectedIndex >= 0) {
        auto layer = LayerManager::GetInstance()->GetLayer(m_selectedIndex);
        if (layer) {
            BOOL visible = ((CButton*)GetDlgItem(IDC_CHECK_VISIBLE))->GetCheck();
            layer->SetVisible(visible == TRUE);
            RefreshLayerList();
        }
    }
}

void CLayerPanel::OnBnClickedCheckLocked() {
    if (m_selectedIndex >= 0) {
        auto layer = LayerManager::GetInstance()->GetLayer(m_selectedIndex);
        if (layer) {
            BOOL locked = ((CButton*)GetDlgItem(IDC_CHECK_LOCKED))->GetCheck();
            layer->SetLocked(locked == TRUE);
            RefreshLayerList();
        }
    }
}

void CLayerPanel::OnLvnItemchangedListLayers(NMHDR *pNMHDR, LRESULT *pResult) {
    LPNMLISTVIEW pNMLV = reinterpret_cast<LPNMLISTVIEW>(pNMHDR);
    
    if (pNMLV->uNewState & LVIS_SELECTED) {
        m_selectedIndex = pNMLV->iItem;
        LayerManager::GetInstance()->SetCurrentLayer(m_selectedIndex);
        UpdateLayerInfo();
    }
    
    *pResult = 0;
}

void CLayerPanel::RefreshLayerList() {
    m_layerList.DeleteAllItems();
    
    LayerManager* pMgr = LayerManager::GetInstance();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < pMgr->GetLayerCount(); i++) {
        auto layer = pMgr->GetLayer(i);
        if (layer) {
            int index = m_layerList.InsertItem(i, layer->GetName().c_str());
            m_layerList.SetItemText(index, 1, layer->IsVisible() ? L"√" : L"");
            m_layerList.SetItemText(index, 2, layer->IsLocked() ? L"√" : L"");
        }
    }
    
    // 选中当前图层
    size_t current = pMgr->GetCurrentLayerIndex();
    m_layerList.SetItemState(current, LVIS_SELECTED, LVIS_SELECTED);
}

void CLayerPanel::UpdateLayerInfo() {
    if (m_selectedIndex >= 0) {
        auto layer = LayerManager::GetInstance()->GetLayer(m_selectedIndex);
        if (layer) {
            ((CButton*)GetDlgItem(IDC_CHECK_VISIBLE))->SetCheck(layer->IsVisible());
            ((CButton*)GetDlgItem(IDC_CHECK_LOCKED))->SetCheck(layer->IsLocked());
        }
    }
}

class CDrawingBoardDoc : public CDocument {
protected:
    CDrawingBoardDoc() noexcept;
    DECLARE_DYNCREATE(CDrawingBoardDoc)

public:
    virtual ~CDrawingBoardDoc();
    virtual void Serialize(CArchive& ar);
    virtual BOOL OnNewDocument();
    virtual BOOL OnOpenDocument(LPCTSTR lpszPathName);
    virtual BOOL OnSaveDocument(LPCTSTR lpszPathName);
    
#ifdef _DEBUG
    virtual void AssertValid() const;
    virtual void Dump(CDumpContext& dc) const;
#endif

private:
    static const DWORD FILE_VERSION = 1;
    void SaveDocument(CArchive& ar);
    void LoadDocument(CArchive& ar);
};
修改DrawingBoardDoc.cpp

C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "Core/LayerManager.h"
#include "Core/PropertyManager.h"

IMPLEMENT_DYNCREATE(CDrawingBoardDoc, CDocument)

CDrawingBoardDoc::CDrawingBoardDoc() noexcept {
}

CDrawingBoardDoc::~CDrawingBoardDoc() {
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardDoc::OnNewDocument() {
    if (!CDocument::OnNewDocument())
        return FALSE;
    
    // 清空所有数据
    LayerManager::GetInstance()->Clear();
    CommandManager::GetInstance()->Clear();
    
    return TRUE;
}

void CDrawingBoardDoc::Serialize(CArchive& ar) {
    if (ar.IsStoring()) {
        SaveDocument(ar);
    } else {
        LoadDocument(ar);
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardDoc::SaveDocument(CArchive& ar) {
    try {
        // 保存文件版本
        ar << FILE_VERSION;
        
        // 保存当前属性设置
        PropertyManager* pPropMgr = PropertyManager::GetInstance();
        ar << pPropMgr->GetColor();
        ar << pPropMgr->GetLineWidth();
        ar << (DWORD)pPropMgr->GetShapeType();
        
        // 保存图层数据
        LayerManager::GetInstance()->Serialize(ar);
        
    } catch (CException* e) {
        e->ReportError();
        e->Delete();
        AfxMessageBox(L"保存文件失败！");
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardDoc::LoadDocument(CArchive& ar) {
    try {
        // 读取文件版本
        DWORD version;
        ar >> version;
        
        if (version != FILE_VERSION) {
            AfxMessageBox(L"文件版本不兼容！");
            return;
        }
        
        // 读取属性设置
        COLORREF color;
        int lineWidth;
        DWORD shapeType;
        
        ar >> color;
        ar >> lineWidth;
        ar >> shapeType;
        
        PropertyManager* pPropMgr = PropertyManager::GetInstance();
        pPropMgr->SetColor(color);
        pPropMgr->SetLineWidth(lineWidth);
        pPropMgr->SetShapeType((ShapeType)shapeType);
        
        // 读取图层数据
        LayerManager::GetInstance()->Serialize(ar);
        
        // 清空命令历史
        CommandManager::GetInstance()->Clear();
        
    } catch (CException* e) {
        e->ReportError();
        e->Delete();
        AfxMessageBox(L"加载文件失败！");
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardDoc::OnOpenDocument(LPCTSTR lpszPathName) {
    if (!CDocument::OnOpenDocument(lpszPathName))
        return FALSE;
    
    UpdateAllViews(NULL);
    return TRUE;
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardDoc::OnSaveDocument(LPCTSTR lpszPathName) {
    return CDocument::OnSaveDocument(lpszPathName);
}

// DrawingBoardApp.cpp
#include "pch.h"

    ON_COMMAND(ID_APP_ABOUT, &CDrawingBoardApp::OnAppAbout)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_FILE_NEW, &CWinApp::OnFileNew)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_FILE_OPEN, &CWinApp::OnFileOpen)
END_MESSAGE_MAP()

CDrawingBoardApp::CDrawingBoardApp() noexcept {
    SetAppID(_T("DrawingBoard.AppID.NoVersion"));
}

CDrawingBoardApp theApp;

BOOL CDrawingBoardApp::InitInstance() {
    // 必须调用基类初始化
    CWinApp::InitInstance();

    // 初始化 OLE 库
    if (!AfxOleInit()) {
        AfxMessageBox(IDP_OLE_INIT_FAILED);
        return FALSE;
    }

    AfxEnableControlContainer();

    // 启用 Windows 原生视觉主题
    EnableTaskbarInteraction(FALSE);

    // 标准初始化
    SetRegistryKey(_T("DrawingBoard"));

    LoadStdProfileSettings(4);

    // 注册文档模板
    CSingleDocTemplate* pDocTemplate;
    pDocTemplate = new CSingleDocTemplate(
        IDR_MAINFRAME,
        RUNTIME_CLASS(CDrawingBoardDoc),
        RUNTIME_CLASS(CMainFrame),
        RUNTIME_CLASS(CDrawingBoardView));
    
    if (!pDocTemplate)
        return FALSE;
    
    AddDocTemplate(pDocTemplate);

    // 解析命令行
    CCommandLineInfo cmdInfo;
    ParseCommandLine(cmdInfo);

    // 分派命令行中指定的命令
    if (!ProcessShellCommand(cmdInfo))
        return FALSE;

    m_pMainWnd->ShowWindow(SW_SHOW);
    m_pMainWnd->UpdateWindow();

    return TRUE;
}

// Core/IShape.h
#pragma once
#include <afxwin.h>

enum class ShapeType {
    LINE,
    RECTANGLE,
    ELLIPSE,
    FREECURVE
};

class IShape {
public:
    virtual ~IShape() = default;
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) = 0;
    virtual ShapeType GetType() const = 0;
};
C++
 |
// Core/LineShape.h
#pragma once
#include "IShape.h"

class LineShape : public IShape {
private:
    CPoint m_start;
    CPoint m_end;
    COLORREF m_color;
    int m_width;

public:
    LineShape() : m_color(RGB(0,0,0)), m_width(1) {}
    
    void SetPoints(CPoint start, CPoint end) {
        m_start = start;
        m_end = end;
    }
    
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) override {
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_width, m_color);
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
        pDC->MoveTo(m_start);
        pDC->LineTo(m_end);
        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }
    
    ShapeType GetType() const override {
        return ShapeType::LINE;
    }
};

6. 检查项目设置

C/C++ → 代码生成 → 运行库 → 确保设置为"多线程调试 DLL (/MDd)" (Debug) 或 "多线程 DLL (/MD)" (Release)
常规 → MFC的使用 → 确保设置为"在共享 DLL 中使用 MFC"

4. 创建 DoubleBufferStrategy.h
C++
 |
// DoubleBufferStrategy.h
#pragma once
#include "IRenderStrategy.h"

class DoubleBufferStrategy : public IRenderStrategy {
private:
    CDC m_memDC;
    CBitmap m_memBitmap;
    CBitmap* m_pOldBitmap;
    CRect m_rect;
    bool m_initialized;

public:
    DoubleBufferStrategy();
    virtual ~DoubleBufferStrategy();
    
    void Initialize(CDC* pDC, const CRect& rect);
    void Render(CDC* pDC) override;
    CDC* GetMemoryDC() { return &m_memDC; }
};
5. 创建 DoubleBufferStrategy.cpp（在"源文件"中添加）
C++
 |
// DoubleBufferStrategy.cpp
#include "pch.h"
#include "DoubleBufferStrategy.h"

DoubleBufferStrategy::DoubleBufferStrategy()
    : m_pOldBitmap(nullptr)
    , m_initialized(false) {
}

DoubleBufferStrategy::~DoubleBufferStrategy() {
    if (m_pOldBitmap) {
        m_memDC.SelectObject(m_pOldBitmap);
    }
}

void DoubleBufferStrategy::Initialize(CDC* pDC, const CRect& rect) {
    if (!m_initialized || m_rect != rect) {
        if (m_pOldBitmap) {
            m_memDC.SelectObject(m_pOldBitmap);
            m_memBitmap.DeleteObject();
        }

        m_rect = rect;
        m_memDC.CreateCompatibleDC(pDC);
        m_memBitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(pDC, m_rect.Width(), m_rect.Height());
        m_pOldBitmap = m_memDC.SelectObject(&m_memBitmap);
        m_initialized = true;
    }
}

void DoubleBufferStrategy::Render(CDC* pDC) {
    if (m_initialized) {
        pDC->BitBlt(0, 0, m_rect.Width(), m_rect.Height(), 
                    &m_memDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
    }
}

    ON_COMMAND(ID_FILE_PRINT_DIRECT, &CView::OnFilePrint)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_FILE_PRINT_PREVIEW, &CView::OnFilePrintPreview)
    ON_WM_LBUTTONDOWN()
    ON_WM_LBUTTONUP()
    ON_WM_MOUSEMOVE()
END_MESSAGE_MAP()

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
    : m_pRenderStrategy(std::make_unique<DoubleBufferStrategy>())
    , m_isDrawing(false) {
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView() {
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs) {
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC) {
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc)
        return;

    // 获取客户区大小
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);

    // 初始化双缓冲
    m_pRenderStrategy->Initialize(pDC, rect);
    CDC* pMemDC = m_pRenderStrategy->GetMemoryDC();

    // 清空背景
    pMemDC->FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));

    // 绘制测试文字
    pMemDC->SetBkMode(TRANSPARENT);
    pMemDC->TextOutW(10, 10, L"Drawing Board - 测试成功!");

    // 如果正在绘制，显示临时线条
    if (m_isDrawing) {
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, 2, RGB(255, 0, 0));
        CPen* pOldPen = pMemDC->SelectObject(&pen);
        pMemDC->MoveTo(m_startPoint);
        pMemDC->LineTo(m_endPoint);
        pMemDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }

    // 渲染到屏幕
    m_pRenderStrategy->Render(pDC);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point) {
    m_isDrawing = true;
    m_startPoint = point;
    m_endPoint = point;
    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point) {
    if (m_isDrawing) {
        m_isDrawing = false;
        ReleaseCapture();
        Invalidate();
    }
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point) {
    if (m_isDrawing) {
        m_endPoint = point;
        Invalidate();
    }
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::OnPreparePrinting(CPrintInfo* pInfo) {
    return DoPreparePrinting(pInfo);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnBeginPrinting(CDC* /*pDC*/, CPrintInfo* /*pInfo*/) {
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEndPrinting(CDC* /*pDC*/, CPrintInfo* /*pInfo*/) {
}

    ASSERT(m_pDocument->IsKindOf(RUNTIME_CLASS(CDrawingBoardDoc)));
    return (CDrawingBoardDoc*)m_pDocument;
}

2. 完全替换 MainFrm.cpp

 |
// MainFrm.cpp
#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#include "MainFrm.h"

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

IMPLEMENT_DYNCREATE(CMainFrame, CFrameWnd)

BEGIN_MESSAGE_MAP(CMainFrame, CFrameWnd)
    ON_WM_CREATE()
END_MESSAGE_MAP()

static UINT indicators[] =
{
    ID_SEPARATOR,
    ID_INDICATOR_CAPS,
    ID_INDICATOR_NUM,
    ID_INDICATOR_SCRL,
};

CMainFrame::CMainFrame() noexcept {
}

CMainFrame::~CMainFrame() {
}

int CMainFrame::OnCreate(LPCREATESTRUCT lpCreateStruct) {
    if (CFrameWnd::OnCreate(lpCreateStruct) == -1)
        return -1;

    if (!m_wndToolBar.CreateEx(this, TBSTYLE_FLAT, 
        WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | CBRS_TOP | CBRS_GRIPPER | 
        CBRS_TOOLTIPS | CBRS_FLYBY | CBRS_SIZE_DYNAMIC) ||
        !m_wndToolBar.LoadToolBar(IDR_MAINFRAME)) {
        TRACE0("未能创建工具栏\n");
        return -1;
    }

    if (!m_wndStatusBar.Create(this)) {
        TRACE0("未能创建状态栏\n");
        return -1;
    }
    m_wndStatusBar.SetIndicators(indicators, sizeof(indicators) / sizeof(UINT));

    m_wndToolBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    DockControlBar(&m_wndToolBar);

    return 0;
}

BOOL CMainFrame::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs) {
    if (!CFrameWnd::PreCreateWindow(cs))
        return FALSE;

    return TRUE;
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardApp::InitInstance() {
    CWinApp::InitInstance();

    if (!AfxOleInit()) {
        AfxMessageBox(_T("OLE 初始化失败"));
        return FALSE;
    }

    AfxEnableControlContainer();

    SetRegistryKey(_T("DrawingBoard"));
    LoadStdProfileSettings(4);

    CSingleDocTemplate* pDocTemplate;
    pDocTemplate = new CSingleDocTemplate(
        IDR_MAINFRAME,
        RUNTIME_CLASS(CDrawingBoardDoc),
        RUNTIME_CLASS(CMainFrame),
        RUNTIME_CLASS(CDrawingBoardView));
    
    if (!pDocTemplate)
        return FALSE;
    
    AddDocTemplate(pDocTemplate);

    CCommandLineInfo cmdInfo;
    ParseCommandLine(cmdInfo);

    if (!ProcessShellCommand(cmdInfo))
        return FALSE;

    m_pMainWnd->ShowWindow(SW_SHOW);
    m_pMainWnd->UpdateWindow();

    return TRUE;
}

int CDrawingBoardApp::ExitInstance() {
    AfxOleTerm(FALSE);
    return CWinApp::ExitInstance();
}

删除后的完整 OnDraw 函数应该是这样：

C++
 |
void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC) {
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc)
        return;

    // 获取客户区大小
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);

    // 初始化双缓冲
    m_pRenderStrategy->Initialize(pDC, rect);
    CDC* pMemDC = m_pRenderStrategy->GetMemoryDC();

    // 清空背景
    pMemDC->FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));

    // 如果正在绘制，显示临时线条
    if (m_isDrawing) {
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, 2, RGB(255, 0, 0));
        CPen* pOldPen = pMemDC->SelectObject(&pen);
        pMemDC->MoveTo(m_startPoint);
        pMemDC->LineTo(m_endPoint);
        pMemDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }

    // 渲染到屏幕
    m_pRenderStrategy->Render(pDC);
}
保存后重新编译运行（F5），文字就消失了！

第二步：创建工具管理器
1. 创建 ToolManager.h
在 Logic 文件夹中：

右键 Logic → 添加 → 新建项 → 头文件 (.h)

C++
 |
// ToolManager.h
#pragma once

// 工具类型枚举
enum class ToolType {
    PEN,           // 自由笔
    LINE,          // 直线
    RECTANGLE,     // 矩形
    CIRCLE,        // 圆形
    ERASER         // 橡皮擦
};

// 工具管理器（单例模式）
class ToolManager {
private:
    ToolType m_currentTool;  // 当前选中的工具
    
    // 单例
    ToolManager() : m_currentTool(ToolType::PEN) {}
    ToolManager(const ToolManager&) = delete;
    ToolManager& operator=(const ToolManager&) = delete;

public:
    // 获取单例实例
    static ToolManager& GetInstance() {
        static ToolManager instance;
        return instance;
    }

    // 设置当前工具
    void SetTool(ToolType tool) {
        m_currentTool = tool;
    }

    // 获取当前工具
    ToolType GetCurrentTool() const {
        return m_currentTool;
    }

    // 获取工具名称（用于调试）
    CString GetToolName() const {
        switch (m_currentTool) {
        case ToolType::PEN:       return _T("自由笔");
        case ToolType::LINE:      return _T("直线");
        case ToolType::RECTANGLE: return _T("矩形");
        case ToolType::CIRCLE:    return _T("圆形");
        case ToolType::ERASER:    return _T("橡皮擦");
        default:                  return _T("未知");
        }
    }
};

// MainFrm.cpp

IMPLEMENT_DYNCREATE(CMainFrame, CFrameWnd)

    ON_WM_CREATE()
    
    // ✅ 新增：工具切换消息映射
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_PEN, &CMainFrame::OnToolPen)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_LINE, &CMainFrame::OnToolLine)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE, &CMainFrame::OnToolRectangle)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_CIRCLE, &CMainFrame::OnToolCircle)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_ERASER, &CMainFrame::OnToolEraser)

    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_TOOL_PEN, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateToolPen)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_TOOL_LINE, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateToolLine)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateToolRectangle)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_TOOL_CIRCLE, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateToolCircle)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_TOOL_ERASER, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateToolEraser)
END_MESSAGE_MAP()

static UINT indicators[] =
{
    ID_SEPARATOR,
    ID_INDICATOR_CAPS,
    ID_INDICATOR_NUM,
    ID_INDICATOR_SCRL,
};

CMainFrame::CMainFrame() noexcept {
}

CMainFrame::~CMainFrame() {
}

int CMainFrame::OnCreate(LPCREATESTRUCT lpCreateStruct) {
    if (CFrameWnd::OnCreate(lpCreateStruct) == -1)
        return -1;

    if (!m_wndToolBar.CreateEx(this, TBSTYLE_FLAT, 
        WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | CBRS_TOP | CBRS_GRIPPER | 
        CBRS_TOOLTIPS | CBRS_FLYBY | CBRS_SIZE_DYNAMIC) ||
        !m_wndToolBar.LoadToolBar(IDR_MAINFRAME)) {
        TRACE0("未能创建工具栏\n");
        return -1;
    }

    if (!m_wndStatusBar.Create(this)) {
        TRACE0("未能创建状态栏\n");
        return -1;
    }
    m_wndStatusBar.SetIndicators(indicators, sizeof(indicators) / sizeof(UINT));

    m_wndToolBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    DockControlBar(&m_wndToolBar);

    return 0;
}

BOOL CMainFrame::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs) {
    if (!CFrameWnd::PreCreateWindow(cs))
        return FALSE;
    return TRUE;
}

// DrawingBoardView.cpp 的 OnDraw 函数

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC) {
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc)
        return;

    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);

    m_pRenderStrategy->Initialize(pDC, rect);
    CDC* pMemDC = m_pRenderStrategy->GetMemoryDC();

    pMemDC->FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));

    // ✅ 显示当前工具（测试用）
    pMemDC->SetBkMode(TRANSPARENT);
    CString toolName = _T("当前工具: ") + ToolManager::GetInstance().GetToolName();
    pMemDC->TextOutW(10, 10, toolName);

    if (m_isDrawing) {
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, 2, RGB(255, 0, 0));
        CPen* pOldPen = pMemDC->SelectObject(&pen);
        pMemDC->MoveTo(m_startPoint);
        pMemDC->LineTo(m_endPoint);
        pMemDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }

    m_pRenderStrategy->Render(pDC);
}

    ON_WM_CREATE()

int CMainFrame::OnCreate(LPCREATESTRUCT lpCreateStruct)
{
    if (CFrameWnd::OnCreate(lpCreateStruct) == -1)
        return -1;

    if (!m_wndToolBar.CreateEx(this, TBSTYLE_FLAT,
        WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | CBRS_TOP | CBRS_GRIPPER |
        CBRS_TOOLTIPS | CBRS_FLYBY | CBRS_SIZE_DYNAMIC) ||
        !m_wndToolBar.LoadToolBar(IDR_MAINFRAME))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建工具栏\n");
        return -1;
    }

    // 定义工具栏按钮数组
    static UINT buttons[] = {
        ID_FILE_NEW,
        ID_FILE_OPEN,
        ID_FILE_SAVE,
        ID_SEPARATOR,
        ID_TOOL_PEN,
        ID_TOOL_LINE,
        ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE,
        ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE,
        ID_TOOL_ERASER
    };

    // 计算按钮数量
    int nButtons = sizeof(buttons) / sizeof(UINT);
    
    // 设置按钮
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtons(buttons, nButtons);

    // 设置绘图工具按钮的文字
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(m_wndToolBar.CommandToIndex(ID_TOOL_PEN), _T("画笔"));
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(m_wndToolBar.CommandToIndex(ID_TOOL_LINE), _T("直线"));
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(m_wndToolBar.CommandToIndex(ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE), _T("矩形"));
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(m_wndToolBar.CommandToIndex(ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE), _T("椭圆"));
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(m_wndToolBar.CommandToIndex(ID_TOOL_ERASER), _T("橡皮"));

    // 调整工具栏大小以显示文字
    m_wndToolBar.SetSizes(CSize(50, 42), CSize(16, 15));

    if (!m_wndStatusBar.Create(this))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建状态栏\n");
        return -1;
    }
    m_wndStatusBar.SetIndicators(indicators, sizeof(indicators)/sizeof(UINT));

    // 工具栏可停靠
    m_wndToolBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    DockControlBar(&m_wndToolBar);

    return 0;
}

我看到问题了！CDrawingBoardView 类还没有定义这些方法和枚举。我们需要先完善 DrawingBoardView.h 和 DrawingBoardView.cpp。

DrawingBoardView.h 完整代码
C++
 |
#pragma once

class CDrawingBoardView : public CView
{
protected: // 仅从序列化创建
    CDrawingBoardView() noexcept;
    DECLARE_DYNCREATE(CDrawingBoardView)

// 特性
public:
    CDrawingBoardDoc* GetDocument() const;

    // 绘图工具枚举
    enum DrawingTool {
        TOOL_PEN = 0,
        TOOL_LINE,
        TOOL_RECTANGLE,
        TOOL_ELLIPSE,
        TOOL_ERASER
    };

// 操作
public:
    void SetDrawingTool(DrawingTool tool);
    DrawingTool GetDrawingTool() const;

// 重写
public:
    virtual void OnDraw(CDC* pDC);  // 重写以绘制该视图
    virtual BOOL PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs);
protected:

// 实现
public:
    virtual ~CDrawingBoardView();
#ifdef _DEBUG
    virtual void AssertValid() const;
    virtual void Dump(CDumpContext& dc) const;
#endif

protected:
    DrawingTool m_currentTool;      // 当前绘图工具
    BOOL m_bDrawing;                // 是否正在绘制
    CPoint m_startPoint;            // 起始点
    CPoint m_endPoint;              // 结束点

// 生成的消息映射函数
protected:
    DECLARE_MESSAGE_MAP()
public:
    afx_msg void OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point);
    afx_msg void OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point);
    afx_msg void OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point);
};

#ifndef _DEBUG  // DrawingBoardView.cpp 中的调试版本
inline CDrawingBoardDoc* CDrawingBoardView::GetDocument() const
   { return reinterpret_cast<CDrawingBoardDoc*>(m_pDocument); }
#endif
DrawingBoardView.cpp 完整代码
C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
// SHARED_HANDLERS 可以在实现预览、缩略图和搜索筛选器句柄的
// ATL 项目中进行定义，并允许与该项目共享文档代码。
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif

#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif


// CDrawingBoardView

IMPLEMENT_DYNCREATE(CDrawingBoardView, CView)

BEGIN_MESSAGE_MAP(CDrawingBoardView, CView)
    ON_WM_LBUTTONDOWN()
    ON_WM_LBUTTONUP()
    ON_WM_MOUSEMOVE()
END_MESSAGE_MAP()

// CDrawingBoardView 构造/析构

{
    m_currentTool = TOOL_PEN;
    m_bDrawing = FALSE;
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

// CDrawingBoardView 绘图

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc)
        return;

    // TODO: 在此处为本机数据添加绘制代码
}


// CDrawingBoardView 诊断

#ifdef _DEBUG
void CDrawingBoardView::AssertValid() const
{
    CView::AssertValid();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::Dump(CDumpContext& dc) const

    return (CDrawingBoardDoc*)m_pDocument;
}
#endif //_DEBUG


// CDrawingBoardView 消息处理程序

void CDrawingBoardView::SetDrawingTool(DrawingTool tool)
{
    m_currentTool = tool;
}

CDrawingBoardView::DrawingTool CDrawingBoardView::GetDrawingTool() const
{
    return m_currentTool;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    m_startPoint = point;
    m_endPoint = point;

    SetCapture(); // 捕获鼠标

    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;
        m_endPoint = point;

        CClientDC dc(this);
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, 2, RGB(0, 0, 0));
        CPen* pOldPen = dc.SelectObject(&pen);

        switch (m_currentTool)
        {
        case TOOL_PEN:
            // 画笔模式在 MouseMove 中已经绘制
            break;

        case TOOL_LINE:
            dc.MoveTo(m_startPoint);
            dc.LineTo(m_endPoint);
            break;

        case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
            dc.SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
            dc.Rectangle(CRect(m_startPoint, m_endPoint));
            break;

        case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
            dc.SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
            dc.Ellipse(CRect(m_startPoint, m_endPoint));
            break;

        case TOOL_ERASER:
            // 橡皮擦模式在 MouseMove 中已经绘制
            break;
        }

        dc.SelectObject(pOldPen);
        ReleaseCapture(); // 释放鼠标捕获
    }

    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        CClientDC dc(this);

        if (m_currentTool == TOOL_PEN)
        {
            // 画笔：连续绘制线条
            CPen pen(PS_SOLID, 2, RGB(0, 0, 0));
            CPen* pOldPen = dc.SelectObject(&pen);
            
            dc.MoveTo(m_endPoint);
            dc.LineTo(point);
            
            dc.SelectObject(pOldPen);
            m_endPoint = point;
        }
        else if (m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER)
        {
            // 橡皮擦：用白色画笔绘制
            CPen pen(PS_SOLID, 10, RGB(255, 255, 255));
            CPen* pOldPen = dc.SelectObject(&pen);
            
            dc.MoveTo(m_endPoint);
            dc.LineTo(point);
            
            dc.SelectObject(pOldPen);
            m_endPoint = point;
        }
        else
        {
            // 其他工具：显示预览效果
            // 这里可以实现橡皮筋效果
            m_endPoint = point;
        }
    }

    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

// CMainFrame

IMPLEMENT_DYNCREATE(CMainFrame, CFrameWnd)

BEGIN_MESSAGE_MAP(CMainFrame, CFrameWnd)
    ON_WM_CREATE()
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_PEN, &CMainFrame::OnToolPen)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_LINE, &CMainFrame::OnToolLine)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE, &CMainFrame::OnToolRectangle)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE, &CMainFrame::OnToolEllipse)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_ERASER, &CMainFrame::OnToolEraser)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_TOOL_PEN, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateToolPen)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_TOOL_LINE, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateToolLine)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateToolRectangle)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateToolEllipse)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_TOOL_ERASER, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateToolEraser)
END_MESSAGE_MAP()

static UINT indicators[] =
{
    ID_SEPARATOR,
    ID_INDICATOR_CAPS,
    ID_INDICATOR_NUM,
    ID_INDICATOR_SCRL,
};

CMainFrame::CMainFrame() noexcept
{
}

CMainFrame::~CMainFrame()
{
}

int CMainFrame::OnCreate(LPCREATESTRUCT lpCreateStruct)
{
    if (CFrameWnd::OnCreate(lpCreateStruct) == -1)
        return -1;

    if (!m_wndToolBar.CreateEx(this, TBSTYLE_FLAT,
        WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | CBRS_TOP | CBRS_GRIPPER |
        CBRS_TOOLTIPS | CBRS_FLYBY | CBRS_SIZE_DYNAMIC) ||
        !m_wndToolBar.LoadToolBar(IDR_MAINFRAME))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建工具栏\n");
        return -1;
    }

    if (!m_wndStatusBar.Create(this))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建状态栏\n");
        return -1;
    }
    m_wndStatusBar.SetIndicators(indicators, sizeof(indicators)/sizeof(UINT));

    m_wndToolBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    DockControlBar(&m_wndToolBar);

    return 0;
}

BOOL CMainFrame::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    if( !CFrameWnd::PreCreateWindow(cs) )
        return FALSE;
    return TRUE;
}

#ifdef _DEBUG

{
    CFrameWnd::AssertValid();
}

{
    CFrameWnd::Dump(dc);
}
#endif //_DEBUG

1. resource.h 文件（添加以下定义）

//{{NO_DEPENDENCIES}}

//
#define IDD_ABOUTBOX                    100
#define IDR_MAINFRAME                   128
#define IDR_DrawingBoardTYPE            130

// 绘图工具命令ID
#define ID_TOOL_PEN                     32771
#define ID_TOOL_LINE                    32772
#define ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE               32773
#define ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE                 32774
#define ID_TOOL_ERASER                  32775

// Next default values for new objects
// 
#ifdef APSTUDIO_INVOKED

#define _APS_NEXT_RESOURCE_VALUE        310
#define _APS_NEXT_COMMAND_VALUE         32776

#define _APS_NEXT_SYMED_VALUE           310

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    m_startPoint = point;
    m_endPoint = point;
    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;
        m_endPoint = point;

        CClientDC dc(this);
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, 2, RGB(0, 0, 0));
        CPen* pOldPen = dc.SelectObject(&pen);

        switch (m_currentTool)
        {
        case TOOL_LINE:
            dc.MoveTo(m_startPoint);
            dc.LineTo(m_endPoint);
            break;

        case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
            dc.SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
            dc.Rectangle(CRect(m_startPoint, m_endPoint));
            break;

        case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
            dc.SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
            dc.Ellipse(CRect(m_startPoint, m_endPoint));
            break;
        }

        dc.SelectObject(pOldPen);
        ReleaseCapture();
    }
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        CClientDC dc(this);

        if (m_currentTool == TOOL_PEN)
        {
            CPen pen(PS_SOLID, 2, RGB(0, 0, 0));
            CPen* pOldPen = dc.SelectObject(&pen);
            dc.MoveTo(m_endPoint);
            dc.LineTo(point);
            dc.SelectObject(pOldPen);
            m_endPoint = point;
        }
        else if (m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER)
        {
            CPen pen(PS_SOLID, 10, RGB(255, 255, 255));
            CPen* pOldPen = dc.SelectObject(&pen);
            dc.MoveTo(m_endPoint);
            dc.LineTo(point);
            dc.SelectObject(pOldPen);
            m_endPoint = point;
        }
    }
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

resource.h 完整代码
C++
 |
//{{NO_DEPENDENCIES}}
// Microsoft Visual C++ 生成的包含文件。
// 由 DrawingBoard.rc 使用
//
#define IDD_ABOUTBOX                    100
#define IDP_OLE_INIT_FAILED             100
#define IDR_MAINFRAME                   128
#define IDR_DrawingBoardTYPE            130

// 绘图工具命令ID
#define ID_TOOL_PEN                     32771
#define ID_TOOL_LINE                    32772
#define ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE               32773
#define ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE                 32774
#define ID_TOOL_ERASER                  32775

// Next default values for new objects
// 
#ifdef APSTUDIO_INVOKED
#ifndef APSTUDIO_READONLY_SYMBOLS
#define _APS_NEXT_RESOURCE_VALUE        310
#define _APS_NEXT_COMMAND_VALUE         32776
#define _APS_NEXT_CONTROL_VALUE         1000
#define _APS_NEXT_SYMED_VALUE           310
#endif
#endif
说明：

IDD_ABOUTBOX 和 IDP_OLE_INIT_FAILED - 通用对话框资源ID
IDR_MAINFRAME - 主框架窗口资源ID（工具栏、菜单等）
IDR_DrawingBoardTYPE - 文档类型资源ID
ID_TOOL_PEN (32771) - 画笔工具命令ID
ID_TOOL_LINE (32772) - 直线工具命令ID
ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE (32773) - 矩形工具命令ID
ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE (32774) - 椭圆工具命令ID
ID_TOOL_ERASER (32775) - 橡皮擦工具命令ID
这个文件定义了所有资源的数字ID，编译器会用这些常量来识别各种UI元素。

现在执行以下步骤：

✅ 复制上面的代码替换你的 resource.h 文件
✅ 清理解决方案（右键解决方案 → 清理解决方案）
✅ 重新生成解决方案（Ctrl + Shift + B）
应该可以成功编译了！🎉

    virtual CShape* Clone() const = 0;

    COLORREF m_color;
    int m_width;
};

2. DrawingBoardView.cpp（完整代码）
C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif

#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

// 图形类实现
void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (m_points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_width, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    pDC->MoveTo(m_points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < m_points.size(); i++)
    {
        pDC->LineTo(m_points[i]);
    }
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_width, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    pDC->MoveTo(m_start);
    pDC->LineTo(m_end);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_width, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    pDC->Rectangle(CRect(m_start, m_end));
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_width, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    pDC->Ellipse(CRect(m_start, m_end));
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
}

// 视图类实现
IMPLEMENT_DYNCREATE(CDrawingBoardView, CView)

BEGIN_MESSAGE_MAP(CDrawingBoardView, CView)
    ON_WM_LBUTTONDOWN()
    ON_WM_LBUTTONUP()
    ON_WM_MOUSEMOVE()
    ON_WM_SIZE()
    ON_WM_ERASEBKGND()
END_MESSAGE_MAP()

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
{
    m_currentTool = TOOL_PEN;
    m_bDrawing = FALSE;
    m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
    m_bMemDCInitialized = FALSE;
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    // 清理所有图形
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_shapes.size(); i++)
    {
        delete m_shapes[i];
    }
    m_shapes.clear();
    
    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        delete m_pCurrentShape;
        m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
    }
    
    // 清理内存DC
    if (m_memDC.GetSafeHdc())
    {
        m_memDC.DeleteDC();
    }
    if (m_bitmap.GetSafeHandle())
    {
        m_bitmap.DeleteObject();
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::InitializeMemDC()
{
    CClientDC dc(this);
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    
    if (m_memDC.GetSafeHdc())
    {
        m_memDC.DeleteDC();
    }
    if (m_bitmap.GetSafeHandle())
    {
        m_bitmap.DeleteObject();
    }
    
    m_memDC.CreateCompatibleDC(&dc);
    m_bitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(&dc, rect.Width(), rect.Height());
    m_memDC.SelectObject(&m_bitmap);
    
    // 用白色填充背景
    m_memDC.FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    
    m_bMemDCInitialized = TRUE;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::RenderToMemDC()
{
    if (!m_bMemDCInitialized)
        return;
    
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    
    // 清空背景
    m_memDC.FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    
    // 绘制所有已完成的图形
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_shapes.size(); i++)
    {
        m_shapes[i]->Draw(&m_memDC);
    }
    
    // 绘制当前正在绘制的图形
    if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_pCurrentShape->Draw(&m_memDC);
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc)
        return;
    
    if (!m_bMemDCInitialized)
    {
        InitializeMemDC();
        RenderToMemDC();
    }
    
    // 将内存DC内容复制到屏幕
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    pDC->BitBlt(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height(), &m_memDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::OnEraseBkgnd(CDC* pDC)
{
    // 不擦除背景，减少闪烁
    return TRUE;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnSize(UINT nType, int cx, int cy)
{
    CView::OnSize(nType, cx, cy);
    
    if (cx > 0 && cy > 0)
    {
        InitializeMemDC();
        RenderToMemDC();
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    m_startPoint = point;
    m_endPoint = point;
    SetCapture();
    
    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        delete m_pCurrentShape;
        m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
    }
    
    COLORREF color = (m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER) ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0);
    int width = (m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER) ? 20 : 2;
    
    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case TOOL_PEN:
    case TOOL_ERASER:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CPenShape(color, width);
        static_cast<CPenShape*>(m_pCurrentShape)->AddPoint(point);
        break;
    case TOOL_LINE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CLineShape(point, point, color, width);
        break;
    case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CRectangleShape(point, point, color, width);
        break;
    case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CEllipseShape(point, point, color, width);
        break;
    }
    
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;
        m_endPoint = point;
        
        if (m_pCurrentShape)
        {
            // 保存图形
            m_shapes.push_back(m_pCurrentShape);
            m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
            
            // 重新渲染
            RenderToMemDC();
            Invalidate(FALSE);
        }
        
        ReleaseCapture();
    }
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_endPoint = point;
        
        switch (m_currentTool)
        {
        case TOOL_PEN:
        case TOOL_ERASER:
            static_cast<CPenShape*>(m_pCurrentShape)->AddPoint(point);
            break;
        case TOOL_LINE:
            {
                COLORREF color = (m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER) ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0);
                delete m_pCurrentShape;
                m_pCurrentShape = new CLineShape(m_startPoint, point, color, 2);
            }
            break;
        case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
            {
                delete m_pCurrentShape;
                m_pCurrentShape = new CRectangleShape(m_startPoint, point, RGB(0, 0, 0), 2);
            }
            break;
        case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
            {
                delete m_pCurrentShape;
                m_pCurrentShape = new CEllipseShape(m_startPoint, point, RGB(0, 0, 0), 2);
            }
            break;
        }
        
        // 实时更新显示
        RenderToMemDC();
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

#ifdef _DEBUG

    CView::AssertValid();
}

{
    CView::Dump(dc);
}

{
    ASSERT(m_pDocument->IsKindOf(RUNTIME_CLASS(CDrawingBoardDoc)));
    return (CDrawingBoardDoc*)m_pDocument;
}

1. DrawingBoardView.h（简化版）
C++
 |
#pragma once
#include <vector>

class CShape
{
public:
    CShape(COLORREF color, int width) : m_color(color), m_width(width) {}
    virtual ~CShape() {}
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) = 0;

protected:
    COLORREF m_color;
    int m_width;
};

class CPenShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CPenShape(COLORREF color, int width) : CShape(color, width) {}
    void AddPoint(CPoint pt) { m_points.push_back(pt); }
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) override;

private:
    std::vector<CPoint> m_points;
};

class CLineShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CLineShape(CPoint start, CPoint end, COLORREF color, int width)
        : CShape(color, width), m_start(start), m_end(end) {}
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) override;

private:
    CPoint m_start;
    CPoint m_end;
};

class CRectangleShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CRectangleShape(CPoint start, CPoint end, COLORREF color, int width)
        : CShape(color, width), m_start(start), m_end(end) {}
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) override;

private:
    CPoint m_start;
    CPoint m_end;
};

class CEllipseShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CEllipseShape(CPoint start, CPoint end, COLORREF color, int width)
        : CShape(color, width), m_start(start), m_end(end) {}
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) override;

private:
    CPoint m_start;
    CPoint m_end;
};

class CDrawingBoardView : public CView
{
protected:
    CDrawingBoardView() noexcept;
    DECLARE_DYNCREATE(CDrawingBoardView)

public:
    CDrawingBoardDoc* GetDocument() const;

    enum DrawingTool {
        TOOL_PEN = 0,
        TOOL_LINE,
        TOOL_RECTANGLE,
        TOOL_ELLIPSE,
        TOOL_ERASER
    };

    void SetDrawingTool(DrawingTool tool) { m_currentTool = tool; }
    DrawingTool GetDrawingTool() const { return m_currentTool; }

public:
    virtual void OnDraw(CDC* pDC) override;
    virtual BOOL PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs) override;
    virtual ~CDrawingBoardView();

protected:
    DrawingTool m_currentTool;
    BOOL m_bDrawing;
    CPoint m_startPoint;
    CPoint m_endPoint;
    
    std::vector<CShape*> m_shapes;
    CShape* m_pCurrentShape;

protected:
    afx_msg void OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point);
    afx_msg void OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point);
    afx_msg void OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point);
    DECLARE_MESSAGE_MAP()

#ifdef _DEBUG
    virtual void AssertValid() const override;
    virtual void Dump(CDumpContext& dc) const override;
#endif
};

inline CDrawingBoardDoc* CDrawingBoardView::GetDocument() const
   { return reinterpret_cast<CDrawingBoardDoc*>(m_pDocument); }

2. DrawingBoardView.cpp（简化版，无双缓冲）
C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif

#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

// 实现绘图函数
void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (m_points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_width, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    pDC->MoveTo(m_points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < m_points.size(); i++)
    {
        pDC->LineTo(m_points[i]);
    }
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_width, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    pDC->MoveTo(m_start);
    pDC->LineTo(m_end);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_width, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    pDC->Rectangle(CRect(m_start, m_end));
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_width, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    pDC->Ellipse(CRect(m_start, m_end));
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
}

IMPLEMENT_DYNCREATE(CDrawingBoardView, CView)

BEGIN_MESSAGE_MAP(CDrawingBoardView, CView)
    ON_WM_LBUTTONDOWN()
    ON_WM_LBUTTONUP()
    ON_WM_MOUSEMOVE()
END_MESSAGE_MAP()

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
{
    m_currentTool = TOOL_PEN;
    m_bDrawing = FALSE;
    m_pCurrentShape = NULL;
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_shapes.size(); i++)
    {
        delete m_shapes[i];
    }
    m_shapes.clear();
    
    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        delete m_pCurrentShape;
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc)
        return;
    
    // 绘制所有已完成的图形
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_shapes.size(); i++)
    {
        m_shapes[i]->Draw(pDC);
    }
    
    // 绘制正在绘制的图形
    if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_pCurrentShape->Draw(pDC);
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    m_startPoint = point;
    m_endPoint = point;
    SetCapture();
    
    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        delete m_pCurrentShape;
        m_pCurrentShape = NULL;
    }
    
    COLORREF color = (m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER) ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0);
    int width = (m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER) ? 20 : 2;
    
    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case TOOL_PEN:
    case TOOL_ERASER:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CPenShape(color, width);
        ((CPenShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->AddPoint(point);
        break;
    case TOOL_LINE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CLineShape(point, point, color, width);
        break;
    case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CRectangleShape(point, point, color, width);
        break;
    case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CEllipseShape(point, point, color, width);
        break;
    }
    
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;
        m_endPoint = point;
        
        if (m_pCurrentShape)
        {
            m_shapes.push_back(m_pCurrentShape);
            m_pCurrentShape = NULL;
            Invalidate();
        }
        
        ReleaseCapture();
    }
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_endPoint = point;
        
        switch (m_currentTool)
        {
        case TOOL_PEN:
        case TOOL_ERASER:
            ((CPenShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->AddPoint(point);
            break;
        case TOOL_LINE:
            {
                COLORREF color = (m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER) ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : RGB(0, 0, 0);
                delete m_pCurrentShape;
                m_pCurrentShape = new CLineShape(m_startPoint, point, color, 2);
            }
            break;
        case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
            {
                delete m_pCurrentShape;
                m_pCurrentShape = new CRectangleShape(m_startPoint, point, RGB(0, 0, 0), 2);
            }
            break;
        case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
            {
                delete m_pCurrentShape;
                m_pCurrentShape = new CEllipseShape(m_startPoint, point, RGB(0, 0, 0), 2);
            }
            break;
        }
        
        Invalidate();
    }
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

class CShape
{
public:
    CShape(COLORREF color, int width) : m_color(color), m_width(width) {}
    virtual ~CShape() {}
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) = 0;

protected:
    COLORREF m_color;
    int m_width;
};

class CPenShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CPenShape(COLORREF color, int width) : CShape(color, width) {}
    void AddPoint(CPoint pt) { m_points.push_back(pt); }
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) override;

private:
    std::vector<CPoint> m_points;
};

class CLineShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CLineShape(CPoint start, CPoint end, COLORREF color, int width)
        : CShape(color, width), m_start(start), m_end(end) {}
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) override;

private:
    CPoint m_start;
    CPoint m_end;
};

class CRectangleShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CRectangleShape(CPoint start, CPoint end, COLORREF color, int width)
        : CShape(color, width), m_start(start), m_end(end) {}
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) override;

private:
    CPoint m_start;
    CPoint m_end;
};

private:
    CPoint m_start;
    CPoint m_end;
};

DrawingBoardView.cpp（对应修改开头部分）
C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif

#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

// 实现绘图函数
void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (m_points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_width, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    pDC->MoveTo(m_points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < m_points.size(); i++)
    {
        pDC->LineTo(m_points[i]);
    }
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_width, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    pDC->MoveTo(m_start);
    pDC->LineTo(m_end);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_width, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    pDC->Rectangle(CRect(m_start, m_end));
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_width, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    pDC->Ellipse(CRect(m_start, m_end));
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
}

第二步：修改 MainFrm.cpp 确保工具栏被创建

C++
 |
int CMainFrame::OnCreate(LPCREATESTRUCT lpCreateStruct)
{
    if (CFrameWnd::OnCreate(lpCreateStruct) == -1)
        return -1;

    // 创建工具栏
    if (!m_wndToolBar.CreateEx(this, TBSTYLE_FLAT, 
        WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | CBRS_TOP | CBRS_GRIPPER | 
        CBRS_TOOLTIPS | CBRS_FLYBY | CBRS_SIZE_DYNAMIC) ||
        !m_wndToolBar.LoadToolBar(IDR_MAINFRAME))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建工具栏\n");
        return -1;
    }

    // 创建状态栏
    if (!m_wndStatusBar.Create(this))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建状态栏\n");
        return -1;
    }
    
    static UINT indicators[] = {
        ID_SEPARATOR,
        IDS_STATUS_PANE1,
        IDS_STATUS_PANE2,
    };
    m_wndStatusBar.SetIndicators(indicators, sizeof(indicators)/sizeof(UINT));

    // 设置工具栏可停靠
    m_wndToolBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    DockControlBar(&m_wndToolBar);

    return 0;
}

第四步：添加工具栏图标（如果没有图标）

C++
 |
int CMainFrame::OnCreate(LPCREATESTRUCT lpCreateStruct)
{
    if (CFrameWnd::OnCreate(lpCreateStruct) == -1)
        return -1;

    // 创建工具栏（简化版本，使用文字）
    if (!m_wndToolBar.CreateEx(this, TBSTYLE_FLAT | TBSTYLE_LIST,
        WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | CBRS_TOP | CBRS_TOOLTIPS) ||
        !m_wndToolBar.LoadToolBar(IDR_MAINFRAME))
    {
        // 如果加载失败，手动创建按钮
        m_wndToolBar.Create(this);
        m_wndToolBar.ModifyStyle(0, TBSTYLE_FLAT | TBSTYLE_TRANSPARENT);
        
        TBBUTTON buttons[] = {
            {0, ID_TOOL_PEN, TBSTATE_ENABLED, TBSTYLE_BUTTON, {0}, 0, (INT_PTR)L"画笔"},
            {1, ID_TOOL_LINE, TBSTATE_ENABLED, TBSTYLE_BUTTON, {0}, 0, (INT_PTR)L"直线"},
            {2, ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE, TBSTATE_ENABLED, TBSTYLE_BUTTON, {0}, 0, (INT_PTR)L"矩形"},
            {3, ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE, TBSTATE_ENABLED, TBSTYLE_BUTTON, {0}, 0, (INT_PTR)L"椭圆"},
            {4, ID_TOOL_ERASER, TBSTATE_ENABLED, TBSTYLE_BUTTON, {0}, 0, (INT_PTR)L"橡皮"},
        };
        
        m_wndToolBar.GetToolBarCtrl().AddButtons(5, buttons);
    }

    m_wndToolBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_TOP);
    EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    DockControlBar(&m_wndToolBar);

    return 0;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnToolPen()
{
    m_currentTool = TOOL_PEN;
    
    // 更新状态栏
    CMainFrame* pFrame = (CMainFrame*)AfxGetMainWnd();
    if (pFrame)
    {
        pFrame->SetMessageText(_T("当前工具: 铅笔"));
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnToolLine()
{
    m_currentTool = TOOL_LINE;
    
    CMainFrame* pFrame = (CMainFrame*)AfxGetMainWnd();
    if (pFrame)
    {
        pFrame->SetMessageText(_T("当前工具: 直线"));
    }
}

可以直接在这个光标进行修改吗

Claude Sonnet 4.512/26 22:49:59
可以的！你可以直接在这个表格界面中修改。

在 String Table 表格中直接添加/修改
方法1：修改现有条目
双击你想修改的那一行（比如 ID_FILE_MRU_FILE10）
会弹出一个编辑对话框
在 "标题" 框中输入：铅笔工具 - 自由绘制\n铅笔
点击 确定
方法2：添加新条目
找到表格最下面的空白行
在 ID 列输入：ID_TOOL_PEN
在 值 列会自动分配一个数字（或者你手动输入 32771）
在 标题 列输入：铅笔工具 - 自由绘制\n铅笔
按 Enter 键确认
方法3：使用右键菜单
在 String Table 表格的空白处右键点击
选择 "新建字符串" 或 "New String"
在弹出的对话框中：
ID: 输入 ID_TOOL_PEN
值: 输入 32771（或留空自动分配）
标题: 输入 铅笔工具 - 自由绘制\n铅笔
点击 确定
快速添加所有工具提示
建议：一个一个添加新字符串，依次输入：

ID	标题
ID_TOOL_PEN	铅笔工具 - 自由绘制\n铅笔
ID_TOOL_LINE	直线工具 - 绘制直线\n直线
ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE	矩形工具 - 绘制矩形\n矩形
ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE	椭圆工具 - 绘制椭圆\n椭圆
ID_TOOL_ERASER	橡皮擦工具 - 擦除内容\n橡皮
ID_COLOR_BLACK	设置黑色\n黑色
ID_COLOR_RED	设置红色\n红色
ID_COLOR_GREEN	设置绿色\n绿色
ID_COLOR_BLUE	设置蓝色\n蓝色
ID_SIZE_THIN	细线(1像素)\n细
ID_SIZE_MEDIUM	中等线条(3像素)\n中
ID_SIZE_THICK	粗线(5像素)\n粗
注意事项
⚠️ 重要：标题中的 \n 是分隔符：

\n 前面的文字 → 显示在状态栏
\n 后面的文字 → 显示在工具提示（鼠标悬停）
例如：铅笔工具 - 自由绘制\n铅笔

状态栏显示：铅笔工具 - 自由绘制
工具提示显示：铅笔
添加完成后，保存 (Ctrl+S) → 编译 (F7) → 运行 (F5)，就能看到效果了！✨

C++
 |
int CMainFrame::OnCreate(LPCREATESTRUCT lpCreateStruct)
{
    if (CFrameWnd::OnCreate(lpCreateStruct) == -1)
        return -1;

    // 创建简单工具栏
    if (!m_wndToolBar.Create(this) ||
        !m_wndToolBar.LoadToolBar(IDR_MAINFRAME))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建工具栏\n");
        return -1;

    // 添加文字标签
    TBBUTTONINFO tbi;
    tbi.cbSize = sizeof(TBBUTTONINFO);
    tbi.dwMask = TBIF_TEXT | TBIF_STYLE;
    tbi.fsStyle = TBSTYLE_BUTTON | TBSTYLE_AUTOSIZE;
    
    // 给每个按钮添加文字
    tbi.pszText = _T("铅笔");
    m_wndToolBar.GetToolBarCtrl().SetButtonInfo(ID_TOOL_PEN, &tbi);
    
    tbi.pszText = _T("直线");
    m_wndToolBar.GetToolBarCtrl().SetButtonInfo(ID_TOOL_LINE, &tbi);
    
    tbi.pszText = _T("矩形");

    m_wndToolBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    DockControlBar(&m_wndToolBar);

    return 0;
}

 |
int CMainFrame::OnCreate(LPCREATESTRUCT lpCreateStruct)
{
    if (CFrameWnd::OnCreate(lpCreateStruct) == -1)
        return -1;

    // 创建工具栏
    m_wndToolBar.Create(this, WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | CBRS_TOP | CBRS_TOOLTIPS);
    
    // 设置按钮
    UINT nButtons[] = {
        ID_TOOL_PEN,
        ID_TOOL_LINE,
        ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE,
        ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE,
        ID_TOOL_ERASER,
        ID_SEPARATOR,
        ID_COLOR_BLACK,
        ID_COLOR_RED,
        ID_COLOR_GREEN,
        ID_COLOR_BLUE,
        ID_SEPARATOR,
        ID_SIZE_THIN,
        ID_SIZE_MEDIUM,
        ID_SIZE_THICK,
    };
    
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtons(nButtons, sizeof(nButtons)/sizeof(UINT));
    
    // 设置按钮文字（修正中文显示）
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(0, L"铅笔");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(1, L"直线");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(2, L"矩形");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(3, L"椭圆");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(4, L"橡皮");

    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(7, L"红色");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(8, L"绿色");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(9, L"蓝色");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(11, L"细线");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(12, L"中线");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(13, L"粗线");

    // 调整工具栏按钮大小以适应文字
    CRect rect;
    m_wndToolBar.GetItemRect(0, &rect);
    m_wndToolBar.SetSizes(CSize(rect.Height(), rect.Height()), CSize(16, 16));

    m_wndToolBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    DockControlBar(&m_wndToolBar);

    return 0;
}

// CMainFrame

IMPLEMENT_DYNCREATE(CMainFrame, CFrameWnd)

BEGIN_MESSAGE_MAP(CMainFrame, CFrameWnd)
    ON_WM_CREATE()
    
    // 命令更新消息映射
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_TOOL_PEN, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateToolPen)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_TOOL_LINE, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateToolLine)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateToolRectangle)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateToolEllipse)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_TOOL_ERASER, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateToolEraser)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_COLOR_BLACK, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateColorBlack)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_COLOR_RED, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateColorRed)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_COLOR_GREEN, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateColorGreen)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_COLOR_BLUE, &CMainFrame::OnUpdateColorBlue)
