int CMainFrame::OnCreate(LPCREATESTRUCT lpCreateStruct)
{
    if (CFrameWnd::OnCreate(lpCreateStruct) == -1)
        return -1;

    // 创建工具栏
    if (!m_wndToolBar.Create(this, WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | CBRS_TOP | CBRS_TOOLTIPS | CBRS_FLYBY))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建工具栏\n");
        return -1;
    }
    
    // 设置按钮
    UINT nButtons[] = {
        ID_TOOL_PEN,
        ID_TOOL_LINE,
        ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE,
        ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE,
        ID_TOOL_ERASER,
        ID_SEPARATOR,
        ID_COLOR_BLACK,
        ID_COLOR_RED,
        ID_COLOR_GREEN,
        ID_COLOR_BLUE,
        ID_SEPARATOR,
        ID_SIZE_THIN,
        ID_SIZE_MEDIUM,
        ID_SIZE_THICK,
    };
    
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtons(nButtons, sizeof(nButtons) / sizeof(UINT));
    
    // 设置按钮文字
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(0, L"铅笔");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(1, L"直线");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(2, L"矩形");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(3, L"椭圆");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(4, L"橡皮");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(6, L"黑色");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(7, L"红色");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(8, L"绿色");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(9, L"蓝色");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(11, L"细线");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(12, L"中线");
    m_wndToolBar.SetButtonText(13, L"粗线");

    // 调整工具栏大小
    CRect rect;
    m_wndToolBar.GetItemRect(0, &rect);
    m_wndToolBar.SetSizes(CSize(rect.Height() + 20, rect.Height()), CSize(16, 16));

    // 启用停靠
    m_wndToolBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    DockControlBar(&m_wndToolBar);

    return 0;
}

        return FALSE;

    return TRUE;

// ========== 工具命令处理 ==========
void CMainFrame::OnToolPen()
{
    CDrawingBoardView* pView = (CDrawingBoardView*)GetActiveView();
    if (pView)
        pView->SetDrawingTool(CDrawingBoardView::TOOL_PEN);
}

void CMainFrame::OnToolLine()
{
    CDrawingBoardView* pView = (CDrawingBoardView*)GetActiveView();
    if (pView)
        pView->SetDrawingTool(CDrawingBoardView::TOOL_LINE);
}

void CMainFrame::OnToolRectangle()
{
    CDrawingBoardView* pView = (CDrawingBoardView*)GetActiveView();
    if (pView)
        pView->SetDrawingTool(CDrawingBoardView::TOOL_RECTANGLE);
}

void CMainFrame::OnToolEllipse()
{
    CDrawingBoardView* pView = (CDrawingBoardView*)GetActiveView();
    if (pView)
        pView->SetDrawingTool(CDrawingBoardView::TOOL_ELLIPSE);
}

void CMainFrame::OnToolEraser()
{
    CDrawingBoardView* pView = (CDrawingBoardView*)GetActiveView();
    if (pView)
        pView->SetDrawingTool(CDrawingBoardView::TOOL_ERASER);

// DrawingBoardView.cpp: CDrawingBoardView 类的实现
//

#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
// SHARED_HANDLERS 可以在实现预览、缩略图和搜索筛选器句柄的
// ATL 项目中进行定义，并允许与该项目共享文档代码。
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif

#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif


// CDrawingBoardView

IMPLEMENT_DYNCREATE(CDrawingBoardView, CView)

BEGIN_MESSAGE_MAP(CDrawingBoardView, CView)
	// 标准打印命令
	ON_COMMAND(ID_FILE_PRINT, &CView::OnFilePrint)
	ON_COMMAND(ID_FILE_PRINT_DIRECT, &CView::OnFilePrint)
	ON_COMMAND(ID_FILE_PRINT_PREVIEW, &CView::OnFilePrintPreview)
	ON_WM_LBUTTONDOWN()
	ON_WM_LBUTTONUP()

	ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_TOOL_LINE, &CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateToolLine)

// CDrawingBoardView 构造/析构

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
{
	// 初始化绘图参数
	m_currentTool = TOOL_PEN;
	m_currentColor = RGB(0, 0, 0);  // 默认黑色
	m_penWidth = 1;  // 默认细线
	m_bDrawing = FALSE;
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
	// 清理动态分配的内存
	for (int i = 0; i < m_allStrokes.GetSize(); i++)
	{
		delete m_allStrokes[i];
	}
	m_allStrokes.RemoveAll();
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
	return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

// CDrawingBoardView 绘图

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
	CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
	ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
	if (!pDoc)
		return;

	// 绘制所有已保存的笔画
	for (int i = 0; i < m_allStrokes.GetSize(); i++)
	{
		CArray<CPoint>* pStroke = m_allStrokes[i];
		if (pStroke->GetSize() < 2)
			continue;

		CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_strokeWidths[i], m_strokeColors[i]);
		CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);

		pDC->MoveTo(pStroke->GetAt(0));
		for (int j = 1; j < pStroke->GetSize(); j++)
		{
			pDC->LineTo(pStroke->GetAt(j));
		}

		pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
	}

	// 绘制当前正在绘制的内容
	if (m_bDrawing)
	{
		CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_penWidth, m_currentColor);
		CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);

		switch (m_currentTool)
		{
		case TOOL_PEN:
			if (m_points.GetSize() >= 2)
			{
				pDC->MoveTo(m_points[0]);
				for (int i = 1; i < m_points.GetSize(); i++)
				{
					pDC->LineTo(m_points[i]);
				}
			}
			break;

		case TOOL_LINE:
			pDC->MoveTo(m_startPoint);
			pDC->LineTo(m_endPoint);
			break;

		case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
		{
			CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
			pDC->Rectangle(CRect(m_startPoint, m_endPoint));
			pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
		}
		break;

		case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
		{
			CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
			pDC->Ellipse(CRect(m_startPoint, m_endPoint));
			pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
		}
		break;

		case TOOL_ERASER:
			if (m_points.GetSize() >= 2)
			{
				CPen eraserPen(PS_SOLID, m_penWidth * 3, RGB(255, 255, 255));
				pDC->SelectObject(&eraserPen);
				pDC->MoveTo(m_points[0]);
				for (int i = 1; i < m_points.GetSize(); i++)
				{
					pDC->LineTo(m_points[i]);
				}
			}
			break;
		}

		pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
	}
}

// CDrawingBoardView 消息处理程序

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
	m_bDrawing = TRUE;
	m_startPoint = point;
	m_endPoint = point;
	m_points.RemoveAll();
	m_points.Add(point);

	SetCapture();

	CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}


void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
	if (m_bDrawing)
	{
		m_bDrawing = FALSE;
		m_endPoint = point;

		// 保存绘制的内容
		CArray<CPoint>* pNewStroke = new CArray<CPoint>();
		
		switch (m_currentTool)
		{
		case TOOL_PEN:
		case TOOL_ERASER:
			pNewStroke->Append(m_points);
			break;

		case TOOL_LINE:
			pNewStroke->Add(m_startPoint);
			pNewStroke->Add(m_endPoint);
			break;

		case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
		{
			CPoint topLeft(min(m_startPoint.x, m_endPoint.x), min(m_startPoint.y, m_endPoint.y));
			CPoint topRight(max(m_startPoint.x, m_endPoint.x), min(m_startPoint.y, m_endPoint.y));
			CPoint bottomRight(max(m_startPoint.x, m_endPoint.x), max(m_startPoint.y, m_endPoint.y));
			CPoint bottomLeft(min(m_startPoint.x, m_endPoint.x), max(m_startPoint.y, m_endPoint.y));

			pNewStroke->Add(topLeft);
			pNewStroke->Add(topRight);
			pNewStroke->Add(bottomRight);
			pNewStroke->Add(bottomLeft);
			pNewStroke->Add(topLeft);
		}
		break;

		case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
		{
			CRect rect(m_startPoint, m_endPoint);
			rect.NormalizeRect();
			
			int centerX = (rect.left + rect.right) / 2;
			int centerY = (rect.top + rect.bottom) / 2;
			int radiusX = abs(rect.right - rect.left) / 2;
			int radiusY = abs(rect.bottom - rect.top) / 2;

			for (int angle = 0; angle <= 360; angle += 5)
			{
				double radian = angle * 3.14159265 / 180.0;
				int x = centerX + (int)(radiusX * cos(radian));
				int y = centerY + (int)(radiusY * sin(radian));
				pNewStroke->Add(CPoint(x, y));
			}
		}
		break;
		}

		m_allStrokes.Add(pNewStroke);
		m_strokeColors.Add(m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : m_currentColor);
		m_strokeWidths.Add(m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER ? m_penWidth * 3 : m_penWidth);

		Invalidate();
		ReleaseCapture();
	}

	CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}


void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
	if (m_bDrawing)
	{
		m_endPoint = point;

		if (m_currentTool == TOOL_PEN || m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER)
		{
			m_points.Add(point);
		}

		Invalidate();
	}

	CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif

#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

// CDrawingBoardView

IMPLEMENT_DYNCREATE(CDrawingBoardView, CView)

BEGIN_MESSAGE_MAP(CDrawingBoardView, CView)
	ON_WM_CONTEXTMENU()
	ON_WM_RBUTTONUP()
	ON_WM_LBUTTONDOWN()
	ON_WM_LBUTTONUP()
	ON_WM_MOUSEMOVE()
	ON_COMMAND(ID_FILE_PRINT, &CView::OnFilePrint)
	ON_COMMAND(ID_FILE_PRINT_DIRECT, &CView::OnFilePrint)
	ON_COMMAND(ID_FILE_PRINT_PREVIEW, &CDrawingBoardView::OnFilePrintPreview)
	ON_WM_CONTEXTMENU()
	ON_WM_RBUTTONUP()
END_MESSAGE_MAP()

// CDrawingBoardView 构造/析构

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
{
	// 初始化成员变量
	m_currentTool = TOOL_PEN;
	m_currentColor = RGB(0, 0, 0);  // 黑色
	m_penWidth = 2;
	m_bDrawing = FALSE;
	m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
	// 清理所有形状
	for (int i = 0; i < m_shapes.GetSize(); i++)
	{
		delete m_shapes[i];
	}
	m_shapes.RemoveAll();
	
	if (m_pCurrentShape)
	{
		delete m_pCurrentShape;
		m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
	}
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
	return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

// CDrawingBoardView 绘图

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
	CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
	ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
	if (!pDoc)
		return;

	// 绘制所有已保存的形状
	for (int i = 0; i < m_shapes.GetSize(); i++)
	{
		DrawingShape* shape = m_shapes[i];
		CPen pen(PS_SOLID, shape->width, shape->color);
		CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
		CBrush brush(shape->color);
		CBrush* pOldBrush = nullptr;

		switch (shape->tool)
		{
		case TOOL_PEN:
			if (shape->points.GetSize() > 1)
			{
				pDC->MoveTo(shape->points[0]);
				for (int j = 1; j < shape->points.GetSize(); j++)
				{
					pDC->LineTo(shape->points[j]);
				}
			}
			break;

		case TOOL_LINE:
			pDC->MoveTo(shape->startPoint);
			pDC->LineTo(shape->endPoint);
			break;

		case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
			pOldBrush = pDC->SelectObject(&brush);
			pDC->Rectangle(CRect(shape->startPoint, shape->endPoint));
			pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
			break;

		case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
			pOldBrush = pDC->SelectObject(&brush);
			pDC->Ellipse(CRect(shape->startPoint, shape->endPoint));
			pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
			break;

		case TOOL_ERASER:
			{
				CPen eraserPen(PS_SOLID, shape->width * 3, RGB(255, 255, 255));
				pDC->SelectObject(&eraserPen);
				if (shape->points.GetSize() > 1)
				{
					pDC->MoveTo(shape->points[0]);
					for (int j = 1; j < shape->points.GetSize(); j++)
					{
						pDC->LineTo(shape->points[j]);
					}
				}
			}
			break;
		}

		pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
	}

	// 绘制当前正在绘制的形状
	if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
	{
		CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_pCurrentShape->width, m_pCurrentShape->color);
		CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
		CBrush brush(m_pCurrentShape->color);
		CBrush* pOldBrush = nullptr;

		switch (m_pCurrentShape->tool)
		{
		case TOOL_LINE:
			pDC->MoveTo(m_pCurrentShape->startPoint);
			pDC->LineTo(m_pCurrentShape->endPoint);
			break;

		case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
			pOldBrush = pDC->SelectObject(&brush);
			pDC->Rectangle(CRect(m_pCurrentShape->startPoint, m_pCurrentShape->endPoint));
			pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
			break;

		case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
			pOldBrush = pDC->SelectObject(&brush);
			pDC->Ellipse(CRect(m_pCurrentShape->startPoint, m_pCurrentShape->endPoint));
			pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
			break;
		}

		pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
	}
}

// CDrawingBoardView 消息处理程序

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
	m_bDrawing = TRUE;
	m_startPoint = point;
	m_endPoint = point;

	// 创建新的形状对象
	m_pCurrentShape = new DrawingShape;
	m_pCurrentShape->tool = m_currentTool;
	m_pCurrentShape->color = m_currentColor;
	m_pCurrentShape->width = m_penWidth;
	m_pCurrentShape->startPoint = point;
	m_pCurrentShape->endPoint = point;

	if (m_currentTool == TOOL_PEN || m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER)
	{
		m_pCurrentShape->points.Add(point);
	}

	SetCapture();
	CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
	if (m_bDrawing)
	{
		m_bDrawing = FALSE;
		m_endPoint = point;

		if (m_pCurrentShape)
		{
			m_pCurrentShape->endPoint = point;
			
			// 保存形状
			m_shapes.Add(m_pCurrentShape);
			m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
		}

		ReleaseCapture();
		Invalidate();
	}

	CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
	if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
	{
		CClientDC dc(this);
		CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_penWidth, m_currentColor);
		CPen* pOldPen = dc.SelectObject(&pen);

		switch (m_currentTool)
		{
		case TOOL_PEN:
			dc.MoveTo(m_endPoint);
			dc.LineTo(point);
			m_pCurrentShape->points.Add(point);
			break;

		case TOOL_ERASER:
			{
				CPen eraserPen(PS_SOLID, m_penWidth * 3, RGB(255, 255, 255));
				dc.SelectObject(&eraserPen);
				dc.MoveTo(m_endPoint);
				dc.LineTo(point);
				m_pCurrentShape->points.Add(point);
			}
			break;

		case TOOL_LINE:
		case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
		case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
			m_pCurrentShape->endPoint = point;
			Invalidate();
			break;
		}

		m_endPoint = point;
		dc.SelectObject(pOldPen);
	}

	CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

	m_currentTool = tool;

void CDrawingBoardView::SetDrawingColor(COLORREF color)
{
	m_currentColor = color;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::SetPenWidth(int width)
{
	m_penWidth = width;
}

// CDrawingBoardView

IMPLEMENT_DYNCREATE(CDrawingBoardView, CView)

BEGIN_MESSAGE_MAP(CDrawingBoardView, CView)
	ON_WM_LBUTTONDOWN()
	ON_WM_LBUTTONUP()
	ON_WM_MOUSEMOVE()
	ON_WM_RBUTTONUP()
	ON_WM_CONTEXTMENU()

	ON_COMMAND(ID_FILE_PRINT_PREVIEW, &CView::OnFilePrintPreview)

// CDrawingBoardView 构造/析构

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
{
	m_currentTool = TOOL_PEN;
	m_currentColor = RGB(0, 0, 0);
	m_penWidth = 2;
	m_bDrawing = FALSE;
	m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
	for (int i = 0; i < m_shapes.GetSize(); i++)
	{
		delete m_shapes[i];
	}
	m_shapes.RemoveAll();
	
	if (m_pCurrentShape)
	{
		delete m_pCurrentShape;
		m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
	}
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
	return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

// CDrawingBoardView 绘图

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
	CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
	ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
	if (!pDoc)
		return;

	// 绘制所有已保存的形状
	for (int i = 0; i < m_shapes.GetSize(); i++)
	{
		DrawingShape* shape = m_shapes[i];
		CPen pen(PS_SOLID, shape->width, shape->color);
		CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
		CBrush brush(shape->color);
		CBrush* pOldBrush = nullptr;

		switch (shape->tool)
		{
		case TOOL_PEN:
			if (shape->points.GetSize() > 1)
			{
				pDC->MoveTo(shape->points[0]);
				for (int j = 1; j < shape->points.GetSize(); j++)
				{
					pDC->LineTo(shape->points[j]);
				}
			}
			break;

		case TOOL_LINE:
			pDC->MoveTo(shape->startPoint);
			pDC->LineTo(shape->endPoint);
			break;

		case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
			pOldBrush = pDC->SelectObject(&brush);
			pDC->Rectangle(CRect(shape->startPoint, shape->endPoint));
			pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
			break;

		case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
			pOldBrush = pDC->SelectObject(&brush);
			pDC->Ellipse(CRect(shape->startPoint, shape->endPoint));
			pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
			break;

		case TOOL_ERASER:
			{
				CPen eraserPen(PS_SOLID, shape->width * 3, RGB(255, 255, 255));
				pDC->SelectObject(&eraserPen);
				if (shape->points.GetSize() > 1)
				{
					pDC->MoveTo(shape->points[0]);
					for (int j = 1; j < shape->points.GetSize(); j++)
					{
						pDC->LineTo(shape->points[j]);
					}
				}
			}
			break;
		}

		pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
	}

	// 绘制当前正在绘制的形状
	if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
	{
		CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_pCurrentShape->width, m_pCurrentShape->color);
		CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);

		switch (m_pCurrentShape->tool)
		{
		case TOOL_LINE:
			pDC->MoveTo(m_pCurrentShape->startPoint);
			pDC->LineTo(m_pCurrentShape->endPoint);
			break;

		case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
			pDC->Rectangle(CRect(m_pCurrentShape->startPoint, m_pCurrentShape->endPoint));
			break;

		case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
			pDC->Ellipse(CRect(m_pCurrentShape->startPoint, m_pCurrentShape->endPoint));
			break;
		}

		pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
	}
}

// CDrawingBoardView 消息处理程序

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
	m_bDrawing = TRUE;
	m_startPoint = point;
	m_endPoint = point;

	m_pCurrentShape = new DrawingShape;
	m_pCurrentShape->tool = m_currentTool;
	m_pCurrentShape->color = m_currentColor;
	m_pCurrentShape->width = m_penWidth;
	m_pCurrentShape->startPoint = point;
	m_pCurrentShape->endPoint = point;

	if (m_currentTool == TOOL_PEN || m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER)
	{
		m_pCurrentShape->points.Add(point);
	}

	SetCapture();
	CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
	if (m_bDrawing)
	{
		m_bDrawing = FALSE;
		m_endPoint = point;

		if (m_pCurrentShape)
		{
			m_pCurrentShape->endPoint = point;
			m_shapes.Add(m_pCurrentShape);
			m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
		}

		ReleaseCapture();
		Invalidate();
	}

	CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
	if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
	{
		CClientDC dc(this);
		CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_penWidth, m_currentColor);
		CPen* pOldPen = dc.SelectObject(&pen);

		switch (m_currentTool)
		{
		case TOOL_PEN:
			dc.MoveTo(m_endPoint);
			dc.LineTo(point);
			m_pCurrentShape->points.Add(point);
			break;

		case TOOL_ERASER:
			{
				CPen eraserPen(PS_SOLID, m_penWidth * 3, RGB(255, 255, 255));
				dc.SelectObject(&eraserPen);
				dc.MoveTo(m_endPoint);
				dc.LineTo(point);
				m_pCurrentShape->points.Add(point);
			}
			break;

		case TOOL_LINE:
		case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
		case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
			m_pCurrentShape->endPoint = point;
			Invalidate();
			break;
		}

		m_endPoint = point;
		dc.SelectObject(pOldPen);
	}

	CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

🔑 关键修复点
问题：CArray 模板参数错误
错误写法：

C++
 |
CArray<CPoint> points;  // ❌ 缺少第二个模板参数
CArray<DrawingShape*> m_shapes;  // ❌ 缺少第二个模板参数
正确写法：

C++
 |
CArray<CPoint, CPoint&> points;  // ✅ 完整的模板参数
CArray<DrawingShape*, DrawingShape*> m_shapes;  // ✅ 完整的模板参数
CArray 模板说明
MFC 的 CArray 需要两个模板参数：

C++
 |
CArray<TYPE, ARG_TYPE>
TYPE: 数组元素类型
ARG_TYPE: 传递参数的类型（通常是 TYPE& 或 TYPE）
常见用法：

CArray<int, int> - 整数数组
CArray<CPoint, CPoint&> - 点数组
CArray<CString, LPCTSTR> - 字符串数组
CArray<MyClass*, MyClass*> - 指针数组
📄 确保 DrawingBoardView.cpp 也使用正确的代码
cpp 文件保持之前的版本不变，只需要头文件修改即可。

🎨 关键修改说明
之前的错误代码：
C++
 |
case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
	pOldBrush = pDC->SelectObject(&brush);  // ❌ 使用了实心画刷
	pDC->Rectangle(CRect(shape->startPoint, shape->endPoint));
	pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
	break;
修改后的正确代码：
C++
 |
case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
	{
		// ✅ 使用 NULL_BRUSH（空心画刷）
		CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
		pDC->Rectangle(CRect(shape->startPoint, shape->endPoint));
		pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
	}
	break;
💡 知识点
MFC 画刷类型：
NULL_BRUSH - 空心画刷（只绘制边框）
WHITE_BRUSH - 白色实心画刷
BLACK_BRUSH - 黑色实心画刷
GRAY_BRUSH - 灰色实心画刷
使用 SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH) 可以让矩形和椭圆只显示轮廓线条，不填充内部。

// 构造函数
CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
{
	m_currentTool = TOOL_PEN;
	m_currentColor = RGB(0, 0, 0);
	m_penWidth = 2;
	m_bDrawing = FALSE;
	m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
	// 清理内存
	for (int i = 0; i < m_shapes.GetSize(); i++)
	{
		delete m_shapes[i];
	}
	m_shapes.RemoveAll();
	
	for (int i = 0; i < m_undoStack.GetSize(); i++)
	{
		delete m_undoStack[i];
	}
	m_undoStack.RemoveAll();
	
	if (m_pCurrentShape)
	{
		delete m_pCurrentShape;
	}
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
	return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

// 辅助函数：绘制单个形状
void CDrawingBoardView::DrawShape(CDC* pDC, DrawingShape* shape)
{
	if (!shape) return;
	
	CPen pen(PS_SOLID, shape->width, shape->color);
	CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);

	switch (shape->tool)
	{
	case TOOL_PEN:
		if (shape->points.GetSize() > 1)
		{
			pDC->MoveTo(shape->points[0]);
			for (int j = 1; j < shape->points.GetSize(); j++)
			{
				pDC->LineTo(shape->points[j]);
			}
		}
		break;

	case TOOL_LINE:
		pDC->MoveTo(shape->startPoint);
		pDC->LineTo(shape->endPoint);
		break;

	case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
		{
			CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
			pDC->Rectangle(CRect(shape->startPoint, shape->endPoint));
			pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
		}
		break;

	case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
		{
			CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
			pDC->Ellipse(CRect(shape->startPoint, shape->endPoint));
			pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
		}
		break;

	case TOOL_ERASER:
		{
			CPen eraserPen(PS_SOLID, shape->width * 3, RGB(255, 255, 255));
			pDC->SelectObject(&eraserPen);
			if (shape->points.GetSize() > 1)
			{
				pDC->MoveTo(shape->points[0]);
				for (int j = 1; j < shape->points.GetSize(); j++)
				{
					pDC->LineTo(shape->points[j]);
				}
			}
		}
		break;
	}

	pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

// OnDraw 函数
void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
	CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
	ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
	if (!pDoc)
		return;

	// 绘制所有已保存的形状
	for (int i = 0; i < m_shapes.GetSize(); i++)
	{
		DrawShape(pDC, m_shapes[i]);
	}

	// 绘制当前正在绘制的形状
	if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
	{
		DrawShape(pDC, m_pCurrentShape);
	}
}

// 鼠标左键按下
void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
	m_bDrawing = TRUE;
	m_startPoint = point;
	m_endPoint = point;

	m_pCurrentShape = new DrawingShape();
	m_pCurrentShape->tool = m_currentTool;
	m_pCurrentShape->color = m_currentColor;
	m_pCurrentShape->width = m_penWidth;
	m_pCurrentShape->startPoint = point;
	m_pCurrentShape->endPoint = point;

	if (m_currentTool == TOOL_PEN || m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER)
	{
		m_pCurrentShape->points.Add(point);
	}

	SetCapture();
	CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

// 鼠标移动
void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
	if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
	{
		CClientDC dc(this);

		if (m_currentTool == TOOL_PEN || m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER)
		{
			m_pCurrentShape->points.Add(point);
			
			CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_penWidth, 
				m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER ? RGB(255, 255, 255) : m_currentColor);
			CPen* pOldPen = dc.SelectObject(&pen);
			
			dc.MoveTo(m_endPoint);
			dc.LineTo(point);
			
			dc.SelectObject(pOldPen);
		}
		else
		{
			Invalidate(FALSE);
			m_pCurrentShape->endPoint = point;
		}

		m_endPoint = point;
	}

	CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

// 鼠标左键抬起
void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
	if (m_bDrawing)
	{
		m_bDrawing = FALSE;
		ReleaseCapture();

		if (m_pCurrentShape)
		{
			m_pCurrentShape->endPoint = point;
			m_shapes.Add(m_pCurrentShape);
			m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
			
			// 清空重做栈
			for (int i = 0; i < m_undoStack.GetSize(); i++)
			{
				delete m_undoStack[i];
			}
			m_undoStack.RemoveAll();
			
			GetDocument()->SetModifiedFlag();
			Invalidate();
		}
	}

	CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

// 清空画布
void CDrawingBoardView::ClearCanvas()
{
	// 保存到撤销栈
	for (int i = 0; i < m_shapes.GetSize(); i++)
	{
		m_undoStack.Add(m_shapes[i]);
	}
	
	m_shapes.RemoveAll();
	GetDocument()->SetModifiedFlag();
	Invalidate();
}

// 撤销
void CDrawingBoardView::Undo()
{
	if (m_shapes.GetSize() > 0)
	{
		DrawingShape* shape = m_shapes[m_shapes.GetSize() - 1];
		m_shapes.RemoveAt(m_shapes.GetSize() - 1);
		m_undoStack.Add(shape);
		
		GetDocument()->SetModifiedFlag();
		Invalidate();
	}
}

// 重做
void CDrawingBoardView::Redo()
{
	if (m_undoStack.GetSize() > 0)
	{
		DrawingShape* shape = m_undoStack[m_undoStack.GetSize() - 1];
		m_undoStack.RemoveAt(m_undoStack.GetSize() - 1);
		m_shapes.Add(shape);
		
		GetDocument()->SetModifiedFlag();
		Invalidate();
	}
}

// 是否可以撤销
BOOL CDrawingBoardView::CanUndo() const
{
	return m_shapes.GetSize() > 0;
}

// 是否可以重做
BOOL CDrawingBoardView::CanRedo() const
{
	return m_undoStack.GetSize() > 0;
}

// 保存绘图
void CDrawingBoardView::SaveDrawing(LPCTSTR filename)
{
	CFile file;
	if (file.Open(filename, CFile::modeCreate | CFile::modeWrite))
	{
		CArchive ar(&file, CArchive::store);
		
		// 保存形状数量
		int count = (int)m_shapes.GetSize();
		ar << count;
		
		// 保存每个形状
		for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
		{
			DrawingShape* shape = m_shapes[i];
			ar << (int)shape->tool;
			ar << (DWORD)shape->color;
			ar << shape->width;
			ar << shape->startPoint;
			ar << shape->endPoint;
			
			int pointCount = (int)shape->points.GetSize();
			ar << pointCount;
			for (int j = 0; j < pointCount; j++)
			{
				ar << shape->points[j];
			}
		}
		
		ar.Close();
		file.Close();
		
		AfxMessageBox(_T("保存成功！"), MB_ICONINFORMATION);
	}
}

// 加载绘图
void CDrawingBoardView::LoadDrawing(LPCTSTR filename)
{
	CFile file;
	if (file.Open(filename, CFile::modeRead))
	{
		CArchive ar(&file, CArchive::load);
		
		// 清空当前绘图
		for (int i = 0; i < m_shapes.GetSize(); i++)
		{
			delete m_shapes[i];
		}
		m_shapes.RemoveAll();
		
		// 读取形状数量
		int count;
		ar >> count;
		
		// 读取每个形状
		for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
		{
			DrawingShape* shape = new DrawingShape();
			
			int tool;
			DWORD color;
			ar >> tool;
			ar >> color;
			ar >> shape->width;
			ar >> shape->startPoint;
			ar >> shape->endPoint;
			
			shape->tool = (DrawingTool)tool;
			shape->color = (COLORREF)color;
			
			int pointCount;
			ar >> pointCount;
			for (int j = 0; j < pointCount; j++)
			{
				CPoint pt;
				ar >> pt;
				shape->points.Add(pt);
			}
			
			m_shapes.Add(shape);
		}
		
		ar.Close();
		file.Close();
		
		Invalidate();
		AfxMessageBox(_T("加载成功！"), MB_ICONINFORMATION);
	}
}

		_T("Drawing Files (*.drw)|*.drw|All Files (*.*)|*.*||"));

		SaveDrawing(dlg.GetPathName());
	}

		OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_FILEMUSTEXIST,
		_T("Drawing Files (*.drw)|*.drw|All Files (*.*)|*.*||"));
	
	if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
	{
		LoadDrawing(dlg.GetPathName());
	}
}

📄 DrawingBoardView.cpp (完整文件)
C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
	CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
	ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
	if (!pDoc)
		return;

	// 绘制所有笔画
	const auto& strokes = pDoc->GetStrokes();
	for (const auto& stroke : strokes)
	{
		if (stroke.size() > 1)
		{
			pDC->MoveTo(stroke[0]);
			for (size_t i = 1; i < stroke.size(); i++)
			{
				pDC->LineTo(stroke[i]);
			}
		}
	}
}

// 鼠标左键按下
void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
	m_bDrawing = TRUE;
	m_ptPrevious = point;
	m_currentStroke.clear();
	m_currentStroke.push_back(point);

	SetCapture();
	CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

// 鼠标左键释放
void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
	if (m_bDrawing)
	{
		m_bDrawing = FALSE;
		ReleaseCapture();

		CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
		if (pDoc && m_currentStroke.size() > 1)
		{
			pDoc->AddStroke(m_currentStroke);
		}
		m_currentStroke.clear();
	}

	CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

// 鼠标移动
void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
	if (m_bDrawing)
	{
		CClientDC dc(this);
		dc.MoveTo(m_ptPrevious);
		dc.LineTo(point);

		m_currentStroke.push_back(point);
		m_ptPrevious = point;
	}

	CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardDoc::OnNewDocument()
{
	if (!CDocument::OnNewDocument())
		return FALSE;

	m_strokes.clear();
	m_undoneStrokes.clear();

	return TRUE;
}

void CDrawingBoardDoc::Serialize(CArchive& ar)
{
	if (ar.IsStoring())
	{
		// 保存笔画数量
		size_t strokeCount = m_strokes.size();
		ar << strokeCount;

		// 保存每个笔画
		for (const auto& stroke : m_strokes)
		{
			size_t pointCount = stroke.size();
			ar << pointCount;

			for (const auto& point : stroke)
			{
				ar << point;
			}
		}
	}
	else
	{
		// 加载笔画数量
		size_t strokeCount;
		ar >> strokeCount;

		m_strokes.clear();

		// 加载每个笔画
		for (size_t i = 0; i < strokeCount; i++)
		{
			size_t pointCount;
			ar >> pointCount;

			std::vector<CPoint> stroke;
			for (size_t j = 0; j < pointCount; j++)
			{
				CPoint point;
				ar >> point;
				stroke.push_back(point);
			}

			m_strokes.push_back(stroke);
		}
	}
}

#ifdef SHARED_HANDLERS
void CDrawingBoardDoc::InitializeSearchContent()
{
	CString strSearchContent;
	SetSearchContent(strSearchContent);
}

void CDrawingBoardDoc::SetSearchContent(const CString& value)
{
	if (value.IsEmpty())
	{
		RemoveChunk(PKEY_Search_Contents.fmtid, PKEY_Search_Contents.pid);
	}
	else
	{
		CMFCFilterChunkValueImpl* pChunk = nullptr;
		ATLTRY(pChunk = new CMFCFilterChunkValueImpl);
		if (pChunk != nullptr)
		{
			pChunk->SetTextValue(PKEY_Search_Contents, value, CHUNK_TEXT);
			SetChunkValue(pChunk);
		}
	}
}
#endif

// 添加笔画
void CDrawingBoardDoc::AddStroke(const std::vector<CPoint>& stroke)
{
	m_strokes.push_back(stroke);
	m_undoneStrokes.clear(); // 添加新笔画后清空重做栈
	SetModifiedFlag();
}

// 撤销
void CDrawingBoardDoc::Undo()
{
	if (!m_strokes.empty())
	{
		m_undoneStrokes.push_back(m_strokes.back());
		m_strokes.pop_back();
		SetModifiedFlag();
	}
}

// 重做
void CDrawingBoardDoc::Redo()
{
	if (!m_undoneStrokes.empty())
	{
		m_strokes.push_back(m_undoneStrokes.back());
		m_undoneStrokes.pop_back();
		SetModifiedFlag();
	}
}

// 清空所有
void CDrawingBoardDoc::ClearAll()
{
	if (!m_strokes.empty())
	{
		m_strokes.clear();
		m_undoneStrokes.clear();
		SetModifiedFlag();
	}
}

// 保存到文件
void CDrawingBoardDoc::SaveToFile()
{
	CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("drw"), _T("drawing.drw"),
		OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT,
		_T("Drawing Files (*.drw)|*.drw|All Files (*.*)|*.*||"));

	if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
	{
		CString filePath = dlg.GetPathName();
		std::ofstream file(filePath, std::ios::binary);

		if (file.is_open())
		{
			// 保存笔画数量
			size_t strokeCount = m_strokes.size();
			file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&strokeCount), sizeof(strokeCount));

			// 保存每个笔画
			for (const auto& stroke : m_strokes)
			{
				size_t pointCount = stroke.size();
				file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&pointCount), sizeof(pointCount));

				for (const auto& point : stroke)
				{
					file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&point.x), sizeof(point.x));
					file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&point.y), sizeof(point.y));
				}
			}

			file.close();
			AfxMessageBox(_T("保存成功！"), MB_ICONINFORMATION);
		}
		else
		{
			AfxMessageBox(_T("无法保存文件！"), MB_ICONERROR);
		}
	}
}

// 从文件加载
void CDrawingBoardDoc::LoadFromFile()
{
	CFileDialog dlg(TRUE, _T("drw"), nullptr,
		OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_FILEMUSTEXIST,
		_T("Drawing Files (*.drw)|*.drw|All Files (*.*)|*.*||"));

	if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
	{
		CString filePath = dlg.GetPathName();
		std::ifstream file(filePath, std::ios::binary);

		if (file.is_open())
		{
			m_strokes.clear();
			m_undoneStrokes.clear();

			// 读取笔画数量
			size_t strokeCount;
			file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&strokeCount), sizeof(strokeCount));

			// 读取每个笔画
			for (size_t i = 0; i < strokeCount; i++)
			{
				size_t pointCount;
				file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&pointCount), sizeof(pointCount));

				std::vector<CPoint> stroke;
				for (size_t j = 0; j < pointCount; j++)
				{
					CPoint point;
					file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&point.x), sizeof(point.x));
					file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&point.y), sizeof(point.y));
					stroke.push_back(point);
				}

				m_strokes.push_back(stroke);
			}

			file.close();
			SetModifiedFlag(FALSE);
			AfxMessageBox(_T("加载成功！"), MB_ICONINFORMATION);
		}
		else
		{
			AfxMessageBox(_T("无法打开文件！"), MB_ICONERROR);
		}
	}
}

#include <vector>

class CDrawingBoardView : public CView
{
protected:
    CDrawingBoardView() noexcept;
    DECLARE_DYNCREATE(CDrawingBoardView)

    // 工具类型枚举
    enum DrawingTool {

        TOOL_LINE,

    };

// ========== 绘制函数 ==========
void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc)
        return;

    // 绘制文档中保存的所有笔画
    const auto& strokes = pDoc->GetStrokes();
    for (const auto& stroke : strokes)
    {
        if (stroke.points.size() < 2)
            continue;

        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, stroke.penWidth, stroke.color);
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);

        pDC->MoveTo(stroke.points[0]);
        for (size_t i = 1; i < stroke.points.size(); i++)
        {
            pDC->LineTo(stroke.points[i]);
        }

        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }

    // 绘制当前正在绘制的笔画
    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentStroke.size() > 1)
    {
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_penWidth, m_currentColor);
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);

        pDC->MoveTo(m_currentStroke[0]);
        for (size_t i = 1; i < m_currentStroke.size(); i++)
        {
            pDC->LineTo(m_currentStroke[i]);
        }

        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }
}

// ========== 鼠标事件处理 ==========
void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_isDrawing = true;
    m_currentStroke.clear();
    m_currentStroke.push_back(point);

    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_isDrawing)
    {
        m_isDrawing = false;
        ReleaseCapture();

        if (m_currentStroke.size() > 1)
        {
            CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
            if (pDoc)
            {
                // 根据当前工具类型处理笔画
                switch (m_currentTool)
                {
                case TOOL_PEN:
                    // 铅笔：保存所有点
                    pDoc->AddStroke(m_currentStroke, m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
                    break;

                case TOOL_LINE:
                    // 直线：只保存起点和终点
                    {
                        std::vector<CPoint> linePoints;
                        linePoints.push_back(m_currentStroke.front());
                        linePoints.push_back(m_currentStroke.back());
                        pDoc->AddStroke(linePoints, m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
                    }
                    break;

                case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
                    // 矩形：生成矩形的四条边
                    {
                        CPoint start = m_currentStroke.front();
                        CPoint end = m_currentStroke.back();
                        std::vector<CPoint> rectPoints;
                        rectPoints.push_back(CPoint(start.x, start.y));
                        rectPoints.push_back(CPoint(end.x, start.y));
                        rectPoints.push_back(CPoint(end.x, end.y));
                        rectPoints.push_back(CPoint(start.x, end.y));
                        rectPoints.push_back(CPoint(start.x, start.y));
                        pDoc->AddStroke(rectPoints, m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
                    }
                    break;

                case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
                    // 椭圆：生成椭圆轮廓点
                    {
                        CPoint start = m_currentStroke.front();
                        CPoint end = m_currentStroke.back();
                        std::vector<CPoint> ellipsePoints;
                        
                        int cx = (start.x + end.x) / 2;
                        int cy = (start.y + end.y) / 2;
                        int rx = abs(end.x - start.x) / 2;
                        int ry = abs(end.y - start.y) / 2;

                        for (int angle = 0; angle <= 360; angle += 5)
                        {
                            double radian = angle * 3.14159265 / 180.0;
                            int x = cx + (int)(rx * cos(radian));
                            int y = cy + (int)(ry * sin(radian));
                            ellipsePoints.push_back(CPoint(x, y));
                        }
                        pDoc->AddStroke(ellipsePoints, m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
                    }
                    break;

                case TOOL_ERASER:
                    // 橡皮擦：使用白色粗线
                    pDoc->AddStroke(m_currentStroke, RGB(255, 255, 255), m_penWidth * 3);
                    break;
                }

                pDoc->SetModifiedFlag();
                Invalidate();
            }
        }

        m_currentStroke.clear();
    }

    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_isDrawing)
    {
        m_currentStroke.push_back(point);

        // 实时显示绘制效果
        CClientDC dc(this);
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_penWidth, m_currentColor);
        CPen* pOldPen = dc.SelectObject(&pen);

        if (m_currentStroke.size() > 1)
        {
            size_t lastIndex = m_currentStroke.size() - 1;
            dc.MoveTo(m_currentStroke[lastIndex - 1]);
            dc.LineTo(m_currentStroke[lastIndex]);
        }

        dc.SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }

    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

// ========== 序列化 ==========
void CDrawingBoardDoc::Serialize(CArchive& ar)
{
    if (ar.IsStoring())
    {
        // 保存笔画数量
        int count = (int)m_strokes.size();
        ar << count;

        // 保存每个笔画
        for (const auto& stroke : m_strokes)
        {
            // 保存点的数量
            int pointCount = (int)stroke.points.size();
            ar << pointCount;

            // 保存所有点
            for (const auto& point : stroke.points)
            {
                ar << point;
            }

            // 保存颜色和宽度
            ar << stroke.color;
            ar << stroke.penWidth;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        // 清空现有数据
        m_strokes.clear();
        m_redoStack.clear();

        // 读取笔画数量
        int count;
        ar >> count;

        // 读取每个笔画
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            Stroke stroke;

            // 读取点的数量
            int pointCount;
            ar >> pointCount;

            // 读取所有点
            for (int j = 0; j < pointCount; j++)
            {
                CPoint point;
                ar >> point;
                stroke.points.push_back(point);
            }

            // 读取颜色和宽度
            ar >> stroke.color;
            ar >> stroke.penWidth;

            m_strokes.push_back(stroke);
        }
    }
}

#ifdef SHARED_HANDLERS
void CDrawingBoardDoc::InitializeSearchContent()
{
    CString strSearchContent;
    SetSearchContent(strSearchContent);
}

void CDrawingBoardDoc::SetSearchContent(const CString& value)
{
    if (value.IsEmpty())
    {
        RemoveChunk(PKEY_Search_Contents.fmtid, PKEY_Search_Contents.pid);
    }
    else
    {
        CMFCFilterChunkValueImpl *pChunk = nullptr;
        ATLTRY(pChunk = new CMFCFilterChunkValueImpl);
        if (pChunk != nullptr)
        {
            pChunk->SetTextValue(PKEY_Search_Contents, value, CHUNK_TEXT);
            SetChunkValue(pChunk);
        }
    }
}
#endif

// ========== 绘图操作 ==========
void CDrawingBoardDoc::AddStroke(const std::vector<CPoint>& points, COLORREF color, int penWidth)
{
    if (points.empty())
        return;

    Stroke stroke(points, color, penWidth);
    m_strokes.push_back(stroke);
    
    // 添加新笔画后清空重做栈
    m_redoStack.clear();
    
    SetModifiedFlag();
}

// ========== 撤销/重做 ==========
void CDrawingBoardDoc::Undo()
{
    if (!m_strokes.empty())
    {
        // 将最后一个笔画移到重做栈
        m_redoStack.push_back(m_strokes.back());
        m_strokes.pop_back();
        SetModifiedFlag();
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardDoc::Redo()
{
    if (!m_redoStack.empty())
    {
        // 从重做栈恢复笔画
        m_strokes.push_back(m_redoStack.back());
        m_redoStack.pop_back();
        SetModifiedFlag();
    }
}

// ========== 清空画布 ==========
void CDrawingBoardDoc::Clear()
{
    m_strokes.clear();
    m_redoStack.clear();
    SetModifiedFlag();
}

// ========== 文件操作 ==========
bool CDrawingBoardDoc::SaveToFile(const CString& filename)
{
    try
    {
        CFile file;
        if (!file.Open(filename, CFile::modeCreate | CFile::modeWrite))
            return false;

        CArchive ar(&file, CArchive::store);
        Serialize(ar);
        ar.Close();
        file.Close();

        SetModifiedFlag(FALSE);
        return true;
    }
    catch (...)
    {
        return false;
    }
}

bool CDrawingBoardDoc::LoadFromFile(const CString& filename)
{
    try
    {
        CFile file;
        if (!file.Open(filename, CFile::modeRead))
            return false;

        CArchive ar(&file, CArchive::load);
        Serialize(ar);
        ar.Close();
        file.Close();

        SetModifiedFlag(FALSE);
        return true;
    }
    catch (...)
    {
        return false;
    }
}

    CDocument::AssertValid();

#pragma once
#include <vector>

// 绘图工具枚举
enum DrawingTool
{
    TOOL_PEN = 0,      // 铅笔
    TOOL_LINE,         // 直线
    TOOL_RECTANGLE,    // 矩形
    TOOL_ELLIPSE,      // 椭圆
    TOOL_ERASER        // 橡皮擦
};

class CDrawingBoardView : public CView
{
protected:
    CDrawingBoardView() noexcept;
    DECLARE_DYNCREATE(CDrawingBoardView)

public:
    CDrawingBoardDoc* GetDocument() const;

    // 重写
    virtual void OnDraw(CDC* pDC);
    virtual BOOL PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs);

protected:
    virtual BOOL OnPreparePrinting(CPrintInfo* pInfo);
    virtual void OnBeginPrinting(CDC* pDC, CPrintInfo* pInfo);
    virtual void OnEndPrinting(CDC* pDC, CPrintInfo* pInfo);

public:
    virtual ~CDrawingBoardView();
#ifdef _DEBUG
    virtual void AssertValid() const;
    virtual void Dump(CDumpContext& dc) const;
#endif

protected:
    DECLARE_MESSAGE_MAP()

public:
    // 鼠标事件处理
    afx_msg void OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point);
    afx_msg void OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point);

    afx_msg void OnUpdateEditUndo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI);
    afx_msg void OnUpdateEditRedo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI);
    afx_msg void OnEditClear();

    // 文件操作
    afx_msg void OnFileSave();
    afx_msg void OnFileOpen();

    // 设置绘图工具和属性
    void SetDrawingTool(DrawingTool tool) { m_currentTool = tool; }
    void SetPenColor(COLORREF color) { m_currentColor = color; }
    void SetPenWidth(int width) { m_penWidth = width; }

private:
    bool m_isDrawing;                      // 是否正在绘制
    std::vector<CPoint> m_currentStroke;   // 当前笔画的点集合
    DrawingTool m_currentTool;             // 当前工具
    COLORREF m_currentColor;               // 当前颜色
    int m_penWidth;                        // 画笔宽度

// ========== 绘制函数 ==========
void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc)
        return;

    // 绘制文档中保存的所有笔画
    const auto& strokes = pDoc->GetStrokes();
    for (const auto& stroke : strokes)
    {
        if (stroke.points.size() < 2)
            continue;

        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, stroke.penWidth, stroke.color);
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);

        pDC->MoveTo(stroke.points[0]);
        for (size_t i = 1; i < stroke.points.size(); i++)
        {
            pDC->LineTo(stroke.points[i]);
        }

        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }

    // 绘制当前正在绘制的笔画
    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentStroke.size() > 1)
    {
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_penWidth, m_currentColor);
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);

        pDC->MoveTo(m_currentStroke[0]);
        for (size_t i = 1; i < m_currentStroke.size(); i++)
        {
            pDC->LineTo(m_currentStroke[i]);
        }

        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }
}

// ========== 鼠标事件处理 ==========
void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_isDrawing = true;
    m_currentStroke.clear();
    m_currentStroke.push_back(point);

    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_isDrawing)
    {
        m_isDrawing = false;
        ReleaseCapture();

        if (m_currentStroke.size() > 1)
        {
            CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
            if (pDoc)
            {
                // 根据当前工具类型处理笔画
                switch (m_currentTool)
                {
                case TOOL_PEN:
                    // 铅笔：保存所有点
                    pDoc->AddStroke(m_currentStroke, m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
                    break;

                case TOOL_LINE:
                    // 直线：只保存起点和终点
                    {
                        std::vector<CPoint> linePoints;
                        linePoints.push_back(m_currentStroke.front());
                        linePoints.push_back(m_currentStroke.back());
                        pDoc->AddStroke(linePoints, m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
                    }
                    break;

                case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
                    // 矩形：生成矩形的四条边
                    {
                        CPoint start = m_currentStroke.front();
                        CPoint end = m_currentStroke.back();
                        std::vector<CPoint> rectPoints;
                        rectPoints.push_back(CPoint(start.x, start.y));
                        rectPoints.push_back(CPoint(end.x, start.y));
                        rectPoints.push_back(CPoint(end.x, end.y));
                        rectPoints.push_back(CPoint(start.x, end.y));
                        rectPoints.push_back(CPoint(start.x, start.y));
                        pDoc->AddStroke(rectPoints, m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
                    }
                    break;

                case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
                    // 椭圆：生成椭圆轮廓点
                    {
                        CPoint start = m_currentStroke.front();
                        CPoint end = m_currentStroke.back();
                        std::vector<CPoint> ellipsePoints;
                        
                        int cx = (start.x + end.x) / 2;
                        int cy = (start.y + end.y) / 2;
                        int rx = abs(end.x - start.x) / 2;
                        int ry = abs(end.y - start.y) / 2;

                        for (int angle = 0; angle <= 360; angle += 5)
                        {
                            double radian = angle * 3.14159265 / 180.0;
                            int x = cx + (int)(rx * cos(radian));
                            int y = cy + (int)(ry * sin(radian));
                            ellipsePoints.push_back(CPoint(x, y));
                        }
                        pDoc->AddStroke(ellipsePoints, m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
                    }
                    break;

                case TOOL_ERASER:
                    // 橡皮擦：使用白色粗线
                    pDoc->AddStroke(m_currentStroke, RGB(255, 255, 255), m_penWidth * 3);
                    break;
                }

                pDoc->SetModifiedFlag();
                Invalidate();
            }
        }

        m_currentStroke.clear();
    }

    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_isDrawing)
    {
        m_currentStroke.push_back(point);

        // 实时显示绘制效果
        CClientDC dc(this);
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_penWidth, m_currentColor);
        CPen* pOldPen = dc.SelectObject(&pen);

        if (m_currentStroke.size() > 1)
        {
            size_t lastIndex = m_currentStroke.size() - 1;
            dc.MoveTo(m_currentStroke[lastIndex - 1]);
            dc.LineTo(m_currentStroke[lastIndex]);
        }

        dc.SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }

    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

// ========== 文件操作 ==========
void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileSave()
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    if (pDoc)
    {
        CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("drw"), NULL,
            OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT,
            _T("Drawing Files (*.drw)|*.drw|All Files (*.*)|*.*||"));

        if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
        {
            pDoc->SaveToFile(dlg.GetPathName());
        }
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileOpen()
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    if (pDoc)
    {
        CFileDialog dlg(TRUE, _T("drw"), NULL,
            OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_FILEMUSTEXIST,
            _T("Drawing Files (*.drw)|*.drw|All Files (*.*)|*.*||"));

        if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
        {
            pDoc->LoadFromFile(dlg.GetPathName());
            Invalidate();
        }
    }
}

int CMainFrame::OnCreate(LPCREATESTRUCT lpCreateStruct)
{
    if (CFrameWnd::OnCreate(lpCreateStruct) == -1)
        return -1;

    // 创建标准工具栏
    if (!m_wndToolBar.CreateEx(this, TBSTYLE_FLAT, 
        WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | CBRS_TOP | CBRS_GRIPPER | 
        CBRS_TOOLTIPS | CBRS_FLYBY | CBRS_SIZE_DYNAMIC) ||
        !m_wndToolBar.LoadToolBar(IDR_MAINFRAME))
    {
        TRACE0("Failed to create toolbar\n");
        return -1;
    }

    // 创建状态栏
    if (!m_wndStatusBar.Create(this))
    {
        TRACE0("Failed to create status bar\n");
        return -1;
    }
    m_wndStatusBar.SetIndicators(indicators, sizeof(indicators)/sizeof(UINT));

    // 允许工具栏停靠
    m_wndToolBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    DockControlBar(&m_wndToolBar);

    return 0;
}

        return FALSE;

    return TRUE;

    EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    DockControlBar(&m_wndToolBar);

    return 0;
}

BOOL CMainFrame::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)

}

好的！这3个错误都在 DrawingBoardView.h 中。让我给你完整的修改后的代码：

📄 DrawingBoardView.h（完整修改版）
C++
 |
#pragma once

// 绘图工具类型枚举
enum DrawingTool
{
    TOOL_PEN = 0,
    TOOL_LINE,
    TOOL_RECTANGLE,
    TOOL_ELLIPSE,
    TOOL_ERASER
};

// 图形基类
class CShape
{
public:
    COLORREF m_color;
    int m_nPenWidth;

    CShape() : m_color(RGB(0, 0, 0)), m_nPenWidth(1) {}
    virtual ~CShape() {}
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) = 0;
};

// 自由画笔
class CPenShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CArray<CPoint, CPoint&> m_points;

    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) override
    {
        if (m_points.GetSize() < 2) return;

        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nPenWidth, m_color);
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);

        pDC->MoveTo(m_points[0]);
        for (int i = 1; i < m_points.GetSize(); i++)
        {
            pDC->LineTo(m_points[i]);
        }

        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }
};

// 直线
class CLineShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CPoint m_ptStart;
    CPoint m_ptEnd;

    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) override
    {
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nPenWidth, m_color);
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);

        pDC->MoveTo(m_ptStart);
        pDC->LineTo(m_ptEnd);

        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }
};

// 矩形
class CRectangleShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CPoint m_ptStart;
    CPoint m_ptEnd;

    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) override
    {
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nPenWidth, m_color);
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
        CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);

        pDC->Rectangle(CRect(m_ptStart, m_ptEnd));

        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
        pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    }
};

// 椭圆
class CEllipseShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CPoint m_ptStart;
    CPoint m_ptEnd;

    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) override
    {
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nPenWidth, m_color);
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
        CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);

        pDC->Ellipse(CRect(m_ptStart, m_ptEnd));

        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
        pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    }
};

// 橡皮擦
class CEraserShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CArray<CPoint, CPoint&> m_points;

    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) override
    {
        if (m_points.GetSize() < 2) return;

        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nPenWidth * 3, RGB(255, 255, 255));
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);

        pDC->MoveTo(m_points[0]);
        for (int i = 1; i < m_points.GetSize(); i++)
        {
            pDC->LineTo(m_points[i]);
        }

        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }
};

// View 类
class CDrawingBoardView : public CView
{
protected:
    CDrawingBoardView() noexcept;
    DECLARE_DYNCREATE(CDrawingBoardView)

public:
    class CDrawingBoardDoc* GetDocument() const;

    virtual void OnDraw(CDC* pDC) override;
    virtual BOOL PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs) override;

#ifdef _DEBUG
    virtual void AssertValid() const;
    virtual void Dump(CDumpContext& dc) const;
#endif

public:
    virtual ~CDrawingBoardView();

protected:
    DECLARE_MESSAGE_MAP()

public:
    // 绘图相关成员变量
    CArray<CShape*, CShape*> m_shapes;      // 所有图形
    CShape* m_pCurrentShape;                 // 当前正在绘制的图形
    
    DrawingTool m_currentTool;               // 当前工具
    COLORREF m_currentColor;                 // 当前颜色
    int m_nPenWidth;                         // 画笔粗细
    
    BOOL m_bDrawing;                         // 是否正在绘图
    CPoint m_ptStart;                        // 起始点
    CPoint m_ptPrevious;                     // 前一个点

    // 公共接口
    void SetDrawingTool(DrawingTool tool);
    void SetPenColor(COLORREF color);
    void SetPenWidth(int width);
    void ClearAll();

    // 消息处理
    afx_msg void OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point);
    afx_msg void OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point);
    afx_msg void OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point);
};

#ifndef _DEBUG
inline CDrawingBoardDoc* CDrawingBoardView::GetDocument() const
{
    return reinterpret_cast<CDrawingBoardDoc*>(m_pDocument);
}
#endif
📄 DrawingBoardView.cpp（对应的实现文件）
C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif

#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

IMPLEMENT_DYNCREATE(CDrawingBoardView, CView)

BEGIN_MESSAGE_MAP(CDrawingBoardView, CView)
    ON_WM_LBUTTONDOWN()
    ON_WM_LBUTTONUP()
    ON_WM_MOUSEMOVE()
END_MESSAGE_MAP()

// ========== 构造和析构 ==========
CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
    : m_currentTool(TOOL_PEN)
    , m_currentColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
    , m_nPenWidth(1)
    , m_bDrawing(FALSE)
    , m_pCurrentShape(nullptr)
{
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    // 清理所有图形
    for (int i = 0; i < m_shapes.GetSize(); i++)
    {
        delete m_shapes[i];
    }
    m_shapes.RemoveAll();

    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        delete m_pCurrentShape;
        m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

// ========== 绘图函数 ==========
void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc)
        return;

    // 绘制所有已完成的图形
    for (int i = 0; i < m_shapes.GetSize(); i++)
    {
        m_shapes[i]->Draw(pDC);
    }

    // 绘制当前正在绘制的图形
    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_pCurrentShape->Draw(pDC);
    }
}

// ========== 鼠标事件 ==========
void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    m_ptStart = point;
    m_ptPrevious = point;

    // 根据当前工具创建对应的图形对象
    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case TOOL_PEN:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CPenShape();
        ((CPenShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_points.Add(point);
        break;

    case TOOL_LINE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CLineShape();
        ((CLineShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_ptStart = point;
        ((CLineShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_ptEnd = point;
        break;

    case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CRectangleShape();
        ((CRectangleShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_ptStart = point;
        ((CRectangleShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_ptEnd = point;
        break;

    case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CEllipseShape();
        ((CEllipseShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_ptStart = point;
        ((CEllipseShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_ptEnd = point;
        break;

    case TOOL_ERASER:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CEraserShape();
        ((CEraserShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_points.Add(point);
        break;
    }

    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_pCurrentShape->m_color = m_currentColor;
        m_pCurrentShape->m_nPenWidth = m_nPenWidth;
    }

    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        switch (m_currentTool)
        {
        case TOOL_PEN:
            ((CPenShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_points.Add(point);
            break;

        case TOOL_LINE:
            ((CLineShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_ptEnd = point;
            break;

        case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
            ((CRectangleShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_ptEnd = point;
            break;

        case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
            ((CEllipseShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_ptEnd = point;
            break;

        case TOOL_ERASER:
            ((CEraserShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_points.Add(point);
            break;
        }

        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }

    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;

        if (m_pCurrentShape)
        {
            m_shapes.Add(m_pCurrentShape);
            m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
        }

        ReleaseCapture();
        Invalidate();
    }

    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

// ========== 公共接口 ==========
void CDrawingBoardView::SetDrawingTool(DrawingTool tool)
{
    m_currentTool = tool;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::SetPenColor(COLORREF color)
{
    m_currentColor = color;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::SetPenWidth(int width)
{
    m_nPenWidth = width;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::ClearAll()
{
    for (int i = 0; i < m_shapes.GetSize(); i++)
    {
        delete m_shapes[i];
    }
    m_shapes.RemoveAll();

    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        delete m_pCurrentShape;
        m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
    }

    Invalidate();
}

// ========== 调试 ==========
#ifdef _DEBUG
void CDrawingBoardView::AssertValid() const
{
    CView::AssertValid();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::Dump(CDumpContext& dc) const
{
    CView::Dump(dc);
}

CDrawingBoardDoc* CDrawingBoardView::GetDocument() const
{
    ASSERT(m_pDocument->IsKindOf(RUNTIME_CLASS(CDrawingBoardDoc)));
    return (CDrawingBoardDoc*)m_pDocument;
}
#endif //_DEBUG

int CMainFrame::OnCreate(LPCREATESTRUCT lpCreateStruct)
{
    if (CFrameWnd::OnCreate(lpCreateStruct) == -1)
        return -1;

    // 创建工具栏（不加载位图）
    if (!m_wndToolBar.CreateEx(this, TBSTYLE_FLAT | TBSTYLE_LIST,
        WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | CBRS_TOP | CBRS_GRIPPER | 
        CBRS_TOOLTIPS | CBRS_FLYBY | CBRS_SIZE_DYNAMIC))
    {
        TRACE0("Failed to create toolbar\n");
        return -1;
    }

    // 定义按钮数组

        IDS_TOOL_PEN,
        IDS_TOOL_LINE,
        IDS_TOOL_RECTANGLE,
        IDS_TOOL_ELLIPSE,
        IDS_TOOL_ERASER,
        ID_SEPARATOR,
        IDS_COLOR_BLACK,
        IDS_COLOR_RED,
        IDS_COLOR_GREEN,
        IDS_COLOR_BLUE,
        ID_SEPARATOR,
        IDS_SIZE_THIN,
        IDS_SIZE_MEDIUM,
        IDS_SIZE_THICK
    };

    m_wndToolBar.SetButtons(buttons, sizeof(buttons) / sizeof(UINT));

// 绘图工具命令ID
#define ID_TOOL_PEN                     32771
#define ID_TOOL_LINE                    32772
#define ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE               32773
#define ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE                 32774

// 颜色命令ID

🔸 步骤3：完整的 DrawingBoardView.h
C++
 |
#pragma once

// 绘图工具类型枚举
enum DrawingTool
{
    TOOL_PEN = 0,
    TOOL_LINE,
    TOOL_RECTANGLE,
    TOOL_ELLIPSE,
    TOOL_ERASER
};

// 图形基类
class CShape
{
public:
    COLORREF m_color;
    int m_nPenWidth;

    CShape() : m_color(RGB(0, 0, 0)), m_nPenWidth(1) {}
    virtual ~CShape() {}
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) = 0;
};

// 自由画笔
class CPenShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CArray<CPoint, CPoint&> m_points;
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) override;
};

// 直线
class CLineShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CPoint m_ptStart;
    CPoint m_ptEnd;
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) override;
};

// 矩形
class CRectangleShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CPoint m_ptStart;
    CPoint m_ptEnd;
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) override;
};

// 椭圆
class CEllipseShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CPoint m_ptStart;
    CPoint m_ptEnd;
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) override;
};

// 橡皮擦
class CEraserShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CArray<CPoint, CPoint&> m_points;
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) override;
};

// View 类
class CDrawingBoardView : public CView
{
protected:
    CDrawingBoardView() noexcept;
    DECLARE_DYNCREATE(CDrawingBoardView)

public:
    class CDrawingBoardDoc* GetDocument() const;
    virtual void OnDraw(CDC* pDC) override;
    virtual BOOL PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs) override;

#ifdef _DEBUG
    virtual void AssertValid() const;
    virtual void Dump(CDumpContext& dc) const;
#endif

public:
    virtual ~CDrawingBoardView();

protected:
    DECLARE_MESSAGE_MAP()

public:
    // 绘图相关成员变量
    CArray<CShape*, CShape*> m_shapes;
    CShape* m_pCurrentShape;
    
    DrawingTool m_currentTool;
    COLORREF m_currentColor;
    int m_nPenWidth;
    
    BOOL m_bDrawing;
    CPoint m_ptStart;
    CPoint m_ptPrevious;

    // 鼠标消息
    afx_msg void OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point);
    afx_msg void OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point);
    afx_msg void OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point);

    // 工具菜单命令
    afx_msg void OnToolPen();
    afx_msg void OnToolLine();
    afx_msg void OnToolRectangle();
    afx_msg void OnToolEllipse();
    afx_msg void OnToolEraser();

    // 颜色菜单命令
    afx_msg void OnColorBlack();
    afx_msg void OnColorRed();
    afx_msg void OnColorGreen();
    afx_msg void OnColorBlue();
    afx_msg void OnColorYellow();

    // 粗细菜单命令
    afx_msg void OnSizeThin();
    afx_msg void OnSizeMedium();
    afx_msg void OnSizeThick();

    // 清空命令
    afx_msg void OnEditClear();
};

#ifndef _DEBUG

    return reinterpret_cast<CDrawingBoardDoc*>(m_pDocument);

C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif

#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

IMPLEMENT_DYNCREATE(CDrawingBoardView, CView)

BEGIN_MESSAGE_MAP(CDrawingBoardView, CView)
    // 鼠标消息
    ON_WM_LBUTTONDOWN()
    ON_WM_LBUTTONUP()
    ON_WM_MOUSEMOVE()
    
    // 工具菜单
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_PEN, &CDrawingBoardView::OnToolPen)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_LINE, &CDrawingBoardView::OnToolLine)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE, &CDrawingBoardView::OnToolRectangle)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE, &CDrawingBoardView::OnToolEllipse)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_ERASER, &CDrawingBoardView::OnToolEraser)
    
    // 颜色菜单
    ON_COMMAND(ID_COLOR_BLACK, &CDrawingBoardView::OnColorBlack)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_COLOR_RED, &CDrawingBoardView::OnColorRed)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_COLOR_GREEN, &CDrawingBoardView::OnColorGreen)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_COLOR_BLUE, &CDrawingBoardView::OnColorBlue)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_COLOR_YELLOW, &CDrawingBoardView::OnColorYellow)

    ON_COMMAND(ID_SIZE_MEDIUM, &CDrawingBoardView::OnSizeMedium)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_SIZE_THICK, &CDrawingBoardView::OnSizeThick)
    
    // 清空
    ON_COMMAND(ID_EDIT_CLEAR, &CDrawingBoardView::OnEditClear)
END_MESSAGE_MAP()

// ========== 图形类实现 ==========
void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (m_points.GetSize() < 2) return;

    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nPenWidth, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);

    pDC->MoveTo(m_points[0]);
    for (int i = 1; i < m_points.GetSize(); i++)
    {
        pDC->LineTo(m_points[i]);
    }

    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nPenWidth, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);

    pDC->MoveTo(m_ptStart);
    pDC->LineTo(m_ptEnd);

    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nPenWidth, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);

    pDC->Rectangle(CRect(m_ptStart, m_ptEnd));

    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nPenWidth, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);

    pDC->Ellipse(CRect(m_ptStart, m_ptEnd));

    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (m_points.GetSize() < 2) return;

    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nPenWidth * 3, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);

    pDC->MoveTo(m_points[0]);
    for (int i = 1; i < m_points.GetSize(); i++)
    {
        pDC->LineTo(m_points[i]);
    }

    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

// ========== 构造和析构 ==========
CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
    : m_currentTool(TOOL_PEN)
    , m_currentColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
    , m_nPenWidth(2)
    , m_bDrawing(FALSE)
    , m_pCurrentShape(nullptr)
{
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    for (int i = 0; i < m_shapes.GetSize(); i++)
    {
        delete m_shapes[i];
    }
    m_shapes.RemoveAll();

    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        delete m_pCurrentShape;
        m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

// ========== 绘图 ==========
void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc)
        return;

    // 白色背景
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    pDC->FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));

    // 绘制所有图形
    for (int i = 0; i < m_shapes.GetSize(); i++)
    {
        m_shapes[i]->Draw(pDC);
    }

    // 绘制当前图形
    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_pCurrentShape->Draw(pDC);
    }
}

// ========== 鼠标事件 ==========
void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    m_ptStart = point;

    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case TOOL_PEN:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CPenShape();
        ((CPenShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_points.Add(point);
        break;

    case TOOL_LINE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CLineShape();
        ((CLineShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_ptStart = point;
        ((CLineShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_ptEnd = point;
        break;

    case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CRectangleShape();
        ((CRectangleShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_ptStart = point;
        ((CRectangleShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_ptEnd = point;
        break;

    case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CEllipseShape();
        ((CEllipseShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_ptStart = point;
        ((CEllipseShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_ptEnd = point;
        break;

    case TOOL_ERASER:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CEraserShape();
        ((CEraserShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_points.Add(point);
        break;
    }

    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_pCurrentShape->m_color = m_currentColor;
        m_pCurrentShape->m_nPenWidth = m_nPenWidth;
    }

    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        switch (m_currentTool)
        {
        case TOOL_PEN:
            ((CPenShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_points.Add(point);
            break;

        case TOOL_LINE:
            ((CLineShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_ptEnd = point;
            break;

        case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
            ((CRectangleShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_ptEnd = point;
            break;

        case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
            ((CEllipseShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_ptEnd = point;
            break;

        case TOOL_ERASER:
            ((CEraserShape*)m_pCurrentShape)->m_points.Add(point);
            break;
        }

        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }

    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;

        if (m_pCurrentShape)
        {
            m_shapes.Add(m_pCurrentShape);
            m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
        }

        ReleaseCapture();
        Invalidate();
    }

    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

是的！就在这里添加。让我详细教你：

📝 在菜单编辑器中添加菜单项
1️⃣ 添加"编辑"菜单的"清空画板"
点击编辑(E) 菜单
在最后一个菜单项（粘贴）下面，点击空白处
右键 → 选择"插入"
在属性窗口中设置：
ID: ID_EDIT_CLEAR
标题: 清空画板(&L)
2️⃣ 添加"工具"菜单（新菜单）
在顶部菜单栏，找到"视图(V)"右边的空白处

右键 → "插入" → 会出现一个新的顶级菜单

设置这个新菜单的属性：

ID: 留空（Pop-up）
标题: 工具(&T)
点击"工具(&T)"，在下拉菜单中添加子菜单项：

标题	ID
画笔(&P)	ID_TOOL_PEN
直线(&L)	ID_TOOL_LINE
矩形(&R)	ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE
椭圆(&E)	ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE
橡皮擦(&A)	ID_TOOL_ERASER
3️⃣ 添加"颜色"菜单
在"工具(&T)"右边添加新菜单：

顶级菜单：

标题: 颜色(&C)
子菜单：

标题	ID
黑色(&B)	ID_COLOR_BLACK
红色(&R)	ID_COLOR_RED
绿色(&G)	ID_COLOR_GREEN
蓝色(&L)	ID_COLOR_BLUE
黄色(&Y)	ID_COLOR_YELLOW
4️⃣ 添加"粗细"菜单
在"颜色(&C)"右边添加新菜单：

顶级菜单：

标题: 粗细(&W)
子菜单：

标题	ID
细(&T)	ID_SIZE_THIN
中(&M)	ID_SIZE_MEDIUM
粗(&H)	ID_SIZE_THICK
🎯 添加后的菜单结构应该是这样的：
 |
文件(F)  编辑(E)  工具(T)  颜色(C)  粗细(W)  视图(V)  帮助(H)
点击每个菜单会有对应的下拉选项。

⚠️ 重要提醒
每添加一个菜单项时，确保：

✅ ID 要和 resource.h 中定义的一致
✅ 标题中的 (&X) 是快捷键，比如 工具(&T) 按 Alt+T 可快速打开
✅ 如果是分隔符，右键选择"分隔符"即可
完成后保存，编译运行，你就能在菜单栏看到新增的菜单了！🎉

#pragma once

#include <vector>

// 绘图工具类型
enum DrawingTool
{
    TOOL_PEN,
    TOOL_LINE,
    TOOL_RECTANGLE,
    TOOL_ELLIPSE,
    TOOL_ERASER
};

// 图形基类
class CShape
{
public:
    DrawingTool m_tool;
    COLORREF m_color;
    int m_nWidth;
    std::vector<CPoint> m_points;

    CShape(DrawingTool tool, COLORREF color, int width)
        : m_tool(tool), m_color(color), m_nWidth(width) {}
    
    virtual ~CShape() {}
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) = 0;
};

// 自由画笔
class CPenShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CPenShape(COLORREF color, int width) : CShape(TOOL_PEN, color, width) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) override;
};

// 直线
class CLineShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CLineShape(COLORREF color, int width) : CShape(TOOL_LINE, color, width) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) override;
};

// 矩形
class CRectangleShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CRectangleShape(COLORREF color, int width) : CShape(TOOL_RECTANGLE, color, width) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) override;
};

// 椭圆
class CEllipseShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CEllipseShape(COLORREF color, int width) : CShape(TOOL_ELLIPSE, color, width) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) override;
};

// 橡皮擦
class CEraserShape : public CShape
{
public:
    CEraserShape(int width) : CShape(TOOL_ERASER, RGB(255, 255, 255), width) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) override;
};

#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif
#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"
#include "resource.h"

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

// 图形类实现
void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nWidth, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    if (m_points.size() > 1)
    {
        pDC->MoveTo(m_points[0]);
        for (size_t i = 1; i < m_points.size(); i++)
        {
            pDC->LineTo(m_points[i]);
        }
    }
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (m_points.size() >= 2)
    {
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nWidth, m_color);
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
        pDC->MoveTo(m_points[0]);
        pDC->LineTo(m_points[1]);
        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (m_points.size() >= 2)
    {
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nWidth, m_color);
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
        CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
        pDC->Rectangle(CRect(m_points[0], m_points[1]));
        pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (m_points.size() >= 2)
    {
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nWidth, m_color);
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
        CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
        pDC->Ellipse(CRect(m_points[0], m_points[1]));
        pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nWidth, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    if (m_points.size() > 1)
    {
        pDC->MoveTo(m_points[0]);
        for (size_t i = 1; i < m_points.size(); i++)
        {
            pDC->LineTo(m_points[i]);
        }
    }
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

// 构造/析构
CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
{
    m_currentTool = TOOL_PEN;
    m_currentColor = RGB(0, 0, 0);
    m_nPenWidth = 1;
    m_bDrawing = FALSE;
    m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    for (auto shape : m_shapes)
    {
        delete shape;
    }
    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        delete m_pCurrentShape;
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

// 绘图
void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc)
        return;

    // 绘制所有已保存的图形
    for (auto shape : m_shapes)
    {
        shape->Draw(pDC);
    }

    // 绘制当前正在绘制的图形
    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_pCurrentShape->Draw(pDC);
    }
}

// 鼠标消息处理
void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    m_ptStart = point;
    m_ptEnd = point;
    SetCapture();

    // 创建当前图形对象
    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case TOOL_PEN:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CPenShape(m_currentColor, m_nPenWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_LINE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CLineShape(m_currentColor, m_nPenWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CRectangleShape(m_currentColor, m_nPenWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CEllipseShape(m_currentColor, m_nPenWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_ERASER:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CEraserShape(m_nPenWidth * 3);
        break;
    }

    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_pCurrentShape->m_points.push_back(point);
    }

    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_ptEnd = point;

        if (m_currentTool == TOOL_PEN || m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER)
        {
            m_pCurrentShape->m_points.push_back(point);
        }
        else
        {
            if (m_pCurrentShape->m_points.size() == 1)
            {
                m_pCurrentShape->m_points.push_back(point);
            }
            else
            {
                m_pCurrentShape->m_points[1] = point;
            }
        }

        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }

    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;
        ReleaseCapture();

        if (m_pCurrentShape)
        {
            m_shapes.push_back(m_pCurrentShape);
            m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
        }

        Invalidate();
    }

    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}
