#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#include "MainFrm.h"

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

// CMainFrame

IMPLEMENT_DYNCREATE(CMainFrame, CFrameWndEx)

BEGIN_MESSAGE_MAP(CMainFrame, CFrameWndEx)
    ON_WM_CREATE()
    ON_COMMAND(ID_VIEW_CUSTOMIZE, &CMainFrame::OnViewCustomize)
    ON_REGISTERED_MESSAGE(AFX_WM_CREATETOOLBAR, &CMainFrame::OnToolbarCreateNew)
END_MESSAGE_MAP()

static UINT indicators[] =
{
    ID_SEPARATOR,
    ID_INDICATOR_CAPS,
    ID_INDICATOR_NUM,
    ID_INDICATOR_SCRL,
};

// 构造/析构
CMainFrame::CMainFrame() noexcept
{
}

CMainFrame::~CMainFrame()
{
}

int CMainFrame::OnCreate(LPCREATESTRUCT lpCreateStruct)
{
    if (CFrameWndEx::OnCreate(lpCreateStruct) == -1)
        return -1;

    BOOL bNameValid;

    // 创建菜单栏
    if (!m_wndMenuBar.Create(this))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建菜单栏\n");
        return -1;
    }
    m_wndMenuBar.SetPaneStyle(m_wndMenuBar.GetPaneStyle() | CBRS_SIZE_DYNAMIC | CBRS_TOOLTIPS | CBRS_FLYBY);
    CMFCPopupMenu::SetForceMenuFocus(FALSE);

    // 创建工具栏
    if (!m_wndToolBar.CreateEx(this, TBSTYLE_FLAT, WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | CBRS_TOP | CBRS_GRIPPER | CBRS_TOOLTIPS | CBRS_FLYBY | CBRS_SIZE_DYNAMIC) ||
        !m_wndToolBar.LoadToolBar(IDR_MAINFRAME))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建工具栏\n");
        return -1;
    }

    CString strToolBarName;
    bNameValid = strToolBarName.LoadString(IDS_TOOLBAR_STANDARD);
    ASSERT(bNameValid);
    m_wndToolBar.SetWindowText(strToolBarName);

    CString strCustomize;
    bNameValid = strCustomize.LoadString(IDS_TOOLBAR_CUSTOMIZE);
    ASSERT(bNameValid);
    m_wndToolBar.EnableCustomizeButton(TRUE, ID_VIEW_CUSTOMIZE, strCustomize);

    // 创建状态栏
    if (!m_wndStatusBar.Create(this))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建状态栏\n");
        return -1;
    }
    m_wndStatusBar.SetIndicators(indicators, sizeof(indicators)/sizeof(UINT));

    // 允许停靠
    m_wndMenuBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    m_wndToolBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    DockPane(&m_wndMenuBar);
    DockPane(&m_wndToolBar);

    // 启用工具栏和菜单栏的自定义
    EnablePaneMenu(TRUE, ID_VIEW_CUSTOMIZE, strCustomize, ID_VIEW_TOOLBAR);

    // 启用快速自定义工具栏按钮
    CMFCToolBar::EnableQuickCustomization();

    return 0;
}

BOOL CMainFrame::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    if( !CFrameWndEx::PreCreateWindow(cs) )
        return FALSE;

    return TRUE;
}

void CMainFrame::OnViewCustomize()
{
    CMFCToolBarsCustomizeDialog* pDlgCust = new CMFCToolBarsCustomizeDialog(this, TRUE);
    pDlgCust->EnableUserDefinedToolbars();
    pDlgCust->Create();
}

LRESULT CMainFrame::OnToolbarCreateNew(WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp)
{
    LRESULT lres = CFrameWndEx::OnToolbarCreateNew(wp, lp);
    if (lres == 0)
    {
        return 0;
    }

    CMFCToolBar* pUserToolbar = (CMFCToolBar*)lres;
    ASSERT_VALID(pUserToolbar);

    BOOL bNameValid;
    CString strCustomize;
    bNameValid = strCustomize.LoadString(IDS_TOOLBAR_CUSTOMIZE);
    ASSERT(bNameValid);

    pUserToolbar->EnableCustomizeButton(TRUE, ID_VIEW_CUSTOMIZE, strCustomize);
    return lres;
}

BOOL CMainFrame::LoadFrame(UINT nIDResource, DWORD dwDefaultStyle, CWnd* pParentWnd, CCreateContext* pContext) 
{
    if (!CFrameWndEx::LoadFrame(nIDResource, dwDefaultStyle, pParentWnd, pContext))
    {
        return FALSE;
    }

    // 启用所有用户定义的工具栏的自定义按钮
    BOOL bNameValid;
    CString strCustomize;
    bNameValid = strCustomize.LoadString(IDS_TOOLBAR_CUSTOMIZE);
    ASSERT(bNameValid);

    for (int i = 0; i < iMaxUserToolbars; i ++)
    {
        CMFCToolBar* pUserToolbar = GetUserToolBarByIndex(i);
        if (pUserToolbar != nullptr)
        {
            pUserToolbar->EnableCustomizeButton(TRUE, ID_VIEW_CUSTOMIZE, strCustomize);
        }
    }

    return TRUE;
}

int CMainFrame::OnCreate(LPCREATESTRUCT lpCreateStruct)
{
    if (CFrameWndEx::OnCreate(lpCreateStruct) == -1)
        return -1;

    // 创建菜单栏
    if (!m_wndMenuBar.Create(this))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建菜单栏\n");
        return -1;
    }
    m_wndMenuBar.SetPaneStyle(m_wndMenuBar.GetPaneStyle() | 
        CBRS_SIZE_DYNAMIC | CBRS_TOOLTIPS | CBRS_FLYBY);

    // 阻止菜单栏在激活时获得焦点
    CMFCPopupMenu::SetForceMenuFocus(FALSE);

    // 创建工具栏
    if (!m_wndToolBar.CreateEx(this, TBSTYLE_FLAT, 
        WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | CBRS_TOP | CBRS_GRIPPER | 
        CBRS_TOOLTIPS | CBRS_FLYBY | CBRS_SIZE_DYNAMIC) ||
        !m_wndToolBar.LoadToolBar(IDR_MAINFRAME))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建工具栏\n");
        return -1;
    }

    CString strToolBarName;
    if (strToolBarName.LoadString(IDS_TOOLBAR_STANDARD))
    {
        m_wndToolBar.SetWindowText(strToolBarName);
    }

    // 创建状态栏
    if (!m_wndStatusBar.Create(this))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建状态栏\n");
        return -1;
    }
    m_wndStatusBar.SetIndicators(indicators, sizeof(indicators)/sizeof(UINT));

    // 允许菜单栏和工具栏停靠
    m_wndMenuBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    m_wndToolBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    DockPane(&m_wndMenuBar);
    DockPane(&m_wndToolBar);

    return 0;
}

📋 DrawingBoardView.cpp (完整代码)
C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif
#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

// 图形类实现
void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nWidth, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    if (m_points.size() > 1)
    {
        pDC->MoveTo(m_points[0]);
        for (size_t i = 1; i < m_points.size(); i++)
        {
            pDC->LineTo(m_points[i]);
        }
    }
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (m_points.size() >= 2)
    {
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nWidth, m_color);
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
        pDC->MoveTo(m_points[0]);
        pDC->LineTo(m_points[1]);
        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (m_points.size() >= 2)
    {
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nWidth, m_color);
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
        CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
        pDC->Rectangle(CRect(m_points[0], m_points[1]));
        pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (m_points.size() >= 2)
    {
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nWidth, m_color);
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
        CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
        pDC->Ellipse(CRect(m_points[0], m_points[1]));
        pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nWidth, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    if (m_points.size() > 1)
    {
        pDC->MoveTo(m_points[0]);
        for (size_t i = 1; i < m_points.size(); i++)
        {
            pDC->LineTo(m_points[i]);
        }
    }
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

// 构造/析构
CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
{
    m_currentTool = TOOL_PEN;
    m_currentColor = RGB(0, 0, 0);
    m_nPenWidth = 1;
    m_bDrawing = FALSE;
    m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    for (auto shape : m_shapes)
    {
        delete shape;
    }
    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        delete m_pCurrentShape;
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

// 绘图
void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc)
        return;

    // 绘制所有已保存的图形
    for (auto shape : m_shapes)
    {
        shape->Draw(pDC);
    }

    // 绘制当前正在绘制的图形
    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_pCurrentShape->Draw(pDC);
    }
}

// 鼠标消息处理
void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    m_ptStart = point;
    m_ptEnd = point;
    SetCapture();

    // 创建当前图形对象
    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case TOOL_PEN:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CPenShape(m_currentColor, m_nPenWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_LINE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CLineShape(m_currentColor, m_nPenWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CRectangleShape(m_currentColor, m_nPenWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CEllipseShape(m_currentColor, m_nPenWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_ERASER:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CEraserShape(m_nPenWidth * 3);
        break;
    }

    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_pCurrentShape->m_points.push_back(point);
    }

    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_ptEnd = point;

        if (m_currentTool == TOOL_PEN || m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER)
        {
            m_pCurrentShape->m_points.push_back(point);
        }
        else
        {
            if (m_pCurrentShape->m_points.size() == 1)
            {
                m_pCurrentShape->m_points.push_back(point);
            }
            else
            {
                m_pCurrentShape->m_points[1] = point;
            }
        }

        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }

    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;
        ReleaseCapture();

        if (m_pCurrentShape)
        {
            m_shapes.push_back(m_pCurrentShape);
            m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
        }

        Invalidate();
    }

    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

{
}

{
}

int CMainFrame::OnCreate(LPCREATESTRUCT lpCreateStruct)
{
    if (CFrameWndEx::OnCreate(lpCreateStruct) == -1)
        return -1;

    // 创建菜单栏
    if (!m_wndMenuBar.Create(this))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建菜单栏\n");
        return -1;
    }

    // 创建工具栏
    if (!m_wndToolBar.CreateEx(this, TBSTYLE_FLAT, 
        WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | CBRS_TOP | CBRS_GRIPPER | CBRS_TOOLTIPS | CBRS_FLYBY | CBRS_SIZE_DYNAMIC))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建工具栏\n");
        return -1;
    }

    if (!m_wndToolBar.LoadToolBar(IDR_MAINFRAME))
    {
        TRACE0("未能加载工具栏\n");
        return -1;
    }

    // 创建状态栏
    if (!m_wndStatusBar.Create(this))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建状态栏\n");
        return -1;
    }
    m_wndStatusBar.SetIndicators(indicators, sizeof(indicators) / sizeof(UINT));

    // 设置停靠
    m_wndMenuBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    m_wndToolBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    DockPane(&m_wndMenuBar);
    DockPane(&m_wndToolBar);

    return 0;
}

BOOL CMainFrame::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    if( !CFrameWndEx::PreCreateWindow(cs) )
        return FALSE;

    return TRUE;
}

C++

#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif
#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

// 图形类实现
void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nWidth, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    if (m_points.size() > 1)
    {
        pDC->MoveTo(m_points[0]);
        for (size_t i = 1; i < m_points.size(); i++)
        {
            pDC->LineTo(m_points[i]);
        }
    }
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (m_points.size() >= 2)
    {
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nWidth, m_color);
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
        pDC->MoveTo(m_points[0]);
        pDC->LineTo(m_points[1]);
        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (m_points.size() >= 2)
    {
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nWidth, m_color);
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
        CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
        pDC->Rectangle(CRect(m_points[0], m_points[1]));
        pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (m_points.size() >= 2)
    {
        CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nWidth, m_color);
        CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
        CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
        pDC->Ellipse(CRect(m_points[0], m_points[1]));
        pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
        pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    }
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_nWidth, m_color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    if (m_points.size() > 1)
    {
        pDC->MoveTo(m_points[0]);
        for (size_t i = 1; i < m_points.size(); i++)
        {
            pDC->LineTo(m_points[i]);
        }
    }
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
{
    m_currentTool = TOOL_PEN;
    m_currentColor = RGB(0, 0, 0);
    m_nPenWidth = 1;
    m_bDrawing = FALSE;
    m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    for (auto shape : m_shapes)
    {
        delete shape;
    }
    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        delete m_pCurrentShape;
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc)
        return;

    for (auto shape : m_shapes)
    {
        shape->Draw(pDC);
    }

    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_pCurrentShape->Draw(pDC);
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    m_ptStart = point;
    m_ptEnd = point;
    SetCapture();

    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case TOOL_PEN:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CPenShape(m_currentColor, m_nPenWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_LINE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CLineShape(m_currentColor, m_nPenWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CRectangleShape(m_currentColor, m_nPenWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CEllipseShape(m_currentColor, m_nPenWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_ERASER:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CEraserShape(m_nPenWidth * 3);
        break;
    }

    if (m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_pCurrentShape->m_points.push_back(point);
    }

    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_ptEnd = point;

        if (m_currentTool == TOOL_PEN || m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER)
        {
            m_pCurrentShape->m_points.push_back(point);
        }
        else
        {
            if (m_pCurrentShape->m_points.size() == 1)
            {
                m_pCurrentShape->m_points.push_back(point);
            }
            else
            {
                m_pCurrentShape->m_points[1] = point;
            }
        }

        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }

    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;
        ReleaseCapture();

        if (m_pCurrentShape)
        {
            m_shapes.push_back(m_pCurrentShape);
            m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
        }

        Invalidate();
    }

    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

int CMainFrame::OnCreate(LPCREATESTRUCT lpCreateStruct)
{
    if (CFrameWndEx::OnCreate(lpCreateStruct) == -1)
        return -1;

    // 创建菜单栏
    if (!m_wndMenuBar.Create(this))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建菜单栏\n");
        return -1;
    }
    m_wndMenuBar.SetPaneStyle(m_wndMenuBar.GetPaneStyle() | CBRS_SIZE_DYNAMIC | CBRS_TOOLTIPS | CBRS_FLYBY);

    // 创建工具栏
    if (!m_wndToolBar.CreateEx(this, TBSTYLE_FLAT, 
        WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | CBRS_TOP | CBRS_GRIPPER | CBRS_TOOLTIPS | CBRS_FLYBY | CBRS_SIZE_DYNAMIC) ||
        !m_wndToolBar.LoadToolBar(IDR_MAINFRAME))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建工具栏\n");
        return -1;
    }
    m_wndToolBar.SetPaneStyle(m_wndToolBar.GetPaneStyle() | CBRS_TOOLTIPS | CBRS_FLYBY);
    m_wndToolBar.SetWindowText(_T("工具栏"));

    // 创建状态栏
    if (!m_wndStatusBar.Create(this))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建状态栏\n");
        return -1;
    }
    m_wndStatusBar.SetIndicators(indicators, sizeof(indicators) / sizeof(UINT));

    // 启用停靠
    m_wndMenuBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    m_wndToolBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    
    DockPane(&m_wndMenuBar);
    DockPane(&m_wndToolBar);

    return 0;
}

BOOL CMainFrame::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)

    if (!CFrameWndEx::PreCreateWindow(cs))
        return FALSE;
    
    return TRUE;
}

    TOOL_PEN,
    TOOL_LINE,

📋 DrawingBoardView.cpp (完整代码)
C++

#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif
#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

// 图形类实现
void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
    {
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    }
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    pDC->LineTo(points[1]);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Rectangle(rect);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Ellipse(rect);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
    {
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    }
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc) return;

    for (auto shape : m_shapes)
        shape->Draw(pDC);

    if (m_pCurrentShape)
        m_pCurrentShape->Draw(pDC);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    m_startPoint = point;
    m_endPoint = point;
    SetCapture();

    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case TOOL_PEN:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CPenShape(m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_LINE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CLineShape(m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CRectangleShape(m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CEllipseShape(m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_ERASER:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CEraserShape(m_penWidth * 3);
        break;
    }

    if (m_pCurrentShape)
        m_pCurrentShape->points.push_back(point);

    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_endPoint = point;

        if (m_currentTool == TOOL_PEN || m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER)
        {
            m_pCurrentShape->points.push_back(point);
        }
        else
        {
            if (m_pCurrentShape->points.size() == 1)
                m_pCurrentShape->points.push_back(point);
            else
                m_pCurrentShape->points[1] = point;
        }

        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }

    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;
        ReleaseCapture();

        if (m_pCurrentShape)
        {
            m_shapes.push_back(m_pCurrentShape);
            m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
        }

        Invalidate();
    }

    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#include "MainFrm.h"

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

IMPLEMENT_DYNCREATE(CMainFrame, CFrameWnd)

BEGIN_MESSAGE_MAP(CMainFrame, CFrameWnd)
    ON_WM_CREATE()
END_MESSAGE_MAP()

static UINT indicators[] =
{
    ID_SEPARATOR,
};

CMainFrame::CMainFrame() noexcept
{
}

CMainFrame::~CMainFrame()
{
}

int CMainFrame::OnCreate(LPCREATESTRUCT lpCreateStruct)
{
    if (CFrameWnd::OnCreate(lpCreateStruct) == -1)
        return -1;

    // 创建工具栏
    if (!m_wndToolBar.CreateEx(this, TBSTYLE_FLAT, WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | CBRS_TOP | CBRS_GRIPPER | CBRS_TOOLTIPS | CBRS_FLYBY | CBRS_SIZE_DYNAMIC) ||
        !m_wndToolBar.LoadToolBar(IDR_MAINFRAME))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建工具栏\n");
        return -1;
    }

    // 创建状态栏
    if (!m_wndStatusBar.Create(this) ||
        !m_wndStatusBar.SetIndicators(indicators, sizeof(indicators)/sizeof(UINT)))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建状态栏\n");
        return -1;
    }

    // 允许工具栏停靠
    m_wndToolBar.EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    EnableDocking(CBRS_ALIGN_ANY);
    DockControlBar(&m_wndToolBar);

    return 0;
}

BOOL CMainFrame::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    if( !CFrameWnd::PreCreateWindow(cs) )
        return FALSE;
    
    return TRUE;
}

    CFrameWnd::AssertValid();

{
    CFrameWnd::Dump(dc);

📋 DrawingBoardView.cpp (完整版)
C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    pDC->LineTo(points[1]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Rectangle(rect);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Ellipse(rect);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

BEGIN_MESSAGE_MAP(CDrawingBoardView, CView)
    ON_WM_LBUTTONDOWN()
    ON_WM_LBUTTONUP()
    ON_WM_MOUSEMOVE()
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_PEN, &CDrawingBoardView::OnToolPen)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_LINE, &CDrawingBoardView::OnToolLine)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE, &CDrawingBoardView::OnToolRectangle)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE, &CDrawingBoardView::OnToolEllipse)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_TOOL_ERASER, &CDrawingBoardView::OnToolEraser)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_COLOR_BLACK, &CDrawingBoardView::OnColorBlack)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_COLOR_RED, &CDrawingBoardView::OnColorRed)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_COLOR_GREEN, &CDrawingBoardView::OnColorGreen)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_COLOR_BLUE, &CDrawingBoardView::OnColorBlue)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_COLOR_YELLOW, &CDrawingBoardView::OnColorYellow)

    ON_COMMAND(ID_SIZE_MEDIUM, &CDrawingBoardView::OnSizeMedium)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_SIZE_THICK, &CDrawingBoardView::OnSizeThick)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_EDIT_CLEAR, &CDrawingBoardView::OnEditClear)
END_MESSAGE_MAP()

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
{
    m_currentTool = TOOL_PEN;
    m_currentColor = RGB(0, 0, 0);
    m_penWidth = 1;
    m_bDrawing = FALSE;
    m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    for (auto shape : m_shapes)
        delete shape;
    if (m_pCurrentShape)
        delete m_pCurrentShape;
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc) return;

    for (auto shape : m_shapes)
        shape->Draw(pDC);
    
    if (m_pCurrentShape)
        m_pCurrentShape->Draw(pDC);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    SetCapture();

    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case TOOL_PEN:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CPenShape(m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_LINE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CLineShape(m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CRectangleShape(m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CEllipseShape(m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_ERASER:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CEraserShape(m_penWidth * 3);
        break;
    }

    if (m_pCurrentShape)
        m_pCurrentShape->points.push_back(point);

    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        if (m_currentTool == TOOL_PEN || m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER)
        {
            m_pCurrentShape->points.push_back(point);
        }
        else
        {
            if (m_pCurrentShape->points.size() == 1)
                m_pCurrentShape->points.push_back(point);
            else
                m_pCurrentShape->points[1] = point;
        }
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;
        ReleaseCapture();
        if (m_pCurrentShape)
        {
            m_shapes.push_back(m_pCurrentShape);
            m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
        }
        Invalidate();
    }
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnToolPen() { m_currentTool = TOOL_PEN; }
void CDrawingBoardView::OnToolLine() { m_currentTool = TOOL_LINE; }
void CDrawingBoardView::OnToolRectangle() { m_currentTool = TOOL_RECTANGLE; }
void CDrawingBoardView::OnToolEllipse() { m_currentTool = TOOL_ELLIPSE; }
void CDrawingBoardView::OnToolEraser() { m_currentTool = TOOL_ERASER; }

void CDrawingBoardView::OnColorBlack() { m_currentColor = RGB(0, 0, 0); }
void CDrawingBoardView::OnColorRed() { m_currentColor = RGB(255, 0, 0); }
void CDrawingBoardView::OnColorGreen() { m_currentColor = RGB(0, 255, 0); }
void CDrawingBoardView::OnColorBlue() { m_currentColor = RGB(0, 0, 255); }
void CDrawingBoardView::OnColorYellow() { m_currentColor = RGB(255, 255, 0); }

void CDrawingBoardView::OnSizeThin() { m_penWidth = 1; }
void CDrawingBoardView::OnSizeMedium() { m_penWidth = 3; }
void CDrawingBoardView::OnSizeThick() { m_penWidth = 6; }

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditClear()
{
    for (auto shape : m_shapes)
        delete shape;
    m_shapes.clear();
    Invalidate();
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Ellipse(rect);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc) return;

    // 绘制已完成的图形
    for (auto shape : m_shapes)
        shape->Draw(pDC);
}

// 橡皮筋绘制（用于临时预览）
void CDrawingBoardView::DrawRubberBand(CDC* pDC, CPoint start, CPoint end)
{
    int oldROP = pDC->SetROP2(R2_NOTXORPEN);  // XOR 模式
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_penWidth, m_currentColor);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);

    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case TOOL_LINE:
        pDC->MoveTo(start);
        pDC->LineTo(end);
        break;
    case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
    {
        CRect rect(start, end);
        rect.NormalizeRect();
        pDC->Rectangle(rect);
        break;
    }
    case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
    {
        CRect rect(start, end);
        rect.NormalizeRect();
        pDC->Ellipse(rect);
        break;
    }
    }

    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SetROP2(oldROP);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    m_lastPoint = point;
    SetCapture();

    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case TOOL_PEN:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CPenShape(m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_LINE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CLineShape(m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CRectangleShape(m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CEllipseShape(m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
        break;
    case TOOL_ERASER:
        m_pCurrentShape = new CEraserShape(m_penWidth * 3);
        break;
    }

    if (m_pCurrentShape)
        m_pCurrentShape->points.push_back(point);

    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        CClientDC dc(this);

        if (m_currentTool == TOOL_PEN || m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER)
        {
            // 自由绘制模式
            if (m_pCurrentShape)
            {
                m_pCurrentShape->points.push_back(point);
                CPen pen(PS_SOLID, m_pCurrentShape->width, m_pCurrentShape->color);
                CPen* pOldPen = dc.SelectObject(&pen);
                dc.MoveTo(m_lastPoint);
                dc.LineTo(point);
                dc.SelectObject(pOldPen);
                m_lastPoint = point;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            // 橡皮筋模式（直线、矩形、椭圆）
            DrawRubberBand(&dc, m_pCurrentShape->points[0], m_lastPoint);  // 擦除旧的
            DrawRubberBand(&dc, m_pCurrentShape->points[0], point);        // 绘制新的
            m_lastPoint = point;
        }
    }

    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;
        ReleaseCapture();

        if (m_pCurrentShape)
        {
            // 对于非自由绘制工具，添加终点
            if (m_currentTool != TOOL_PEN && m_currentTool != TOOL_ERASER)
            {
                if (m_pCurrentShape->points.size() == 1)
                    m_pCurrentShape->points.push_back(point);
                else
                    m_pCurrentShape->points[1] = point;
            }

            m_shapes.push_back(m_pCurrentShape);
            m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;
        }

        Invalidate();  // 重绘整个窗口
    }

    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

// ============ 形状基类 (Strategy 模式) ============
class IShape
{
public:
    DrawingTool tool;
    COLORREF color;
    int width;
    std::vector<CPoint> points;

    IShape(DrawingTool t, COLORREF c, int w) : tool(t), color(c), width(w) {}
    virtual ~IShape() {}
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) const = 0;
    virtual IShape* Clone() const = 0;
    
    // 序列化接口
    virtual void Serialize(CArchive& ar);
};

// ============ 具体形状类 ============

    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CPenShape(*this); }
};

class CLineShape : public IShape

    CLineShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(TOOL_LINE, c, w) {}

    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CLineShape(*this); }
};

    CRectangleShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(TOOL_RECTANGLE, c, w) {}

    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CRectangleShape(*this); }

// ============ Factory 模式 ============
class ShapeFactory
{
public:
    static std::shared_ptr<IShape> CreateShape(DrawingTool tool, COLORREF color, int width)
    {
        switch (tool)
        {
        case TOOL_PEN:       return std::make_shared<CPenShape>(color, width);
        case TOOL_LINE:      return std::make_shared<CLineShape>(color, width);
        case TOOL_RECTANGLE: return std::make_shared<CRectangleShape>(color, width);
        case TOOL_ELLIPSE:   return std::make_shared<CEllipseShape>(color, width);
        case TOOL_ERASER:    return std::make_shared<CEraserShape>(width * 3);
        default:             return nullptr;
        }
    }
};

// ============ Command 模式 (撤销/重做) ============
class ICommand
{
public:
    virtual ~ICommand() {}
    virtual void Execute() = 0;
    virtual void Undo() = 0;
};

class AddShapeCommand : public ICommand
{
private:
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<IShape>>& m_shapes;
    std::shared_ptr<IShape> m_shape;
public:
    AddShapeCommand(std::vector<std::shared_ptr<IShape>>& shapes, std::shared_ptr<IShape> shape)
        : m_shapes(shapes), m_shape(shape) {}

    void Execute() override { m_shapes.push_back(m_shape); }
    void Undo() override { m_shapes.pop_back(); }
};

// ============ 命令管理器 ============
class CommandManager
{
private:
    std::stack<std::shared_ptr<ICommand>> m_undoStack;
    std::stack<std::shared_ptr<ICommand>> m_redoStack;

public:
    void ExecuteCommand(std::shared_ptr<ICommand> cmd)
    {
        cmd->Execute();
        m_undoStack.push(cmd);
        // 清空重做栈
        while (!m_redoStack.empty()) m_redoStack.pop();
    }

    bool CanUndo() const { return !m_undoStack.empty(); }
    bool CanRedo() const { return !m_redoStack.empty(); }

    void Undo()
    {
        if (!CanUndo()) return;
        auto cmd = m_undoStack.top();
        m_undoStack.pop();
        cmd->Undo();
        m_redoStack.push(cmd);
    }

    void Redo()
    {
        if (!CanRedo()) return;
        auto cmd = m_redoStack.top();
        m_redoStack.pop();
        cmd->Execute();
        m_undoStack.push(cmd);
    }

    void Clear()
    {
        while (!m_undoStack.empty()) m_undoStack.pop();
        while (!m_redoStack.empty()) m_redoStack.pop();
    }
};

// ============ 形状序列化实现 ============
void IShape::Serialize(CArchive& ar)
{
    if (ar.IsStoring())
    {
        ar << (int)tool << (DWORD)color << width;
        ar << (int)points.size();
        for (const auto& pt : points)
            ar << pt;
    }
    else
    {
        int t, count;
        DWORD c;
        ar >> t >> c >> width;
        tool = (DrawingTool)t;
        color = (COLORREF)c;
        ar >> count;
        points.resize(count);
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            ar >> points[i];
    }
}

// ============ 图形绘制实现 ============
void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CGdiObjectWrapper pen(::CreatePen(PS_SOLID, width, color));
    HGDIOBJ oldPen = ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, pen);
    
    ::MoveToEx(pDC->m_hDC, points[0].x, points[0].y, NULL);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        ::LineTo(pDC->m_hDC, points[i].x, points[i].y);
    
    ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, oldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CGdiObjectWrapper pen(::CreatePen(PS_SOLID, width, color));
    HGDIOBJ oldPen = ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, pen);
    
    ::MoveToEx(pDC->m_hDC, points[0].x, points[0].y, NULL);
    ::LineTo(pDC->m_hDC, points[1].x, points[1].y);
    
    ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, oldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CGdiObjectWrapper pen(::CreatePen(PS_SOLID, width, color));
    HGDIOBJ oldPen = ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, pen);
    HGDIOBJ oldBrush = ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, ::GetStockObject(NULL_BRUSH));
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    ::Rectangle(pDC->m_hDC, rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom);
    
    ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, oldBrush);
    ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, oldPen);
}

    if (points.size() < 2) return;

    ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, oldBrush);

}

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
{
    m_currentTool = TOOL_PEN;
    m_currentColor = RGB(0, 0, 0);
    m_penWidth = 1;
    m_bDrawing = FALSE;
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    if (m_memDC.m_hDC) m_memDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_memBitmap.m_hObject) m_memBitmap.DeleteObject();
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

// 双缓冲初始化
void CDrawingBoardView::InitDoubleBuffer()
{
    GetClientRect(&m_clientRect);
    
    if (m_memDC.m_hDC) m_memDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_memBitmap.m_hObject) m_memBitmap.DeleteObject();
    
    CClientDC dc(this);
    m_memDC.CreateCompatibleDC(&dc);
    m_memBitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(&dc, m_clientRect.Width(), m_clientRect.Height());
    m_memDC.SelectObject(&m_memBitmap);
    
    // 白色背景
    m_memDC.FillSolidRect(&m_clientRect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    DrawAllShapes(&m_memDC);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnSize(UINT nType, int cx, int cy)
{
    CView::OnSize(nType, cx, cy);
    InitDoubleBuffer();
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::OnEraseBkgnd(CDC* pDC)
{
    return TRUE;  // 防止闪烁
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (m_memDC.m_hDC)
        pDC->BitBlt(0, 0, m_clientRect.Width(), m_clientRect.Height(), &m_memDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
}

// 绘制所有图形
void CDrawingBoardView::DrawAllShapes(CDC* pDC)
{
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
        shape->Draw(pDC);
}
DrawingBoardView.cpp (第2部分 - 鼠标处理)
C++

// 橡皮筋绘制
void CDrawingBoardView::DrawRubberBand(CDC* pDC, CPoint start, CPoint end)
{
    int oldROP = pDC->SetROP2(R2_NOTXORPEN);
    CGdiObjectWrapper pen(::CreatePen(PS_SOLID, m_penWidth, m_currentColor));
    HGDIOBJ oldPen = ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, pen);
    HGDIOBJ oldBrush = ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, ::GetStockObject(NULL_BRUSH));

    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case TOOL_LINE:
        ::MoveToEx(pDC->m_hDC, start.x, start.y, NULL);
        ::LineTo(pDC->m_hDC, end.x, end.y);
        break;
    case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
    {
        CRect rect(start, end);
        rect.NormalizeRect();
        ::Rectangle(pDC->m_hDC, rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom);
        break;
    }
    case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
    {
        CRect rect(start, end);
        rect.NormalizeRect();
        ::Ellipse(pDC->m_hDC, rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom);
        break;
    }
    }

    ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, oldBrush);
    ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, oldPen);
    pDC->SetROP2(oldROP);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    m_lastPoint = point;
    SetCapture();

    m_pCurrentShape = ShapeFactory::CreateShape(m_currentTool, m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
    if (m_pCurrentShape)
        m_pCurrentShape->points.push_back(point);

    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        CClientDC dc(this);

        if (m_currentTool == TOOL_PEN || m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER)
        {
            // 自由绘制
            m_pCurrentShape->points.push_back(point);
            CGdiObjectWrapper pen(::CreatePen(PS_SOLID, m_pCurrentShape->width, m_pCurrentShape->color));
            HGDIOBJ oldPen = ::SelectObject(dc.m_hDC, pen);
            ::MoveToEx(dc.m_hDC, m_lastPoint.x, m_lastPoint.y, NULL);
            ::LineTo(dc.m_hDC, point.x, point.y);
            ::SelectObject(dc.m_hDC, oldPen);

            // 同步到内存DC
            ::SelectObject(m_memDC.m_hDC, pen);
            ::MoveToEx(m_memDC.m_hDC, m_lastPoint.x, m_lastPoint.y, NULL);
            ::LineTo(m_memDC.m_hDC, point.x, point.y);

            m_lastPoint = point;
        }
        else
        {
            // 橡皮筋模式
            DrawRubberBand(&dc, m_pCurrentShape->points[0], m_lastPoint);
            DrawRubberBand(&dc, m_pCurrentShape->points[0], point);
            m_lastPoint = point;
        }
    }

    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;
        ReleaseCapture();

        // 添加终点
        if (m_currentTool != TOOL_PEN && m_currentTool != TOOL_ERASER)
        {
            if (m_pCurrentShape->points.size() == 1)
                m_pCurrentShape->points.push_back(point);
            else
                m_pCurrentShape->points[1] = point;
        }

        // 使用 Command 模式添加图形
        auto cmd = std::make_shared<AddShapeCommand>(m_shapes, m_pCurrentShape);
        m_commandManager.ExecuteCommand(cmd);
        m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;

        // 重绘到内存DC
        m_memDC.FillSolidRect(&m_clientRect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
        DrawAllShapes(&m_memDC);
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }

    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

// ============ 文件命令 ============
void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileSave()
{
    CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("draw"), NULL, OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT,
        _T("Drawing Files (*.draw)|*.draw||"));

    if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
    {
        try
        {
            CFile file(dlg.GetPathName(), CFile::modeCreate | CFile::modeWrite);
            CArchive ar(&file, CArchive::store);

            ar << (int)m_shapes.size();
            for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
            {
                ar << (int)shape->tool;
                const_cast<IShape*>(shape.get())->Serialize(ar);
            }

            ar.Close();
            file.Close();
            AfxMessageBox(_T("保存成功！"));
        }
        catch (CException* e)
        {
            TCHAR szError[1024];
            e->GetErrorMessage(szError, 1024);
            AfxMessageBox(szError);
            e->Delete();
        }
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileOpen()
{
    CFileDialog dlg(TRUE, _T("draw"), NULL, OFN_FILEMUSTEXIST,
        _T("Drawing Files (*.draw)|*.draw||"));

    if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
    {
        try
        {
            CFile file(dlg.GetPathName(), CFile::modeRead);
            CArchive ar(&file, CArchive::load);

            m_shapes.clear();
            m_commandManager.Clear();

            int count;
            ar >> count;

            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            {
                int tool;
                ar >> tool;

                auto shape = ShapeFactory::CreateShape((DrawingTool)tool, RGB(0, 0, 0), 1);
                const_cast<IShape*>(shape.get())->Serialize(ar);
                m_shapes.push_back(shape);
            }

            ar.Close();
            file.Close();

            m_memDC.FillSolidRect(&m_clientRect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
            DrawAllShapes(&m_memDC);
            Invalidate();

            AfxMessageBox(_T("加载成功！"));
        }
        catch (CException* e)
        {
            TCHAR szError[1024];
            e->GetErrorMessage(szError, 1024);
            AfxMessageBox(szError);
            e->Delete();
        }
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileExportPng()
{
    CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("png"), NULL, OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT,
        _T("PNG Files (*.png)|*.png||"));

    if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
    {
        GdiplusStartupInput gdiplusStartupInput;
        ULONG_PTR gdiplusToken;
        GdiplusStartup(&gdiplusToken, &gdiplusStartupInput, NULL);

        Bitmap bitmap(m_clientRect.Width(), m_clientRect.Height(), PixelFormat24bppRGB);
        Graphics graphics(&bitmap);
        HDC hdc = graphics.GetHDC();
        ::BitBlt(hdc, 0, 0, m_clientRect.Width(), m_clientRect.Height(), m_memDC.m_hDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
        graphics.ReleaseHDC(hdc);

        CLSID pngClsid;
        GetEncoderClsid(L"image/png", &pngClsid);
        bitmap.Save(dlg.GetPathName(), &pngClsid, NULL);

        GdiplusShutdown(gdiplusToken);
        AfxMessageBox(_T("导出成功！"));
    }
}

// GDI+ 编码器辅助函数
int GetEncoderClsid(const WCHAR* format, CLSID* pClsid)
{
    UINT num = 0, size = 0;
    GetImageEncodersSize(&num, &size);
    if (size == 0) return -1;

    ImageCodecInfo* pImageCodecInfo = (ImageCodecInfo*)(malloc(size));
    if (pImageCodecInfo == NULL) return -1;

    GetImageEncoders(num, size, pImageCodecInfo);
    for (UINT j = 0; j < num; ++j)
    {
        if (wcscmp(pImageCodecInfo[j].MimeType, format) == 0)
        {
            *pClsid = pImageCodecInfo[j].Clsid;
            free(pImageCodecInfo);
            return j;
        }
    }
    free(pImageCodecInfo);
    return -1;
}

## 修改内容

// DrawingBoardView.cpp : CDrawingBoardView 类的实现
//

#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif

#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"
#include <gdiplus.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "gdiplus.lib")

using namespace Gdiplus;

#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

// GDI+ 辅助函数声明

// ============================================================================
// 第一部分：形状类实现

void IShape::Serialize(CArchive& ar)
{
    if (ar.IsStoring())
    {
        ar << (int)tool << (DWORD)color << width;
        ar << (int)points.size();
        for (const auto& pt : points)
            ar << pt;
    }
    else
    {
        int t, count;
        DWORD c;
        ar >> t >> c >> width;
        tool = (DrawingTool)t;
        color = (COLORREF)c;
        ar >> count;
        points.resize(count);
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            ar >> points[i];
    }
}

void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CGdiObjectWrapper pen(::CreatePen(PS_SOLID, width, color));
    HGDIOBJ oldPen = ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, pen);
    
    ::MoveToEx(pDC->m_hDC, points[0].x, points[0].y, NULL);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        ::LineTo(pDC->m_hDC, points[i].x, points[i].y);
    
    ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, oldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CGdiObjectWrapper pen(::CreatePen(PS_SOLID, width, color));
    HGDIOBJ oldPen = ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, pen);
    
    ::MoveToEx(pDC->m_hDC, points[0].x, points[0].y, NULL);
    ::LineTo(pDC->m_hDC, points[1].x, points[1].y);
    
    ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, oldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CGdiObjectWrapper pen(::CreatePen(PS_SOLID, width, color));
    HGDIOBJ oldPen = ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, pen);
    HGDIOBJ oldBrush = ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, ::GetStockObject(NULL_BRUSH));
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    ::Rectangle(pDC->m_hDC, rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom);
    
    ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, oldBrush);
    ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, oldPen);
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CGdiObjectWrapper pen(::CreatePen(PS_SOLID, width, color));
    HGDIOBJ oldPen = ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, pen);
    HGDIOBJ oldBrush = ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, ::GetStockObject(NULL_BRUSH));
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    ::Ellipse(pDC->m_hDC, rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom);
    
    ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, oldBrush);
    ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, oldPen);
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CGdiObjectWrapper pen(::CreatePen(PS_SOLID, width, color));
    HGDIOBJ oldPen = ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, pen);
    
    ::MoveToEx(pDC->m_hDC, points[0].x, points[0].y, NULL);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        ::LineTo(pDC->m_hDC, points[i].x, points[i].y);
    
    ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, oldPen);
}

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
{
    m_currentTool = TOOL_PEN;
    m_currentColor = RGB(0, 0, 0);
    m_penWidth = 1;
    m_bDrawing = FALSE;
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    if (m_memDC.m_hDC) m_memDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_memBitmap.m_hObject) m_memBitmap.DeleteObject();
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::InitDoubleBuffer()
{
    GetClientRect(&m_clientRect);
    
    if (m_memDC.m_hDC) m_memDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_memBitmap.m_hObject) m_memBitmap.DeleteObject();
    
    CClientDC dc(this);
    m_memDC.CreateCompatibleDC(&dc);
    m_memBitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(&dc, m_clientRect.Width(), m_clientRect.Height());
    m_memDC.SelectObject(&m_memBitmap);
    
    m_memDC.FillSolidRect(&m_clientRect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    DrawAllShapes(&m_memDC);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnSize(UINT nType, int cx, int cy)
{
    CView::OnSize(nType, cx, cy);
    InitDoubleBuffer();
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::OnEraseBkgnd(CDC* pDC)
{
    return TRUE;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    if (m_memDC.m_hDC)
        pDC->BitBlt(0, 0, m_clientRect.Width(), m_clientRect.Height(), &m_memDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::DrawAllShapes(CDC* pDC)
{
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
        shape->Draw(pDC);
}

// ============================================================================
// 第三部分：鼠标交互
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::DrawRubberBand(CDC* pDC, CPoint start, CPoint end)
{
    int oldROP = pDC->SetROP2(R2_NOTXORPEN);
    CGdiObjectWrapper pen(::CreatePen(PS_SOLID, m_penWidth, m_currentColor));
    HGDIOBJ oldPen = ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, pen);
    HGDIOBJ oldBrush = ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, ::GetStockObject(NULL_BRUSH));

    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case TOOL_LINE:
        ::MoveToEx(pDC->m_hDC, start.x, start.y, NULL);
        ::LineTo(pDC->m_hDC, end.x, end.y);
        break;
    case TOOL_RECTANGLE:
    {
        CRect rect(start, end);
        rect.NormalizeRect();
        ::Rectangle(pDC->m_hDC, rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom);
        break;
    }
    case TOOL_ELLIPSE:
    {
        CRect rect(start, end);
        rect.NormalizeRect();
        ::Ellipse(pDC->m_hDC, rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom);
        break;
    }
    }

    ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, oldBrush);
    ::SelectObject(pDC->m_hDC, oldPen);
    pDC->SetROP2(oldROP);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    m_lastPoint = point;
    SetCapture();

    m_pCurrentShape = ShapeFactory::CreateShape(m_currentTool, m_currentColor, m_penWidth);
    if (m_pCurrentShape)
        m_pCurrentShape->points.push_back(point);

    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        CClientDC dc(this);

        if (m_currentTool == TOOL_PEN || m_currentTool == TOOL_ERASER)
        {
            m_pCurrentShape->points.push_back(point);
            CGdiObjectWrapper pen(::CreatePen(PS_SOLID, m_pCurrentShape->width, m_pCurrentShape->color));
            HGDIOBJ oldPen = ::SelectObject(dc.m_hDC, pen);
            ::MoveToEx(dc.m_hDC, m_lastPoint.x, m_lastPoint.y, NULL);
            ::LineTo(dc.m_hDC, point.x, point.y);
            ::SelectObject(dc.m_hDC, oldPen);

            ::SelectObject(m_memDC.m_hDC, pen);
            ::MoveToEx(m_memDC.m_hDC, m_lastPoint.x, m_lastPoint.y, NULL);
            ::LineTo(m_memDC.m_hDC, point.x, point.y);

            m_lastPoint = point;
        }
        else
        {
            DrawRubberBand(&dc, m_pCurrentShape->points[0], m_lastPoint);
            DrawRubberBand(&dc, m_pCurrentShape->points[0], point);
            m_lastPoint = point;
        }
    }

    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing && m_pCurrentShape)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;
        ReleaseCapture();

        if (m_currentTool != TOOL_PEN && m_currentTool != TOOL_ERASER)
        {
            if (m_pCurrentShape->points.size() == 1)
                m_pCurrentShape->points.push_back(point);
            else
                m_pCurrentShape->points[1] = point;
        }

        auto cmd = std::make_shared<AddShapeCommand>(m_shapes, m_pCurrentShape);
        m_commandManager.ExecuteCommand(cmd);
        m_pCurrentShape = nullptr;

        m_memDC.FillSolidRect(&m_clientRect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
        DrawAllShapes(&m_memDC);
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }

    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileSave()
{
    CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("draw"), NULL, OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT,
        _T("Drawing Files (*.draw)|*.draw||"));

    if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
    {
        try
        {
            CFile file(dlg.GetPathName(), CFile::modeCreate | CFile::modeWrite);
            CArchive ar(&file, CArchive::store);

            ar << (int)m_shapes.size();
            for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
            {
                ar << (int)shape->tool;
                const_cast<IShape*>(shape.get())->Serialize(ar);
            }

            ar.Close();
            file.Close();
            AfxMessageBox(_T("保存成功！"));
        }
        catch (CException* e)
        {
            TCHAR szError[1024];
            e->GetErrorMessage(szError, 1024);
            AfxMessageBox(szError);
            e->Delete();
        }
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileOpen()
{
    CFileDialog dlg(TRUE, _T("draw"), NULL, OFN_FILEMUSTEXIST,
        _T("Drawing Files (*.draw)|*.draw||"));

    if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
    {
        try
        {
            CFile file(dlg.GetPathName(), CFile::modeRead);
            CArchive ar(&file, CArchive::load);

            m_shapes.clear();
            m_commandManager.Clear();

            int count;
            ar >> count;

            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            {
                int tool;
                ar >> tool;

                auto shape = ShapeFactory::CreateShape((DrawingTool)tool, RGB(0, 0, 0), 1);
                const_cast<IShape*>(shape.get())->Serialize(ar);
                m_shapes.push_back(shape);
            }

            ar.Close();
            file.Close();

            m_memDC.FillSolidRect(&m_clientRect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
            DrawAllShapes(&m_memDC);
            Invalidate();

            AfxMessageBox(_T("加载成功！"));
        }
        catch (CException* e)
        {
            TCHAR szError[1024];
            e->GetErrorMessage(szError, 1024);
            AfxMessageBox(szError);
            e->Delete();
        }
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileExportPng()
{
    CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("png"), NULL, OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT,
        _T("PNG Files (*.png)|*.png||"));

    if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
    {
        GdiplusStartupInput gdiplusStartupInput;
        ULONG_PTR gdiplusToken;
        GdiplusStartup(&gdiplusToken, &gdiplusStartupInput, NULL);

        Bitmap bitmap(m_clientRect.Width(), m_clientRect.Height(), PixelFormat24bppRGB);
        Graphics graphics(&bitmap);
        HDC hdc = graphics.GetHDC();
        ::BitBlt(hdc, 0, 0, m_clientRect.Width(), m_clientRect.Height(), m_memDC.m_hDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
        graphics.ReleaseHDC(hdc);

        CLSID pngClsid;
        GetEncoderClsid(L"image/png", &pngClsid);
        bitmap.Save(dlg.GetPathName(), &pngClsid, NULL);

        GdiplusShutdown(gdiplusToken);
        AfxMessageBox(_T("导出成功！"));
    }
}

// GDI+ 编码器辅助函数
int GetEncoderClsid(const WCHAR* format, CLSID* pClsid)
{
    UINT num = 0, size = 0;
    GetImageEncodersSize(&num, &size);
    if (size == 0) return -1;

    ImageCodecInfo* pImageCodecInfo = (ImageCodecInfo*)(malloc(size));
    if (pImageCodecInfo == NULL) return -1;

    GetImageEncoders(num, size, pImageCodecInfo);
    for (UINT j = 0; j < num; ++j)
    {
        if (wcscmp(pImageCodecInfo[j].MimeType, format) == 0)
        {
            *pClsid = pImageCodecInfo[j].Clsid;
            free(pImageCodecInfo);
            return j;
        }
    }
    free(pImageCodecInfo);
    return -1;
}

//{{NO_DEPENDENCIES}}
// Microsoft Visual C++ 生成的包含文件。
// 供 DrawingBoard.rc 使用
//
#define IDD_ABOUTBOX                    100
#define IDP_OLE_INIT_FAILED             100
#define IDR_MAINFRAME                   128
#define IDR_DrawingBoardTYPE            130
#define ID_VIEW_APPLOOK_WIN_2000        159
#define ID_VIEW_APPLOOK_OFF_XP          160
#define ID_VIEW_APPLOOK_WIN_XP          161

 |
IDS_EDIT_CLEAR          "清空画布\n清空"
IDS_EDIT_UNDO           "撤销\nCtrl+Z"

⚠️ 注意事项

 |

"Y", ID_EDIT_REDO, VIRTKEY, CONTROL

// DrawingBoardView.h: CDrawingBoardView 类的接口

#pragma once

class IShape;

enum class DrawingTool
{
    PEN,
    LINE,
    RECTANGLE,
    ELLIPSE,
    ERASER
};

// 形状基类
class IShape
{
public:
    DrawingTool tool;
    COLORREF color;
    int width;
    std::vector<CPoint> points;

    IShape(DrawingTool t, COLORREF c, int w)
        : tool(t), color(c), width(w) {}
    virtual ~IShape() = default;
    
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) const = 0;
    virtual void Serialize(CArchive& ar);
};

// 铅笔工具

{

    CPenShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::PEN, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
};

📄 完整修正后的 DrawingBoardView.cpp
C++
 |
// DrawingBoardView.cpp : CDrawingBoardView 类的实现
//

#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif

#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"
#include <gdiplus.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "gdiplus.lib")

using namespace Gdiplus;

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

// GDI+ 初始化
static ULONG_PTR g_gdiplusToken = 0;

// GDI+ 辅助函数
int GetEncoderClsid(const WCHAR* format, CLSID* pClsid)
{
    UINT num = 0;
    UINT size = 0;
    GetImageEncodersSize(&num, &size);
    if (size == 0) return -1;

    ImageCodecInfo* pImageCodecInfo = (ImageCodecInfo*)(malloc(size));
    if (pImageCodecInfo == NULL) return -1;

    GetImageEncoders(num, size, pImageCodecInfo);
    for (UINT j = 0; j < num; ++j)
    {
        if (wcscmp(pImageCodecInfo[j].MimeType, format) == 0)
        {
            *pClsid = pImageCodecInfo[j].Clsid;
            free(pImageCodecInfo);
            return j;
        }
    }
    free(pImageCodecInfo);
    return -1;
}

// ============================================================================
// 形状类实现
// ============================================================================

void IShape::Serialize(CArchive& ar)
{
    if (ar.IsStoring())
    {
        ar << (int)tool << (DWORD)color << width;
        ar << (int)points.size();
        for (const auto& pt : points)
            ar << pt;
    }
    else
    {
        int t, count;
        DWORD c;
        ar >> t >> c >> width;
        tool = (DrawingTool)t;
        color = (COLORREF)c;
        ar >> count;
        points.resize(count);
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            ar >> points[i];
    }
}

void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    pDC->LineTo(points[1]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    pDC->Rectangle(CRect(points[0], points[1]));
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    pDC->Ellipse(CRect(points[0], points[1]));
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
    : m_currentTool(DrawingTool::PEN)
    , m_currentColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
    , m_currentWidth(2)
    , m_isDrawing(false)
{
    // 初始化 GDI+
    if (g_gdiplusToken == 0)
    {
        GdiplusStartupInput gdiplusStartupInput;
        GdiplusStartup(&g_gdiplusToken, &gdiplusStartupInput, NULL);
    }
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    // 关闭 GDI+
    if (g_gdiplusToken != 0)
    {
        GdiplusShutdown(g_gdiplusToken);
        g_gdiplusToken = 0;
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

// ============================================================================
// 绘图函数
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc) return;

    // 绘制所有已保存的形状
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
    {
        if (shape)
            shape->Draw(pDC);
    }

    // 绘制当前正在绘制的形状
    if (m_currentShape)
        m_currentShape->Draw(pDC);
}

// ============================================================================
// 鼠标事件处理
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_isDrawing = true;
    m_lastPoint = point;

    // 创建新形状
    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case DrawingTool::PEN:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CPenShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::LINE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CLineShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::RECTANGLE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CRectangleShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ELLIPSE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEllipseShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ERASER:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEraserShape>(m_currentWidth * 3);
        break;
    }

    if (m_currentShape)
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);

    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (!m_isDrawing || !m_currentShape)
    {
        CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
        return;
    }

    if (m_currentTool == DrawingTool::PEN || m_currentTool == DrawingTool::ERASER)
    {
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }
    else
    {
        if (m_currentShape->points.size() > 1)
            m_currentShape->points[1] = point;
        else
            m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }

    Invalidate(FALSE);
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
    {
        SaveStateForUndo();
        m_shapes.push_back(m_currentShape);
        m_currentShape.reset();
        SaveShapesToDocument();
        Invalidate();
    }

    m_isDrawing = false;
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditClear()
{
    if (!m_shapes.empty())
    {
        SaveStateForUndo();
        m_shapes.clear();
        SaveShapesToDocument();
        Invalidate();
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditUndo()
{
    if (!m_undoStack.empty())
    {
        m_redoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
        m_shapes = m_undoStack.back();
        m_undoStack.pop_back();
        SaveShapesToDocument();
        Invalidate();
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditRedo()
{
    if (!m_redoStack.empty())
    {
        m_undoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
        m_shapes = m_redoStack.back();
        m_redoStack.pop_back();
        SaveShapesToDocument();
        Invalidate();
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditUndo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_undoStack.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditRedo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_redoStack.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileExportPng()
{
    CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("png"), _T("drawing.png"),
        OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT,
        _T("PNG Files (*.png)|*.png||"));

    if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
    {
        ExportToPNG(dlg.GetPathName());
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::ExportToPNG(const CString& filename)
{
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);

    CDC* pDC = GetDC();
    CDC memDC;
    memDC.CreateCompatibleDC(pDC);

    CBitmap bitmap;
    bitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(pDC, rect.Width(), rect.Height());
    CBitmap* pOldBitmap = memDC.SelectObject(&bitmap);

    // 填充白色背景
    memDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));

    // 绘制所有形状
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
    {
        if (shape)
            shape->Draw(&memDC);
    }

    // 转换为 GDI+ Bitmap
    BITMAP bm;
    bitmap.GetBitmap(&bm);

    Bitmap gdipBitmap(bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight, PixelFormat24bppRGB);
    BitmapData bitmapData;
    Rect lockRect(0, 0, bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight);
    gdipBitmap.LockBits(&lockRect, ImageLockModeWrite, PixelFormat24bppRGB, &bitmapData);

    // 复制位图数据
    BITMAPINFO bi = { 0 };
    bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
    bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = bm.bmWidth;
    bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -bm.bmHeight;
    bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 24;
    bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

    GetDIBits(memDC.m_hDC, (HBITMAP)bitmap.m_hObject, 0, bm.bmHeight,
        bitmapData.Scan0, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS);

    gdipBitmap.UnlockBits(&bitmapData);

    // 保存为 PNG
    CLSID pngClsid;
    GetEncoderClsid(L"image/png", &pngClsid);
    gdipBitmap.Save(filename, &pngClsid, NULL);

    memDC.SelectObject(pOldBitmap);
    ReleaseDC(pDC);

    AfxMessageBox(_T("导出成功！"));
}

// ============================================================================
// 辅助函数
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::SaveStateForUndo()
{
    m_undoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    m_redoStack.clear();
    
    // 限制撤销栈大小
    if (m_undoStack.size() > 50)
        m_undoStack.erase(m_undoStack.begin());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::SaveShapesToDocument()
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    if (pDoc)
        pDoc->SetModifiedFlag();
}

📄 完整修正后的 DrawingBoardView.cpp
C++
 |
// DrawingBoardView.cpp : CDrawingBoardView 类的实现
//

#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif

#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"
#include <gdiplus.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "gdiplus.lib")

using namespace Gdiplus;

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

// GDI+ 初始化
static ULONG_PTR g_gdiplusToken = 0;

// GDI+ 辅助函数
int GetEncoderClsid(const WCHAR* format, CLSID* pClsid)
{
    UINT num = 0;
    UINT size = 0;
    GetImageEncodersSize(&num, &size);
    if (size == 0) return -1;

    ImageCodecInfo* pImageCodecInfo = (ImageCodecInfo*)(malloc(size));
    if (pImageCodecInfo == NULL) return -1;

    GetImageEncoders(num, size, pImageCodecInfo);
    for (UINT j = 0; j < num; ++j)
    {
        if (wcscmp(pImageCodecInfo[j].MimeType, format) == 0)
        {
            *pClsid = pImageCodecInfo[j].Clsid;
            free(pImageCodecInfo);
            return j;
        }
    }
    free(pImageCodecInfo);
    return -1;
}

// ============================================================================
// 形状类实现
// ============================================================================

void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
    {
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    }
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    pDC->LineTo(points[1]);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    // 关键：使用 NULL_BRUSH 避免填充
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Rectangle(rect);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    // 关键：使用 NULL_BRUSH 避免填充
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Ellipse(rect);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
    {
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    }
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
    : m_currentTool(DrawingTool::PEN)
    , m_currentColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
    , m_currentWidth(2)
    , m_isDrawing(false)
    , m_bBufferInitialized(false)
{
    // 初始化 GDI+
    if (g_gdiplusToken == 0)
    {
        GdiplusStartupInput gdiplusStartupInput;
        GdiplusStartup(&g_gdiplusToken, &gdiplusStartupInput, NULL);
    }
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc())
    {
        m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    }
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle())
    {
        m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();
    }
}

    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);

// ============================================================================
// 双缓冲相关
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::InitializeBuffer()
{
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);

    if (rect.Width() <= 0 || rect.Height() <= 0)
        return;

    // 如果缓冲区已存在且大小没变，不重新创建
    if (m_bBufferInitialized && rect == m_lastClientRect)
        return;

    // 清理旧缓冲区
    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc())
    {
        m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    }
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle())
    {
        m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();
    }

    // 创建新缓冲区
    CDC* pDC = GetDC();
    m_bufferDC.CreateCompatibleDC(pDC);
    m_bufferBitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(pDC, rect.Width(), rect.Height());
    m_bufferDC.SelectObject(&m_bufferBitmap);
    ReleaseDC(pDC);

    // 填充白色背景
    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));

    m_lastClientRect = rect;
    m_bBufferInitialized = true;

    // 重绘所有形状到缓冲区
    RedrawBuffer();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::RedrawBuffer()
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
        return;

    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);

    // 清空缓冲区（白色背景）
    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));

    // 绘制所有已保存的形状
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
    {
        if (shape)
            shape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::OnEraseBkgnd(CDC* pDC)
{
    // 不擦除背景，减少闪烁
    return TRUE;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnSize(UINT nType, int cx, int cy)
{
    CView::OnSize(nType, cx, cy);
    
    // 窗口大小改变时重新初始化缓冲区
    m_bBufferInitialized = false;
    InitializeBuffer();
}

// ============================================================================
// 绘图函数
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc) return;

    // 初始化缓冲区
    InitializeBuffer();

    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
        return;

    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);

    // 先绘制缓冲区内容（已保存的形状）
    pDC->BitBlt(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height(), &m_bufferDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);

    // 如果正在绘制，叠加绘制当前形状（预览）
    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
    {
        m_currentShape->Draw(pDC);
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 鼠标事件处理
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_isDrawing = true;
    m_startPoint = point;
    m_lastPoint = point;

    // 创建新形状
    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case DrawingTool::PEN:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CPenShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::LINE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CLineShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::RECTANGLE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CRectangleShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ELLIPSE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEllipseShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ERASER:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEraserShape>(m_currentWidth * 3);
        break;
    }

    if (m_currentShape)
    {
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }

    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (!m_isDrawing || !m_currentShape)
    {
        CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
        return;
    }

    // 对于铅笔和橡皮擦，连续添加点
    if (m_currentTool == DrawingTool::PEN || m_currentTool == DrawingTool::ERASER)
    {
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
        m_lastPoint = point;
    }
    // 对于几何图形，更新终点
    else
    {
        if (m_currentShape->points.size() > 1)
        {
            m_currentShape->points[1] = point;
        }
        else
        {
            m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
        }
    }

    // 只刷新客户区，不闪烁
    Invalidate(FALSE);
    
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
    {
        // 保存状态用于撤销
        SaveStateForUndo();

        // 将当前形状添加到已保存列表
        m_shapes.push_back(m_currentShape);

        // 将形状绘制到缓冲区
        m_currentShape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);

        // 清除当前形状
        m_currentShape.reset();

        // 标记文档已修改
        SaveShapesToDocument();

        // 刷新显示
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }

    m_isDrawing = false;
    ReleaseCapture();
    
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}
