void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditClear()
{
    if (m_shapes.empty())
    {
        MessageBox(_T("画板已经是空的！"), _T("提示"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }

    int result = MessageBox(_T("确定要清空整个画板吗？\n此操作不可撤销！"), 
                           _T("确认清空"), 
                           MB_YESNO | MB_ICONQUESTION);
    
    if (result == IDYES)
    {
        // 保存状态用于撤销
        SaveStateForUndo();
        
        // 清空所有形状
        m_shapes.clear();
        
        // 重绘缓冲区
        RedrawBuffer();
        
        // 标记文档已修改
        SaveShapesToDocument();
        
        // 刷新显示
        Invalidate();
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditUndo()
{
    if (!m_undoStack.empty())
    {
        // 保存当前状态到重做栈
        m_redoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
        
        // 恢复之前的状态
        m_shapes = m_undoStack.back();
        m_undoStack.pop_back();
        
        // 重绘缓冲区
        RedrawBuffer();
        
        // 标记文档已修改
        SaveShapesToDocument();
        
        // 刷新显示
        Invalidate();
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditRedo()
{
    if (!m_redoStack.empty())
    {
        // 保存当前状态到撤销栈
        m_undoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
        
        // 恢复重做状态
        m_shapes = m_redoStack.back();
        m_redoStack.pop_back();
        
        // 重绘缓冲区
        RedrawBuffer();
        
        // 标记文档已修改
        SaveShapesToDocument();
        
        // 刷新显示
        Invalidate();
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditUndo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_undoStack.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditRedo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_redoStack.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileExportPng()
{
    CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("png"), _T("drawing.png"),
        OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT,
        _T("PNG 文件 (*.png)|*.png|所有文件 (*.*)|*.*||"));

    if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
    {
        ExportToPNG(dlg.GetPathName());
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::ExportToPNG(const CString& filename)
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        MessageBox(_T("画板未初始化！"), _T("错误"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }

    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);

    if (rect.Width() <= 0 || rect.Height() <= 0)
    {
        MessageBox(_T("画板大小无效！"), _T("错误"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }

    // 获取缓冲区位图
    BITMAP bm;
    m_bufferBitmap.GetBitmap(&bm);

    // 创建 GDI+ Bitmap
    Bitmap gdipBitmap(bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight, PixelFormat24bppRGB);
    BitmapData bitmapData;
    Rect lockRect(0, 0, bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight);
    
    Status status = gdipBitmap.LockBits(&lockRect, ImageLockModeWrite, PixelFormat24bppRGB, &bitmapData);
    if (status != Ok)
    {
        MessageBox(_T("锁定位图失败！"), _T("错误"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }

    // 复制位图数据
    BITMAPINFO bi = { 0 };
    bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
    bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = bm.bmWidth;
    bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -bm.bmHeight;  // 负值表示从上到下
    bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 24;
    bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

    GetDIBits(m_bufferDC.m_hDC, (HBITMAP)m_bufferBitmap.m_hObject, 0, bm.bmHeight,
        bitmapData.Scan0, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS);

    gdipBitmap.UnlockBits(&bitmapData);

    // 保存为 PNG
    CLSID pngClsid;
    if (GetEncoderClsid(L"image/png", &pngClsid) < 0)
    {
        MessageBox(_T("未找到 PNG 编码器！"), _T("错误"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }

    status = gdipBitmap.Save(filename, &pngClsid, NULL);
    if (status == Ok)
    {
        CString msg;
        msg.Format(_T("图片已成功导出到：\n%s"), (LPCTSTR)filename);
        MessageBox(msg, _T("导出成功"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
    }
    else
    {
        MessageBox(_T("保存文件失败！"), _T("错误"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 辅助函数
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::SaveStateForUndo()
{
    // 保存当前状态到撤销栈
    m_undoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    
    // 清空重做栈
    m_redoStack.clear();
    
    // 限制撤销栈大小（最多保留50步）
    if (m_undoStack.size() > 50)
    {
        m_undoStack.erase(m_undoStack.begin());
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::SaveShapesToDocument()
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    if (pDoc)
    {
        pDoc->SetModifiedFlag(TRUE);
    }
}

// DrawingBoardView.h: CDrawingBoardView 类的接口
//

#pragma once
#include <vector>
#include <memory>

// 前向声明
class IShape;

// 绘图工具枚举
enum class DrawingTool
{
    PEN,
    LINE,
    RECTANGLE,
    ELLIPSE,
    ERASER
};

// 形状基类
class IShape
{
public:
    DrawingTool tool;
    COLORREF color;
    int width;
    std::vector<CPoint> points;

    IShape(DrawingTool t, COLORREF c, int w)
        : tool(t), color(c), width(w) {}
    virtual ~IShape() = default;
    
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) const = 0;
    virtual IShape* Clone() const = 0;
};

// 铅笔工具
class CPenShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CPenShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::PEN, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CPenShape(*this); }
};

// 直线工具
class CLineShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CLineShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::LINE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CLineShape(*this); }
};

// 矩形工具
class CRectangleShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CRectangleShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::RECTANGLE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CRectangleShape(*this); }
};

// 椭圆工具
class CEllipseShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CEllipseShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::ELLIPSE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CEllipseShape(*this); }
};

// 橡皮擦工具
class CEraserShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CEraserShape(int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::ERASER, RGB(255, 255, 255), w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CEraserShape(*this); }
};

C++

// DrawingBoardView.cpp : CDrawingBoardView 类的实现
//

#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif

#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"
#include <gdiplus.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "gdiplus.lib")

using namespace Gdiplus;

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

// GDI+ 初始化
static ULONG_PTR g_gdiplusToken = 0;

// GDI+ 辅助函数
int GetEncoderClsid(const WCHAR* format, CLSID* pClsid)
{
    UINT num = 0;
    UINT size = 0;
    GetImageEncodersSize(&num, &size);
    if (size == 0) return -1;

    ImageCodecInfo* pImageCodecInfo = (ImageCodecInfo*)(malloc(size));
    if (pImageCodecInfo == NULL) return -1;

    GetImageEncoders(num, size, pImageCodecInfo);
    for (UINT j = 0; j < num; ++j)
    {
        if (wcscmp(pImageCodecInfo[j].MimeType, format) == 0)
        {
            *pClsid = pImageCodecInfo[j].Clsid;
            free(pImageCodecInfo);
            return j;
        }
    }
    free(pImageCodecInfo);
    return -1;
}

// ============================================================================
// 形状类实现
// ============================================================================

void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
    {
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    }
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    pDC->LineTo(points[1]);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Rectangle(rect);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Ellipse(rect);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
    {
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    }
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
    : m_currentTool(DrawingTool::PEN)
    , m_currentColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
    , m_currentWidth(2)
    , m_isDrawing(false)
    , m_bBufferInitialized(false)
{
    // 初始化 GDI+
    if (g_gdiplusToken == 0)
    {
        GdiplusStartupInput gdiplusStartupInput;
        GdiplusStartup(&g_gdiplusToken, &gdiplusStartupInput, NULL);
    }
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc())
    {
        m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    }
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle())
    {
        m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

// ============================================================================
// 双缓冲相关
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::InitializeBuffer()
{
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);

    if (rect.Width() <= 0 || rect.Height() <= 0)
        return;

    if (m_bBufferInitialized && rect == m_lastClientRect)
        return;

    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc())
    {
        m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    }
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle())
    {
        m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();
    }

    CDC* pDC = GetDC();
    m_bufferDC.CreateCompatibleDC(pDC);
    m_bufferBitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(pDC, rect.Width(), rect.Height());
    m_bufferDC.SelectObject(&m_bufferBitmap);
    ReleaseDC(pDC);

    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));

    m_lastClientRect = rect;
    m_bBufferInitialized = true;

    RedrawBuffer();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::RedrawBuffer()
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
        return;

    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);

    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));

    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
    {
        if (shape)
            shape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::OnEraseBkgnd(CDC* pDC)
{
    return TRUE;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnSize(UINT nType, int cx, int cy)
{
    CView::OnSize(nType, cx, cy);
    m_bBufferInitialized = false;
    InitializeBuffer();
}

// ============================================================================
// 绘图函数
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc) return;

    InitializeBuffer();

    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
        return;

    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);

    pDC->BitBlt(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height(), &m_bufferDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);

    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
    {
        m_currentShape->Draw(pDC);
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 鼠标事件处理
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_isDrawing = true;
    m_startPoint = point;
    m_lastPoint = point;

    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case DrawingTool::PEN:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CPenShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::LINE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CLineShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::RECTANGLE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CRectangleShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ELLIPSE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEllipseShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ERASER:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEraserShape>(m_currentWidth * 3);
        break;
    }

    if (m_currentShape)
    {
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }

    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (!m_isDrawing || !m_currentShape)
    {
        CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
        return;
    }

    if (m_currentTool == DrawingTool::PEN || m_currentTool == DrawingTool::ERASER)
    {
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
        m_lastPoint = point;
    }
    else
    {
        if (m_currentShape->points.size() > 1)
        {
            m_currentShape->points[1] = point;
        }
        else
        {
            m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
        }
    }

    Invalidate(FALSE);
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
    {
        SaveStateForUndo();
        m_shapes.push_back(m_currentShape);
        m_currentShape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
        m_currentShape.reset();
        SaveShapesToDocument();
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }

    m_isDrawing = false;
    ReleaseCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

// ============================================================================
// 编辑命令 - 核心功能
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditClearAll()
{
    TRACE("OnEditClearAll called\n");  // 调试信息
    
    if (m_shapes.empty())
    {
        AfxMessageBox(_T("画板已经是空的！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }

    int result = AfxMessageBox(
        _T("确定要清空整个画板吗？\n此操作可以撤销。"), 
        MB_YESNO | MB_ICONQUESTION
    );
    
    if (result == IDYES)
    {
        TRACE("Clearing board - shapes count: %d\n", (int)m_shapes.size());
        
        // 保存当前状态到撤销栈
        SaveStateForUndo();
        
        // 清空所有形状
        m_shapes.clear();
        
        // 重绘缓冲区为白色背景
        RedrawBuffer();
        
        // 标记文档已修改
        SaveShapesToDocument();
        
        // 刷新显示
        Invalidate();
        
        TRACE("Board cleared successfully\n");
        AfxMessageBox(_T("画板已清空！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditUndo()
{
    TRACE("OnEditUndo called - undo stack size: %d\n", (int)m_undoStack.size());
    
    if (m_undoStack.empty())
    {
        AfxMessageBox(_T("没有可以撤销的操作！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }

    // 保存当前状态到重做栈
    m_redoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    
    // 恢复之前的状态
    m_shapes = m_undoStack.back();
    m_undoStack.pop_back();
    
    TRACE("Undo performed - new shapes count: %d\n", (int)m_shapes.size());
    
    // 重绘缓冲区
    RedrawBuffer();
    
    // 标记文档已修改
    SaveShapesToDocument();
    
    // 刷新显示
    Invalidate();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditRedo()
{
    TRACE("OnEditRedo called - redo stack size: %d\n", (int)m_redoStack.size());
    
    if (m_redoStack.empty())
    {
        AfxMessageBox(_T("没有可以重做的操作！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }

    // 保存当前状态到撤销栈
    m_undoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    
    // 恢复重做状态
    m_shapes = m_redoStack.back();
    m_redoStack.pop_back();
    
    TRACE("Redo performed - new shapes count: %d\n", (int)m_shapes.size());
    
    // 重绘缓冲区
    RedrawBuffer();
    
    // 标记文档已修改
    SaveShapesToDocument();
    
    // 刷新显示
    Invalidate();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditClearAll(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    // 只有当画板不为空时才启用
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_shapes.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditUndo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    // 只有当撤销栈不为空时才启用
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_undoStack.empty());
    
    CString text;
    if (!m_undoStack.empty())
    {
        text.Format(_T("撤销 (%d)"), (int)m_undoStack.size());
    }
    else
    {
        text = _T("撤销");
    }
    pCmdUI->SetText(text);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditRedo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    // 只有当重做栈不为空时才启用
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_redoStack.empty());
    
    CString text;
    if (!m_redoStack.empty())
    {
        text.Format(_T("重做 (%d)"), (int)m_redoStack.size());
    }
    else
    {
        text = _T("重做");
    }
    pCmdUI->SetText(text);
}

// ============================================================================
// 文件命令
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileExportPng()
{
    CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("png"), _T("drawing.png"),
        OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT,
        _T("PNG 文件 (*.png)|*.png|所有文件 (*.*)|*.*||"));

    if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
    {
        ExportToPNG(dlg.GetPathName());
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::ExportToPNG(const CString& filename)
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        AfxMessageBox(_T("画板未初始化！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }

    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);

    if (rect.Width() <= 0 || rect.Height() <= 0)
    {
        AfxMessageBox(_T("画板大小无效！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }

    BITMAP bm;
    m_bufferBitmap.GetBitmap(&bm);

    Bitmap gdipBitmap(bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight, PixelFormat24bppRGB);
    BitmapData bitmapData;
    Rect lockRect(0, 0, bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight);
    
    Status status = gdipBitmap.LockBits(&lockRect, ImageLockModeWrite, PixelFormat24bppRGB, &bitmapData);
    if (status != Ok)
    {
        AfxMessageBox(_T("锁定位图失败！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }

    BITMAPINFO bi = { 0 };
    bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
    bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = bm.bmWidth;
    bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -bm.bmHeight;
    bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 24;
    bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

    GetDIBits(m_bufferDC.m_hDC, (HBITMAP)m_bufferBitmap.m_hObject, 0, bm.bmHeight,
        bitmapData.Scan0, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS);

    gdipBitmap.UnlockBits(&bitmapData);

    CLSID pngClsid;
    if (GetEncoderClsid(L"image/png", &pngClsid) < 0)
    {
        AfxMessageBox(_T("未找到 PNG 编码器！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }

    status = gdipBitmap.Save(filename, &pngClsid, NULL);
    if (status == Ok)
    {
        CString msg;
        msg.Format(_T("图片已成功导出到：\n%s"), (LPCTSTR)filename);
        AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
    }
    else
    {
        AfxMessageBox(_T("保存文件失败！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 辅助函数
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::SaveStateForUndo()
{
    TRACE("SaveStateForUndo - current shapes: %d\n", (int)m_shapes.size());
    
    // 保存当前状态到撤销栈
    m_undoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    
    // 清空重做栈（新操作后不能重做）
    m_redoStack.clear();
    
    // 限制撤销栈大小（最多50步）
    if (m_undoStack.size() > 50)
    {
        m_undoStack.erase(m_undoStack.begin());
    }
    
    TRACE("Undo stack size: %d\n", (int)m_undoStack.size());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::SaveShapesToDocument()
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    if (pDoc)
    {
        pDoc->SetModifiedFlag(TRUE);
    }
}

// DrawingBoardView.h
#pragma once
#include <vector>
#include <memory>

class IShape;

enum class DrawingTool
{
    PEN,
    LINE,
    RECTANGLE,
    ELLIPSE,
    ERASER
};

class IShape
{
public:
    DrawingTool tool;
    COLORREF color;
    int width;
    std::vector<CPoint> points;

    IShape(DrawingTool t, COLORREF c, int w)
        : tool(t), color(c), width(w) {}
    virtual ~IShape() = default;
    
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) const = 0;
    virtual IShape* Clone() const = 0;
};

class CPenShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CPenShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::PEN, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CPenShape(*this); }
};

class CLineShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CLineShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::LINE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CLineShape(*this); }
};

class CRectangleShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CRectangleShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::RECTANGLE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CRectangleShape(*this); }
};

class CEllipseShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CEllipseShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::ELLIPSE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CEllipseShape(*this); }
};

class CEraserShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CEraserShape(int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::ERASER, RGB(255, 255, 255), w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CEraserShape(*this); }
};

📄 5. DrawingBoardView.cpp - 完整版（修复所有问题）
C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif
#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"
#include <gdiplus.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "gdiplus.lib")

using namespace Gdiplus;

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

static ULONG_PTR g_gdiplusToken = 0;

int GetEncoderClsid(const WCHAR* format, CLSID* pClsid)
{
    UINT num = 0;
    UINT size = 0;
    GetImageEncodersSize(&num, &size);
    if (size == 0) return -1;

    ImageCodecInfo* pImageCodecInfo = (ImageCodecInfo*)(malloc(size));
    if (pImageCodecInfo == NULL) return -1;

    GetImageEncoders(num, size, pImageCodecInfo);
    for (UINT j = 0; j < num; ++j)
    {
        if (wcscmp(pImageCodecInfo[j].MimeType, format) == 0)
        {
            *pClsid = pImageCodecInfo[j].Clsid;
            free(pImageCodecInfo);
            return j;
        }
    }
    free(pImageCodecInfo);
    return -1;
}

// ========== 形状类实现 ==========

void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    pDC->LineTo(points[1]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    // 关键：设置透明画刷，不填充
    int oldMode = pDC->SetBkMode(TRANSPARENT);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Rectangle(rect);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SetBkMode(oldMode);
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    // 关键：设置透明画刷，不填充
    int oldMode = pDC->SetBkMode(TRANSPARENT);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Ellipse(rect);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SetBkMode(oldMode);
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
    : m_currentTool(DrawingTool::PEN)
    , m_currentColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
    , m_currentWidth(2)
    , m_isDrawing(false)
    , m_bBufferInitialized(false)
{
    if (g_gdiplusToken == 0)
    {
        GdiplusStartupInput gdiplusStartupInput;
        GdiplusStartup(&g_gdiplusToken, &gdiplusStartupInput, NULL);
    }
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc())
        m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle())
        m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

// ========== 双缓冲 ==========

void CDrawingBoardView::InitializeBuffer()
{
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    if (rect.Width() <= 0 || rect.Height() <= 0) return;
    if (m_bBufferInitialized && rect == m_lastClientRect) return;

    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc()) m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle()) m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();

    CDC* pDC = GetDC();
    m_bufferDC.CreateCompatibleDC(pDC);
    m_bufferBitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(pDC, rect.Width(), rect.Height());
    m_bufferDC.SelectObject(&m_bufferBitmap);
    ReleaseDC(pDC);

    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    m_lastClientRect = rect;
    m_bBufferInitialized = true;
    RedrawBuffer();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::RedrawBuffer()
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized) return;
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
    {
        if (shape) shape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::OnEraseBkgnd(CDC* pDC)
{
    return TRUE;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnSize(UINT nType, int cx, int cy)
{
    CView::OnSize(nType, cx, cy);
    m_bBufferInitialized = false;
    InitializeBuffer();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc) return;

    InitializeBuffer();
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized) return;

    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    pDC->BitBlt(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height(), &m_bufferDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);

    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
        m_currentShape->Draw(pDC);
}

// ========== 鼠标事件 ==========

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_isDrawing = true;
    m_startPoint = point;

    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case DrawingTool::PEN:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CPenShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::LINE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CLineShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::RECTANGLE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CRectangleShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ELLIPSE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEllipseShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ERASER:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEraserShape>(m_currentWidth * 3);
        break;
    }

    if (m_currentShape)
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);

    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (!m_isDrawing || !m_currentShape)
    {
        CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
        return;
    }

    if (m_currentTool == DrawingTool::PEN || m_currentTool == DrawingTool::ERASER)
    {
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }
    else
    {
        if (m_currentShape->points.size() > 1)
            m_currentShape->points[1] = point;
        else
            m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }

    Invalidate(FALSE);
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
    {
        SaveStateForUndo();
        m_shapes.push_back(m_currentShape);
        m_currentShape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
        m_currentShape.reset();
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }

    m_isDrawing = false;
    ReleaseCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditUndo()
{
    if (m_undoStack.empty())
    {
        MessageBeep(MB_OK);
        return;
    }

    m_redoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    m_shapes = m_undoStack.back();
    m_undoStack.pop_back();
    
    RedrawBuffer();
    Invalidate();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditRedo()
{
    if (m_redoStack.empty())
    {
        MessageBeep(MB_OK);
        return;
    }

    m_undoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    m_shapes = m_redoStack.back();
    m_redoStack.pop_back();
    
    RedrawBuffer();
    Invalidate();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditClearAll()
{
    if (m_shapes.empty())
    {
        AfxMessageBox(_T("画板已经是空的！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }

    if (AfxMessageBox(_T("确定要清空整个画板吗？\n此操作可以撤销。"), 
        MB_YESNO | MB_ICONQUESTION) == IDYES)
    {
        SaveStateForUndo();
        m_shapes.clear();
        RedrawBuffer();
        Invalidate();
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditUndo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_undoStack.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditRedo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_redoStack.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditClearAll(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_shapes.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::SaveStateForUndo()
{
    m_undoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    m_redoStack.clear();
    if (m_undoStack.size() > 50)
        m_undoStack.erase(m_undoStack.begin());
}

// ========== 导出PNG ==========

void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileExportPng()
{
    CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("png"), _T("drawing.png"),
        OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT,
        _T("PNG 文件 (*.png)|*.png||"));

    if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
    {
        if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
        {
            AfxMessageBox(_T("画板未初始化！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
            return;
        }

        BITMAP bm;
        m_bufferBitmap.GetBitmap(&bm);

        Bitmap gdipBitmap(bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight, PixelFormat24bppRGB);
        BitmapData bitmapData;
        Rect lockRect(0, 0, bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight);
        
        if (gdipBitmap.LockBits(&lockRect, ImageLockModeWrite, PixelFormat24bppRGB, &bitmapData) != Ok)
        {
            AfxMessageBox(_T("锁定位图失败！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
            return;
        }

        BITMAPINFO bi = { 0 };
        bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
        bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = bm.bmWidth;
        bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -bm.bmHeight;
        bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
        bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 24;
        bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

        GetDIBits(m_bufferDC.m_hDC, (HBITMAP)m_bufferBitmap.m_hObject, 0, bm.bmHeight,
            bitmapData.Scan0, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS);

        gdipBitmap.UnlockBits(&bitmapData);

        CLSID pngClsid;
        if (GetEncoderClsid(L"image/png", &pngClsid) >= 0)
        {
            if (gdipBitmap.Save(dlg.GetPathName(), &pngClsid, NULL) == Ok)
                AfxMessageBox(_T("导出成功！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
            else
                AfxMessageBox(_T("保存失败！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        }
    }
}

{
    PEN,
    LINE,
    RECTANGLE,
    ELLIPSE,
    ERASER

// 形状基类
class IShape
{
public:
    DrawingTool tool;
    COLORREF color;
    int width;
    std::vector<CPoint> points;

    IShape(DrawingTool t, COLORREF c, int w)
        : tool(t), color(c), width(w) {}
    virtual ~IShape() = default;
    
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) const = 0;
    virtual IShape* Clone() const = 0;

📄 3. DrawingBoardView.cpp - 完整实现
C++
 |
// DrawingBoardView.cpp
#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif
#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"
#include <gdiplus.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "gdiplus.lib")

using namespace Gdiplus;

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

static ULONG_PTR g_gdiplusToken = 0;

// GDI+ 辅助函数
int GetEncoderClsid(const WCHAR* format, CLSID* pClsid)
{
    UINT num = 0;
    UINT size = 0;
    GetImageEncodersSize(&num, &size);
    if (size == 0) return -1;

    ImageCodecInfo* pImageCodecInfo = (ImageCodecInfo*)(malloc(size));
    if (pImageCodecInfo == NULL) return -1;

    GetImageEncoders(num, size, pImageCodecInfo);
    for (UINT j = 0; j < num; ++j)
    {
        if (wcscmp(pImageCodecInfo[j].MimeType, format) == 0)
        {
            *pClsid = pImageCodecInfo[j].Clsid;
            free(pImageCodecInfo);
            return j;
        }
    }
    free(pImageCodecInfo);
    return -1;
}

// ============================================================================
// 形状类实现
// ============================================================================

void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    pDC->LineTo(points[1]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    int oldMode = pDC->SetBkMode(TRANSPARENT);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Rectangle(rect);
    
    pDC->SetBkMode(oldMode);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    int oldMode = pDC->SetBkMode(TRANSPARENT);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Ellipse(rect);
    
    pDC->SetBkMode(oldMode);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_MY_UNDO, &CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyUndo)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_MY_REDO, &CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyRedo)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_EDIT_CLEAR_ALL, &CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditClearAll)
    
    // 文件命令
    ON_COMMAND(ID_FILE_EXPORT_PNG, &CDrawingBoardView::OnFileExportPng)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_FILE_PRINT, &CView::OnFilePrint)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_FILE_PRINT_DIRECT, &CView::OnFilePrint)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_FILE_PRINT_PREVIEW, &CView::OnFilePrintPreview)
END_MESSAGE_MAP()

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()

    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc())
        m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle())
        m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();
}

    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

// ============================================================================
// 双缓冲
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::InitializeBuffer()
{
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    if (rect.Width() <= 0 || rect.Height() <= 0) return;
    if (m_bBufferInitialized && rect == m_lastClientRect) return;

    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc()) m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle()) m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();

    CDC* pDC = GetDC();
    m_bufferDC.CreateCompatibleDC(pDC);
    m_bufferBitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(pDC, rect.Width(), rect.Height());
    m_bufferDC.SelectObject(&m_bufferBitmap);
    ReleaseDC(pDC);

    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    m_lastClientRect = rect;
    m_bBufferInitialized = true;
    RedrawBuffer();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::RedrawBuffer()
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized) return;
    
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
    {
        if (shape) shape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::OnEraseBkgnd(CDC* pDC)
{
    return TRUE;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnSize(UINT nType, int cx, int cy)
{
    CView::OnSize(nType, cx, cy);
    m_bBufferInitialized = false;
    InitializeBuffer();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc) return;

    InitializeBuffer();
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized) return;

    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    pDC->BitBlt(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height(), &m_bufferDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);

    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
        m_currentShape->Draw(pDC);
}

// ============================================================================
// 鼠标事件
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_isDrawing = true;
    m_startPoint = point;

    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case DrawingTool::PEN:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CPenShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::LINE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CLineShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::RECTANGLE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CRectangleShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ELLIPSE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEllipseShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ERASER:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEraserShape>(m_currentWidth * 3);
        break;
    }

    if (m_currentShape)
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);

    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (!m_isDrawing || !m_currentShape)
    {
        CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
        return;
    }

    if (m_currentTool == DrawingTool::PEN || m_currentTool == DrawingTool::ERASER)
    {
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }
    else
    {
        if (m_currentShape->points.size() > 1)
            m_currentShape->points[1] = point;
        else
            m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }

    Invalidate(FALSE);
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
    {
        SaveStateForUndo();
        m_shapes.push_back(m_currentShape);
        m_currentShape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
        m_currentShape.reset();
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }

    m_isDrawing = false;
    ReleaseCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

// ============================================================================
// 编辑命令 - 核心实现
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyUndo()
{
    TRACE("======= OnMyUndo called =======\n");
    TRACE("Undo stack size: %d\n", (int)m_undoStack.size());
    
    if (m_undoStack.empty())
    {
        AfxMessageBox(_T("没有可撤销的操作！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        MessageBeep(MB_OK);
        return;
    }

    // 保存当前状态到重做栈
    m_redoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    
    // 恢复之前的状态
    m_shapes = m_undoStack.back();
    m_undoStack.pop_back();
    
    TRACE("After undo - shapes count: %d\n", (int)m_shapes.size());
    TRACE("Redo stack size: %d\n", (int)m_redoStack.size());
    
    // 重绘
    RedrawBuffer();
    Invalidate();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyRedo()
{
    TRACE("======= OnMyRedo called =======\n");
    TRACE("Redo stack size: %d\n", (int)m_redoStack.size());
    
    if (m_redoStack.empty())
    {
        AfxMessageBox(_T("没有可重做的操作！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        MessageBeep(MB_OK);
        return;
    }

    // 保存当前状态到撤销栈
    m_undoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    
    // 恢复重做状态
    m_shapes = m_redoStack.back();
    m_redoStack.pop_back();
    
    TRACE("After redo - shapes count: %d\n", (int)m_shapes.size());
    TRACE("Undo stack size: %d\n", (int)m_undoStack.size());
    
    // 重绘
    RedrawBuffer();
    Invalidate();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditClearAll()
{
    TRACE("======= OnEditClearAll called =======\n");
    TRACE("Current shapes count: %d\n", (int)m_shapes.size());
    
    if (m_shapes.empty())
    {
        AfxMessageBox(_T("画板已经是空的！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }

    int result = AfxMessageBox(
        _T("确定要清空整个画板吗？\n\n此操作可以通过撤销恢复。"), 
        MB_YESNO | MB_ICONQUESTION | MB_DEFBUTTON2
    );
    
    if (result == IDYES)
    {
        TRACE("User confirmed - clearing board\n");
        
        // 保存当前状态到撤销栈
        SaveStateForUndo();
        
        // 清空所有图形
        m_shapes.clear();
        
        TRACE("Shapes cleared - new count: %d\n", (int)m_shapes.size());
        TRACE("Undo stack size: %d\n", (int)m_undoStack.size());
        
        // 重绘缓冲区为白色背景
        RedrawBuffer();
        
        // 刷新显示
        Invalidate();
        
        AfxMessageBox(_T("画板已清空！\n可以按 Ctrl+Z 撤销此操作。"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
    }
    else
    {
        TRACE("User cancelled\n");
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyUndo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    BOOL bEnable = !m_undoStack.empty();
    pCmdUI->Enable(bEnable);
    
    CString text;
    if (bEnable)
        text.Format(_T("撤销 (%d 步)"), (int)m_undoStack.size());
    else
        text = _T("撤销");
    pCmdUI->SetText(text);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyRedo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    BOOL bEnable = !m_redoStack.empty();
    pCmdUI->Enable(bEnable);
    
    CString text;
    if (bEnable)
        text.Format(_T("重做 (%d 步)"), (int)m_redoStack.size());
    else
        text = _T("重做");
    pCmdUI->SetText(text);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditClearAll(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    BOOL bEnable = !m_shapes.empty();
    pCmdUI->Enable(bEnable);
    
    if (!bEnable)
        pCmdUI->SetText(_T("清空画板 (画板为空)"));
    else
        pCmdUI->SetText(_T("清空画板"));
}

void CDrawingBoardView::SaveStateForUndo()
{
    TRACE("SaveStateForUndo - current shapes: %d\n", (int)m_shapes.size());
    
    // 保存当前状态
    m_undoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    
    // 清空重做栈
    m_redoStack.clear();
    
    // 限制撤销栈大小
    if (m_undoStack.size() > 50)
        m_undoStack.erase(m_undoStack.begin());
    
    TRACE("Undo stack size after save: %d\n", (int)m_undoStack.size());
}

// ============================================================================
// 导出PNG
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileExportPng()
{
    CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("png"), _T("drawing.png"),
        OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT,
        _T("PNG 文件 (*.png)|*.png||"));

    if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
    {
        if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
        {
            AfxMessageBox(_T("画板未初始化！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
            return;
        }

        BITMAP bm;
        m_bufferBitmap.GetBitmap(&bm);

        Bitmap gdipBitmap(bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight, PixelFormat24bppRGB);
        BitmapData bitmapData;
        Rect lockRect(0, 0, bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight);
        
        if (gdipBitmap.LockBits(&lockRect, ImageLockModeWrite, PixelFormat24bppRGB, &bitmapData) != Ok)
        {
            AfxMessageBox(_T("锁定位图失败！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
            return;
        }

        BITMAPINFO bi = { 0 };
        bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
        bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = bm.bmWidth;
        bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -bm.bmHeight;
        bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
        bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 24;
        bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

        GetDIBits(m_bufferDC.m_hDC, (HBITMAP)m_bufferBitmap.m_hObject, 0, bm.bmHeight,
            bitmapData.Scan0, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS);

        gdipBitmap.UnlockBits(&bitmapData);

        CLSID pngClsid;
        if (GetEncoderClsid(L"image/png", &pngClsid) >= 0)
        {
            if (gdipBitmap.Save(dlg.GetPathName(), &pngClsid, NULL) == Ok)
            {
                CString msg;
                msg.Format(_T("图片已成功导出到：\n%s"), (LPCTSTR)dlg.GetPathName());
                AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
            }
            else
                AfxMessageBox(_T("保存文件失败！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        }
        else
            AfxMessageBox(_T("未找到 PNG 编码器！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
    }
}

📋 4. 手动添加菜单（在资源编辑器中）

 |
编辑(&E)
├─ 撤销(&U)    Ctrl+Z    ID_MY_UNDO
├─ 重做(&R)    Ctrl+Y    ID_MY_REDO
├─ ──────────────────
└─ 清空画板(&C)         ID_EDIT_CLEAR_ALL
添加快捷键表 IDR_MAINFRAME ACCELERATORS:
 |
Ctrl+Z  →  ID_MY_UNDO
Ctrl+Y  →  ID_MY_REDO
Ctrl+Delete  →  ID_EDIT_CLEAR_ALL
✅ 测试清单
操作	预期结果
画几个图形	正常绘制 ✅

    pCmdUI->Enable(bEnable);
    
    if (bEnable)
        pCmdUI->SetText(_T("清空画板"));
    else
        pCmdUI->SetText(_T("清空画板 (画板为空)"));
}

// DrawingBoardView.h
#pragma once
#include <vector>
#include <memory>

class IShape;

enum class DrawingTool
{
    PEN,
    LINE,
    RECTANGLE,
    ELLIPSE,
    ERASER
};

// 形状基类
class IShape
{
public:
    DrawingTool tool;
    COLORREF color;
    int width;
    std::vector<CPoint> points;

    IShape(DrawingTool t, COLORREF c, int w)
        : tool(t), color(c), width(w) {}
    virtual ~IShape() = default;
    
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) const = 0;
    virtual IShape* Clone() const = 0;
};

// 铅笔
class CPenShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CPenShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::PEN, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CPenShape(*this); }
};

// 直线
class CLineShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CLineShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::LINE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CLineShape(*this); }
};

// 矩形
class CRectangleShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CRectangleShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::RECTANGLE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CRectangleShape(*this); }
};

// 椭圆
class CEllipseShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CEllipseShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::ELLIPSE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CEllipseShape(*this); }
};

// 橡皮擦
class CEraserShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CEraserShape(int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::ERASER, RGB(255, 255, 255), w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CEraserShape(*this); }
};

📄 3. DrawingBoardView.cpp - 完整实现（直接全部替换）
C++
 |
// DrawingBoardView.cpp
#include "pch.h"
#include "framework.h"
#ifndef SHARED_HANDLERS
#include "DrawingBoard.h"
#endif
#include "DrawingBoardDoc.h"
#include "DrawingBoardView.h"
#include "Resource.h"
#include <gdiplus.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "gdiplus.lib")

using namespace Gdiplus;

#ifdef _DEBUG
#define new DEBUG_NEW
#endif

static ULONG_PTR g_gdiplusToken = 0;

// GDI+ 辅助函数
int GetEncoderClsid(const WCHAR* format, CLSID* pClsid)
{
    UINT num = 0;
    UINT size = 0;
    GetImageEncodersSize(&num, &size);
    if (size == 0) return -1;

    ImageCodecInfo* pImageCodecInfo = (ImageCodecInfo*)(malloc(size));
    if (pImageCodecInfo == NULL) return -1;

    GetImageEncoders(num, size, pImageCodecInfo);
    for (UINT j = 0; j < num; ++j)
    {
        if (wcscmp(pImageCodecInfo[j].MimeType, format) == 0)
        {
            *pClsid = pImageCodecInfo[j].Clsid;
            free(pImageCodecInfo);
            return j;
        }
    }
    free(pImageCodecInfo);
    return -1;
}

// ============================================================================
// 形状类实现
// ============================================================================

void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    pDC->LineTo(points[1]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    int oldMode = pDC->SetBkMode(TRANSPARENT);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Rectangle(rect);
    
    pDC->SetBkMode(oldMode);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    int oldMode = pDC->SetBkMode(TRANSPARENT);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Ellipse(rect);
    
    pDC->SetBkMode(oldMode);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
    : m_currentTool(DrawingTool::PEN)
    , m_currentColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
    , m_currentWidth(2)
    , m_isDrawing(false)
    , m_bBufferInitialized(false)
{
    if (g_gdiplusToken == 0)
    {
        GdiplusStartupInput gdiplusStartupInput;
        GdiplusStartup(&g_gdiplusToken, &gdiplusStartupInput, NULL);
    }
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc())
        m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle())
        m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::InitializeBuffer()
{
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    if (rect.Width() <= 0 || rect.Height() <= 0) return;
    if (m_bBufferInitialized && rect == m_lastClientRect) return;

    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc()) m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle()) m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();

    CDC* pDC = GetDC();
    m_bufferDC.CreateCompatibleDC(pDC);
    m_bufferBitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(pDC, rect.Width(), rect.Height());
    m_bufferDC.SelectObject(&m_bufferBitmap);
    ReleaseDC(pDC);

    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    m_lastClientRect = rect;
    m_bBufferInitialized = true;
    RedrawBuffer();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::RedrawBuffer()
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized) return;
    
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
    {
        if (shape) shape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::OnEraseBkgnd(CDC* pDC)
{
    return TRUE;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnSize(UINT nType, int cx, int cy)
{
    CView::OnSize(nType, cx, cy);
    m_bBufferInitialized = false;
    InitializeBuffer();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc) return;

    InitializeBuffer();
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized) return;

    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    pDC->BitBlt(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height(), &m_bufferDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);

    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
        m_currentShape->Draw(pDC);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_isDrawing = true;
    m_startPoint = point;

    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case DrawingTool::PEN:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CPenShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::LINE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CLineShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::RECTANGLE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CRectangleShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ELLIPSE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEllipseShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ERASER:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEraserShape>(m_currentWidth * 3);
        break;
    }

    if (m_currentShape)
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);

    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (!m_isDrawing || !m_currentShape)
    {
        CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
        return;
    }

    if (m_currentTool == DrawingTool::PEN || m_currentTool == DrawingTool::ERASER)
    {
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }
    else
    {
        if (m_currentShape->points.size() > 1)
            m_currentShape->points[1] = point;
        else
            m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }

    Invalidate(FALSE);
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
    {
        SaveStateForUndo();
        m_shapes.push_back(m_currentShape);
        m_currentShape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
        m_currentShape.reset();
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }

    m_isDrawing = false;
    ReleaseCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

// 工具命令

void CDrawingBoardView::OnToolLine() { m_currentTool = DrawingTool::LINE; }
void CDrawingBoardView::OnToolRectangle() { m_currentTool = DrawingTool::RECTANGLE; }
void CDrawingBoardView::OnToolEllipse() { m_currentTool = DrawingTool::ELLIPSE; }
void CDrawingBoardView::OnToolEraser() { m_currentTool = DrawingTool::ERASER; }

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateToolPen(CCmdUI* pCmdUI) { pCmdUI->SetCheck(m_currentTool == DrawingTool::PEN); }
void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateToolLine(CCmdUI* pCmdUI) { pCmdUI->SetCheck(m_currentTool == DrawingTool::LINE); }

// 编辑命令 - 核心实现
void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyUndo()
{
    if (m_undoStack.empty()) return;
    
    m_redoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    m_shapes = m_undoStack.back();
    m_undoStack.pop_back();
    
    RedrawBuffer();
    Invalidate();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyRedo()
{
    if (m_redoStack.empty()) return;
    
    m_undoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    m_shapes = m_redoStack.back();
    m_redoStack.pop_back();
    
    RedrawBuffer();
    Invalidate();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditClearAll()
{
    if (m_shapes.empty())
    {
        AfxMessageBox(_T("画板已经是空的！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }

    int result = AfxMessageBox(
        _T("确定要清空整个画板吗？\n\n此操作可以通过撤销恢复。"), 
        MB_YESNO | MB_ICONQUESTION | MB_DEFBUTTON2
    );
    
    if (result == IDYES)
    {
        SaveStateForUndo();
        m_shapes.clear();
        RedrawBuffer();
        Invalidate();
        AfxMessageBox(_T("画板已清空！\n可以按 Ctrl+Z 撤销此操作。"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyUndo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_undoStack.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyRedo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_redoStack.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditClearAll(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_shapes.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::SaveStateForUndo()
{
    m_undoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    m_redoStack.clear();
    
    if (m_undoStack.size() > 50)
        m_undoStack.erase(m_undoStack.begin());
}

// 导出PNG
void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileExportPng()
{
    CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("png"), _T("drawing.png"),
        OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT,
        _T("PNG 文件 (*.png)|*.png||"));

    if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
    {
        if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
        {
            AfxMessageBox(_T("画板未初始化！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
            return;
        }

        BITMAP bm;
        m_bufferBitmap.GetBitmap(&bm);

        Bitmap gdipBitmap(bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight, PixelFormat24bppRGB);
        BitmapData bitmapData;
        Rect lockRect(0, 0, bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight);
        
        if (gdipBitmap.LockBits(&lockRect, ImageLockModeWrite, PixelFormat24bppRGB, &bitmapData) != Ok)
        {
            AfxMessageBox(_T("锁定位图失败！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
            return;
        }

        BITMAPINFO bi = { 0 };
        bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
        bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = bm.bmWidth;
        bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -bm.bmHeight;
        bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
        bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 24;
        bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

        GetDIBits(m_bufferDC.m_hDC, (HBITMAP)m_bufferBitmap.m_hObject, 0, bm.bmHeight,
            bitmapData.Scan0, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS);

        gdipBitmap.UnlockBits(&bitmapData);

        CLSID pngClsid;
        if (GetEncoderClsid(L"image/png", &pngClsid) >= 0)
        {
            if (gdipBitmap.Save(dlg.GetPathName(), &pngClsid, NULL) == Ok)
            {
                CString msg;
                msg.Format(_T("图片已成功导出到：\n%s"), static_cast<LPCTSTR>(dlg.GetPathName()));
                AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
            }
            else
                AfxMessageBox(_T("保存文件失败！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        }
        else
            AfxMessageBox(_T("未找到 PNG 编码器！"), MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::OnPreparePrinting(CPrintInfo* pInfo)

    return DoPreparePrinting(pInfo);
}

🔍 关键修改说明
问题 1：撤销/重做 ID 冲突
原代码：

C++
 |
#define ID_EDIT_UNDO 0xE12B  // 标准MFC ID - 这会与系统冲突！
#define ID_EDIT_REDO 0xE12C  // 标准MFC ID - 这会与系统冲突！
修正后：

C++
 |
#define ID_MY_UNDO   32786   // 自定义撤销ID
#define ID_MY_REDO   32787   // 自定义重做ID
原因：

0xE12B 和 0xE12C 是 MFC 框架保留的标准 ID
使用它们会导致消息映射冲突
改用自定义 ID（32786/32787）避免冲突
问题 2：字符串 ID 命名规范
原代码：

C++
 |
#define IDS_EDIT_CLEAR  61014  // 与上面的 700 重复定义
#define IDS_EDIT_UNDO   61015  // 与上面的 709 重复定义
#define IDS_EDIT_REDO   61016  // 与上面的 710 重复定义
修正后：

C++
 |
#define IDS_EDIT_CLEAR_TEXT       61014  // 改名避免冲突
#define IDS_EDIT_UNDO_TEXT        61015  // 改名避免冲突
#define IDS_EDIT_REDO_TEXT        61016  // 改名避免冲突
#define IDS_FILE_EXPORT_PNG_TEXT  61017  // 统一命名规范

[x] 没有重复的 #define 定义
[x] 所有数字 ID 唯一且连续

// DrawingBoardView.h
#pragma once
#include <vector>
#include <memory>
#include <map>

class IShape;

enum class DrawingTool
{
    PEN,
    LINE,
    RECTANGLE,
    ELLIPSE,
    ERASER
};

enum class Language
{
    CHINESE,
    ENGLISH
};

// 形状基类
class IShape
{
public:
    DrawingTool tool;
    COLORREF color;
    int width;
    std::vector<CPoint> points;

    IShape(DrawingTool t, COLORREF c, int w)
        : tool(t), color(c), width(w) {}
    virtual ~IShape() = default;
    
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) const = 0;
    virtual IShape* Clone() const = 0;
};

// 铅笔
class CPenShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CPenShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::PEN, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CPenShape(*this); }
};

// 直线
class CLineShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CLineShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::LINE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CLineShape(*this); }
};

// 矩形
class CRectangleShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CRectangleShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::RECTANGLE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CRectangleShape(*this); }
};

// 椭圆
class CEllipseShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CEllipseShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::ELLIPSE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CEllipseShape(*this); }
};

// 橡皮擦
class CEraserShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CEraserShape(int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::ERASER, RGB(255, 255, 255), w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CEraserShape(*this); }
};

// 语言管理器
class LanguageManager
{
private:
    Language m_currentLanguage;
    std::map<CString, CString> m_chineseStrings;
    std::map<CString, CString> m_englishStrings;

public:
    LanguageManager();
    void SetLanguage(Language lang) { m_currentLanguage = lang; }
    Language GetLanguage() const { return m_currentLanguage; }
    CString GetString(const CString& key) const;
};

CString LanguageManager::GetString(const CString& key) const
{
    if (m_currentLanguage == Language::CHINESE)
    {
        auto it = m_chineseStrings.find(key);
        return (it != m_chineseStrings.end()) ? it->second : key;
    }
    else
    {
        auto it = m_englishStrings.find(key);
        return (it != m_englishStrings.end()) ? it->second : key;
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// GDI+ 辅助函数
// ============================================================================

int GetEncoderClsid(const WCHAR* format, CLSID* pClsid)
{
    UINT num = 0;
    UINT size = 0;
    GetImageEncodersSize(&num, &size);
    if (size == 0) return -1;

    ImageCodecInfo* pImageCodecInfo = (ImageCodecInfo*)(malloc(size));
    if (pImageCodecInfo == NULL) return -1;

    GetImageEncoders(num, size, pImageCodecInfo);
    for (UINT j = 0; j < num; ++j)
    {
        if (wcscmp(pImageCodecInfo[j].MimeType, format) == 0)
        {
            *pClsid = pImageCodecInfo[j].Clsid;
            free(pImageCodecInfo);
            return j;
        }
    }
    free(pImageCodecInfo);
    return -1;
}

// 形状类实现

void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    pDC->LineTo(points[1]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    int oldMode = pDC->SetBkMode(TRANSPARENT);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Rectangle(rect);
    
    pDC->SetBkMode(oldMode);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    int oldMode = pDC->SetBkMode(TRANSPARENT);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Ellipse(rect);
    
    pDC->SetBkMode(oldMode);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

        m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();
}

{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);

void CDrawingBoardView::InitializeBuffer()
{
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    if (rect.Width() <= 0 || rect.Height() <= 0) return;
    if (m_bBufferInitialized && rect == m_lastClientRect) return;

    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc()) m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle()) m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();

    CDC* pDC = GetDC();
    m_bufferDC.CreateCompatibleDC(pDC);
    m_bufferBitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(pDC, rect.Width(), rect.Height());
    m_bufferDC.SelectObject(&m_bufferBitmap);
    ReleaseDC(pDC);

    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    m_lastClientRect = rect;
    m_bBufferInitialized = true;
    RedrawBuffer();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::RedrawBuffer()
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized) return;
    
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
    {
        if (shape) shape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::OnEraseBkgnd(CDC* pDC)
{
    return TRUE;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnSize(UINT nType, int cx, int cy)
{
    CView::OnSize(nType, cx, cy);
    m_bBufferInitialized = false;
    InitializeBuffer();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc) return;

    InitializeBuffer();
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized) return;

    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    pDC->BitBlt(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height(), &m_bufferDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);

    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
        m_currentShape->Draw(pDC);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_isDrawing = true;
    m_startPoint = point;

    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case DrawingTool::PEN:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CPenShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::LINE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CLineShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::RECTANGLE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CRectangleShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ELLIPSE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEllipseShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ERASER:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEraserShape>(m_currentWidth * 3);
        break;
    }

    if (m_currentShape)
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);

    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (!m_isDrawing || !m_currentShape)
    {
        CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
        return;
    }

    if (m_currentTool == DrawingTool::PEN || m_currentTool == DrawingTool::ERASER)
    {
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }
    else
    {
        if (m_currentShape->points.size() > 1)
            m_currentShape->points[1] = point;
        else
            m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }

    Invalidate(FALSE);
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
    {
        SaveStateForUndo();
        m_shapes.push_back(m_currentShape);
        m_currentShape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
        m_currentShape.reset();
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }

    m_isDrawing = false;
    ReleaseCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyUndo()
{
    if (m_undoStack.empty()) return;
    
    // 保存当前状态到重做栈
    m_redoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    
    // 恢复上一个状态
    m_shapes = m_undoStack.back();
    m_undoStack.pop_back();
    
    // 重绘
    RedrawBuffer();
    Invalidate();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyRedo()
{
    if (m_redoStack.empty()) return;
    
    // 保存当前状态到撤销栈
    m_undoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    
    // 恢复重做状态
    m_shapes = m_redoStack.back();
    m_redoStack.pop_back();
    
    // 重绘
    RedrawBuffer();
    Invalidate();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditClearAll()
{
    if (m_shapes.empty())
    {
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_BOARD_EMPTY")), 
            MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }

    int result = AfxMessageBox(
        m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_CLEAR_CONFIRM")), 
        MB_YESNO | MB_ICONQUESTION | MB_DEFBUTTON2
    );
    
    if (result == IDYES)
    {
        SaveStateForUndo();
        m_shapes.clear();
        RedrawBuffer();
        Invalidate();
        
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_CLEAR_SUCCESS")), 
            MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyUndo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_undoStack.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyRedo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_redoStack.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditClearAll(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_shapes.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::SaveStateForUndo()
{
    // 深拷贝当前形状列表
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<IShape>> stateCopy;
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
    {
        if (shape)
        {
            stateCopy.push_back(std::shared_ptr<IShape>(shape->Clone()));
        }
    }
    
    m_undoStack.push_back(stateCopy);
    m_redoStack.clear(); // 新操作清空重做栈
    
    // 限制撤销栈大小
    if (m_undoStack.size() > 50)
        m_undoStack.erase(m_undoStack.begin());
}

// ============================================================================
// 导出PNG
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileExportPng()
{
    CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("png"), 
        m_langManager.GetString(_T("DEFAULT_FILENAME")),
        OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT,
        m_langManager.GetString(_T("FILE_FILTER")));

    if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
    {
        if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
        {
            AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_BUFFER_NOT_INIT")), 
                MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
            return;
        }

        BITMAP bm;
        m_bufferBitmap.GetBitmap(&bm);

        Bitmap gdipBitmap(bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight, PixelFormat24bppRGB);
        BitmapData bitmapData;
        Rect lockRect(0, 0, bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight);
        
        if (gdipBitmap.LockBits(&lockRect, ImageLockModeWrite, PixelFormat24bppRGB, &bitmapData) != Ok)
        {
            AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_LOCK_BITMAP_FAILED")), 
                MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
            return;
        }

        BITMAPINFO bi = { 0 };
        bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
        bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = bm.bmWidth;
        bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -bm.bmHeight;
        bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
        bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 24;
        bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

        GetDIBits(m_bufferDC.m_hDC, (HBITMAP)m_bufferBitmap.m_hObject, 0, bm.bmHeight,
            bitmapData.Scan0, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS);

        gdipBitmap.UnlockBits(&bitmapData);

        CLSID pngClsid;
        if (GetEncoderClsid(L"image/png", &pngClsid) >= 0)
        {
            if (gdipBitmap.Save(dlg.GetPathName(), &pngClsid, NULL) == Ok)
            {
                CString msg;
                msg.Format(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_EXPORT_SUCCESS")), 
                    static_cast<LPCTSTR>(dlg.GetPathName()));
                AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
            }
            else
            {
                AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_EXPORT_FAILED")), 
                    MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_NO_PNG_ENCODER")), 
                MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 语言切换

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLanguageChinese()
{
    m_langManager.SetLanguage(Language::CHINESE);
    AfxMessageBox(_T("语言已切换为中文"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLanguageEnglish()
{
    m_langManager.SetLanguage(Language::ENGLISH);
    AfxMessageBox(_T("Language switched to English"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateLanguageChinese(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->SetCheck(m_langManager.GetLanguage() == Language::CHINESE);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateLanguageEnglish(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->SetCheck(m_langManager.GetLanguage() == Language::ENGLISH);
}

📁 文件3: 如果找不到 .rc 文件，手动添加
如果你的项目没有 .rc 文件或无法编辑，可以在 MainFrm.cpp 中注释掉状态栏初始化代码：

MainFrm.cpp 修改方案
找到 CMainFrame::OnCreate 函数，注释掉或修改状态栏相关代码：

C++
 |
int CMainFrame::OnCreate(LPCREATESTRUCT lpCreateStruct)
{
    if (CFrameWnd::OnCreate(lpCreateStruct) == -1)
        return -1;

    // 创建工具栏等...
    
    // ===== 注释掉或修改这部分 =====
    /*
    if (!m_wndStatusBar.Create(this))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建状态栏\n");
        return -1;
    }
    m_wndStatusBar.SetIndicators(indicators, sizeof(indicators)/sizeof(UINT));
    */
    
    // 或者使用简单的状态栏（不依赖字符串资源）
    if (!m_wndStatusBar.Create(this))
    {
        TRACE0("未能创建状态栏\n");
        return -1;
    }
    
    return 0;
}

// DrawingBoardView.h
#pragma once
#include <vector>
#include <memory>
#include <map>

class IShape;

enum class DrawingTool
{
    PEN,
    LINE,
    RECTANGLE,
    ELLIPSE,
    ERASER
};

enum class Language
{
    CHINESE,
    ENGLISH
};

// 形状基类
class IShape
{
public:
    DrawingTool tool;
    COLORREF color;
    int width;
    std::vector<CPoint> points;

    IShape(DrawingTool t, COLORREF c, int w)
        : tool(t), color(c), width(w) {}
    virtual ~IShape() = default;
    
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) const = 0;
    virtual IShape* Clone() const = 0;
};

// 铅笔
class CPenShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CPenShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::PEN, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CPenShape(*this); }
};

// 直线
class CLineShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CLineShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::LINE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CLineShape(*this); }
};

// 矩形
class CRectangleShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CRectangleShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::RECTANGLE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CRectangleShape(*this); }
};

// 椭圆
class CEllipseShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CEllipseShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::ELLIPSE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CEllipseShape(*this); }
};

// 橡皮擦
class CEraserShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CEraserShape(int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::ERASER, RGB(255, 255, 255), w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CEraserShape(*this); }
};

// 语言管理器
class LanguageManager
{
private:
    Language m_currentLanguage;
    std::map<CString, CString> m_chineseStrings;
    std::map<CString, CString> m_englishStrings;

public:
    LanguageManager();
    void SetLanguage(Language lang) { m_currentLanguage = lang; }
    Language GetLanguage() const { return m_currentLanguage; }
    CString GetString(const CString& key) const;
};
