CString LanguageManager::GetString(const CString& key) const
{
    if (m_currentLanguage == Language::CHINESE)
    {
        auto it = m_chineseStrings.find(key);
        return (it != m_chineseStrings.end()) ? it->second : key;
    }
    else
    {
        auto it = m_englishStrings.find(key);
        return (it != m_englishStrings.end()) ? it->second : key;
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// GDI+ 辅助函数
// ============================================================================

int GetEncoderClsid(const WCHAR* format, CLSID* pClsid)
{
    UINT num = 0;
    UINT size = 0;
    GetImageEncodersSize(&num, &size);
    if (size == 0) return -1;

    ImageCodecInfo* pImageCodecInfo = (ImageCodecInfo*)(malloc(size));
    if (pImageCodecInfo == NULL) return -1;

    GetImageEncoders(num, size, pImageCodecInfo);
    for (UINT j = 0; j < num; ++j)
    {
        if (wcscmp(pImageCodecInfo[j].MimeType, format) == 0)
        {
            *pClsid = pImageCodecInfo[j].Clsid;
            free(pImageCodecInfo);
            return j;
        }
    }
    free(pImageCodecInfo);
    return -1;
}

// ============================================================================
// 形状类实现
// ============================================================================

void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    pDC->LineTo(points[1]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    int oldMode = pDC->SetBkMode(TRANSPARENT);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Rectangle(rect);
    
    pDC->SetBkMode(oldMode);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    int oldMode = pDC->SetBkMode(TRANSPARENT);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Ellipse(rect);
    
    pDC->SetBkMode(oldMode);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
    : m_currentTool(DrawingTool::PEN)
    , m_currentColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
    , m_currentWidth(2)
    , m_isDrawing(false)
    , m_bBufferInitialized(false)
{
    if (g_gdiplusToken == 0)
    {
        GdiplusStartupInput gdiplusStartupInput;
        GdiplusStartup(&g_gdiplusToken, &gdiplusStartupInput, NULL);
    }
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc())
        m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle())
        m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::InitializeBuffer()
{
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    if (rect.Width() <= 0 || rect.Height() <= 0) return;
    if (m_bBufferInitialized && rect == m_lastClientRect) return;

    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc()) m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle()) m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();

    CDC* pDC = GetDC();
    m_bufferDC.CreateCompatibleDC(pDC);
    m_bufferBitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(pDC, rect.Width(), rect.Height());
    m_bufferDC.SelectObject(&m_bufferBitmap);
    ReleaseDC(pDC);

    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    m_lastClientRect = rect;
    m_bBufferInitialized = true;
    RedrawBuffer();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::RedrawBuffer()
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized) return;
    
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
    {
        if (shape) shape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::OnEraseBkgnd(CDC* pDC)
{
    return TRUE;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnSize(UINT nType, int cx, int cy)
{
    CView::OnSize(nType, cx, cy);
    m_bBufferInitialized = false;
    InitializeBuffer();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc) return;

    InitializeBuffer();
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized) return;

    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    pDC->BitBlt(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height(), &m_bufferDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);

    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
        m_currentShape->Draw(pDC);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_isDrawing = true;
    m_startPoint = point;

    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case DrawingTool::PEN:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CPenShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::LINE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CLineShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::RECTANGLE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CRectangleShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ELLIPSE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEllipseShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ERASER:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEraserShape>(m_currentWidth * 3);
        break;
    }

    if (m_currentShape)
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);

    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (!m_isDrawing || !m_currentShape)
    {
        CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
        return;
    }

    if (m_currentTool == DrawingTool::PEN || m_currentTool == DrawingTool::ERASER)
    {
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }
    else
    {
        if (m_currentShape->points.size() > 1)
            m_currentShape->points[1] = point;
        else
            m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }

    Invalidate(FALSE);
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
    {
        SaveStateForUndo();
        m_shapes.push_back(m_currentShape);
        m_currentShape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
        m_currentShape.reset();
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }

    m_isDrawing = false;
    ReleaseCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

// 编辑命令 - 撤销/重做/清空

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyUndo()
{
    if (m_undoStack.empty()) return;
    
    m_redoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    m_shapes = m_undoStack.back();
    m_undoStack.pop_back();
    
    RedrawBuffer();
    Invalidate();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyRedo()
{
    if (m_redoStack.empty()) return;
    
    m_undoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    m_shapes = m_redoStack.back();
    m_redoStack.pop_back();
    
    RedrawBuffer();
    Invalidate();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditClearAll()
{
    if (m_shapes.empty())
    {
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_BOARD_EMPTY")), 
            MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }

    int result = AfxMessageBox(
        m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_CLEAR_CONFIRM")), 
        MB_YESNO | MB_ICONQUESTION | MB_DEFBUTTON2
    );
    
    if (result == IDYES)
    {
        SaveStateForUndo();
        m_shapes.clear();
        RedrawBuffer();
        Invalidate();
        
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_CLEAR_SUCCESS")), 
            MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyUndo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_undoStack.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyRedo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_redoStack.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditClearAll(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_shapes.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::SaveStateForUndo()
{
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<IShape>> stateCopy;
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
    {
        if (shape)
        {
            stateCopy.push_back(std::shared_ptr<IShape>(shape->Clone()));
        }
    }
    
    m_undoStack.push_back(stateCopy);
    m_redoStack.clear();
    
    if (m_undoStack.size() > 50)
        m_undoStack.erase(m_undoStack.begin());
}

// ============================================================================
// 导出PNG
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileExportPng()
{
    CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("png"), 
        m_langManager.GetString(_T("DEFAULT_FILENAME")),
        OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT,
        m_langManager.GetString(_T("FILE_FILTER")));

    if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
    {
        if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
        {
            AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_BUFFER_NOT_INIT")), 
                MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
            return;
        }

        BITMAP bm;
        m_bufferBitmap.GetBitmap(&bm);

        Bitmap gdipBitmap(bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight, PixelFormat24bppRGB);
        BitmapData bitmapData;
        Rect lockRect(0, 0, bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight);
        
        if (gdipBitmap.LockBits(&lockRect, ImageLockModeWrite, PixelFormat24bppRGB, &bitmapData) != Ok)
        {
            AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_LOCK_BITMAP_FAILED")), 
                MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
            return;
        }

        BITMAPINFO bi = { 0 };
        bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
        bi.b
170.751423

12/27 15:24:13
继续生成
Claude Sonnet 4.512/27 15:24:53
C++
 |
        bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = bm.bmWidth;
        bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -bm.bmHeight;
        bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
        bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 24;
        bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;

        GetDIBits(m_bufferDC.m_hDC, (HBITMAP)m_bufferBitmap.m_hObject, 0, bm.bmHeight,
            bitmapData.Scan0, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS);

        gdipBitmap.UnlockBits(&bitmapData);

        CLSID pngClsid;
        if (GetEncoderClsid(L"image/png", &pngClsid) >= 0)
        {
            if (gdipBitmap.Save(dlg.GetPathName(), &pngClsid, NULL) == Ok)
            {
                CString msg;
                msg.Format(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_EXPORT_SUCCESS")), 
                    static_cast<LPCTSTR>(dlg.GetPathName()));
                AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
            }
            else
            {
                AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_EXPORT_FAILED")), 
                    MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_NO_PNG_ENCODER")), 
                MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        }
    }
}

// DrawingBoardView.h
#pragma once
#include <vector>
#include <memory>
#include <map>

class IShape;

enum class DrawingTool
{
    PEN,
    LINE,
    RECTANGLE,
    ELLIPSE,
    ERASER
};

enum class Language
{
    CHINESE,
    ENGLISH
};

// ============================================================================
// 形状基类
// ============================================================================
class IShape
{
public:
    DrawingTool tool;
    COLORREF color;
    int width;
    std::vector<CPoint> points;

    IShape(DrawingTool t, COLORREF c, int w)
        : tool(t), color(c), width(w) {}
    virtual ~IShape() = default;
    
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) const = 0;
    virtual IShape* Clone() const = 0;
};

// 铅笔
class CPenShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CPenShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::PEN, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CPenShape(*this); }
};

// 直线
class CLineShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CLineShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::LINE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CLineShape(*this); }
};

// 矩形
class CRectangleShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CRectangleShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::RECTANGLE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CRectangleShape(*this); }
};

// 椭圆
class CEllipseShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CEllipseShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::ELLIPSE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CEllipseShape(*this); }
};

// 橡皮擦
class CEraserShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CEraserShape(int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::ERASER, RGB(255, 255, 255), w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CEraserShape(*this); }
};

// ============================================================================
// 语言管理器
// ============================================================================
class LanguageManager
{
private:
    Language m_currentLanguage;
    std::map<CString, CString> m_chineseStrings;
    std::map<CString, CString> m_englishStrings;

public:
    LanguageManager();
    void SetLanguage(Language lang) { m_currentLanguage = lang; }
    Language GetLanguage() const { return m_currentLanguage; }
    CString GetString(const CString& key) const;
    void UpdateMenuText(CMenu* pMenu);  // 新增：更新菜单文本
};

CString LanguageManager::GetString(const CString& key) const
{
    if (m_currentLanguage == Language::CHINESE)
    {
        auto it = m_chineseStrings.find(key);
        return (it != m_chineseStrings.end()) ? it->second : key;
    }
    else
    {
        auto it = m_englishStrings.find(key);
        return (it != m_englishStrings.end()) ? it->second : key;
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// GDI+ 辅助函数
// ============================================================================

int GetEncoderClsid(const WCHAR* format, CLSID* pClsid)
{
    UINT num = 0;
    UINT size = 0;
    GetImageEncodersSize(&num, &size);
    if (size == 0) return -1;

    ImageCodecInfo* pImageCodecInfo = (ImageCodecInfo*)(malloc(size));
    if (pImageCodecInfo == NULL) return -1;

    GetImageEncoders(num, size, pImageCodecInfo);
    for (UINT j = 0; j < num; ++j)
    {
        if (wcscmp(pImageCodecInfo[j].MimeType, format) == 0)
        {
            *pClsid = pImageCodecInfo[j].Clsid;
            free(pImageCodecInfo);
            return j;
        }
    }
    free(pImageCodecInfo);
    return -1;
}

// ============================================================================
// 形状类实现
// ============================================================================

void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    pDC->LineTo(points[1]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Rectangle(rect);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Ellipse(rect);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
    : m_currentTool(DrawingTool::PEN)
    , m_currentColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
    , m_currentWidth(2)
    , m_isDrawing(false)
    , m_bBufferInitialized(false)
{
    if (g_gdiplusToken == 0)
    {
        GdiplusStartupInput gdiplusStartupInput;
        GdiplusStartup(&g_gdiplusToken, &gdiplusStartupInput, NULL);
    }
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc())
        m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle())
        m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::InitializeBuffer()
{
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    if (rect.Width() <= 0 || rect.Height() <= 0) return;
    if (m_bBufferInitialized && rect == m_lastClientRect) return;

    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc()) m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle()) m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();

    CDC* pDC = GetDC();
    m_bufferDC.CreateCompatibleDC(pDC);
    m_bufferBitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(pDC, rect.Width(), rect.Height());
    m_bufferDC.SelectObject(&m_bufferBitmap);
    ReleaseDC(pDC);

    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    m_lastClientRect = rect;
    m_bBufferInitialized = true;
    RedrawBuffer();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::RedrawBuffer()
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized) return;
    
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
    {
        if (shape) shape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::OnEraseBkgnd(CDC* pDC)
{
    return TRUE;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnSize(UINT nType, int cx, int cy)
{
    CView::OnSize(nType, cx, cy);
    m_bBufferInitialized = false;
    InitializeBuffer();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc) return;

    InitializeBuffer();
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized) return;

    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    pDC->BitBlt(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height(), &m_bufferDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);

    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
        m_currentShape->Draw(pDC);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_isDrawing = true;
    m_startPoint = point;

    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case DrawingTool::PEN:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CPenShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::LINE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CLineShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::RECTANGLE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CRectangleShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ELLIPSE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEllipseShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ERASER:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEraserShape>(m_currentWidth * 3);
        break;
    }

    if (m_currentShape)
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);

    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (!m_isDrawing || !m_currentShape)
    {
        CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
        return;
    }

    if (m_currentTool == DrawingTool::PEN || m_currentTool == DrawingTool::ERASER)
    {
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }
    else
    {
        if (m_currentShape->points.size() > 1)
            m_currentShape->points[1] = point;
        else
            m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }

    Invalidate(FALSE);
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
    {
        // 关键修复：先保存状态再添加形状
        SaveStateForUndo();
        m_shapes.push_back(m_currentShape);
        m_currentShape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
        m_currentShape.reset();
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }

    m_isDrawing = false;
    ReleaseCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

// ============================================================================
// 编辑命令 - 撤销/重做/清空（关键修复）
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyUndo()
{
    if (m_undoStack.empty()) 
    {
        TRACE(_T("撤销栈为空\n"));
        return;
    }
    
    TRACE(_T("执行撤销，当前撤销栈大小: %d\n"), (int)m_undoStack.size());
    
    // 保存当前状态到重做栈
    m_redoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    
    // 恢复上一个状态
    m_shapes = m_undoStack.back();
    m_undoStack.pop_back();
    
    // 重绘
    RedrawBuffer();
    Invalidate();
    
    TRACE(_T("撤销完成，剩余撤销栈大小: %d，重做栈大小: %d\n"), 
        (int)m_undoStack.size(), (int)m_redoStack.size());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyRedo()
{
    if (m_redoStack.empty()) 
    {
        TRACE(_T("重做栈为空\n"));
        return;
    }
    
    TRACE(_T("执行重做，当前重做栈大小: %d\n"), (int)m_redoStack.size());
    
    // 保存当前状态到撤销栈
    m_undoStack.push_back(m_shapes);
    
    // 恢复重做状态
    m_shapes = m_redoStack.back();
    m_redoStack.pop_back();
    
    // 重绘
    RedrawBuffer();
    Invalidate();
    
    TRACE(_T("重做完成，撤销栈大小: %d，剩余重做栈大小: %d\n"), 
        (int)m_undoStack.size(), (int)m_redoStack.size());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditClearAll()
{
    if (m_shapes.empty())
    {
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_BOARD_EMPTY")), 
            MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }

    int result = AfxMessageBox(
        m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_CLEAR_CONFIRM")), 
        MB_YESNO | MB_ICONQUESTION | MB_DEFBUTTON2
    );
    
    if (result == IDYES)
    {
        SaveStateForUndo();
        m_shapes.clear();
        RedrawBuffer();
        Invalidate();
        
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_CLEAR_SUCCESS"
168.215114

12/27 15:38:03
继续生成
Claude Sonnet 4.512/27 15:38:58
C++
 |
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_CLEAR_SUCCESS")), 
            MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::SaveStateForUndo()
{
    // 保存当前状态到撤销栈
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<IShape>> currentState;
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
    {
        if (shape)
        {
            std::shared_ptr<IShape> clonedShape(shape->Clone());
            currentState.push_back(clonedShape);
        }
    }
    m_undoStack.push_back(currentState);
    
    // 清空重做栈（新操作后不能再重做）
    m_redoStack.clear();
    
    // 限制撤销栈大小（可选，防止内存占用过大）
    const size_t MAX_UNDO_STEPS = 50;
    if (m_undoStack.size() > MAX_UNDO_STEPS)
    {
        m_undoStack.erase(m_undoStack.begin());
    }
    
    TRACE(_T("保存状态，撤销栈大小: %d\n"), (int)m_undoStack.size());
}

// ============================================================================
// 文件导出
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileExportPng()
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_BUFFER_NOT_INIT")), 
            MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }

    CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("png"), 
        m_langManager.GetString(_T("DEFAULT_FILENAME")),
        OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT,
        m_langManager.GetString(_T("FILE_FILTER")));

    if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
    {
        CRect rect;
        GetClientRect(&rect);

        Bitmap gdipBitmap(rect.Width(), rect.Height(), PixelFormat24bppRGB);
        BitmapData bitmapData;
        Rect lockRect(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height());

        if (gdipBitmap.LockBits(&lockRect, ImageLockModeWrite, 
            PixelFormat24bppRGB, &bitmapData) != Ok)
        {
            AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_LOCK_BITMAP_FAILED")), 
                MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
            return;
        }

        BITMAP bm;
        m_bufferBitmap.GetBitmap(&bm);

        BITMAPINFOHEADER bi = { sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER) };
        bi.biWidth = bm.bmWidth;
        bi.biHeight = -bm.bmHeight;
        bi.biPlanes = 1;
        bi.biBitCount = 24;
        bi.biCompression = BI_RGB;

        GetDIBits(m_bufferDC.m_hDC, (HBITMAP)m_bufferBitmap.m_hObject, 
            0, bm.bmHeight, bitmapData.Scan0, (BITMAPINFO*)&bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS);

        gdipBitmap.UnlockBits(&bitmapData);

        CLSID pngClsid;
        if (GetEncoderClsid(L"image/png", &pngClsid) >= 0)
        {
            if (gdipBitmap.Save(dlg.GetPathName(), &pngClsid, NULL) == Ok)
            {
                CString msg;
                msg.Format(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_EXPORT_SUCCESS")), 
                    static_cast<LPCTSTR>(dlg.GetPathName()));
                AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
            }
            else
            {
                AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_EXPORT_FAILED")), 
                    MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_NO_PNG_ENCODER")), 
                MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        }
    }
}

{
    if (CFrameWnd::OnCreate(lpCreateStruct) == -1)

🐛 常见问题修复
问题1：按 Ctrl+Z 没反应
原因： 加速键表没配置

修复： 在 DrawingBoard.rc 中确认有：

 |
IDR_MAINFRAME ACCELERATORS
BEGIN
    "Z",            ID_MY_UNDO,             VIRTKEY, CONTROL
    "Y",            ID_MY_REDO,             VIRTKEY, CONTROL
END
问题2：菜单项是灰色的
原因： OnUpdate 函数没被调用

检查：

BEGIN_MESSAGE_MAP 中是否有：

C++
 |
ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_MY_UNDO, &CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyUndo)
Resource.h 中 ID 定义是否正确：

C++
 |
#define ID_MY_UNDO    32786
问题3：撤销后画面没变化
原因： RedrawBuffer() 没调用

修复： 在 OnMyUndo() 和 OnMyRedo() 中确认有：

C++
 |
RedrawBuffer();  // 重绘缓冲区
Invalidate();    // 触发重绘
问题4：语言菜单看不到
检查 .rc 文件：

 |
POPUP "语言(&L)"
BEGIN
    MENUITEM "中文(&C)",      ID_LANGUAGE_CHINESE
    MENUITEM "English(&E)",   ID_LANGUAGE_ENGLISH
END
检查 Resource.h：

C++
 |
#define ID_LANGUAGE_CHINESE    32800
#define ID_LANGUAGE_ENGLISH    32801

// DrawingBoardView.h
#pragma once
#include <vector>
#include <memory>
#include <map>

class IShape;

enum class DrawingTool
{
    PEN,
    LINE,
    RECTANGLE,
    ELLIPSE,
    ERASER
};

enum class Language
{
    CHINESE,
    ENGLISH
};

// ============================================================================
// 形状基类（保持不变）
// ============================================================================
class IShape
{
public:
    DrawingTool tool;
    COLORREF color;
    int width;
    std::vector<CPoint> points;

    IShape(DrawingTool t, COLORREF c, int w)
        : tool(t), color(c), width(w) {}
    virtual ~IShape() = default;
    
    virtual void Draw(CDC* pDC) const = 0;
    virtual IShape* Clone() const = 0;
};

class CPenShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CPenShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::PEN, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CPenShape(*this); }
};

class CLineShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CLineShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::LINE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CLineShape(*this); }
};

class CRectangleShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CRectangleShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::RECTANGLE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CRectangleShape(*this); }
};

class CEllipseShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CEllipseShape(COLORREF c, int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::ELLIPSE, c, w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CEllipseShape(*this); }
};

class CEraserShape : public IShape
{
public:
    CEraserShape(int w) : IShape(DrawingTool::ERASER, RGB(255, 255, 255), w) {}
    void Draw(CDC* pDC) const override;
    IShape* Clone() const override { return new CEraserShape(*this); }
};

    // 新增：获取菜单文本
    CString GetMenuText(UINT commandID) const;
};

CString LanguageManager::GetString(const CString& key) const
{
    if (m_currentLanguage == Language::CHINESE)
    {
        auto it = m_chineseStrings.find(key);
        return (it != m_chineseStrings.end()) ? it->second : key;
    }
    else
    {
        auto it = m_englishStrings.find(key);
        return (it != m_englishStrings.end()) ? it->second : key;
    }
}

CString LanguageManager::GetMenuText(UINT commandID) const
{
    // 根据命令ID返回对应的菜单文本
    switch (commandID)
    {
        // 文件菜单
        case ID_FILE_NEW:           return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_NEW"));
        case ID_FILE_OPEN:          return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_OPEN"));
        case ID_FILE_SAVE:          return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_SAVE"));
        case ID_FILE_SAVE_AS:       return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_SAVE_AS"));
        case ID_FILE_EXPORT_PNG:    return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_EXPORT"));
        case ID_FILE_PRINT:         return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_PRINT"));
        case ID_FILE_PRINT_PREVIEW: return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_PRINT_PREVIEW"));
        case ID_FILE_PRINT_SETUP:   return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_PRINT_SETUP"));
        case ID_APP_EXIT:           return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_EXIT"));
        
        // 编辑菜单
        case ID_MY_UNDO:            return GetString(_T("MENU_EDIT_UNDO"));
        case ID_MY_REDO:            return GetString(_T("MENU_EDIT_REDO"));
        case ID_EDIT_CLEAR_ALL:     return GetString(_T("MENU_EDIT_CLEAR"));
        
        // 工具菜单
        case ID_TOOL_PEN:           return GetString(_T("MENU_TOOL_PEN"));
        case ID_TOOL_LINE:          return GetString(_T("MENU_TOOL_LINE"));
        case ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE:     return GetString(_T("MENU_TOOL_RECTANGLE"));
        case ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE:       return GetString(_T("MENU_TOOL_ELLIPSE"));
        case ID_TOOL_ERASER:        return GetString(_T("MENU_TOOL_ERASER"));
        
        // 颜色菜单
        case ID_COLOR_BLACK:        return GetString(_T("MENU_COLOR_BLACK"));
        case ID_COLOR_RED:          return GetString(_T("MENU_COLOR_RED"));
        case ID_COLOR_GREEN:        return GetString(_T("MENU_COLOR_GREEN"));
        case ID_COLOR_BLUE:         return GetString(_T("MENU_COLOR_BLUE"));
        case ID_COLOR_YELLOW:       return GetString(_T("MENU_COLOR_YELLOW"));
        
        // 粗细菜单
        case ID_SIZE_THIN:          return GetString(_T("MENU_WIDTH_THIN"));
        case ID_SIZE_MEDIUM:        return GetString(_T("MENU_WIDTH_MEDIUM"));
        case ID_SIZE_THICK:         return GetString(_T("MENU_WIDTH_THICK"));
        
        // 语言菜单
        case ID_LANGUAGE_CHINESE:   return GetString(_T("MENU_LANGUAGE_CN"));
        case ID_LANGUAGE_ENGLISH:   return GetString(_T("MENU_LANGUAGE_EN"));
        
        // 视图菜单
        case ID_VIEW_TOOLBAR:       return GetString(_T("MENU_VIEW_TOOLBAR"));
        case ID_VIEW_STATUS_BAR:    return GetString(_T("MENU_VIEW_STATUS"));
        
        // 帮助菜单
        case ID_APP_ABOUT:          return GetString(_T("MENU_HELP_ABOUT"));
        
        default:
            return _T("");
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// GDI+ 辅助函数（保持不变）
// ============================================================================

int GetEncoderClsid(const WCHAR* format, CLSID* pClsid)
{
    UINT num = 0;
    UINT size = 0;
    GetImageEncodersSize(&num, &size);
    if (size == 0) return -1;

    ImageCodecInfo* pImageCodecInfo = (ImageCodecInfo*)(malloc(size));
    if (pImageCodecInfo == NULL) return -1;

    GetImageEncoders(num, size, pImageCodecInfo);
    for (UINT j = 0; j < num; ++j)
    {
        if (wcscmp(pImageCodecInfo[j].MimeType, format) == 0)
        {
            *pClsid = pImageCodecInfo[j].Clsid;
            free(pImageCodecInfo);
            return j;
        }
    }
    free(pImageCodecInfo);
    return -1;
}

// ============================================================================
// 形状类实现（保持不变）
// ============================================================================

void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    pDC->LineTo(points[1]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Rectangle(rect);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Ellipse(rect);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc())
        m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle())
        m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::InitializeBuffer()
{
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    if (rect.Width() <= 0 || rect.Height() <= 0) return;
    if (m_bBufferInitialized && rect == m_lastClientRect) return;

    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc()) m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle()) m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();

    CDC* pDC = GetDC();
    m_bufferDC.CreateCompatibleDC(pDC);
    m_bufferBitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(pDC, rect.Width(), rect.Height());
    m_bufferDC.SelectObject(&m_bufferBitmap);
    ReleaseDC(pDC);

    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    m_lastClientRect = rect;
    m_bBufferInitialized = true;
    RedrawBuffer();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::RedrawBuffer()
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized) return;
    
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
    {
        if (shape) shape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::OnEraseBkgnd(CDC* pDC)
{
    return TRUE;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnSize(UINT nType, int cx, int cy)
{
    CView::OnSize(nType, cx, cy);
    m_bBufferInitialized = false;
    InitializeBuffer();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc) return;

    InitializeBuffer();
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized) return;

    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    pDC->BitBlt(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height(), &m_bufferDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);

    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
        m_currentShape->Draw(pDC);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_isDrawing = true;
    m_startPoint = point;

    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case DrawingTool::PEN:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CPenShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::LINE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CLineShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::RECTANGLE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CRectangleShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ELLIPSE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEllipseShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ERASER:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEraserShape>(m_currentWidth * 3);
        break;
    }

    if (m_currentShape)
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);

    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (!m_isDrawing || !m_currentShape)
    {
        CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
        return;
    }

    if (m_currentTool == DrawingTool::PEN || m_currentTool == DrawingTool::ERASER)
    {
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }
    else
    {
        if (m_currentShape->points.size() > 1)
            m_currentShape->points[1] = point;
        else
            m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }

    Invalidate(FALSE);
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
    {
        SaveStateForUndo();
        m_shapes.push_back(m_currentShape);
        m_currentShape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
        m_currentShape.reset();
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }

    m_isDrawing = false;
    ReleaseCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

{

    COLORREF color;
    int width;
    std::vector<CPoint> points;

        : tool(t), color(c), width(w) {}

    virtual IShape* Clone() const = 0;

📁 文件4: DrawingBoardView.cpp - GetString 实现（第2部分）
C++
 |
CString LanguageManager::GetString(const CString& key) const
{
    const std::map<CString, CString>* pStrings = nullptr;
    
    switch (m_currentLanguage)
    {
    case Language::CHINESE:
        pStrings = &m_chineseStrings;
        break;
    case Language::ENGLISH:
        pStrings = &m_englishStrings;
        break;
    case Language::KOREAN:  // 新增
        pStrings = &m_koreanStrings;
        break;
    default:
        pStrings = &m_chineseStrings;
        break;
    }
    
    auto it = pStrings->find(key);
    return (it != pStrings->end()) ? it->second : key;
}

CString LanguageManager::GetMenuText(UINT commandID) const
{
    switch (commandID)
    {
        // 文件菜单
        case ID_FILE_NEW:           return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_NEW"));
        case ID_FILE_OPEN:          return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_OPEN"));
        case ID_FILE_SAVE:          return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_SAVE"));
        case ID_FILE_SAVE_AS:       return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_SAVE_AS"));
        case ID_FILE_EXPORT_PNG:    return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_EXPORT"));
        case ID_FILE_PRINT:         return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_PRINT"));
        case ID_FILE_PRINT_PREVIEW: return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_PRINT_PREVIEW"));
        case ID_FILE_PRINT_SETUP:   return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_PRINT_SETUP"));
        case ID_APP_EXIT:           return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_EXIT"));
        
        // 编辑菜单
        case ID_MY_UNDO:            return GetString(_T("MENU_EDIT_UNDO"));
        case ID_MY_REDO:            return GetString(_T("MENU_EDIT_REDO"));
        case ID_EDIT_CLEAR_ALL:     return GetString(_T("MENU_EDIT_CLEAR"));
        
        // 工具菜单
        case ID_TOOL_PEN:           return GetString(_T("MENU_TOOL_PEN"));
        case ID_TOOL_LINE:          return GetString(_T("MENU_TOOL_LINE"));
        case ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE:     return GetString(_T("MENU_TOOL_RECTANGLE"));
        case ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE:       return GetString(_T("MENU_TOOL_ELLIPSE"));
        case ID_TOOL_ERASER:        return GetString(_T("MENU_TOOL_ERASER"));
        
        // 颜色菜单
        case ID_COLOR_BLACK:        return GetString(_T("MENU_COLOR_BLACK"));
        case ID_COLOR_RED:          return GetString(_T("MENU_COLOR_RED"));
        case ID_COLOR_GREEN:        return GetString(_T("MENU_COLOR_GREEN"));
        case ID_COLOR_BLUE:         return GetString(_T("MENU_COLOR_BLUE"));
        case ID_COLOR_YELLOW:       return GetString(_T("MENU_COLOR_YELLOW"));
        
        // 粗细菜单
        case ID_SIZE_THIN:          return GetString(_T("MENU_WIDTH_THIN"));
        case ID_SIZE_MEDIUM:        return GetString(_T("MENU_WIDTH_MEDIUM"));
        case ID_SIZE_THICK:         return GetString(_T("MENU_WIDTH_THICK"));
        
        // 语言菜单
        case ID_LANGUAGE_CHINESE:   return GetString(_T("MENU_LANGUAGE_CN"));
        case ID_LANGUAGE_ENGLISH:   return GetString(_T("MENU_LANGUAGE_EN"));
        case ID_LANGUAGE_KOREAN:    return GetString(_T("MENU_LANGUAGE_KR"));  // 新增
        
        // 视图菜单
        case ID_VIEW_TOOLBAR:       return GetString(_T("MENU_VIEW_TOOLBAR"));
        case ID_VIEW_STATUS_BAR:    return GetString(_T("MENU_VIEW_STATUS"));
        
        // 帮助菜单
        case ID_APP_ABOUT:          return GetString(_T("MENU_HELP_ABOUT"));
        
        default:
            return _T("");
    }
}

C++
 |
// ============================================================================
// 语言切换命令处理
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLanguageChinese()
{
    m_langManager.SetLanguage(Language::CHINESE);
    UpdateAllMenus();
    AfxMessageBox(_T("语言已切换为中文"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLanguageEnglish()
{
    m_langManager.SetLanguage(Language::ENGLISH);
    UpdateAllMenus();
    AfxMessageBox(_T("Language switched to English"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLanguageKorean()  // 新增
{
    m_langManager.SetLanguage(Language::KOREAN);
    UpdateAllMenus();
    AfxMessageBox(_T("언어가 한국어로 전환되었습니다"), MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
}

// ============================================================================
// 语言菜单UI更新
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateLanguageChinese(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->SetCheck(m_langManager.GetLanguage() == Language::CHINESE);
    pCmdUI->SetText(m_langManager.GetMenuText(ID_LANGUAGE_CHINESE));
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateLanguageEnglish(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->SetCheck(m_langManager.GetLanguage() == Language::ENGLISH);
    pCmdUI->SetText(m_langManager.GetMenuText(ID_LANGUAGE_ENGLISH));
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateLanguageKorean(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)  // 新增
{
    pCmdUI->SetCheck(m_langManager.GetLanguage() == Language::KOREAN);
    pCmdUI->SetText(m_langManager.GetMenuText(ID_LANGUAGE_KOREAN));
}

// ============================================================================
// 更新所有菜单文本
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::UpdateAllMenus()
{
    CMainFrame* pMainFrame = (CMainFrame*)AfxGetMainWnd();
    if (!pMainFrame) return;
    
    CMenu* pMenu = pMainFrame->GetMenu();
    if (!pMenu) return;

    // 定义菜单项ID数组
    UINT fileMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_FILE_NEW, ID_FILE_OPEN, ID_FILE_SAVE, ID_FILE_SAVE_AS,
        ID_FILE_EXPORT_PNG, ID_FILE_PRINT, ID_FILE_PRINT_PREVIEW,
        ID_FILE_PRINT_SETUP, ID_APP_EXIT
    };
    
    UINT editMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_MY_UNDO, ID_MY_REDO, ID_EDIT_CLEAR_ALL
    };
    
    UINT toolMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_TOOL_PEN, ID_TOOL_LINE, ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE,
        ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE, ID_TOOL_ERASER
    };
    
    UINT colorMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_COLOR_BLACK, ID_COLOR_RED, ID_COLOR_GREEN,
        ID_COLOR_BLUE, ID_COLOR_YELLOW
    };
    
    UINT sizeMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_SIZE_THIN, ID_SIZE_MEDIUM, ID_SIZE_THICK
    };
    
    UINT languageMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_LANGUAGE_CHINESE, ID_LANGUAGE_ENGLISH, ID_LANGUAGE_KOREAN  // 更新
    };
    
    UINT viewMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_VIEW_TOOLBAR, ID_VIEW_STATUS_BAR
    };
    
    UINT helpMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_APP_ABOUT
    };

    // 更新所有菜单项
    auto updateMenuItems = [this, pMenu](UINT* ids, int count) {
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            CString text = m_langManager.GetMenuText(ids[i]);
            if (!text.IsEmpty())
            {
                MENUITEMINFO mii = { sizeof(MENUITEMINFO) };
                mii.fMask = MIIM_STRING;
                mii.dwTypeData = (LPTSTR)(LPCTSTR)text;
                pMenu->SetMenuItemInfo(ids[i], &mii, FALSE);
            }
        }
    };

    updateMenuItems(fileMenuIDs, _countof(fileMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(editMenuIDs, _countof(editMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(toolMenuIDs, _countof(toolMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(colorMenuIDs, _countof(colorMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(sizeMenuIDs, _countof(sizeMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(languageMenuIDs, _countof(languageMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(viewMenuIDs, _countof(viewMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(helpMenuIDs, _countof(helpMenuIDs));

    // 强制重绘菜单
    pMainFrame->DrawMenuBar();
}

// ============================================================================
// GDI+ 辅助函数
// ============================================================================

int GetEncoderClsid(const WCHAR* format, CLSID* pClsid)
{
    UINT num = 0;          // 图像编码器数量
    UINT size = 0;         // 图像编码器数组的大小（字节）

    GetImageEncodersSize(&num, &size);
    if (size == 0)
        return -1;

    ImageCodecInfo* pImageCodecInfo = (ImageCodecInfo*)(malloc(size));
    if (pImageCodecInfo == NULL)
        return -1;

    GetImageEncoders(num, size, pImageCodecInfo);

    for (UINT j = 0; j < num; ++j)
    {
        if (wcscmp(pImageCodecInfo[j].MimeType, format) == 0)
        {
            *pClsid = pImageCodecInfo[j].Clsid;
            free(pImageCodecInfo);
            return j;
        }
    }

    free(pImageCodecInfo);
    return -1;
}

CString LanguageManager::GetString(const CString& key) const
{
    const std::map<CString, CString>* pStrings = nullptr;
    
    switch (m_currentLanguage)
    {
    case Language::CHINESE:
        pStrings = &m_chineseStrings;
        break;
    case Language::ENGLISH:
        pStrings = &m_englishStrings;
        break;
    case Language::KOREAN:
        pStrings = &m_koreanStrings;
        break;
    default:
        pStrings = &m_chineseStrings;
        break;
    }
    
    auto it = pStrings->find(key);
    return (it != pStrings->end()) ? it->second : key;
}

CString LanguageManager::GetMenuText(UINT commandID) const
{
    switch (commandID)
    {
        // 文件菜单
        case ID_FILE_NEW:           return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_NEW"));

        case ID_FILE_PRINT:         return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_PRINT"));
        case ID_FILE_PRINT_PREVIEW: return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_PRINT_PREVIEW"));
        case ID_FILE_PRINT_SETUP:   return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_PRINT_SETUP"));
        case ID_APP_EXIT:           return GetString(_T("MENU_FILE_EXIT"));
        
        // 编辑菜单
        case ID_MY_UNDO:            return GetString(_T("MENU_EDIT_UNDO"));
        case ID_MY_REDO:            return GetString(_T("MENU_EDIT_REDO"));

        // 工具菜单

        // 颜色菜单

        case ID_COLOR_GREEN:        return GetString(_T("MENU_COLOR_GREEN"));

// ============================================================================
// 形状类实现
// ============================================================================

void CPenShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
    {
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    }
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CLineShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    pDC->LineTo(points[1]);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CRectangleShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Rectangle(rect);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEllipseShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = (CBrush*)pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
    
    CRect rect(points[0], points[1]);
    rect.NormalizeRect();
    pDC->Ellipse(rect);
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

void CEraserShape::Draw(CDC* pDC) const
{
    if (points.size() < 2) return;
    
    CPen pen(PS_SOLID, width, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    pDC->MoveTo(points[0]);
    for (size_t i = 1; i < points.size(); i++)
    {
        pDC->LineTo(points[i]);
    }
    
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
}

// ============================================================================
// CDrawingBoardView 构造/析构
// ============================================================================

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
    : m_currentTool(DrawingTool::PEN)
    , m_currentColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
    , m_currentWidth(2)
    , m_isDrawing(false)
    , m_bBufferInitialized(false)
{
    // 初始化 GDI+
    if (g_gdiplusToken == 0)
    {
        GdiplusStartupInput gdiplusStartupInput;
        GdiplusStartup(&g_gdiplusToken, &gdiplusStartupInput, NULL);
    }
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    // 清理缓冲区资源
    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc())
        m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle())
        m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

// ============================================================================
// 双缓冲实现
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::InitializeBuffer()
{
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    
    if (rect.Width() <= 0 || rect.Height() <= 0)
        return;
    
    // 如果已初始化且大小未改变，则不重新创建
    if (m_bBufferInitialized && rect == m_lastClientRect)
        return;
    
    // 清理旧资源
    if (m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc())
        m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle())
        m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();
    
    // 创建新的缓冲区
    CDC* pDC = GetDC();
    m_bufferDC.CreateCompatibleDC(pDC);
    m_bufferBitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(pDC, rect.Width(), rect.Height());
    m_bufferDC.SelectObject(&m_bufferBitmap);
    ReleaseDC(pDC);
    
    // 白色背景
    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    
    m_lastClientRect = rect;
    m_bBufferInitialized = true;
    
    // 重绘所有已有形状到缓冲区
    RedrawBuffer();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::RedrawBuffer()
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
        return;
    
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    
    // 清空缓冲区
    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    
    // 绘制所有形状
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
    {
        if (shape)
            shape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::OnEraseBkgnd(CDC* pDC)
{
    // 阻止背景擦除，减少闪烁
    return TRUE;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnSize(UINT nType, int cx, int cy)
{
    CView::OnSize(nType, cx, cy);
    
    // 标记需要重新初始化缓冲区
    m_bBufferInitialized = false;
    InitializeBuffer();
}

// ============================================================================
// CDrawingBoardView 绘图
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc)
        return;
    
    // 确保缓冲区已初始化
    InitializeBuffer();
    
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
        return;
    
    // 将缓冲区内容复制到屏幕
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    pDC->BitBlt(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height(), 
                &m_bufferDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
    
    // 绘制正在绘制的形状（不保存到缓冲区）
    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
    {
        m_currentShape->Draw(pDC);
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 鼠标消息处理
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_isDrawing = true;
    m_startPoint = point;
    
    // 根据当前工具创建对应的形状对象
    switch (m_currentTool)
    {
    case DrawingTool::PEN:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CPenShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::LINE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CLineShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::RECTANGLE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CRectangleShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ELLIPSE:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEllipseShape>(m_currentColor, m_currentWidth);
        break;
    case DrawingTool::ERASER:
        m_currentShape = std::make_shared<CEraserShape>(m_currentWidth * 3);
        break;
    }
    
    if (m_currentShape)
    {
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }
    
    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (!m_isDrawing || !m_currentShape)
    {
        CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
        return;
    }
    
    // 铅笔和橡皮擦：添加轨迹点
    if (m_currentTool == DrawingTool::PEN || m_currentTool == DrawingTool::ERASER)
    {
        m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }
    // 其他工具：更新终点
    else
    {
        if (m_currentShape->points.size() > 1)
            m_currentShape->points[1] = point;
        else
            m_currentShape->points.push_back(point);
    }
    
    Invalidate(FALSE);
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_isDrawing && m_currentShape)
    {
        // 保存状态用于撤销
        SaveStateForUndo();
        
        // 将形状添加到形状列表
        m_shapes.push_back(m_currentShape);
        
        // 将形状绘制到缓冲区
        m_currentShape->Draw(&m_bufferDC);
        
        // 重置当前形状
        m_currentShape.reset();
        
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }
    
    m_isDrawing = false;
    ReleaseCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

// ============================================================================
// 撤销/重做功能
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::SaveStateForUndo()
{
    // 保存当前状态
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr
187.050544

12/27 15:54:41
继续生成
Claude Sonnet 4.512/27 15:55:52
C++
 |
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<IShape>> currentState;
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
    {
        if (shape)
        {
            std::shared_ptr<IShape> clonedShape(shape->Clone());
            currentState.push_back(clonedShape);
        }
    }
    
    m_undoStack.push_back(currentState);
    
    // 清空重做栈
    m_redoStack.clear();
    
    // 限制撤销栈大小（例如最多保存50步）
    const size_t MAX_UNDO_STEPS = 50;
    if (m_undoStack.size() > MAX_UNDO_STEPS)
    {
        m_undoStack.erase(m_undoStack.begin());
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyUndo()
{
    if (m_undoStack.empty())
        return;
    
    // 保存当前状态到重做栈
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<IShape>> currentState;
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
    {
        if (shape)
        {
            std::shared_ptr<IShape> clonedShape(shape->Clone());
            currentState.push_back(clonedShape);
        }
    }
    m_redoStack.push_back(currentState);
    
    // 恢复上一个状态
    m_shapes = m_undoStack.back();
    m_undoStack.pop_back();
    
    // 重绘缓冲区和屏幕
    RedrawBuffer();
    Invalidate(FALSE);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyRedo()
{
    if (m_redoStack.empty())
        return;
    
    // 保存当前状态到撤销栈
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<IShape>> currentState;
    for (const auto& shape : m_shapes)
    {
        if (shape)
        {
            std::shared_ptr<IShape> clonedShape(shape->Clone());
            currentState.push_back(clonedShape);
        }
    }
    m_undoStack.push_back(currentState);
    
    // 恢复重做状态
    m_shapes = m_redoStack.back();
    m_redoStack.pop_back();
    
    // 重绘缓冲区和屏幕
    RedrawBuffer();
    Invalidate(FALSE);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyUndo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_undoStack.empty());
    pCmdUI->SetText(m_langManager.GetMenuText(ID_MY_UNDO));
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyRedo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_redoStack.empty());
    pCmdUI->SetText(m_langManager.GetMenuText(ID_MY_REDO));
}

// ============================================================================
// 清空画板功能
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditClearAll()
{
    if (m_shapes.empty())
    {
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_BOARD_EMPTY")), 
                      MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }
    
    int result = AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_CLEAR_CONFIRM")), 
                               MB_YESNO | MB_ICONQUESTION);
    
    if (result == IDYES)
    {
        // 保存状态用于撤销
        SaveStateForUndo();
        
        // 清空形状列表
        m_shapes.clear();
        
        // 重绘缓冲区和屏幕
        RedrawBuffer();
        Invalidate(FALSE);
        
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_CLEAR_SUCCESS")), 
                      MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditClearAll(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_shapes.empty());
    pCmdUI->SetText(m_langManager.GetMenuText(ID_EDIT_CLEAR_ALL));
}

// ============================================================================
// 导出PNG功能
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileExportPng()
{
    // 检查缓冲区是否已初始化
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_BUFFER_NOT_INIT")), 
                      MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }
    
    // 显示文件保存对话框
    CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("png"), 
                    m_langManager.GetString(_T("DEFAULT_FILENAME")),
                    OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT,
                    m_langManager.GetString(_T("FILE_FILTER")),
                    this);
    
    if (dlg.DoModal() != IDOK)
        return;
    
    CString filePath = dlg.GetPathName();
    
    // 获取缓冲区位图信息
    BITMAP bm;
    m_bufferBitmap.GetBitmap(&bm);
    
    // 创建 GDI+ Bitmap
    Bitmap* pBitmap = new Bitmap(bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight, PixelFormat24bppRGB);
    if (!pBitmap)
    {
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_EXPORT_FAILED")), 
                      MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }
    
    // 锁定位图
    BitmapData bitmapData;
    Rect rect(0, 0, bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight);
    Status status = pBitmap->LockBits(&rect, ImageLockModeWrite, 
                                      PixelFormat24bppRGB, &bitmapData);
    
    if (status != Ok)
    {
        delete pBitmap;
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_LOCK_BITMAP_FAILED")), 
                      MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }
    
    // 获取位图数据
    BITMAPINFO bi = { 0 };
    bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
    bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = bm.bmWidth;
    bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -bm.bmHeight; // 负值表示从上到下
    bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 24;
    bi.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;
    
    CDC* pDC = GetDC();
    GetDIBits(pDC->GetSafeHdc(), (HBITMAP)m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle(), 
              0, bm.bmHeight, bitmapData.Scan0, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS);
    ReleaseDC(pDC);
    
    // 解锁位图
    pBitmap->UnlockBits(&bitmapData);
    
    // 获取 PNG 编码器
    CLSID pngClsid;
    if (GetEncoderClsid(L"image/png", &pngClsid) < 0)
    {
        delete pBitmap;
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_NO_PNG_ENCODER")), 
                      MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }
    
    // 保存文件
    status = pBitmap->Save(filePath, &pngClsid, NULL);
    delete pBitmap;
    
    if (status == Ok)
    {
        CString msg;
        msg.Format(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_EXPORT_SUCCESS")), filePath);
        AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
    }
    else
    {
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_EXPORT_FAILED")), 
                      MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 更新所有菜单文本
// ============================================================================

void CDrawingBoardView::UpdateAllMenus()
{
    CMainFrame* pMainFrame = (CMainFrame*)AfxGetMainWnd();
    if (!pMainFrame) return;
    
    CMenu* pMenu = pMainFrame->GetMenu();
    if (!pMenu) return;

    // 定义菜单项ID数组
    UINT fileMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_FILE_NEW, ID_FILE_OPEN, ID_FILE_SAVE, ID_FILE_SAVE_AS,
        ID_FILE_EXPORT_PNG, ID_FILE_PRINT, ID_FILE_PRINT_PREVIEW,
        ID_FILE_PRINT_SETUP, ID_APP_EXIT
    };
    
    UINT editMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_MY_UNDO, ID_MY_REDO, ID_EDIT_CLEAR_ALL
    };
    
    UINT toolMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_TOOL_PEN, ID_TOOL_LINE, ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE,
        ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE, ID_TOOL_ERASER
    };
    
    UINT colorMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_COLOR_BLACK, ID_COLOR_RED, ID_COLOR_GREEN,
        ID_COLOR_BLUE, ID_COLOR_YELLOW
    };
    
    UINT sizeMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_SIZE_THIN, ID_SIZE_MEDIUM, ID_SIZE_THICK
    };
    
    UINT languageMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_LANGUAGE_CHINESE, ID_LANGUAGE_ENGLISH, ID_LANGUAGE_KOREAN
    };
    
    UINT viewMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_VIEW_TOOLBAR, ID_VIEW_STATUS_BAR
    };
    
    UINT helpMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_APP_ABOUT
    };

    // Lambda函数：更新菜单项
    auto updateMenuItems = [this, pMenu](UINT* ids, int count) {
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            CString text = m_langManager.GetMenuText(ids[i]);
            if (!text.IsEmpty())
            {
                MENUITEMINFO mii = { sizeof(MENUITEMINFO) };
                mii.fMask = MIIM_STRING;
                mii.dwTypeData = (LPTSTR)(LPCTSTR)text;
                pMenu->SetMenuItemInfo(ids[i], &mii, FALSE);
            }
        }
    };

    // 更新所有菜单类别
    updateMenuItems(fileMenuIDs, _countof(fileMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(editMenuIDs, _countof(editMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(toolMenuIDs, _countof(toolMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(colorMenuIDs, _countof(colorMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(sizeMenuIDs, _countof(sizeMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(languageMenuIDs, _countof(languageMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(viewMenuIDs, _countof(viewMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(helpMenuIDs, _countof(helpMenuIDs));

    // 强制重绘菜单栏
    pMainFrame->DrawMenuBar();
}

12/27 15:57:36
出现如图错误，解决错误

Claude Sonnet 4.512/27 15:58:07
🔧 错误解决方案
这个错误是因为 Gdiplus::Bitmap 构造函数参数不匹配。让我修正这部分代码：

📝 修改 OnFileExportPng() 函数
在 DrawingBoardView.cpp 中找到 OnFileExportPng() 函数，替换为以下正确版本：

C++
 |
void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileExportPng()
{
    // 检查缓冲区是否已初始化
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_BUFFER_NOT_INIT")), 
                      MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }
    
    // 显示文件保存对话框
    CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("png"), 
                    m_langManager.GetString(_T("DEFAULT_FILENAME")),
                    OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT,
                    m_langManager.GetString(_T("FILE_FILTER")),
                    this);
    
    if (dlg.DoModal() != IDOK)
        return;
    
    CString filePath = dlg.GetPathName();
    
    // 获取缓冲区位图信息
    BITMAP bm;
    m_bufferBitmap.GetBitmap(&bm);
    
    // ========================================================================
    // 修正：使用正确的 Bitmap 构造函数
    // ========================================================================
    // 方法1：从 HBITMAP 创建（推荐）
    Bitmap* pBitmap = Bitmap::FromHBITMAP((HBITMAP)m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle(), NULL);
    
    if (!pBitmap)
    {
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_EXPORT_FAILED")), 
                      MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }
    
    // 获取 PNG 编码器
    CLSID pngClsid;
    if (GetEncoderClsid(L"image/png", &pngClsid) < 0)
    {
        delete pBitmap;
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_NO_PNG_ENCODER")), 
                      MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }
    
    // 保存文件
    Status status = pBitmap->Save(filePath, &pngClsid, NULL);
    delete pBitmap;
    
    if (status == Ok)
    {
        CString msg;
        msg.Format(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_EXPORT_SUCCESS")), filePath);
        AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
    }
    else
    {
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_EXPORT_FAILED")), 
                      MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
    }
}
🎯 错误原因分析
原始错误代码：
C++
 |
Bitmap* pBitmap = new Bitmap(bm.bmWidth, bm.bmHeight, PixelFormat24bppRGB);
问题：
这个构造函数原型是：

C++
 |
Bitmap(INT width, INT height, PixelFormat format = PixelFormatDontCare);
但后续代码尝试使用 LockBits 手动填充数据，这个过程复杂且容易出错。

✅ 正确做法：
C++
 |
Bitmap* pBitmap = Bitmap::FromHBITMAP((HBITMAP)m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle(), NULL);
这个静态方法直接从 HBITMAP 创建 Bitmap，自动处理所有数据转换。

📦 完整的优化版本（可选）
如果你想要更安全的实现，可以使用智能指针版本：

C++
 |
void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileExportPng()
{
    // 检查缓冲区是否已初始化
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_BUFFER_NOT_INIT")), 
                      MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }
    
    // 显示文件保存对话框
    CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("png"), 
                    m_langManager.GetString(_T("DEFAULT_FILENAME")),
                    OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT,
                    m_langManager.GetString(_T("FILE_FILTER")),
                    this);
    
    if (dlg.DoModal() != IDOK)
        return;
    
    CString filePath = dlg.GetPathName();
    
    // 从 HBITMAP 创建 GDI+ Bitmap
    std::unique_ptr<Bitmap> pBitmap(
        Bitmap::FromHBITMAP((HBITMAP)m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle(), NULL)
    );
    
    if (!pBitmap || pBitmap->GetLastStatus() != Ok)
    {
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_EXPORT_FAILED")), 
                      MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }
    
    // 获取 PNG 编码器
    CLSID pngClsid;
    if (GetEncoderClsid(L"image/png", &pngClsid) < 0)
    {
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_NO_PNG_ENCODER")), 
                      MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return;
    }
    
    // 保存文件
    Status status = pBitmap->Save(filePath, &pngClsid, NULL);
    
    if (status == Ok)
    {
        CString msg;
        msg.Format(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_EXPORT_SUCCESS")), filePath);
        AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
    }
    else
    {
        AfxMessageBox(m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_EXPORT_FAILED")), 
                      MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
    }
}

🔧 完整解决方案：菜单文本切换 + 恢复撤销/重做
我看到两个问题：

切换语言时顶级菜单（文件、编辑等）文本没有改变
撤销/重做功能显示为灰色不可用
让我提供完整的解决方案：

📝 第一步：修改 LanguageManager.h
添加顶级菜单的多语言支持：

C++
 |
// LanguageManager.h
#pragma once
#include <map>
#include <string>

enum class Language
{
    CHINESE,
    ENGLISH,
    KOREAN
};

class LanguageManager
{
public:
    LanguageManager();
    ~LanguageManager();
    
    void SetLanguage(Language lang);
    Language GetLanguage() const { return m_currentLanguage; }
    
    CString GetString(const CString& key) const;
    CString GetMenuText(UINT menuID) const;
    
    // ✨ 新增：获取顶级菜单文本
    CString GetTopLevelMenuText(int menuIndex) const;

private:
    void InitializeStrings();
    void InitializeMenuTexts();
    void InitializeTopLevelMenus();  // ✨ 新增
    
    Language m_currentLanguage;
    std::map<CString, std::map<Language, CString>> m_strings;
    std::map<UINT, std::map<Language, CString>> m_menuTexts;
    std::map<int, std::map<Language, CString>> m_topLevelMenus;  // ✨ 新增
};
📝 第二步：修改 LanguageManager.cpp
C++
 |
// LanguageManager.cpp
#include "pch.h"
#include "LanguageManager.h"
#include "resource.h"

LanguageManager::LanguageManager()
    : m_currentLanguage(Language::CHINESE)
{
    InitializeStrings();
    InitializeMenuTexts();
    InitializeTopLevelMenus();  // ✨ 新增
}

LanguageManager::~LanguageManager()
{
}

void LanguageManager::SetLanguage(Language lang)
{
    m_currentLanguage = lang;
}

CString LanguageManager::GetString(const CString& key) const
{
    auto it = m_strings.find(key);
    if (it != m_strings.end())
    {
        auto langIt = it->second.find(m_currentLanguage);
        if (langIt != it->second.end())
        {
            return langIt->second;
        }
    }
    return _T("");
}

CString LanguageManager::GetMenuText(UINT menuID) const
{
    auto it = m_menuTexts.find(menuID);
    if (it != m_menuTexts.end())
    {
        auto langIt = it->second.find(m_currentLanguage);
        if (langIt != it->second.end())
        {
            return langIt->second;
        }
    }
    return _T("");
}

// ✨ 新增：获取顶级菜单文本
CString LanguageManager::GetTopLevelMenuText(int menuIndex) const
{
    auto it = m_topLevelMenus.find(menuIndex);
    if (it != m_topLevelMenus.end())
    {
        auto langIt = it->second.find(m_currentLanguage);
        if (langIt != it->second.end())
        {
            return langIt->second;
        }
    }
    return _T("");
}

📝 第三步：修改 DrawingBoardView.cpp 的 UpdateAllMenus() 函数

 |
// DrawingBoardView.cpp

// ============================================================================
// ✨ 完全重写：更新所有菜单文本（包括顶级菜单）
// ============================================================================
void CDrawingBoardView::UpdateAllMenus()
{
    CMainFrame* pMainFrame = (CMainFrame*)AfxGetMainWnd();
    if (!pMainFrame) return;
    
    CMenu* pMenu = pMainFrame->GetMenu();
    if (!pMenu) return;

    // ========================================================================
    // 第一步：更新顶级菜单文本
    // ========================================================================
    struct TopMenuInfo {
        int index;
        CString text;
    };

    TopMenuInfo topMenus[] = {
        {0, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(0)},  // 文件
        {1, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(1)},  // 编辑
        {2, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(2)},  // 视图
        {3, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(3)},  // 帮助
        {4, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(4)},  // 工具
        {5, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(5)},  // 颜色
        {6, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(6)},  // 粗细
        {7, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(7)}   // 语言
    };

    for (const auto& menu : topMenus)
    {
        if (!menu.text.IsEmpty())
        {
            MENUITEMINFO mii = { sizeof(MENUITEMINFO) };
            mii.fMask = MIIM_STRING;
            mii.dwTypeData = (LPTSTR)(LPCTSTR)menu.text;
            pMenu->SetMenuItemInfo(menu.index, &mii, TRUE);  // TRUE = by position
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // 第二步：更新子菜单项文本
    // ========================================================================
    UINT fileMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_FILE_NEW, ID_FILE_OPEN, ID_FILE_SAVE, ID_FILE_SAVE_AS,
        ID_FILE_EXPORT_PNG, ID_APP_EXIT
    };
    
    UINT editMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_MY_UNDO, ID_MY_REDO, ID_EDIT_CLEAR_ALL
    };
    
    UINT toolMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_TOOL_PEN, ID_TOOL_LINE, ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE,
        ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE, ID_TOOL_ERASER
    };
    
    UINT colorMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_COLOR_BLACK, ID_COLOR_RED, ID_COLOR_GREEN,
        ID_COLOR_BLUE, ID_COLOR_YELLOW
    };
    
    UINT sizeMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_SIZE_THIN, ID_SIZE_MEDIUM, ID_SIZE_THICK
    };
    
    UINT languageMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_LANGUAGE_CHINESE, ID_LANGUAGE_ENGLISH, ID_LANGUAGE_KOREAN
    };
    
    UINT viewMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_VIEW_TOOLBAR, ID_VIEW_STATUS_BAR
    };
    
    UINT helpMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_APP_ABOUT
    };

    // Lambda函数：更新菜单项
    auto updateMenuItems = [this, pMenu](UINT* ids, int count) {
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            CString text = m_langManager.GetMenuText(ids[i]);
            if (!text.IsEmpty())
            {
                MENUITEMINFO mii = { sizeof(MENUITEMINFO) };
                mii.fMask = MIIM_STRING;
                mii.dwTypeData = (LPTSTR)(LPCTSTR)text;
                pMenu->SetMenuItemInfo(ids[i], &mii, FALSE);  // FALSE = by command ID
            }
        }
    };

    // 更新所有子菜单
    updateMenuItems(fileMenuIDs, _countof(fileMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(editMenuIDs, _countof(editMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(toolMenuIDs, _countof(toolMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(colorMenuIDs, _countof(colorMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(sizeMenuIDs, _countof(sizeMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(languageMenuIDs, _countof(languageMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(viewMenuIDs, _countof(viewMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(helpMenuIDs, _countof(helpMenuIDs));

    // ========================================================================
    // 第三步：强制重绘菜单栏
    // ========================================================================
    pMainFrame->DrawMenuBar();
}

📄 LanguageManager.h
C++
 |
#pragma once
#include <map>
#include <string>

enum class Language
{
    CHINESE,
    ENGLISH,
    KOREAN
};

class LanguageManager
{
public:
    LanguageManager();
    ~LanguageManager();
    
    void SetLanguage(Language lang);
    Language GetLanguage() const { return m_currentLanguage; }
    
    CString GetString(const CString& key) const;
    CString GetMenuText(UINT menuID) const;
    CString GetTopLevelMenuText(int menuIndex) const;

private:
    void InitializeStrings();
    void InitializeMenuTexts();
    void InitializeTopLevelMenus();
    
    Language m_currentLanguage;
    std::map<CString, std::map<Language, CString>> m_strings;
    std::map<UINT, std::map<Language, CString>> m_menuTexts;
    std::map<int, std::map<Language, CString>> m_topLevelMenus;
};
📄 LanguageManager.cpp

#include "pch.h"
#include "LanguageManager.h"
#include "resource.h"

LanguageManager::LanguageManager()
    : m_currentLanguage(Language::CHINESE)
{
    InitializeStrings();
    InitializeMenuTexts();
    InitializeTopLevelMenus();
}

LanguageManager::~LanguageManager()
{
}

void LanguageManager::SetLanguage(Language lang)
{
    m_currentLanguage = lang;
}

CString LanguageManager::GetString(const CString& key) const
{
    auto it = m_strings.find(key);
    if (it != m_strings.end())
    {
        auto langIt = it->second.find(m_currentLanguage);
        if (langIt != it->second.end())
        {
            return langIt->second;
        }
    }
    return _T("");
}

CString LanguageManager::GetMenuText(UINT menuID) const
{
    auto it = m_menuTexts.find(menuID);
    if (it != m_menuTexts.end())
    {
        auto langIt = it->second.find(m_currentLanguage);
        if (langIt != it->second.end())
        {
            return langIt->second;
        }
    }
    return _T("");
}

CString LanguageManager::GetTopLevelMenuText(int menuIndex) const
{
    auto it = m_topLevelMenus.find(menuIndex);
    if (it != m_topLevelMenus.end())
    {
        auto langIt = it->second.find(m_currentLanguage);
        if (langIt != it->second.end())
        {
            return langIt->second;
        }
    }
    return _T("");
}

📄 DrawingBoardView.h
C++
