#pragma once
#include <vector>
#include <gdiplus.h>
#include "LanguageManager.h"

using namespace Gdiplus;
#pragma comment(lib, "gdiplus.lib")

enum class ToolType
{
    PEN,
    LINE,
    RECTANGLE,
    ELLIPSE,
    ERASER
};

struct DrawCommand
{
    ToolType tool;
    COLORREF color;
    int penWidth;
    CPoint startPoint;
    CPoint endPoint;
    std::vector<CPoint> points;
};

class CDrawingBoardView : public CView
{
protected:
    CDrawingBoardView() noexcept;
    DECLARE_DYNCREATE(CDrawingBoardView)

public:
    CDrawingBoardDoc* GetDocument() const;

    virtual void OnDraw(CDC* pDC);
    virtual BOOL PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs);
protected:
    virtual BOOL OnPreparePrinting(CPrintInfo* pInfo);
    virtual void OnBeginPrinting(CDC* pDC, CPrintInfo* pInfo);
    virtual void OnEndPrinting(CDC* pDC, CPrintInfo* pInfo);

public:
    virtual ~CDrawingBoardView();
#ifdef _DEBUG
    virtual void AssertValid() const;
    virtual void Dump(CDumpContext& dc) const;
#endif

protected:
    ToolType m_currentTool;
    COLORREF m_currentColor;
    int m_currentPenWidth;
    
    BOOL m_bDrawing;
    CPoint m_startPoint;
    CPoint m_endPoint;
    std::vector<CPoint> m_points;
    
    std::vector<DrawCommand> m_drawCommands;
    std::vector<DrawCommand> m_redoCommands;
    
    CDC m_bufferDC;
    CBitmap m_bufferBitmap;
    BOOL m_bBufferInitialized;
    
    LanguageManager m_langManager;
    
    ULONG_PTR m_gdiplusToken;

protected:
    void InitializeBuffer(int width, int height);
    void DrawToBuffer(const DrawCommand& cmd);
    void ExecuteCommand(const DrawCommand& cmd, CDC* pDC);
    void RedrawAllCommands();
    void UpdateAllMenus();
    int GetEncoderClsid(const WCHAR* format, CLSID* pClsid);

protected:
    afx_msg void OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point);
    afx_msg void OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point);
    afx_msg void OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point);
    afx_msg void OnSize(UINT nType, int cx, int cy);
    afx_msg BOOL OnEraseBkgnd(CDC* pDC);
    
    afx_msg void OnToolPen();
    afx_msg void OnToolLine();

void CDrawingBoardView::InitializeBuffer(int width, int height)
{
    if (m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle())
    {
        m_bufferDC.SelectObject((CBitmap*)NULL);
        m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();
        m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
    }

    CClientDC dc(this);
    m_bufferDC.CreateCompatibleDC(&dc);
    m_bufferBitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(&dc, width, height);
    m_bufferDC.SelectObject(&m_bufferBitmap);
    
    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(0, 0, width, height, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    
    m_bBufferInitialized = TRUE;
    
    RedrawAllCommands();
}

void CDrawingBoardView::RedrawAllCommands()
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
        return;
    
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    
    for (const auto& cmd : m_drawCommands)
    {
        ExecuteCommand(cmd, &m_bufferDC);
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::ExecuteCommand(const DrawCommand& cmd, CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen;
    pen.CreatePen(PS_SOLID, cmd.penWidth, cmd.color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    CBrush brush;
    brush.CreateSolidBrush(cmd.color);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = pDC->SelectObject(&brush);

    switch (cmd.tool)
    {
    case ToolType::PEN:
        if (!cmd.points.empty())
        {
            pDC->MoveTo(cmd.points[0]);
            for (size_t i = 1; i < cmd.points.size(); i++)
            {
                pDC->LineTo(cmd.points[i]);
            }
        }
        break;

    case ToolType::LINE:
        pDC->MoveTo(cmd.startPoint);
        pDC->LineTo(cmd.endPoint);
        break;

    case ToolType::RECTANGLE:
        pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
        pDC->Rectangle(cmd.startPoint.x, cmd.startPoint.y, cmd.endPoint.x, cmd.endPoint.y);
        break;

    case ToolType::ELLIPSE:
        pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
        pDC->Ellipse(cmd.startPoint.x, cmd.startPoint.y, cmd.endPoint.x, cmd.endPoint.y);
        break;

    case ToolType::ERASER:
        if (!cmd.points.empty())
        {
            CPen eraserPen;
            eraserPen.CreatePen(PS_SOLID, cmd.penWidth, RGB(255, 255, 255));
            pDC->SelectObject(&eraserPen);
            pDC->MoveTo(cmd.points[0]);
            for (size_t i = 1; i < cmd.points.size(); i++)
            {
                pDC->LineTo(cmd.points[i]);
            }
        }
        break;
    }

    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::DrawToBuffer(const DrawCommand& cmd)
{
    if (m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        ExecuteCommand(cmd, &m_bufferDC);
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    m_startPoint = point;
    m_endPoint = point;
    m_points.clear();
    m_points.push_back(point);
    
    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;
        m_endPoint = point;
        
        DrawCommand cmd;
        cmd.tool = m_currentTool;
        cmd.color = m_currentColor;
        cmd.penWidth = m_currentPenWidth;
        cmd.startPoint = m_startPoint;
        cmd.endPoint = m_endPoint;
        cmd.points = m_points;
        
        m_drawCommands.push_back(cmd);
        m_redoCommands.clear();
        
        DrawToBuffer(cmd);
        
        Invalidate(FALSE);
        ReleaseCapture();
    }
    
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_endPoint = point;
        
        CClientDC dc(this);
        
        if (m_currentTool == ToolType::PEN || m_currentTool == ToolType::ERASER)
        {
            m_points.push_back(point);
            
            if (m_bBufferInitialized)
            {
                CPen pen;
                if (m_currentTool == ToolType::ERASER)
                {
                    pen.CreatePen(PS_SOLID, m_currentPenWidth, RGB(255, 255, 255));
                }
                else
                {
                    pen.CreatePen(PS_SOLID, m_currentPenWidth, m_currentColor);
                }
                
                CPen* pOldPen = m_bufferDC.SelectObject(&pen);
                
                if (m_points.size() >= 2)
                {
                    m_bufferDC.MoveTo(m_points[m_points.size() - 2]);
                    m_bufferDC.LineTo(m_points[m_points.size() - 1]);
                }
                
                m_bufferDC.SelectObject(pOldPen);
                
                CRect rect;
                GetClientRect(&rect);
                dc.BitBlt(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height(), &m_bufferDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (m_bBufferInitialized)
            {
                CRect rect;
                GetClientRect(&rect);
                dc.BitBlt(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height(), &m_bufferDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
                
                CPen pen;
                pen.CreatePen(PS_SOLID, m_currentPenWidth, m_currentColor);
                CPen* pOldPen = dc.SelectObject(&pen);
                dc.SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
                
                switch (m_currentTool)
                {
                case ToolType::LINE:
                    dc.MoveTo(m_startPoint);
                    dc.LineTo(m_endPoint);
                    break;
                case ToolType::RECTANGLE:
                    dc.Rectangle(m_startPoint.x, m_startPoint.y, m_endPoint.x, m_endPoint.y);
                    break;
                case ToolType::ELLIPSE:
                    dc.Ellipse(m_startPoint.x, m_startPoint.y, m_endPoint.x, m_endPoint.y);
                    break;
                }
                
                dc.SelectObject(pOldPen);
            }
        }
    }
    
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::ExecuteCommand(const DrawCommand& cmd, CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen;
    pen.CreatePen(PS_SOLID, cmd.penWidth, cmd.color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);
    
    CBrush brush;
    brush.CreateSolidBrush(cmd.color);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = pDC->SelectObject(&brush);

    switch (cmd.tool)
    {
    case ToolType::PEN:
        if (!cmd.points.empty())
        {
            pDC->MoveTo(cmd.points[0]);
            for (size_t i = 1; i < cmd.points.size(); i++)
            {
                pDC->LineTo(cmd.points[i]);
            }
        }
        break;

    case ToolType::LINE:
        pDC->MoveTo(cmd.startPoint);
        pDC->LineTo(cmd.endPoint);
        break;

    case ToolType::RECTANGLE:
        pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
        pDC->Rectangle(cmd.startPoint.x, cmd.startPoint.y, cmd.endPoint.x, cmd.endPoint.y);
        break;

    case ToolType::ELLIPSE:
        pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
        pDC->Ellipse(cmd.startPoint.x, cmd.startPoint.y, cmd.endPoint.x, cmd.endPoint.y);
        break;

    case ToolType::ERASER:
        if (!cmd.points.empty())
        {
            CPen eraserPen;
            eraserPen.CreatePen(PS_SOLID, cmd.penWidth, RGB(255, 255, 255));
            pDC->SelectObject(&eraserPen);
            pDC->MoveTo(cmd.points[0]);
            for (size_t i = 1; i < cmd.points.size(); i++)
            {
                pDC->LineTo(cmd.points[i]);
            }
        }
        break;
    }

    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);

void CDrawingBoardView::UpdateAllMenus()
{
    CMainFrame* pMainFrame = (CMainFrame*)AfxGetMainWnd();
    if (!pMainFrame) return;
    
    CMenu* pMenu = pMainFrame->GetMenu();
    if (!pMenu) return;

    struct TopMenuInfo {
        int index;
        CString text;
    };

    TopMenuInfo topMenus[] = {
        {0, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(0)},
        {1, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(1)},
        {2, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(2)},
        {3, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(3)},
        {4, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(4)},
        {5, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(5)},
        {6, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(6)},
        {7, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(7)}
    };

    for (const auto& menu : topMenus)
    {
        if (!menu.text.IsEmpty())
        {
            MENUITEMINFO mii = { sizeof(MENUITEMINFO) };
            mii.fMask = MIIM_STRING;
            mii.dwTypeData = (LPTSTR)(LPCTSTR)menu.text;
            pMenu->SetMenuItemInfo(menu.index, &mii, TRUE);
        }
    }

    UINT fileMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_FILE_NEW, ID_FILE_OPEN, ID_FILE_SAVE, ID_FILE_SAVE_AS,
        ID_FILE_EXPORT_PNG, ID_APP_EXIT
    };
    
    UINT editMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_MY_UNDO, ID_MY_REDO, ID_EDIT_CLEAR_ALL
    };
    
    UINT toolMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_TOOL_PEN, ID_TOOL_LINE, ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE,
        ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE, ID_TOOL_ERASER
    };
    
    UINT colorMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_COLOR_BLACK, ID_COLOR_RED, ID_COLOR_GREEN,
        ID_COLOR_BLUE, ID_COLOR_YELLOW
    };
    
    UINT sizeMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_SIZE_THIN, ID_SIZE_MEDIUM, ID_SIZE_THICK
    };
    
    UINT languageMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_LANGUAGE_CHINESE, ID_LANGUAGE_ENGLISH, ID_LANGUAGE_KOREAN
    };
    
    UINT viewMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_VIEW_TOOLBAR, ID_VIEW_STATUS_BAR
    };
    
    UINT helpMenuIDs[] = {
        ID_APP_ABOUT
    };

    auto updateMenuItems = [this, pMenu](UINT* ids, int count) {
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            CString text = m_langManager.GetMenuText(ids[i]);
            if (!text.IsEmpty())
            {
                MENUITEMINFO mii = { sizeof(MENUITEMINFO) };
                mii.fMask = MIIM_STRING;
                mii.dwTypeData = (LPTSTR)(LPCTSTR)text;
                pMenu->SetMenuItemInfo(ids[i], &mii, FALSE);
            }
        }
    };

    updateMenuItems(fileMenuIDs, _countof(fileMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(editMenuIDs, _countof(editMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(toolMenuIDs, _countof(toolMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(colorMenuIDs, _countof(colorMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(sizeMenuIDs, _countof(sizeMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(languageMenuIDs, _countof(languageMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(viewMenuIDs, _countof(viewMenuIDs));
    updateMenuItems(helpMenuIDs, _countof(helpMenuIDs));

    pMainFrame->DrawMenuBar();
}

int CDrawingBoardView::GetEncoderClsid(const WCHAR* format, CLSID* pClsid)
{
    UINT num = 0;
    UINT size = 0;

    GetImageEncodersSize(&num, &size);
    if (size == 0)
        return -1;

    ImageCodecInfo* pImageCodecInfo = (ImageCodecInfo*)(malloc(size));
    if (pImageCodecInfo == NULL)
        return -1;

    GetImageEncoders(num, size, pImageCodecInfo);

    for (UINT j = 0; j < num; ++j)
    {
        if (wcscmp(pImageCodecInfo[j].MimeType, format) == 0)
        {
            *pClsid = pImageCodecInfo[j].Clsid;
            free(pImageCodecInfo);
            return j;
        }
    }

    free(pImageCodecInfo);
    return -1;
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    m_startPoint = point;
    m_endPoint = point;
    m_points.clear();
    m_points.push_back(point);
    
    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;
        m_endPoint = point;
        
        DrawCommand cmd;
        cmd.tool = m_currentTool;
        cmd.color = m_currentColor;
        cmd.penWidth = m_currentPenWidth;
        cmd.startPoint = m_startPoint;
        cmd.endPoint = m_endPoint;
        cmd.points = m_points;
        
        m_drawCommands.push_back(cmd);
        m_redoCommands.clear();
        
        DrawToBuffer(cmd);
        
        Invalidate(FALSE);
        ReleaseCapture();
    }
    
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_endPoint = point;
        
        CClientDC dc(this);
        
        if (m_currentTool == ToolType::PEN || m_currentTool == ToolType::ERASER)
        {
            m_points.push_back(point);
            
            if (m_bBufferInitialized)
            {
                CPen pen;
                if (m_currentTool == ToolType::ERASER)
                {
                    pen.CreatePen(PS_SOLID, m_currentPenWidth, RGB(255, 255, 255));
                }
                else
                {
                    pen.CreatePen(PS_SOLID, m_currentPenWidth, m_currentColor);
                }
                
                CPen* pOldPen = m_bufferDC.SelectObject(&pen);
                
                if (m_points.size() >= 2)
                {
                    m_bufferDC.MoveTo(m_points[m_points.size() - 2]);
                    m_bufferDC.LineTo(m_points[m_points.size() - 1]);
                }
                
                m_bufferDC.SelectObject(pOldPen);
                
                CRect rect;
                GetClientRect(&rect);
                dc.BitBlt(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height(), &m_bufferDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (m_bBufferInitialized)
            {
                CRect rect;
                GetClientRect(&rect);
                dc.BitBlt(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height(), &m_bufferDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
                
                CPen pen;
                pen.CreatePen(PS_SOLID, m_currentPenWidth, m_currentColor);
                CPen* pOldPen = dc.SelectObject(&pen);
                dc.SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);
                
                switch (m_currentTool)
                {
                case ToolType::LINE:
                    dc.MoveTo(m_startPoint);
                    dc.LineTo(m_endPoint);
                    break;
                case ToolType::RECTANGLE:
                    dc.Rectangle(m_startPoint.x, m_startPoint.y, m_endPoint.x, m_endPoint.y);
                    break;
                case ToolType::ELLIPSE:
                    dc.Ellipse(m_startPoint.x, m_startPoint.y, m_endPoint.x, m_endPoint.y);
                    break;
                }
                
                dc.SelectObject(pOldPen);
            }
        }
    }
    
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditClearAll()
{
    if (m_drawCommands.empty())
    {
        CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_BOARD_EMPTY"));
        AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }

    CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_CLEAR_CONFIRM"));
    if (AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_YESNO | MB_ICONQUESTION) == IDYES)
    {
        m_drawCommands.clear();
        m_redoCommands.clear();
        
        if (m_bBufferInitialized)
        {
            CRect rect;
            GetClientRect(&rect);
            m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
        }
        
        Invalidate(FALSE);
        
        CString successMsg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_CLEAR_SUCCESS"));
        AfxMessageBox(successMsg, MB_ICONINFORMATION);
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditClearAll(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_drawCommands.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnFileExportPng()
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_BUFFER_NOT_INIT"));
        AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_ICONWARNING);
        return;
    }

    CString defaultName = m_langManager.GetString(_T("DEFAULT_FILENAME"));
    CString filter = m_langManager.GetString(_T("FILE_FILTER"));
    
    CFileDialog dlg(FALSE, _T("png"), defaultName, 
                    OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT, 
                    filter);

    if (dlg.DoModal() == IDOK)
    {
        CString filePath = dlg.GetPathName();
        
        HBITMAP hBitmap = (HBITMAP)m_bufferBitmap.GetSafeHandle();
        Bitmap* pBitmap = Bitmap::FromHBITMAP(hBitmap, NULL);
        
        CLSID pngClsid;
        if (GetEncoderClsid(L"image/png", &pngClsid) == -1)
        {
            CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_NO_PNG_ENCODER"));
            AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_ICONERROR);
            delete pBitmap;
            return;
        }
        
        Status status = pBitmap->Save(filePath, &pngClsid, NULL);
        delete pBitmap;
        
        if (status == Ok)
        {
            CString msg;
            CString format = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_EXPORT_SUCCESS"));
            msg.Format(format, filePath);
            AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        }
        else
        {
            CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_EXPORT_FAILED"));
            AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_ICONERROR);
        }
    }
}

C++
 |
// 1. 数据结构（在DrawingBoardView.h中定义）
std::vector<DrawCommand> m_drawCommands;    // 已执行的命令
std::vector<DrawCommand> m_redoCommands;    // 可重做的命令

// 2. 撤销功能实现
void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyUndo()
{
    if (!m_drawCommands.empty())
    {
        m_redoCommands.push_back(m_drawCommands.back());  // 保存到重做栈
        m_drawCommands.pop_back();                        // 从命令栈移除
        
        RedrawAllCommands();  // 重绘所有剩余命令
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }
}

// 3. 重做功能实现
void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyRedo()
{
    if (!m_redoCommands.empty())
    {
        m_drawCommands.push_back(m_redoCommands.back());  // 恢复到命令栈
        m_redoCommands.pop_back();                        // 从重做栈移除
        
        RedrawAllCommands();  // 重绘所有命令
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }
}

// 4. 按钮启用/禁用状态
void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyUndo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_drawCommands.empty());  // 有命令时启用
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyRedo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_redoCommands.empty());  // 有可重做命令时启用
}

🔄 工作流程说明
绘制时的处理
C++
 |
void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        // 创建命令
        DrawCommand cmd;
        cmd.tool = m_currentTool;
        cmd.color = m_currentColor;
        cmd.penWidth = m_currentPenWidth;
        cmd.startPoint = m_startPoint;
        cmd.endPoint = m_endPoint;
        cmd.points = m_points;
        
        // 添加到命令历史
        m_drawCommands.push_back(cmd);
        
        // ⚠️ 重要：新操作会清空重做栈
        m_redoCommands.clear();
        
        DrawToBuffer(cmd);
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }
}
清空画板时的处理
C++
 |
void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditClearAll()
{
    if (m_drawCommands.empty())
    {
        // 提示画板已空
        return;
    }

    if (确认清空)
    {
        m_drawCommands.clear();    // 清空命令历史
        m_redoCommands.clear();    // 清空重做栈
        
        // 清空缓冲区
        CRect rect;
        GetClientRect(&rect);
        m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
        
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }
}

🔄 实现重新生成功能
我理解了，您需要添加重新生成功能！这个功能将清空画板并重新按顺序绘制所有图形（带动画效果）。

📝 完整实现步骤
1️⃣ 修改 resource.h

 |
#define ID_EDIT_REGENERATE      32777
2️⃣ 修改 DrawingBoardView.h
添加重新生成相关的声明：

C++
 |
class CDrawingBoardView : public CView
{
protected:
    // ... 现有成员变量 ...
    
    // 重新生成相关
    BOOL m_bRegenerating;                    // 是否正在重新生成

添加重新生成功能实现
C++
 |
// 开始重新生成
void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditRegenerate()
{
    if (m_drawCommands.empty())
    {
        CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_BOARD_EMPTY"));
        if (msg.IsEmpty())
            msg = _T("画板为空，无法重新生成！");
        AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }

    if (m_bRegenerating)
    {
        CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_REGENERATING"));
        if (msg.IsEmpty())
            msg = _T("正在重新生成中...");
        AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }

    CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_REGENERATE_CONFIRM"));
    if (msg.IsEmpty())
        msg = _T("确定要重新生成画板吗？");
    
    if (AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_YESNO | MB_ICONQUESTION) == IDYES)
    {
        StartRegenerate();
    }
}

// 更新重新生成菜单状态
void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditRegenerate(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_drawCommands.empty() && !m_bRegenerating);
}

// 启动重新生成过程
void CDrawingBoardView::StartRegenerate()
{
    // 备份当前所有命令
    m_backupCommands = m_drawCommands;
    
    // 清空画板
    if (m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        CRect rect;
        GetClientRect(&rect);
        m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    }
    
    // 初始化重新生成状态
    m_bRegenerating = TRUE;
    m_nRegenerateIndex = 0;
    
    // 启动定时器 (每50毫秒执行一步，可以调整速度)
    m_nTimerID = SetTimer(1, 50, NULL);
    
    Invalidate(FALSE);
}

// 停止重新生成过程
void CDrawingBoardView::StopRegenerate()
{
    if (m_nTimerID != 0)
    {
        KillTimer(m_nTimerID);
        m_nTimerID = 0;
    }
    
    m_bRegenerating = FALSE;
    m_nRegenerateIndex = 0;
    m_backupCommands.clear();
    
    Invalidate(FALSE);
}

// 重新生成每一步
void CDrawingBoardView::RegenerateStep()
{
    if (m_nRegenerateIndex >= (int)m_backupCommands.size())
    {
        // 完成重新生成
        StopRegenerate();
        
        CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_REGENERATE_COMPLETE"));
        if (msg.IsEmpty())
            msg = _T("重新生成完成！");
        AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }
    
    // 绘制下一个命令
    if (m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        ExecuteCommand(m_backupCommands[m_nRegenerateIndex], &m_bufferDC);
        m_nRegenerateIndex++;
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }
}

// 定时器处理
void CDrawingBoardView::OnTimer(UINT_PTR nIDEvent)
{
    if (nIDEvent == m_nTimerID && m_bRegenerating)
    {
        RegenerateStep();
    }
    
    CView::OnTimer(nIDEvent);
}
修改鼠标按下事件（禁止在重新生成时绘制）
C++
 |
void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    // 如果正在重新生成，禁止绘制
    if (m_bRegenerating)
    {
        CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_WAIT_REGENERATE"));
        if (msg.IsEmpty())
            msg = _T("请等待重新生成完成！");
        AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_ICONWARNING);
        return;
    }
    
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    m_startPoint = point;
    m_endPoint = point;
    m_points.clear();
    m_points.push_back(point);
    
    SetCapture();
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

工作流程

定时器启动 → 每50ms绘制一个命令
逐步重绘 → 显示动画效果
完成 → 停止定时器 → 显示完成提示

m_nTimerID = SetTimer(1, 200, NULL); // 200ms = 较慢
🎨 增强功能（可选）
1. 添加进度显示
C++
 |
void CDrawingBoardView::RegenerateStep()
{
    if (m_nRegenerateIndex >= (int)m_backupCommands.size())
    {
        StopRegenerate();
        CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_REGENERATE_COMPLETE"));
        AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }
    
    // 在状态栏显示进度
    CMainFrame* pMainFrame = (CMainFrame*)AfxGetMainWnd();
    if (pMainFrame)
    {
        CString progress;
        progress.Format(_T("重新生成中... %d/%d"), 
                       m_nRegenerateIndex + 1, 
                       m_backupCommands.size());
        pMainFrame->SetMessageText(progress);
    }
    
    if (m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        ExecuteCommand(m_backupCommands[m_nRegenerateIndex], &m_bufferDC);
        m_nRegenerateIndex++;
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateEditPauseRegenerate(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)

    pCmdUI->SetCheck(m_bRegeneratePaused);

{
    if (nIDEvent == m_nTimerID && m_bRegenerating && !m_bRegeneratePaused)
    {
        RegenerateStep();
    }
    
    CView::OnTimer(nIDEvent);
}

{
    PEN,        // 画笔
    LINE,       // 直线
    RECTANGLE,  // 矩形
    ELLIPSE,    // 椭圆
    ERASER      // 橡皮擦
};

// 绘图命令结构
struct DrawCommand
{
    ToolType tool;                  // 工具类型

    int penWidth;                   // 画笔宽度

    CPoint endPoint;                // 结束点
    std::vector<CPoint> points;     // 自由绘制的点集（用于画笔和橡皮擦）
};

A. 构造函数和析构函数
C++
 |
CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
    : m_currentTool(ToolType::PEN)
    , m_currentColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
    , m_currentPenWidth(2)
    , m_bDrawing(FALSE)
    , m_bBufferInitialized(FALSE)
    , m_gdiplusToken(0)
{
    // 初始化 GDI+
    GdiplusStartupInput gdiplusStartupInput;
    GdiplusStartup(&m_gdiplusToken, &gdiplusStartupInput, NULL);
    
    // 清空命令历史
    m_drawCommands.clear();
    m_redoCommands.clear();
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    CleanupBuffer();
    
    // 清空命令历史
    m_drawCommands.clear();
    m_redoCommands.clear();
    
    // 关闭 GDI+
    if (m_gdiplusToken != 0)
    {
        GdiplusShutdown(m_gdiplusToken);
    }
}

C. 撤销功能实现
C++
 |
// ========== 撤销功能 ==========
void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyUndo()
{
    // 检查是否有可撤销的命令
    if (m_drawCommands.empty())
    {
        CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_NO_UNDO"));
        if (msg.IsEmpty())
            msg = _T("没有可撤销的操作！");
        AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }
    
    // 将最后一个命令移到重做栈
    DrawCommand lastCommand = m_drawCommands.back();
    m_redoCommands.push_back(lastCommand);
    m_drawCommands.pop_back();
    
    // 重新绘制所有剩余命令
    RedrawAllCommands();
    
    // 刷新显示
    Invalidate(FALSE);
    
    // 输出调试信息
    TRACE(_T("撤销操作: 命令历史=%d, 重做栈=%d\n"), 
          m_drawCommands.size(), m_redoCommands.size());
}

// 更新撤销按钮状态
void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyUndo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    // 只有当有可撤销的命令时才启用
    BOOL bEnable = !m_drawCommands.empty();
    pCmdUI->Enable(bEnable);
    
    // 可选：显示可撤销步数
    if (bEnable)
    {
        CString text;
        text.Format(_T("撤销 (%d)"), m_drawCommands.size());
        // pCmdUI->SetText(text);  // 如果需要显示步数，取消注释
    }
}

// ========== 重做功能 ==========
void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyRedo()
{
    // 检查是否有可重做的命令
    if (m_redoCommands.empty())
    {
        CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_NO_REDO"));
        if (msg.IsEmpty())
            msg = _T("没有可重做的操作！");
        AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }
    
    // 将重做栈顶的命令恢复到命令历史
    DrawCommand redoCommand = m_redoCommands.back();
    m_drawCommands.push_back(redoCommand);
    m_redoCommands.pop_back();
    
    // 重新绘制所有命令
    RedrawAllCommands();
    
    // 刷新显示
    Invalidate(FALSE);
    
    // 输出调试信息
    TRACE(_T("重做操作: 命令历史=%d, 重做栈=%d\n"), 
          m_drawCommands.size(), m_redoCommands.size());
}

// 更新重做按钮状态
void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyRedo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    // 只有当有可重做的命令时才启用
    BOOL bEnable = !m_redoCommands.empty();
    pCmdUI->Enable(bEnable);
    
    // 可选：显示可重做步数
    if (bEnable)
    {
        CString text;
        text.Format(_T("重做 (%d)"), m_redoCommands.size());
        // pCmdUI->SetText(text);  // 如果需要显示步数，取消注释
    }
}
E. 重新绘制所有命令
C++
 |
// 重新绘制所有命令
void CDrawingBoardView::RedrawAllCommands()
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
        return;
    
    // 清空缓冲区（填充白色背景）
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    
    // 重新执行所有命令
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_drawCommands.size(); i++)
    {
        ExecuteCommand(m_drawCommands[i], &m_bufferDC);
    }
    
    TRACE(_T("重绘完成: 共 %d 个命令\n"), m_drawCommands.size());
}
F. 修改鼠标释放事件（添加命令到历史）
C++
 |
void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;
        ReleaseCapture();
        
        m_endPoint = point;
        
        // 对于画笔和橡皮擦，添加最后一个点
        if (m_currentTool == ToolType::PEN || m_currentTool == ToolType::ERASER)
        {
            m_points.push_back(point);
        }
        
        // ========== 创建绘图命令 ==========
        DrawCommand cmd;
        cmd.tool = m_currentTool;
        cmd.color = m_currentColor;
        cmd.penWidth = m_currentPenWidth;
        cmd.startPoint = m_startPoint;
        cmd.endPoint = m_endPoint;
        cmd.points = m_points;
        
        // ========== 添加到命令历史 ==========
        m_drawCommands.push_back(cmd);
        
        // ========== 重要：清空重做栈 ==========
        // 一旦有新操作，就清空所有重做记录
        if (!m_redoCommands.empty())
        {
            m_redoCommands.clear();
            TRACE(_T("新操作，清空重做栈\n"));
        }
        
        // 绘制到缓冲区
        DrawToBuffer(cmd);
        
        // 刷新显示
        Invalidate(FALSE);
        
        // 输出调试信息
        TRACE(_T("添加命令: 工具=%d, 命令数=%d\n"), 
              (int)cmd.tool, m_drawCommands.size());
    }
    
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}
G. 修改清空画板功能
C++
 |
void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditClearAll()
{
    // 如果画板已经为空，给出提示
    if (m_drawCommands.empty())
    {
        CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_BOARD_EMPTY"));
        if (msg.IsEmpty())
            msg = _T("画板已经是空的！");
        AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }
    
    // 确认清空
    CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_CLEAR_CONFIRM"));
    if (msg.IsEmpty())
        msg = _T("确定要清空画板吗？\n这将删除所有内容且无法恢复！");
    
    if (AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_YESNO | MB_ICONQUESTION) == IDYES)
    {
        // ========== 清空所有命令历史 ==========
        m_drawCommands.clear();
        m_redoCommands.clear();
        
        // 清空缓冲区
        if (m_bBufferInitialized)
        {
            CRect rect;
            GetClientRect(&rect);
            m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
        }
        
        // 刷新显示
        Invalidate(FALSE);
        
        TRACE(_T("画板已清空\n"));
    }
}

🐛 常见问题排查
问题1：撤销后图形没消失
检查：

RedrawAllCommands() 是否被调用？
Invalidate(FALSE) 是否被调用？
解决：确保 OnMyUndo() 中有这两行

问题2：重做不起作用
检查：

m_redoCommands 是否为空？
新操作后是否清空了重做栈？
解决：检查 OnLButtonUp() 中是否有 m_redoCommands.clear()

问题3：菜单始终灰色
检查：

消息映射中是否有 ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI？
OnUpdateMyUndo/Redo 是否被调用？
解决：确保消息映射正确

问题4：清空画板后仍可撤销
检查：OnEditClearAll() 中是否清空了两个容器？

解决：

C++
 |
m_drawCommands.clear();
m_redoCommands.clear();

    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_MY_UNDO, &CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyUndo)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_MY_REDO, &CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyRedo)
    
    // 鼠标消息
    ON_WM_LBUTTONDOWN()
    ON_WM_LBUTTONUP()
    ON_WM_MOUSEMOVE()
    
    // 语言切换
    ON_COMMAND(ID_LANGUAGE_CHINESE, &CDrawingBoardView::OnLanguageChinese)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_LANGUAGE_ENGLISH, &CDrawingBoardView::OnLanguageEnglish)
    ON_COMMAND(ID_LANGUAGE_KOREAN, &CDrawingBoardView::OnLanguageKorean)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_LANGUAGE_CHINESE, &CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateLanguageChinese)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_LANGUAGE_ENGLISH, &CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateLanguageEnglish)
    ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI(ID_LANGUAGE_KOREAN, &CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateLanguageKorean)
END_MESSAGE_MAP()

// CDrawingBoardView 构造/析构

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
    : m_currentTool(ToolType::PEN)
    , m_currentColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
    , m_currentPenWidth(2)
    , m_bDrawing(FALSE)
    , m_bBufferInitialized(FALSE)
    , m_gdiplusToken(0)
{
    // 初始化 GDI+
    GdiplusStartupInput gdiplusStartupInput;
    GdiplusStartup(&m_gdiplusToken, &gdiplusStartupInput, NULL);
    
    // 清空命令历史
    m_drawCommands.clear();
    m_redoCommands.clear();
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    CleanupBuffer();
    
    // 清空命令历史
    m_drawCommands.clear();
    m_redoCommands.clear();
    
    // 关闭 GDI+
    if (m_gdiplusToken != 0)
    {
        GdiplusShutdown(m_gdiplusToken);
    }
}

BOOL CDrawingBoardView::PreCreateWindow(CREATESTRUCT& cs)
{
    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);
}

// CDrawingBoardView 绘图

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc)
        return;

    // 初始化缓冲区（如果需要）
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        InitializeBuffer();
    }

    // 将缓冲区内容绘制到屏幕
    if (m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        CRect rect;
        GetClientRect(&rect);
        pDC->BitBlt(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height(), &m_bufferDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
    }
}

// ========================================
// 缓冲区管理
// ========================================

void CDrawingBoardView::InitializeBuffer()
{
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);

    if (rect.Width() > 0 && rect.Height() > 0)
    {
        CClientDC dc(this);
        
        // 创建兼容的内存DC
        m_bufferDC.CreateCompatibleDC(&dc);
        
        // 创建兼容的位图
        m_bufferBitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(&dc, rect.Width(), rect.Height());
        
        // 选择位图到DC
        m_bufferDC.SelectObject(&m_bufferBitmap);
        
        // 填充白色背景
        m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
        
        m_bBufferInitialized = TRUE;
        
        TRACE(_T("缓冲区初始化成功: %d x %d\n"), rect.Width(), rect.Height());
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::CleanupBuffer()
{
    if (m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();
        m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
        m_bBufferInitialized = FALSE;
        
        TRACE(_T("缓冲区已清理\n"));
    }
}

// ========================================
// 绘图方法
// ========================================

void CDrawingBoardView::DrawToBuffer(const DrawCommand& cmd)
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
        return;

    ExecuteCommand(cmd, &m_bufferDC);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::ExecuteCommand(const DrawCommand& cmd, CDC* pDC)
{
    Graphics graphics(pDC->GetSafeHdc());
    graphics.SetSmoothingMode(SmoothingModeAntiAlias);

    Pen pen(Color(GetRValue(cmd.color), GetGValue(cmd.color), GetBValue(cmd.color)), 
            (REAL)cmd.penWidth);
    pen.SetLineCap(LineCapRound, LineCapRound, DashCapRound);

    switch (cmd.tool)
    {
    case ToolType::PEN:
        {
            if (cmd.points.size() >= 2)
            {
                for (size_t i = 0; i < cmd.points.size() - 1; i++)
                {
                    graphics.DrawLine(&pen, 
                        cmd.points[i].x, cmd.points[i].y,
                        cmd.points[i + 1].x, cmd.points[i + 1].y);
                }
            }
        }
        break;

    case ToolType::LINE:
        {
            graphics.DrawLine(&pen, 
                cmd.startPoint.x, cmd.startPoint.y,
                cmd.endPoint.x, cmd.endPoint.y);
        }
        break;

    case ToolType::RECTANGLE:
        {
            int left = min(cmd.startPoint.x, cmd.endPoint.x);
            int top = min(cmd.startPoint.y, cmd.endPoint.y);
            int width = abs(cmd.endPoint.x - cmd.startPoint.x);
            int height = abs(cmd.endPoint.y - cmd.startPoint.y);
            
            graphics.DrawRectangle(&pen, left, top, width, height);
        }
        break;

    case ToolType::ELLIPSE:
        {
            int left = min(cmd.startPoint.x, cmd.endPoint.x);
            int top = min(cmd.startPoint.y, cmd.endPoint.y);
            int width = abs(cmd.endPoint.x - cmd.startPoint.x);
            int height = abs(cmd.endPoint.y - cmd.startPoint.y);
            
            graphics.DrawEllipse(&pen, left, top, width, height);
        }
        break;

    case ToolType::ERASER:
        {
            Pen eraserPen(Color(255, 255, 255), (REAL)cmd.penWidth * 2);
            eraserPen.SetLineCap(LineCapRound, LineCapRound, DashCapRound);
            
            if (cmd.points.size() >= 2)
            {
                for (size_t i = 0; i < cmd.points.size() - 1; i++)
                {
                    graphics.DrawLine(&eraserPen, 
                        cmd.points[i].x, cmd.points[i].y,
                        cmd.points[i + 1].x, cmd.points[i + 1].y);
                }
            }
        }
        break;
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::RedrawAllCommands()
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
        return;
    
    // 清空缓冲区（填充白色背景）
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    
    // 重新执行所有命令
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_drawCommands.size(); i++)
    {
        ExecuteCommand(m_drawCommands[i], &m_bufferDC);
    }
    
    TRACE(_T("重绘完成: 共 %d 个命令\n"), m_drawCommands.size());
}

// ========================================
// 编辑操作
// ========================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnEditClearAll()
{
    // 如果画板已经为空，给出提示
    if (m_drawCommands.empty())
    {
        CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_BOARD_EMPTY"));
        if (msg.IsEmpty())
            msg = _T("画板已经是空的！");
        AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }
    
    // 确认清空
    CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_CLEAR_CONFIRM"));
    if (msg.IsEmpty())
        msg = _T("确定要清空画板吗？\n这将删除所有内容且无法恢复！");
    
    if (AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_YESNO | MB_ICONQUESTION) == IDYES)
    {
        // 清空所有命令历史
        m_drawCommands.clear();
        m_redoCommands.clear();
        
        // 清空缓冲区
        if (m_bBufferInitialized)
        {
            CRect rect;
            GetClientRect(&rect);
            m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
        }
        
        // 刷新显示
        Invalidate(FALSE);
        
        TRACE(_T("画板已清空\n"));
    }
}

// ========================================
// 撤销和重做功能
// ========================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyUndo()
{
    // 检查是否有可撤销的命令
    if (m_drawCommands.empty())
    {
        CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_NO_UNDO"));
        if (msg.IsEmpty())
            msg = _T("没有可撤销的操作！");
        AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }
    
    // 将最后一个命令移到重做栈
    DrawCommand lastCommand = m_drawCommands.back();
    m_redoCommands.push_back(lastCommand);
    m_drawCommands.pop_back();
    
    // 重新绘制所有剩余命令
    RedrawAllCommands();
    
    // 刷新显示
    Invalidate(FALSE);
    
    // 输出调试信息
    TRACE(_T("撤销操作: 命令历史=%d, 重做栈=%d\n"), 
          m_drawCommands.size(), m_redoCommands.size());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyRedo()
{
    // 检查是否有可重做的命令
    if (m_redoCommands.empty())
    {
        CString msg = m_langManager.GetString(_T("MSG_NO_REDO"));
        if (msg.IsEmpty())
            msg = _T("没有可重做的操作！");
        AfxMessageBox(msg, MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }
    
    // 将重做栈顶的命令恢复到命令历史
    DrawCommand redoCommand = m_redoCommands.back();
    m_drawCommands.push_back(redoCommand);
    m_redoCommands.pop_back();
    
    // 重新绘制所有命令
    RedrawAllCommands();
    
    // 刷新显示
    Invalidate(FALSE);
    
    // 输出调试信息
    TRACE(_T("重做操作: 命令历史=%d, 重做栈=%d\n"), 
          m_drawCommands.size(), m_redoCommands.size());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyUndo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    // 只有当有可撤销的命令时才启用
    BOOL bEnable = !m_drawCommands.empty();
    pCmdUI->Enable(bEnable);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyRedo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    // 只有当有可重做的命令时才启用
    BOOL bEnable = !m_redoCommands.empty();
    pCmdUI->Enable(bEnable);
}

// ========================================
// 鼠标消息处理
// ========================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    m_startPoint = point;
    m_endPoint = point;
    m_points.clear();
    m_points.push_back(point);
    
    SetCapture();
    
    TRACE(_T("开始绘制: 工具=%d, 起点=(%d, %d)\n"), 
          (int)m_currentTool, point.x, point.y);
    
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;
        ReleaseCapture();
        
        m_endPoint = point;
        
        // 对于画笔和橡皮擦，添加最后一个点
        if (m_currentTool == ToolType::PEN || m_currentTool == ToolType::ERASER)
        {
            m_points.push_back(point);
        }
        
        // 创建绘图命令
        DrawCommand cmd;
        cmd.tool = m_currentTool;
        cmd.color = m_currentColor;
        cmd.penWidth = m_currentPenWidth;
        cmd.startPoint = m_startPoint;
        cmd.endPoint = m_endPoint;
        cmd.points = m_points;
        
        // 添加到命令历史
        m_drawCommands.push_back(cmd);
        
        // 重要：清空重做栈
        // 一旦有新操作，就清空所有重做记录
        if (!m_redoCommands.empty())
        {
            m_redoCommands.clear();
            TRACE(_T("新操作，清空重做栈\n"));
        }
        
        // 绘制到缓冲区
        DrawToBuffer(cmd);
        
        // 刷新显示
        Invalidate(FALSE);
        
        // 输出调试信息
        TRACE(_T("完成绘制: 工具=%d, 终点=(%d, %d), 命令数=%d\n"), 
              (int)cmd.tool, point.x, point.y, m_drawCommands.size());
    }
    
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        // 对于画笔和橡皮擦，记录轨迹点
        if (m_currentTool == ToolType::PEN || m_currentTool == ToolType::ERASER)
        {
            m_points.push_back(point);
            
            // 实时绘制到缓冲区
            if (m_bBufferInitialized && m_points.size() >= 2)
            {
                Graphics graphics(m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc());
                graphics.SetSmoothingMode(SmoothingModeAntiAlias);
                
                if (m_currentTool == ToolType::PEN)
                {
                    Pen pen(Color(GetRValue(m_currentColor), 
                                  GetGValue(m_currentColor), 
                                  GetBValue(m_currentColor)), 
                            (REAL)m_currentPenWidth);
                    pen.SetLineCap(LineCapRound, LineCapRound, DashCapRound);
                    
                    size_t lastIdx = m_points.size() - 1;
                    graphics.DrawLine(&pen, 
                        m_points[lastIdx - 1].x, m_points[lastIdx - 1].y,
                        m_points[lastIdx].x, m_points[lastIdx].y);
                }
                else if (m_currentTool == ToolType::ERASER)
                {
                    Pen eraserPen(Color(255, 255, 255), (REAL)m_currentPenWidth * 2);
                    eraserPen.SetLineCap(LineCapRound, LineCapRound, DashCapRound);
                    
                    size_t lastIdx = m_points.size() - 1;
                    graphics.DrawLine(&eraserPen, 
                        m_points[lastIdx - 1].x, m_points[lastIdx - 1].y,
                        m_points[lastIdx].x, m_points[lastIdx].y);
                }
            }
            
            Invalidate(FALSE);
        }
        else
        {
            // 对于形状工具，更新终点并重绘
            m_endPoint = point;
            
            // 重绘所有已保存的命令
            RedrawAllCommands();
            
            // 在缓冲区上绘制临时预览
            if (m_bBufferInitialized)
            {
                DrawCommand previewCmd;
                previewCmd.tool = m_currentTool;
                previewCmd.color = m_currentColor;
                previewCmd.penWidth = m_currentPenWidth;
                previewCmd.startPoint = m_startPoint;
                previewCmd.endPoint = m_endPoint;
                
                ExecuteCommand(previewCmd, &m_bufferDC);
            }
            
            Invalidate(FALSE);
        }
    }
    
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

🔑 关键实现要点
1. 命令模式设计
C++
 |
struct DrawCommand
{
    ToolType tool;
    COLORREF color;
    int penWidth;
    CPoint startPoint;
    CPoint endPoint;
    std::vector<CPoint> points;
};
2. 双栈管理
C++
 |
std::vector<DrawCommand> m_drawCommands;  // 命令历史
std::vector<DrawCommand> m_redoCommands;  // 重做栈
3. 撤销逻辑
C++
 |
// 从历史移到重做栈
DrawCommand lastCommand = m_drawCommands.back();
m_redoCommands.push_back(lastCommand);
m_drawCommands.pop_back();
RedrawAllCommands();
4. 重做逻辑
C++
 |
// 从重做栈恢复到历史
DrawCommand redoCommand = m_redoCommands.back();
m_drawCommands.push_back(redoCommand);
m_redoCommands.pop_back();
RedrawAllCommands();
5. 新操作清空重做栈
C++
 |
// 在 OnLButtonUp 中
if (!m_redoCommands.empty())
{
    m_redoCommands.clear();
}

🔧 使用上传文件的标识符修复错误
根据您上传的 resource.h 文件，我发现了问题所在。您的资源文件中使用的是 ID_SIZE_THIN、ID_SIZE_MEDIUM、ID_SIZE_THICK，但代码中使用的是 ID_WIDTH_THIN、ID_WIDTH_MEDIUM、ID_WIDTH_THICK。

另外还缺少一些必要的定义。

📝 步骤 1：更新 resource.h
将您的 resource.h 文件修改为：

📝 步骤 5：修改菜单资源（DrawingBoard.rc）
在资源编辑器中，打开菜单资源 IDR_MAINFRAME，确保菜单项使用正确的 ID：

菜单结构：
 |
文件(&F)
├── 新建(&N)\tCtrl+N                    [ID_FILE_NEW]
├── 打开(&O)...\tCtrl+O                [ID_FILE_OPEN]
├── 保存(&S)\tCtrl+S                   [ID_FILE_SAVE]
├── 另存为(&A)...                       [ID_FILE_SAVE_AS]
├── ─────────────────
├── 导出为PNG(&E)...                    [ID_FILE_EXPORT_PNG]
├── ─────────────────
├── 打印(&P)...\tCtrl+P                [ID_FILE_PRINT]
├── 打印预览(&V)                        [ID_FILE_PRINT_PREVIEW]
├── 打印设置(&R)...                     [ID_FILE_PRINT_SETUP]
├── ─────────────────
└── 退出(&X)                            [ID_APP_EXIT]

编辑(&E)
├── 撤销(&U)\tCtrl+Z                    [ID_MY_UNDO]
├── 重做(&R)\tCtrl+Y                    [ID_MY_REDO]
├── ─────────────────
└── 清空画板(&C)                        [ID_EDIT_CLEAR_ALL]

工具(&T)
├── 画笔(&P)                            [ID_TOOL_PEN]
├── 直线(&L)                            [ID_TOOL_LINE]
├── 矩形(&R)                            [ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE]
├── 椭圆(&E)                            [ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE]
└── 橡皮擦(&A)                          [ID_TOOL_ERASER]

颜色(&C)
├── 黑色(&B)                            [ID_COLOR_BLACK]
├── 红色(&R)                            [ID_COLOR_RED]
├── 绿色(&G)                            [ID_COLOR_GREEN]
├── 蓝色(&L)                            [ID_COLOR_BLUE]
├── 黄色(&Y)                            [ID_COLOR_YELLOW]
├── ─────────────────
└── 自定义颜色(&C)...                   [ID_COLOR_CUSTOM]

画笔宽度(&W)
├── 细(&T)                              [ID_WIDTH_THIN]
├── 中(&M)                              [ID_WIDTH_MEDIUM]
└── 粗(&K)                              [ID_WIDTH_THICK]

语言(&L)
├── 中文(&C)                            [ID_LANGUAGE_CHINESE]
├── 英文(&E)                            [ID_LANGUAGE_ENGLISH]
└── 韩文(&K)                            [ID_LANGUAGE_KOREAN]

📝 步骤 7：完整的 LanguageManager.cpp
这是完整的文件，包含所有必要的定义：

C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "LanguageManager.h"

LanguageManager::LanguageManager()
    : m_currentLanguage(Language::CHINESE)
{
    InitializeStrings();
    InitializeMenuTexts();
}

void LanguageManager::SetLanguage(Language lang)
{
    m_currentLanguage = lang;
}

Language LanguageManager::GetCurrentLanguage() const
{
    return m_currentLanguage;
}

CString LanguageManager::GetString(const CString& key) const
{
    auto langIt = m_strings.find(m_currentLanguage);
    if (langIt != m_strings.end())
    {
        auto strIt = langIt->second.find(key);
        if (strIt != langIt->second.end())
        {
            return strIt->second;
        }
    }
    return _T("");
}

CString LanguageManager::GetMenuText(UINT commandID) const
{
    auto langIt = m_menuTexts.find(m_currentLanguage);
    if (langIt != m_menuTexts.end())
    {
        auto menuIt = langIt->second.find(commandID);
        if (menuIt != langIt->second.end())
        {
            return menuIt->second;
        }
    }
    return _T("");
}

void LanguageManager::InitializeStrings()
{
    // ==================== 中文 ====================
    m_strings[Language::CHINESE][_T("MSG_NO_UNDO")] = _T("没有可撤销的操作！");
    m_strings[Language::CHINESE][_T("MSG_NO_REDO")] = _T("没有可重做的操作！");
    m_strings[Language::CHINESE][_T("MSG_BOARD_EMPTY")] = _T("画板已经是空的！");
    m_strings[Language::CHINESE][_T("MSG_CLEAR_CONFIRM")] = _T("确定要清空画板吗？\n这将删除所有内容且无法恢复！");
    
    // ==================== 英文 ====================
    m_strings[Language::ENGLISH][_T("MSG_NO_UNDO")] = _T("No operation to undo!");
    m_strings[Language::ENGLISH][_T("MSG_NO_REDO")] = _T("No operation to redo!");
    m_strings[Language::ENGLISH][_T("MSG_BOARD_EMPTY")] = _T("The board is already empty!");
    m_strings[Language::ENGLISH][_T("MSG_CLEAR_CONFIRM")] = _T("Are you sure to clear the board?\nThis will delete all content and cannot be undone!");
    
    // ==================== 韩文 ====================
    m_strings[Language::KOREAN][_T("MSG_NO_UNDO")] = _T("실행 취소할 작업이 없습니다!");
    m_strings[Language::KOREAN][_T("MSG_NO_REDO")] = _T("다시 실행할 작업이 없습니다!");
    m_strings[Language::KOREAN][_T("MSG_BOARD_EMPTY")] = _T("보드가 이미 비어 있습니다!");
    m_strings[Language::KOREAN][_T("MSG_CLEAR_CONFIRM")] = _T("보드를 지우시겠습니까?\n모든 내용이 삭제되며 복구할 수 없습니다!");
}

// CDrawingBoardView 构造/析构

CDrawingBoardView::CDrawingBoardView() noexcept
    : m_currentTool(ToolType::PEN)
    , m_currentColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
    , m_currentPenWidth(2)
    , m_bDrawing(FALSE)
    , m_bBufferInitialized(FALSE)
    , m_gdiplusToken(0)
{
    // 初始化 GDI+
    GdiplusStartupInput gdiplusStartupInput;
    GdiplusStartup(&m_gdiplusToken, &gdiplusStartupInput, NULL);
    
    // 清空命令历史
    m_drawCommands.clear();
    m_redoCommands.clear();
}

CDrawingBoardView::~CDrawingBoardView()
{
    CleanupBuffer();
    
    // 清空命令历史
    m_drawCommands.clear();
    m_redoCommands.clear();
    
    // 关闭 GDI+
    if (m_gdiplusToken != 0)
    {
        GdiplusShutdown(m_gdiplusToken);
    }
}

    return CView::PreCreateWindow(cs);

// CDrawingBoardView 绘图

void CDrawingBoardView::OnDraw(CDC* pDC)
{
    CDrawingBoardDoc* pDoc = GetDocument();
    ASSERT_VALID(pDoc);
    if (!pDoc)
        return;

    // 初始化缓冲区（如果需要）
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        InitializeBuffer();
    }

    // 将缓冲区内容绘制到屏幕
    if (m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        CRect rect;
        GetClientRect(&rect);
        pDC->BitBlt(0, 0, rect.Width(), rect.Height(), &m_bufferDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
    }
}

// ========================================
// 缓冲区管理
// ========================================

void CDrawingBoardView::InitializeBuffer()
{
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);

    if (rect.Width() > 0 && rect.Height() > 0)
    {
        CClientDC dc(this);
        
        // 创建兼容的内存DC
        m_bufferDC.CreateCompatibleDC(&dc);
        
        // 创建兼容的位图
        m_bufferBitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(&dc, rect.Width(), rect.Height());
        
        // 选择位图到DC
        m_bufferDC.SelectObject(&m_bufferBitmap);
        
        // 填充白色背景
        m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
        
        m_bBufferInitialized = TRUE;
        
        TRACE(_T("缓冲区初始化成功: %d x %d\n"), rect.Width(), rect.Height());
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::CleanupBuffer()
{
    if (m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        m_bufferBitmap.DeleteObject();
        m_bufferDC.DeleteDC();
        m_bBufferInitialized = FALSE;
        
        TRACE(_T("缓冲区已清理\n"));
    }
}

// ========================================
// 绘图方法
// ========================================

void CDrawingBoardView::DrawToBuffer(const DrawCommand& cmd)
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
        return;

    ExecuteCommand(cmd, &m_bufferDC);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::ExecuteCommand(const DrawCommand& cmd, CDC* pDC)
{
    Graphics graphics(pDC->GetSafeHdc());
    graphics.SetSmoothingMode(SmoothingModeAntiAlias);

    Pen pen(Color(GetRValue(cmd.color), GetGValue(cmd.color), GetBValue(cmd.color)), 
            (REAL)cmd.penWidth);
    pen.SetLineCap(LineCapRound, LineCapRound, DashCapRound);

    switch (cmd.tool)
    {
    case ToolType::PEN:
        {
            if (cmd.points.size() >= 2)
            {
                for (size_t i = 0; i < cmd.points.size() - 1; i++)
                {
                    graphics.DrawLine(&pen, 
                        cmd.points[i].x, cmd.points[i].y,
                        cmd.points[i + 1].x, cmd.points[i + 1].y);
                }
            }
        }
        break;

    case ToolType::LINE:
        {
            graphics.DrawLine(&pen, 
                cmd.startPoint.x, cmd.startPoint.y,
                cmd.endPoint.x, cmd.endPoint.y);
        }
        break;

    case ToolType::RECTANGLE:
        {
            int left = min(cmd.startPoint.x, cmd.endPoint.x);
            int top = min(cmd.startPoint.y, cmd.endPoint.y);
            int width = abs(cmd.endPoint.x - cmd.startPoint.x);
            int height = abs(cmd.endPoint.y - cmd.startPoint.y);
            
            graphics.DrawRectangle(&pen, left, top, width, height);
        }
        break;

    case ToolType::ELLIPSE:
        {
            int left = min(cmd.startPoint.x, cmd.endPoint.x);
            int top = min(cmd.startPoint.y, cmd.endPoint.y);
            int width = abs(cmd.endPoint.x - cmd.startPoint.x);
            int height = abs(cmd.endPoint.y - cmd.startPoint.y);
            
            graphics.DrawEllipse(&pen, left, top, width, height);
        }
        break;

    case ToolType::ERASER:
        {
            Pen eraserPen(Color(255, 255, 255), (REAL)cmd.penWidth * 2);
            eraserPen.SetLineCap(LineCapRound, LineCapRound, DashCapRound);
            
            if (cmd.points.size() >= 2)
            {
                for (size_t i = 0; i < cmd.points.size() - 1; i++)
                {
                    graphics.DrawLine(&eraserPen, 
                        cmd.points[i].x, cmd.points[i].y,
                        cmd.points[i + 1].x, cmd.points[i + 1].y);
                }
            }
        }
        break;
    }
}

void CDrawingBoardView::RedrawAllCommands()
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
        return;
    
    // 清空缓冲区（填充白色背景）
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));
    
    // 重新执行所有命令
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_drawCommands.size(); i++)
    {
        ExecuteCommand(m_drawCommands[i], &m_bufferDC);
    }
    
    TRACE(_T("重绘完成: 共 %d 个命令\n"), m_drawCommands.size());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateToolEraser(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)

// ========================================
// 撤销和重做功能
// ========================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyUndo()
{
    // 检查是否有可撤销的命令
    if (m_drawCommands.empty())
    {
        AfxMessageBox(_T("没有可撤销的操作！"), MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }
    
    // 将最后一个命令移到重做栈
    DrawCommand lastCommand = m_drawCommands.back();
    m_redoCommands.push_back(lastCommand);
    m_drawCommands.pop_back();
    
    // 重新绘制所有剩余命令
    RedrawAllCommands();
    
    // 刷新显示
    Invalidate(FALSE);
    
    // 输出调试信息
    TRACE(_T("撤销操作: 命令历史=%d, 重做栈=%d\n"), 
          m_drawCommands.size(), m_redoCommands.size());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyRedo()
{
    // 检查是否有可重做的命令
    if (m_redoCommands.empty())
    {
        AfxMessageBox(_T("没有可重做的操作！"), MB_ICONINFORMATION);
        return;
    }
    
    // 将重做栈顶的命令恢复到命令历史
    DrawCommand redoCommand = m_redoCommands.back();
    m_drawCommands.push_back(redoCommand);
    m_redoCommands.pop_back();
    
    // 重新绘制所有命令
    RedrawAllCommands();
    
    // 刷新显示
    Invalidate(FALSE);
    
    // 输出调试信息
    TRACE(_T("重做操作: 命令历史=%d, 重做栈=%d\n"), 
          m_drawCommands.size(), m_redoCommands.size());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyUndo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    // 只有当有可撤销的命令时才启用
    BOOL bEnable = !m_drawCommands.empty();
    pCmdUI->Enable(bEnable);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyRedo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    // 只有当有可重做的命令时才启用
    BOOL bEnable = !m_redoCommands.empty();
    pCmdUI->Enable(bEnable);
}

// ========================================
// 鼠标消息处理
// ========================================

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonDown(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    m_bDrawing = TRUE;
    m_startPoint = point;
    m_endPoint = point;
    m_points.clear();
    m_points.push_back(point);
    
    SetCapture();
    
    TRACE(_T("开始绘制: 工具=%d, 起点=(%d, %d)\n"), 
          (int)m_currentTool, point.x, point.y);
    
    CView::OnLButtonDown(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        m_bDrawing = FALSE;
        ReleaseCapture();
        
        m_endPoint = point;
        
        // 对于画笔和橡皮擦，添加最后一个点
        if (m_currentTool == ToolType::PEN || m_currentTool == ToolType::ERASER)
        {
            m_points.push_back(point);
        }
        
        // 创建绘图命令
        DrawCommand cmd;
        cmd.tool = m_currentTool;
        cmd.color = m_currentColor;
        cmd.penWidth = m_currentPenWidth;
        cmd.startPoint = m_startPoint;
        cmd.endPoint = m_endPoint;
        cmd.points = m_points;
        
        // 添加到命令历史
        m_drawCommands.push_back(cmd);
        
        // 重要：清空重做栈
        // 一旦有新操作，就清空所有重做记录
        if (!m_redoCommands.empty())
        {
            m_redoCommands.clear();
            TRACE(_T("新操作，清空重做栈\n"));
        }
        
        // 绘制到缓冲区
        DrawToBuffer(cmd);
        
        // 刷新显示
        Invalidate(FALSE);
        
        // 输出调试信息
        TRACE(_T("完成绘制: 工具=%d, 终点=(%d, %d), 命令数=%d\n"), 
              (int)cmd.tool, point.x, point.y, m_drawCommands.size());
    }
    
    CView::OnLButtonUp(nFlags, point);
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnMouseMove(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        // 对于画笔和橡皮擦，记录轨迹点
        if (m_currentTool == ToolType::PEN || m_currentTool == ToolType::ERASER)
        {
            m_points.push_back(point);
            
            // 实时绘制到缓冲区
            if (m_bBufferInitialized && m_points.size() >= 2)
            {
                Graphics graphics(m_bufferDC.GetSafeHdc());
                graphics.SetSmoothingMode(SmoothingModeAntiAlias);
                
                if (m_currentTool == ToolType::PEN)
                {
                    Pen pen(Color(GetRValue(m_currentColor), 
                                  GetGValue(m_currentColor), 
                                  GetBValue(m_currentColor)), 
                            (REAL)m_currentPenWidth);
                    pen.SetLineCap(LineCapRound, LineCapRound, DashCapRound);
                    
                    size_t lastIdx = m_points.size() - 1;
                    graphics.DrawLine(&pen, 
                        m_points[lastIdx - 1].x, m_points[lastIdx - 1].y,
                        m_points[lastIdx].x, m_points[lastIdx].y);
                }
                else if (m_currentTool == ToolType::ERASER)
                {
                    Pen eraserPen(Color(255, 255, 255), (REAL)m_currentPenWidth * 2);
                    eraserPen.SetLineCap(LineCapRound, LineCapRound, DashCapRound);
                    
                    size_t lastIdx = m_points.size() - 1;
                    graphics.DrawLine(&eraserPen, 
                        m_points[lastIdx - 1].x, m_points[lastIdx - 1].y,
                        m_points[lastIdx].x, m_points[lastIdx].y);
                }
            }
            
            Invalidate(FALSE);
        }
        else
        {
            // 对于形状工具，更新终点并重绘
            m_endPoint = point;
            
            // 重绘所有已保存的命令
            RedrawAllCommands();
            
            // 在缓冲区上绘制临时预览
            if (m_bBufferInitialized)
            {
                DrawCommand previewCmd;
                previewCmd.tool = m_currentTool;
                previewCmd.color = m_currentColor;
                previewCmd.penWidth = m_currentPenWidth;
                previewCmd.startPoint = m_startPoint;
                previewCmd.endPoint = m_endPoint;
                
                ExecuteCommand(previewCmd, &m_bufferDC);
            }
            
            Invalidate(FALSE);
        }
    }
    
    CView::OnMouseMove(nFlags, point);
}

🔧 解决 LanguageManager 中的标识符错误
看到您上传的 LanguageManager 文件，我发现问题所在：文件中使用了 ID_WIDTH_* 和 ID_COLOR_CUSTOM 以及 ID_EDIT_CLEAR_ALL，但这些在您的 resource.h 中并不存在。

根据您的 resource.h，应该使用 ID_SIZE_* 前缀。

📝 修正后的 LanguageManager.h
C++
 |
// LanguageManager.h
#pragma once
#include <map>
#include <string>

enum class Language
{
    CHINESE,
    ENGLISH,
    KOREAN
};

class LanguageManager
{
public:
    LanguageManager();
    ~LanguageManager();

    void SetLanguage(Language lang);
    Language GetLanguage() const { return m_currentLanguage; }

    CString GetString(const CString& key) const;
    CString GetMenuText(UINT menuID) const;

    // 获取顶级菜单文本
    CString GetTopLevelMenuText(int menuIndex) const;

private:
    void InitializeStrings();
    void InitializeMenuTexts();
    void InitializeTopLevelMenus();

    Language m_currentLanguage;
    std::map<CString, std::map<Language, CString>> m_strings;
    std::map<UINT, std::map<Language, CString>> m_menuTexts;
    std::map<int, std::map<Language, CString>> m_topLevelMenus;
};
📝 修正后的 LanguageManager.cpp
C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "LanguageManager.h"
#include "resource.h"

LanguageManager::LanguageManager()
    : m_currentLanguage(Language::CHINESE)
{
    InitializeStrings();
    InitializeMenuTexts();
    InitializeTopLevelMenus();
}

LanguageManager::~LanguageManager()
{
}

void LanguageManager::SetLanguage(Language lang)
{
    m_currentLanguage = lang;
}

CString LanguageManager::GetString(const CString& key) const
{
    auto it = m_strings.find(key);
    if (it != m_strings.end())
    {
        auto langIt = it->second.find(m_currentLanguage);
        if (langIt != it->second.end())
        {
            return langIt->second;
        }
    }
    return _T("");
}

CString LanguageManager::GetMenuText(UINT menuID) const
{
    auto it = m_menuTexts.find(menuID);
    if (it != m_menuTexts.end())
    {
        auto langIt = it->second.find(m_currentLanguage);
        if (langIt != it->second.end())
        {
            return langIt->second;
        }
    }
    return _T("");
}

🔍 分析撤销和重做功能未实现的原因
看了您的代码，撤销和重做功能实际上已经实现了，但可能存在以下问题：

⚠️ 可能的问题
1. 菜单项 ID 不匹配
您的 resource.h 中使用的是：

ID_MY_UNDO (32775)
ID_MY_REDO (32776)
但您可能在菜单资源文件（.rc）中使用了不同的 ID。

2. 快捷键未配置
撤销（Ctrl+Z）和重做（Ctrl+Y）的快捷键可能没有在加速键表中配置。

✅ 完整的解决方案
📝 第一步：确认 DrawingBoardView.h
C++
 |
#pragma once
#include <vector>
#include <gdiplus.h>
#include "LanguageManager.h"

using namespace Gdiplus;
#pragma comment(lib, "gdiplus.lib")

enum class ToolType
{
    PEN,
    LINE,
    RECTANGLE,
    ELLIPSE,
    ERASER
};

struct DrawCommand
{
    ToolType tool;
    COLORREF color;
    int penWidth;
    CPoint startPoint;
    CPoint endPoint;
    std::vector<CPoint> points;
};

class CDrawingBoardView : public CView
{
protected:
    CDrawingBoardView() noexcept;
    DECLARE_DYNCREATE(CDrawingBoardView)

public:
    CDrawingBoardDoc* GetDocument() const;

#endif

    CPoint m_endPoint;
    std::vector<CPoint> m_points;

    std::vector<DrawCommand> m_redoCommands;  // 可重做的命令

    // 双缓冲

protected:

📝 第二步：检查 DrawingBoardView.cpp 的撤销/重做实现
您的代码中这两个函数已经实现：

C++
 |
// ✅ 撤销功能 - 代码正确
void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyUndo()
{
    if (!m_drawCommands.empty())
    {
        // 1. 将最后一个命令移到重做栈
        m_redoCommands.push_back(m_drawCommands.back());
        m_drawCommands.pop_back();

        // 2. 重新绘制所有剩余命令
        RedrawAllCommands();
        
        // 3. 刷新界面
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }
}

// ✅ 重做功能 - 代码正确
void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyRedo()
{
    if (!m_redoCommands.empty())
    {
        // 1. 从重做栈恢复命令
        m_drawCommands.push_back(m_redoCommands.back());
        m_redoCommands.pop_back();

        // 2. 重新绘制所有命令
        RedrawAllCommands();
        
        // 3. 刷新界面
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }
}

// ✅ UI 更新 - 代码正确
void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyUndo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_drawCommands.empty());  // 有命令时才启用
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyRedo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_redoCommands.empty());  // 有可重做的命令时才启用
}
🔍 为什么可能"看起来没实现"？
原因 1：新操作后重做栈被清空
C++
 |
void CDrawingBoardView::OnLButtonUp(UINT nFlags, CPoint point)
{
    if (m_bDrawing)
    {
        // ... 省略代码 ...
        
        m_drawCommands.push_back(cmd);
        
        // ⚠️ 关键：新操作会清空重做栈
        m_redoCommands.clear();  // 这是正确的设计！
        
        // ... 省略代码 ...
    }
}
这是正确的行为：

用户画了一笔 → 撤销 → 能重做
用户画了一笔 → 撤销 → 又画了新的一笔 → 不能重做之前撤销的
原因 2：快捷键未配置
检查加速键表：
打开 DrawingBoard.rc，找到 IDR_MAINFRAME ACCELERATORS 部分，确保有：

 |
IDR_MAINFRAME ACCELERATORS
BEGIN
    "N",            ID_FILE_NEW,            VIRTKEY, CONTROL
    "O",            ID_FILE_OPEN,           VIRTKEY, CONTROL
    "S",            ID_FILE_SAVE,           VIRTKEY, CONTROL
    "Z",            ID_MY_UNDO,             VIRTKEY, CONTROL  // ✅ 撤销快捷键
    "Y",            ID_MY_REDO,             VIRTKEY, CONTROL  // ✅ 重做快捷键
END
原因 3：菜单项 ID 不匹配
检查菜单资源：
打开 DrawingBoard.rc，找到编辑菜单，确保：

 |
POPUP "编辑(&E)"
BEGIN
    MENUITEM "撤销(&U)\tCtrl+Z",         ID_MY_UNDO    // ✅ 必须是 32775
    MENUITEM "重做(&R)\tCtrl+Y",         ID_MY_REDO    // ✅ 必须是 32776
    MENUITEM SEPARATOR
    MENUITEM "清空画板(&C)",             ID_EDIT_CLEAR_ALL
END
🧪 测试步骤
编译运行程序

测试撤销：
点击菜单 编辑 → 撤销 或按 Ctrl+Z
应该看到最后一笔消失
测试重做：
点击菜单 编辑 → 重做 或按 Ctrl+Y
应该看到刚才撤销的那笔重新出现
测试撤销后新操作：
撤销一笔
画一笔新的
此时重做应该变灰（这是正确的）

目前重做功能也是撤销功能，分析原因
Claude Sonnet 4.512/27 17:02:32
🔍 重做功能变成撤销的原因分析
看了您的代码，我发现了问题！让我详细分析：

❌ 问题根源
查看您的 OnMyRedo() 函数：

C++
 |
void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyRedo()
{
    if (!m_redoCommands.empty())
    {
        // 1. 从重做栈取出命令
        m_drawCommands.push_back(m_redoCommands.back());
        m_redoCommands.pop_back();

        // 2. ⚠️ 问题在这里！
        RedrawAllCommands();  // 这个函数重绘了所有 m_drawCommands
        
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }
}
问题分析：

RedrawAllCommands() 会清空缓冲区并重绘所有命令，但是：

它只重绘 m_drawCommands 中的命令
不会单独绘制刚恢复的那个命令
🔧 正确的解决方案
方案一：修改重做函数，只绘制恢复的命令
C++
 |
void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyRedo()
{
    if (!m_redoCommands.empty())
    {
        // 1. 从重做栈取出最后一个命令
        DrawCommand cmd = m_redoCommands.back();
        m_redoCommands.pop_back();
        
        // 2. 添加到命令历史
        m_drawCommands.push_back(cmd);
        
        // 3. ✅ 只绘制这一个恢复的命令（不是重绘所有）
        DrawToBuffer(cmd);
        
        // 4. 刷新显示
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }
}
方案二：保持原有逻辑但确保完整重绘
如果您想保持 RedrawAllCommands() 的调用，确保该函数正确：

C++
 |
void CDrawingBoardView::RedrawAllCommands()
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
        return;

    // 1. 清空缓冲区（白色背景）
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));

    // 2. ✅ 重绘所有命令
    for (const auto& cmd : m_drawCommands)
    {
        ExecuteCommand(cmd, &m_bufferDC);
    }
}
然后重做函数保持原样：

        m_drawCommands.push_back(m_redoCommands.back());
        m_redoCommands.pop_back();

        // 重绘所有命令（包括刚恢复的）
        RedrawAllCommands();
        
        Invalidate(FALSE);
    }
}
📋 完整的正确代码
DrawingBoardView.cpp 中的关键函数
C++
 |
// ============================================
// 撤销功能
// ============================================
void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyUndo()
{
    if (!m_drawCommands.empty())
    {
        // 1. 将最后一个命令移到重做栈
        m_redoCommands.push_back(m_drawCommands.back());
        m_drawCommands.pop_back();

        // 2. 重新绘制所有剩余命令
        RedrawAllCommands();
        
        // 3. 刷新界面
        Invalidate(FALSE);
        
        TRACE(_T("撤销: 命令数=%d, 重做栈=%d\n"), 
              m_drawCommands.size(), m_redoCommands.size());
    }
}

// ============================================
// 重做功能（修正版）
// ============================================
void CDrawingBoardView::OnMyRedo()
{
    if (!m_redoCommands.empty())
    {
        // 1. 从重做栈取出命令
        DrawCommand cmd = m_redoCommands.back();
        m_redoCommands.pop_back();
        
        // 2. 添加回命令历史
        m_drawCommands.push_back(cmd);
        
        // 3. 方案A：只绘制恢复的命令（推荐，性能更好）
        DrawToBuffer(cmd);
        
        // 或者 方案B：重绘所有命令（更安全）
        // RedrawAllCommands();
        
        // 4. 刷新界面
        Invalidate(FALSE);
        
        TRACE(_T("重做: 命令数=%d, 重做栈=%d\n"), 
              m_drawCommands.size(), m_redoCommands.size());
    }
}

// ============================================
// 重绘所有命令（确保正确实现）
// ============================================
void CDrawingBoardView::RedrawAllCommands()
{
    if (!m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        TRACE(_T("⚠️ 缓冲区未初始化\n"));
        return;
    }

    // 1. 清空缓冲区
    CRect rect;
    GetClientRect(&rect);
    m_bufferDC.FillSolidRect(&rect, RGB(255, 255, 255));

    // 2. 按顺序执行所有命令
    TRACE(_T("重绘 %d 个命令\n"), m_drawCommands.size());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_drawCommands.size(); i++)
    {
        ExecuteCommand(m_drawCommands[i], &m_bufferDC);
    }
}

// ============================================
// 执行单个绘图命令（确保正确实现）
// ============================================
void CDrawingBoardView::ExecuteCommand(const DrawCommand& cmd, CDC* pDC)
{
    CPen pen;
    pen.CreatePen(PS_SOLID, cmd.penWidth, cmd.color);
    CPen* pOldPen = pDC->SelectObject(&pen);

    CBrush brush;
    brush.CreateSolidBrush(cmd.color);
    CBrush* pOldBrush = pDC->SelectObject(&brush);

    switch (cmd.tool)
    {
    case ToolType::PEN:
        if (!cmd.points.empty())
        {
            pDC->MoveTo(cmd.points[0]);
            for (size_t i = 1; i < cmd.points.size(); i++)
            {
                pDC->LineTo(cmd.points[i]);
            }
        }
        break;

    case ToolType::LINE:
        pDC->MoveTo(cmd.startPoint);
        pDC->LineTo(cmd.endPoint);
        break;

    case ToolType::RECTANGLE:
        pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);  // 空心
        pDC->Rectangle(cmd.startPoint.x, cmd.startPoint.y, 
                      cmd.endPoint.x, cmd.endPoint.y);
        break;

    case ToolType::ELLIPSE:
        pDC->SelectStockObject(NULL_BRUSH);  // 空心
        pDC->Ellipse(cmd.startPoint.x, cmd.startPoint.y, 
                    cmd.endPoint.x, cmd.endPoint.y);
        break;

    case ToolType::ERASER:
        if (!cmd.points.empty())
        {
            CPen eraserPen;
            eraserPen.CreatePen(PS_SOLID, cmd.penWidth, RGB(255, 255, 255));
            pDC->SelectObject(&eraserPen);
            
            pDC->MoveTo(cmd.points[0]);
            for (size_t i = 1; i < cmd.points.size(); i++)
            {
                pDC->LineTo(cmd.points[i]);
            }
        }
        break;
    }

    pDC->SelectObject(pOldPen);
    pDC->SelectObject(pOldBrush);
}

// ============================================
// 绘制到缓冲区
// ============================================
void CDrawingBoardView::DrawToBuffer(const DrawCommand& cmd)
{
    if (m_bBufferInitialized)
    {
        ExecuteCommand(cmd, &m_bufferDC);
    }
}

// ============================================
// UI 更新
// ============================================
void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyUndo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_drawCommands.empty());
}

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyRedo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_redoCommands.empty());
}

12/27 17:09:31
为什么在实现撤销功能以后，语言切换时，撤销菜单不能切换成其他语言
Claude Sonnet 4.512/27 17:10:28
🔍 语言切换时撤销菜单不更新的原因分析
这是一个非常典型的 MFC 动态菜单更新问题！让我详细分析原因和解决方案。

❌ 问题根源
原因 1：ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI 会覆盖菜单文本
当您实现了 OnUpdateMyUndo() 和 OnUpdateMyRedo() 后：

C++
 |
void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyUndo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_drawCommands.empty());  // ⚠️ 这会触发菜单刷新
}
MFC 的工作机制：

菜单显示前，MFC 调用 OnUpdateMyUndo()
CCmdUI::Enable() 会保留原始菜单文本
即使您用 SetMenuItemInfo() 修改了菜单文本
下次 OnUpdateMyUndo() 触发时，文本会被还原回原来的文本
原因 2：菜单文本存储在资源文件中
MFC 会从资源文件（.rc）中读取菜单的原始文本，ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI 每次都会重新读取。

✅ 完整解决方案
方案一：在 OnUpdateXXX 中同时更新文本（推荐）
C++
 |
// DrawingBoardView.cpp

void CDrawingBoardView::OnUpdateMyUndo(CCmdUI* pCmdUI)
{
    // 1. 设置启用状态
    pCmdUI->Enable(!m_drawCommands.empty());
    
    // 2. ✅ 同时更新菜单文本
    CString text = m_langManager.GetMenuText(ID_MY_UNDO);
    if (!text.IsEmpty())
    {
        pCmdUI->SetText(text);
    }
}

方案二：优化 UpdateAllMenus() 函数
保持动态更新菜单的同时，确保文本正确：

C++
 |
void CDrawingBoardView::UpdateAllMenus()
{
    CMainFrame* pMainFrame = (CMainFrame*)AfxGetMainWnd();
    if (!pMainFrame) return;

    CMenu* pMenu = pMainFrame->GetMenu();
    if (!pMenu) return;

    // ============================================
    // 1. 更新顶级菜单
    // ============================================
    struct TopMenuInfo {
        int index;
        CString text;
    };

    TopMenuInfo topMenus[] = {
        {0, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(0)},  // 文件
        {1, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(1)},  // 编辑
        {2, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(2)},  // 工具
        {3, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(3)},  // 颜色
        {4, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(4)},  // 粗细
        {5, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(5)},  // 语言
        {6, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(6)},  // 视图
        {7, m_langManager.GetTopLevelMenuText(7)}   // 帮助
    };

    for (const auto& menu : topMenus)
    {
        if (!menu.text.IsEmpty())
        {
            MENUITEMINFO mii = { sizeof(MENUITEMINFO) };
            mii.fMask = MIIM_STRING;
            mii.dwTypeData = (LPTSTR)(LPCTSTR)menu.text;
            pMenu->SetMenuItemInfo(menu.index, &mii, TRUE);
        }
    }

    // ============================================
    // 2. 更新所有菜单项（包括有 ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI 的）
    // ============================================
    UINT allMenuIDs[] = {
        // 文件菜单
        ID_FILE_NEW, ID_FILE_OPEN, ID_FILE_SAVE, ID_FILE_SAVE_AS,
        ID_FILE_EXPORT_PNG, ID_APP_EXIT,
        
        // 编辑菜单
        ID_MY_UNDO, ID_MY_REDO, ID_EDIT_CLEAR_ALL,
        
        // 工具菜单
        ID_TOOL_PEN, ID_TOOL_LINE, ID_TOOL_RECTANGLE,
        ID_TOOL_ELLIPSE, ID_TOOL_ERASER,
        
        // 颜色菜单
        ID_COLOR_BLACK, ID_COLOR_RED, ID_COLOR_GREEN,
        ID_COLOR_BLUE, ID_COLOR_YELLOW,
        
        // 粗细菜单
        ID_SIZE_THIN, ID_SIZE_MEDIUM, ID_SIZE_THICK,
        
        // 语言菜单
        ID_LANGUAGE_CHINESE, ID_LANGUAGE_ENGLISH, ID_LANGUAGE_KOREAN,
        
        // 视图菜单
        ID_VIEW_TOOLBAR, ID_VIEW_STATUS_BAR,
        
        // 帮助菜单
        ID_APP_ABOUT
    };

    for (UINT id : allMenuIDs)
    {
        CString text = m_langManager.GetMenuText(id);
        if (!text.IsEmpty())
        {
            MENUITEMINFO mii = { sizeof(MENUITEMINFO) };
            mii.fMask = MIIM_STRING;
            mii.dwTypeData = (LPTSTR)(LPCTSTR)text;
            pMenu->SetMenuItemInfo(id, &mii, FALSE);
        }
    }

    // ✅ 强制重绘菜单
    pMainFrame->DrawMenuBar();
    
    // ✅ 强制更新所有命令 UI（关键！）
    pMainFrame->SendMessage(WM_IDLEUPDATECMDUI, (WPARAM)TRUE, 0);
}

📋 完整的语言切换函数
C++
 |
void CDrawingBoardView::OnLanguageChinese()
{
    m_langManager.SetLanguage(Language::CHINESE);
    UpdateAllMenus();  // 更新菜单文本
    
    // ✅ 强制刷新所有命令 UI
    CMainFrame* pMainFrame = (CMainFrame*)AfxGetMainWnd();
    if (pMainFrame)
    {
        pMainFrame->SendMessage(WM_IDLEUPDATECMDUI, (WPARAM)TRUE, 0);
    }

   ↓

   - 更新所有子菜单文本
   ↓

   - 触发所有 OnUpdateXXX() 函数
   ↓
6. OnUpdateMyUndo() 被调用
   - Enable(...)
   - SetText(新语言文本)  ← 在这里更新！
   ↓
7. 菜单显示新语言 ✅
🎯 总结
问题根本原因：

ON_UPDATE_COMMAND_UI 每次都会重置菜单文本为资源文件中的原始文本
必须在每个 OnUpdateXXX() 函数中同时更新文本
最佳解决方案：

✅ 在所有 OnUpdateXXX() 函数中调用 pCmdUI->SetText()
✅ 使用辅助函数 UpdateMenuText() 简化代码
✅ 语言切换后发送 WM_IDLEUPDATECMDUI 消息
按照上述方案修改后，所有菜单项（包括撤销/重做）都能正确切换语言了！🚀

    m_menuTexts[Language::CHINESE][32771] = _T("撤销\tCtrl+Z");  
    m_menuTexts[Language::ENGLISH][32771] = _T("Undo\tCtrl+Z");

    m_menuTexts[Language::CHINESE][ID_MY_UNDO] = _T("撤销\tCtrl+Z");
