C++
 |
#include "pch.h"
#include "CppUnitTest.h"
#include <vector>

// 如果需要 MFC 支持
#include <afxwin.h>

using namespace Microsoft::VisualStudio::CppUnitTestFramework;

// ========== 复制主项目的结构体定义 ==========

enum class ToolType
{
    PEN,
    LINE,
    RECTANGLE,
    ELLIPSE,
    ERASER
};

struct DrawCommand
{
    ToolType tool;
    COLORREF color;
    int penWidth;
    CPoint startPoint;
    CPoint endPoint;
    std::vector<CPoint> points;

    DrawCommand()
        : tool(ToolType::PEN)
        , color(RGB(0, 0, 0))
        , penWidth(1)
        , startPoint(0, 0)
        , endPoint(0, 0)
    {
    }

    DrawCommand(const DrawCommand& other)
        : tool(other.tool)
        , color(other.color)
        , penWidth(other.penWidth)
        , startPoint(other.startPoint)
        , endPoint(other.endPoint)
    {
        points.clear();
        for (size_t i = 0; i < other.points.size(); i++)
        {
            points.push_back(other.points[i]);
        }
    }

    DrawCommand& operator=(const DrawCommand& other)
    {
        if (this != &other)
        {
            tool = other.tool;
            color = other.color;
            penWidth = other.penWidth;
            startPoint = other.startPoint;
            endPoint = other.endPoint;

            points.clear();
            for (size_t i = 0; i < other.points.size(); i++)
            {
                points.push_back(other.points[i]);
            }
        }
        return *this;
    }
};

// ========== Google Test 测试用例 ==========

namespace DrawingBoardTests
{
    // 测试 1：默认构造函数
    TEST(DrawCommandTest, DefaultConstructor)
    {
        DrawCommand cmd;

        EXPECT_EQ(cmd.tool, ToolType::PEN);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd.color, RGB(0, 0, 0));
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd.penWidth, 1);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd.startPoint.x, 0);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd.startPoint.y, 0);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd.endPoint.x, 0);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd.endPoint.y, 0);
        EXPECT_TRUE(cmd.points.empty());
    }

    // 测试 2：拷贝构造函数（深拷贝验证）
    TEST(DrawCommandTest, CopyConstructorDeepCopy)
    {
        DrawCommand cmd1;
        cmd1.tool = ToolType::ELLIPSE;
        cmd1.color = RGB(255, 0, 0);
        cmd1.penWidth = 5;
        cmd1.startPoint = CPoint(10, 20);
        cmd1.endPoint = CPoint(100, 200);
        cmd1.points.push_back(CPoint(1, 2));
        cmd1.points.push_back(CPoint(3, 4));

        // 拷贝构造
        DrawCommand cmd2(cmd1);

        // 验证数据正确
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.tool, ToolType::ELLIPSE);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.color, RGB(255, 0, 0));
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.penWidth, 5);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.startPoint.x, 10);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.startPoint.y, 20);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.endPoint.x, 100);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.endPoint.y, 200);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.points.size(), 2u);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.points[0].x, 1);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.points[0].y, 2);

        // 🔑 关键：验证是深拷贝（修改 cmd1 不影响 cmd2）
        cmd1.points[0].x = 999;
        cmd1.startPoint.x = 888;

        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.points[0].x, 1);      // cmd2 的 points 不变
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.startPoint.x, 10);   // cmd2 的 startPoint 不变
    }

    // 测试 3：赋值操作符（深拷贝验证）
    TEST(DrawCommandTest, AssignmentOperatorDeepCopy)
    {
        DrawCommand cmd1;
        cmd1.tool = ToolType::RECTANGLE;
        cmd1.color = RGB(0, 255, 0);
        cmd1.points.push_back(CPoint(50, 60));
        cmd1.points.push_back(CPoint(70, 80));

        DrawCommand cmd2;
        cmd2 = cmd1;  // 赋值

        // 验证数据正确
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.tool, ToolType::RECTANGLE);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.color, RGB(0, 255, 0));
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.points.size(), 2u);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.points[0].x, 50);

        // 🔑 验证深拷贝
        cmd1.points[0].x = 777;
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.points[0].x, 50);  // cmd2 不变
    }

    // 测试 4：自赋值
    TEST(DrawCommandTest, SelfAssignment)
    {
        DrawCommand cmd;
        cmd.tool = ToolType::LINE;
        cmd.points.push_back(CPoint(1, 2));

        cmd = cmd;  // 自赋值

        EXPECT_EQ(cmd.tool, ToolType::LINE);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd.points.size(), 1u);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd.points[0].x, 1);
    }

    // 测试 5：vector 的深拷贝
    TEST(DrawCommandTest, VectorDeepCopy)
    {
        std::vector<DrawCommand> commands1;

        DrawCommand cmd;
        cmd.tool = ToolType::PEN;
        cmd.points.push_back(CPoint(10, 20));
        commands1.push_back(cmd);

        // 拷贝 vector
        std::vector<DrawCommand> commands2 = commands1;

        // 修改 commands1
        commands1[0].points[0].x = 999;

        // 🔑 验证 commands2 不受影响
        EXPECT_EQ(commands2[0].points[0].x, 10);
    }

    // 测试 6：模拟撤销/重做逻辑
    TEST(UndoRedoTest, BasicUndoRedo)
    {
        std::vector<DrawCommand> drawCommands;
        std::vector<DrawCommand> redoCommands;

        // 1. 添加第一个圆形命令
        DrawCommand cmd1;
        cmd1.tool = ToolType::ELLIPSE;
        cmd1.startPoint = CPoint(10, 10);
        cmd1.endPoint = CPoint(50, 50);
        drawCommands.push_back(cmd1);

        // 2. 添加第二个圆形命令
        DrawCommand cmd2;
        cmd2.tool = ToolType::ELLIPSE;
        cmd2.startPoint = CPoint(100, 100);
        cmd2.endPoint = CPoint(150, 150);
        drawCommands.push_back(cmd2);

        EXPECT_EQ(drawCommands.size(), 2u);

        // 3. 撤销（Undo）
        DrawCommand lastCmd = drawCommands.back();
        drawCommands.pop_back();
        redoCommands.push_back(lastCmd);

        EXPECT_EQ(drawCommands.size(), 1u);
        EXPECT_EQ(redoCommands.size(), 1u);
        EXPECT_EQ(redoCommands[0].startPoint.x, 100);

        // 4. 重做（Redo）
        DrawCommand redoCmd = redoCommands.back();
        redoCommands.pop_back();
        drawCommands.push_back(redoCmd);

        EXPECT_EQ(drawCommands.size(), 2u);
        EXPECT_EQ(redoCommands.size(), 0u);

        // 5. 🔑 验证数据完整性
        EXPECT_EQ(drawCommands[1].startPoint.x, 100);
        EXPECT_EQ(drawCommands[1].startPoint.y, 100);
        EXPECT_EQ(drawCommands[1].endPoint.x, 150);
        EXPECT_EQ(drawCommands[1].endPoint.y, 150);
    }

    // 测试 7：多次撤销重做
    TEST(UndoRedoTest, MultipleUndoRedo)
    {
        std::vector<DrawCommand> drawCommands;
        std::vector<DrawCommand> redoCommands;

        // 添加 5 个命令
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
        {
            DrawCommand cmd;
            cmd.tool = ToolType::ELLIPSE;
            cmd.startPoint = CPoint(i * 10, i * 10);
            cmd.endPoint = CPoint(i * 10 + 50, i * 10 + 50);
            drawCommands.push_back(cmd);
        }

        EXPECT_EQ(drawCommands.size(), 5u);

        // 撤销 3 次
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        {
            redoCommands.push_back(drawCommands.back());
            drawCommands.pop_back();
        }

        EXPECT_EQ(drawCommands.size(), 2u);
        EXPECT_EQ(redoCommands.size(), 3u);

        // 重做 2 次
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
        {
            drawCommands.push_back(redoCommands.back());
            redoCommands.pop_back();
        }

        EXPECT_EQ(drawCommands.size(), 4u);
        EXPECT_EQ(redoCommands.size(), 1u);

        // 🔑 验证顺序正确
        EXPECT_EQ(drawCommands[0].startPoint.x, 0);
        EXPECT_EQ(drawCommands[3].startPoint.x, 30);
    }

    // 测试 8：边界条件 - 空 points
    TEST(DrawCommandTest, EmptyPoints)
    {
        DrawCommand cmd;
        EXPECT_TRUE(cmd.points.empty());

        DrawCommand cmd2(cmd);
        EXPECT_TRUE(cmd2.points.empty());

        DrawCommand cmd3;
        cmd3 = cmd;
        EXPECT_TRUE(cmd3.points.empty());
    }

    // 测试 9：大量数据点
    TEST(DrawCommandTest, LargePointsArray)
    {
        DrawCommand cmd;

        // 添加 1000 个点
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++)
        {
            cmd.points.push_back(CPoint(i, i * 2));
        }

        DrawCommand cmd2(cmd);

        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.points.size(), 1000u);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.points[0].x, 0);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.points[999].x, 999);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.points[999].y, 1998);

        // 修改原始数据
        cmd.points[500].x = -1;

        // 🔑 验证拷贝不受影响
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.points[500].x, 500);
    }

    // 测试 10：撤销后新操作清空重做栈
    TEST(UndoRedoTest, NewOperationClearsRedoStack)
    {
        std::vector<DrawCommand> drawCommands;
        std::vector<DrawCommand> redoCommands;

        // 添加 3 个命令
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        {
            DrawCommand cmd;
            cmd.tool = ToolType::LINE;
            drawCommands.push_back(cmd);
        }

        // 撤销 2 次
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
        {
            redoCommands.push_back(drawCommands.back());
            drawCommands.pop_back();
        }

        EXPECT_EQ(drawCommands.size(), 1u);
        EXPECT_EQ(redoCommands.size(), 2u);

        // 添加新命令（模拟用户画了新图形）
        DrawCommand newCmd;
        newCmd.tool = ToolType::RECTANGLE;
        drawCommands.push_back(newCmd);

        // 🔑 应该清空重做栈
        redoCommands.clear();

        EXPECT_EQ(drawCommands.size(), 2u);
        EXPECT_EQ(redoCommands.size(), 0u);
    }

    // 测试 11：深拷贝辅助函数
    DrawCommand DeepCopyCommand(const DrawCommand& src)
    {
        DrawCommand dst;
        dst.tool = src.tool;
        dst.color = src.color;
        dst.penWidth = src.penWidth;
        dst.startPoint.x = src.startPoint.x;
        dst.startPoint.y = src.startPoint.y;
        dst.endPoint.x = src.endPoint.x;
        dst.endPoint.y = src.endPoint.y;

        dst.points.clear();
        dst.points.reserve(src.points.size());
        for (size_t i = 0; i < src.points.size(); i++)
        {
            CPoint pt(src.points[i].x, src.points[i].y);
            dst.points.push_back(pt);
        }

        return dst;
    }

    TEST(DeepCopyTest, DeepCopyFunction)
    {
        DrawCommand cmd1;
        cmd1.tool = ToolType::ELLIPSE;
        cmd1.color = RGB(100, 150, 200);
        cmd1.startPoint = CPoint(5, 10);
        cmd1.points.push_back(CPoint(5, 6));
        cmd1.points.push_back(CPoint(7, 8));

        DrawCommand cmd2 = DeepCopyCommand(cmd1);

        // 验证数据正确
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.tool, ToolType::ELLIPSE);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.color, RGB(100, 150, 200));
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.startPoint.x, 5);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.points.size(), 2u);

        // 🔑 修改 cmd1，验证 cmd2 不受影响
        cmd1.points[0].x = 999;
        cmd1.startPoint.x = 888;

        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.points[0].x, 5);
        EXPECT_EQ(cmd2.startPoint.x, 5);
    }

    // 测试 12：CPoint 的拷贝
    TEST(CPointTest, CPointCopy)
    {
        CPoint p1(10, 20);
        CPoint p2 = p1;

        EXPECT_EQ(p2.x, 10);
        EXPECT_EQ(p2.y, 20);

        // CPoint 是值类型，修改 p1 不影响 p2
        p1.x = 999;
        EXPECT_EQ(p2.x, 10);
    }
}

🎯 快速配置模板
如果手动配置太麻烦，可以直接编辑项目文件：

在 <PropertyGroup> 或 <ItemDefinitionGroup> 中添加：

Xml
 |
<ItemDefinitionGroup>
  <ClCompile>
    <AdditionalIncludeDirectories>$(SolutionDir)packages\Microsoft.googletest.v140.windesktop.msvcstl.static.rt-dyn.1.8.1.8\build\native\include;$(SolutionDir)DrawingBoard;%(AdditionalIncludeDirectories)</AdditionalIncludeDirectories>
    <PrecompiledHeader>Use</PrecompiledHeader>
    <PrecompiledHeaderFile>pch.h</PrecompiledHeaderFile>
    <RuntimeLibrary Condition="'$(Configuration)'=='Debug'">MultiThreadedDebugDLL</RuntimeLibrary>
    <RuntimeLibrary Condition="'$(Configuration)'=='Release'">MultiThreadedDLL</RuntimeLibrary>
  </ClCompile>
  <Link>
    <AdditionalLibraryDirectories>$(SolutionDir)packages\Microsoft.googletest.v140.windesktop.msvcstl.static.rt-dyn.1.8.1.8\build\native\lib\$(Platform)\v140\$(Configuration);%(AdditionalLibraryDirectories)</AdditionalLibraryDirectories>
    <AdditionalDependencies>gtest.lib;gtest_main.lib;%(AdditionalDependencies)</AdditionalDependencies>
  </Link>
</ItemDefinitionGroup>
